data.title: Data Engineering Manager
data.description:
As a Data Engineering Manager at Dyson, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and guiding a small team of data engineers within the Data and Analytics group. You will provide hands-on technical leadership in the Data domain, ensuring the team leverages a diverse set of Data technologies and remains adaptable to evolving requirements and industry trends. Your leadership will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to help prioritise projects and align data engineering initiatives with broader business objectives. You will be responsible for mentoring and developing your team, driving the delivery of robust, reliable data solutions that adhere to industry best practices. Additionally, you will actively contribute to technical design reviews, offering constructive feedback and ensuring high standards throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Your responsibilities will include designing, building, and optimising scalable data solutions for analytics, as well as establishing and maintaining efficient workflows and good practices across a global data engineering environment. You will champion clear documentation standards and lead efforts to enhance data quality, reliability, data lineage, and governance. Your expertise and guidance will support the professional growth of your team and the ongoing improvement of data engineering processes at Dyson. 

Key Competencies

- 8+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or related fields 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring data engineering teams 
 - Proven ability to manage and deliver complex data engineering projects through all stages 
 - Expertise in designing, developing and optimising data pipelines and solutions 
 - Advanced proficiency in one or more programming languages (e. g. , Python, SQL, DBT) 
 - Extensive experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) 
 - Strong knowledge of CI/CD, DataOps, and modern data engineering best practices

Strategic Leadership and Influence

You will take a central role in defining and executing data engineering strategy, actively shaping the vision and roadmap for data-driven initiatives across the organisation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, providing mentorship and direction to ensure successful project outcomes and alignment with business priorities. By instilling a culture of excellence in documentation, best practices, and workflow efficiency, you will drive continuous improvement and ensure the team remains at the forefront of emerging technologies. Your leadership will be instrumental in upholding and advancing the highest standards for data quality, reliability, and governance on a global scale. 

Technical Proficiencies

With over eight years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines, you possess a deep understanding of the end-to-end project lifecycle and a proven record of delivering complex data solutions. Your technical expertise encompasses the design, development, and optimisation of scalable data pipelines and analytics platforms. You are highly proficient in leading programming languages such as Python, SQL, and DBT, and bring substantial experience with major cloud environments, including AWS, GCP, or Azure. Your knowledge of CI/CD, DataOps, and modern data engineering best practices allows you to set technical direction, conduct thorough design reviews, and provide constructive feedback that ensures robust, reliable outcomes. As the technical authority for your team, you guide architectural decisions and champion innovation in data engineering solutions. 

Academic Credentials

You hold an advanced degree-Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD-in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, forming a strong academic basis for your senior expertise and leadership within the data domain. 

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don't think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

data.title: Senior Manager, AI Engineering
data.description:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE: RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. 

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration. 

, 

Purpose & Scope -

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that accelerate Ralph Lauren's transformation into an AI-enabled enterprise. This role combines strong technical leadership with hands-on execution to deliver production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and reusable engineering capabilities across the organization. This leader partners closely with AI Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Product, Security, Governance, and Business Technology teams to translate prioritized use cases into secure, scalable, and high-impact AI solutions built on Microsoft Azure and Databricks. 

The Role Is Responsible For

- Enterprise AI and agentic AI solution delivery 
 - Multi-agent orchestration and intelligent workflow automation 
 - LLMOps and MLOps engineering practices 
 - AI integration, observability, and operational excellence 
 - Responsible AI implementation and governance adherence 
 - Engineering team leadership and capability development

This leader is expected to drive engineering excellence while enabling rapid experimentation, innovation, and scalable AI adoption across business functions. 

, 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

AI Solution Delivery

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions aligned with business priorities. 
 - Translate prioritized AI use cases into scalable, production-ready applications and services. 
 - Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define solution requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Drive disciplined execution across prototyping, engineering, testing, deployment, and production support. 

Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

- Design and implement agentic AI solutions using Azure AI services, Databricks, vector platforms, orchestration frameworks, and modern LLM ecosystems. 
 - Build and maintain multi-agent workflows, orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation solutions. 
 - Develop reusable patterns for memory management, tool usage, reasoning workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, and enterprise action execution. 
 - Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies based on business value, risk, and engineering fit. 

AI Platform Engineering

- Contribute to enterprise AI platforms, reusable services, SDKs, templates, and engineering accelerators. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and shared AI capabilities supporting multiple business use cases. 
 - Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready data foundations and scalable access patterns in Azure and Databricks. 
 - Support technical decisions related to AI services, inference, model deployment, infrastructure, and integrations. 

Engineering Excellence & Operations

- Establish and promote standards for CI/CD, testing, release management, monitoring, and operational support. 
 - Implement LLMOps and MLOps practices including evaluation, prompt management, experimentation, telemetry, and runtime optimization. 
 - Lead production-readiness reviews for reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency. 
 - Monitor performance and drive continuous improvement through operational analytics. 

Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI standards. 
 - Partner with Security and Governance teams to implement guardrails, auditability, policy enforcement, and risk controls. 
 - Support observability frameworks including telemetry, evaluation, performance tracking, and drift detection. 

Team Leadership & Talent Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers and technical specialists. 
 - Provide technical coaching and hands-on guidance throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, engineering rigor, and continuous learning. 
 - Support recruiting, onboarding, performance enablement, and career development. 
 - Drive collaboration across strategy, architecture, data, infrastructure, product, and business teams. 

, 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or data engineering, including technical leadership responsibility. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that deliver AI or machine learning solutions. 
 - Proven experience developing and deploying production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and intelligent automation solutions. 
 - Strong hands-on engineering skills with the ability to architect, prototype, review, and troubleshoot AI systems. 
 - Deep experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, API Management, and cloud-native engineering patterns. 
 - Strong experience with Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, AI/ML pipelines, vector search, and scalable data processing. 
 - Experience building RAG solutions, vector database integrations, memory architectures, and enterprise knowledge-retrieval systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of LLMOps and MLOps, including deployment, prompt management, evaluation, observability, experimentation, governance, and runtime optimization. 
 - Experience with API-first architecture, microservices, event-driven systems, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and business teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience delivering agentic AI and multi-agent solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate, and adopt emerging AI technologies and practices. 
 - Experience building reusable engineering frameworks, accelerators, and shared AI services. 
 - Familiarity with AI-native commerce and Agentic Commerce ecosystems, including UCP, ACP, and autonomous transaction orchestration patterns. 
 - Experience in retail, luxury retail, eCommerce, or digital commerce environments. 
 - Relevant Azure, Databricks, cloud engineering, or AI/ML certifications.

data.description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We've learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members-including HR and leadership-via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. 

What To Know

- Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text. 
 - We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day. 
 - Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee. 

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault. com

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks - keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company's unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100, 000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

Senior Engineer- C++

The Opportunity

We have an outstanding career opportunity for Senior Engineer- C++ at Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune locations. In this role you will build scalable, high-performance enterprise software. 

What You'll Do. . . 

- Design, develop, and maintain core components in a distributed storage platform. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Debug complex production issues and improve system performance. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and conduct code reviews. 
 - Drive innovation while maintaining product quality and reliability. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric solutions. 

Who You Are. . . 

- Bachelor's degree required. 
 - 4 or more years of software development experience
 - Strong experience in C++ Object oriented programming. 
 - Good understanding of Linux and Windows internals, including process, memory, storage, and networking concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience with debugging and troubleshooting tools such as gdb, WinDbg, ProcMon, Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar. 
 - Proven experience with crash dump analysis, memory leaks, handle leaks, deadlocks, race conditions, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong experience working with systems involving micro-services & service architecture, client-server architecture, and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, and Design Patterns. 
 - Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software development best practices. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a strong sense of ownership. 
 - Security and SaaS experience strongly preferred. 

You'll Love Working Here Because

- Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
 - Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
 - Annual health check-ups, Car lease Program, and Tuition Reimbursement
 - An inclusive company culture, an opportunity to join our Community Guilds
 - Personal accident cover and Term life cover

Ready to #makeyourmark at Commvault? Apply now!

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work. 

Commvault's goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault. com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault. com. 

Commvault's Privacy Policy

data.title: Software Development Engineer II - Frontend
data.description:
About HighLevel: 

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes. 

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. 

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our People

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts . 

About Commerce & Payments Team: 

The Commerce & Payments team is a newly formed organization to add HighLevel's evolving capabilities and make it both a Commerce Platform and a surface where our customers can perform their sales motions for their products. Building Catalogs, subscriptions, fulfillment , payment processing engines, inventory mgmt, pricing, documents/contracts and more to enable our SMBs to increase their revenue will be the core focus of the org. Hardly any tech debt, mostly green field work working closely with product folks to build, ship and refine our Commerce offerings makes this an exciting place to learn, engage and thrive. 

About the Role: 

We're building a global commerce platform to power $1T+ in annual transactions for millions of SMEs. As an SDE II on the frontend, you'll build the surfaces that customers and their buyers touch: storefronts, checkout, catalog, subscription management, invoices and contracts. 

These surfaces carry money. They get embedded inside other people's experiences. They run on slow phones and flaky networks in 150+ countries. A layout shift shows up in someone's conversion rate, and a 300ms regression shows up in someone's revenue. 

This role is for engineers who obsess over frontend craft and have the depth to back it up. If you already know why your bundle is that size, where your hydration cost goes, and what your service worker does on a cache miss, we want to talk to you. 

Responsibilities: 

- Build and ship the commerce surfaces: storefronts, checkout, catalog, subscription management, invoices and documents
 - Embed our experiences inside other experiences - module federation, iframes and white-label hosts that stay isolated, load fast and degrade gracefully
 - Own performance budgets end to end: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, render cost, hydration, main-thread work. Measure them in CI and defend them
 - Build installable, offline-tolerant PWAs with service workers, considered caching strategies and background sync
 - Deliver WCAG 2. 2 AA accessibility and full localisation across languages, currencies, tax and address formats, and RTL layouts
 - Instrument the client with real-user monitoring and OpenTelemetry so regressions surface before customers report them
 - Collaborate with PM/Design and mentor junior engineers

Requirements: 

- 2+ years building and operating production frontend applications
 - Deep Vue. js knowledge: the reactivity model, component composition, rendering behaviour, and the runtime cost of each choice
 - A visible performance habit. You live in Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools and the performance profiler, and you can walk us through a regression you found, measured and fixed
 - Service workers and caching strategy: precaching, runtime caching, versioning, invalidation, and offline behaviour that stays correct
 - Client state management and local caching at scale (TanStack Query or equivalent): cache keys, staleness, invalidation, optimistic updates
 - Accessibility as a build-time discipline: semantics, focus management, keyboard paths, screen reader behaviour, WCAG 2. 2 AA
 - Internationalisation and localisation: message extraction, plurals, locale-aware currency and date formatting, RTL
 - Modern frontend tooling and module federation (Rspack, Vite), plus bundle analysis and code splitting
 - An eye for craft. You notice the four-pixel misalignment, the janky scroll, and the layout shift that only appears on a throttled connection, and you fix all three
 - Comfortable consuming typed backend contracts (ConnectRPC/protobuf) and reasoning about API contracts and error states
 - Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills

Tech Stack: 

Frontend: Vue. js, Rspack, Module Federation, TanStack Query

Client platform: Service workers/PWA, OpenTelemetry, Vite, ESLint

Backend contracts: Go, ConnectRPC, Buf

Cloud: GCP (GKE), Pub/Sub

EEO Statement: 

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision. 

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

IBM Systems helps IT leaders think differently about their infrastructure. IBM servers and storage are no longer inanimate - they can understand, reason, and learn so our clients can innovate while avoiding IT issues. Our systems power the world's most important industries and our clients are the architects of the future. Join us to help build our leading-edge technology portfolio designed for cognitive business and optimized for cloud computing. 

Wonder if IBM is the one for you? : 

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better. 

Being an IBMer means you'll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you'll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment everyday, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background. 

Our IBMers are growth minded, always staying curious, open to feedback and learning new information and skills to constantly transform themselves and our company. IBM's greatest invention is the IBMer. We believe that through the application of intelligence, reason and science, we can improve business, society and the human condition, bringing the power of an open hybrid cloud and AI strategy to life for our clients and partners around the world. 

Restlessly reinventing since 1911, we are not only one of the largest corporate organizations in the world, we're also one of the biggest technology and consulting employers, with many of the Fortune 50 companies relying on the IBM Cloud to run their business. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Your Role and Responsibilities

As a Back-End Developer for Systems, you will design and develop offering solutions using the latest technologies. You will work on developing software, including open-source software, and driving community best practices in IBM processes. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Demonstrate experience of validation and verification for High Availability/Disaster Recovery products. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency in C/C++, alongside strong scripting capabilities in Python, Perl or Bash. Hands-on experience using deep diagnostic and debugging utilities (gdb/dbx) or platform-specific tools like nmon, topas, perfpmr, and trace. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency with benchmarking utilities (fio, iperf, custom load generators) and data analysis pipelines. 
 - Design Software: Designs, develops, tests, and delivers software, including open source software, working effectively with open source communities for Systems. 
 - Deliver Open Source Software: Works effectively with open source communities for Systems, driving community best practices in IBM processes. 

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- 7+ years of total IT experience, with 6+ years focused on validating and verifying High Availability/Disaster Recovery products. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency in C/C++, alongside strong scripting capabilities in Python, Perl or Bash. Hands-on experience using deep diagnostic and debugging utilities (gdb/dbx) or platform-specific tools like nmon, topas, perfpmr, and trace. 
 - Demonstrate proficiency with benchmarking utilities (fio, iperf, custom load generators) and data analysis pipelines. 
 - Design Software: Designs, develops, tests, and delivers software, including open source software, working effectively with open source communities for Systems. 
 - Deliver Open Source Software: Works effectively with open source communities for Systems, driving community best practices in IBM processes. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Prior Operating System development experience in UNIX (HP UX, Solaris, AIX) or Linux Operating systems. 

- Skills on unit testing, scripting and automation. 
 - Agile process knowledge
 - Experience on tools like Jenkins, Git/GitHub, Gerrit or other equivalent tools. 
 - Should have good knowledge of unit testing.

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Cost & Engineering Efficiency

Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Hybrid)

Summary Of Role

Sumo Logic's microservices architecture, hosted on AWS, ingests petabytes of data daily across many geographic regions in support of our planet-scale observability and security products, serving hundreds of millions of queries a day against thousands of petabytes of data. At that scale, every inefficiency - in code, architecture, or infrastructure - compounds into real cost. 

This role sits within the Product SRE organization, working alongside your global SRE team on your product area's reliability roadmap - with a mandate that leads with code as much as operations. You'll find where Sumo's systems are spending more compute, storage, or engineering time than necessary, and fix it in the code and architecture, not just the infra config, while also carrying the fuller SRE mandate - reliability, security posture, and improving the day-to-day experience of the engineers within your product area. You'll be part of a team that blends SRE and backend software engineering skillsets, partnering closely with product engineering teams across your product area. 

This is an engineering role - the work is about shipping code, architecture, and system-level changes that improve unit economics, not managing cost dashboards, tagging, or reserved-instance/savings-plan purchasing. 

What You'll Do

- Continuously discover cost and efficiency opportunities through production profiling, telemetry, cost data, capacity trends, and system-level analysis - across algorithmic inefficiencies, resource-heavy code paths, and architectural decisions - and turn ambiguous problems into prioritized engineering initiatives. 
 - Apply performance and capacity engineering techniques to understand CPU, memory, storage, network, and I/O behavior under real production workloads, and optimize the resulting resource footprint. 
 - Write production-grade code to implement the optimizations you identify - JVM/GC tuning, algorithmic and resource-efficiency improvements, re-architecting inefficient services - in systems that process petabytes of data daily. 
 - Define and track engineering efficiency metrics such as cost per GB ingested, cost per query, cost per event, resource utilization, or cost per customer workload, and translate the work into measurable impact for engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement - influencing teams where you don't have direct ownership - and help establish engineering patterns and practices that make cost and efficiency a continuous part of the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with engineering teams in your product area to prioritize changes, and with developer infrastructure and Global SRE to align with the broader reliability roadmap. 
 - Participate in the SRE responsibilities for different product areas - SLOs, on-call, incident response, and blameless RCA - using those experiences to identify systemic reliability, performance, and efficiency improvements. 

What You'll Have

- B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience with a demonstrated track record of ownership. 
 - Strong CS fundamentals - comfortable with algorithmic complexity, data-structure performance characteristics, and system design at scale. 
 - Ability to author production-ready code in at least one OO/systems language (Java, Scala, Go, C++, or similar) - depth of engineering ability matters more than which language. 
 - Experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of independently identifying ambiguous performance, scalability, or cost problems and driving engineering changes that produced measurable improvements in production. 
 - Strong ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior, capacity, performance, and cost, and use production data to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes. 
 - Working fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS compute, storage, networking) - enough to reason about cost and architectural tradeoffs. 
 - Comfort moving across the stack, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on, to find root causes of inefficiency. 

Nice to have

- JVM tuning and GC optimization experience at scale. 
 - Exposure to cost-attribution/FinOps practices or tooling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or modern CI/CD tooling. 
 - Prior SRE experience - on-call, SLOs, incident response. 
 - Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kafka Streams) or observability/security platforms. 

Why this role

- Visibility - Cost/efficiency work maps directly to metrics the business already tracks. 
 - Scope you define - you identify where the opportunities are rather than executing a fixed backlog. 
 - Real scale - systems ingesting petabytes of data daily and serving hundreds of millions of queries. 

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www. sumologic. com. 

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

What you'll bring

 - DevOps & Infrastructure Automation: Strong experience in Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/GKE, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, automated testing, and infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Product & Platform Mindset: Demonstrated success in building shared platforms, establishing self-service capabilities, managing engineering roadmaps, and delivering scalable enterprise solutions. 
 - Leadership & Mentorship: Proven ability to lead engineering squads, mentor team members, influence technical direction, and collaborate effectively across distributed global teams. 
 - Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification is mandatory. 

What you'll experience

ASM Auto Group develops safety-compliant automotive MCUs for EV, HEV, traction inverters, onboard chargers, BMS, and body and chassis control. We are seeking an experienced AVV technical leader with 5+ years of pre-silicon and post-silicon functional validation experience to own subsystem-level validation strategy for automotive MCUs. You will define functional validation methodology, lead complex root-cause investigations, drive functional bring-up on silicon, and make evidence-based silicon readiness recommendations. You will work as a technical peer with Architecture, Design, RTL Verification, and Firmware teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own functional validation strategy and sign-off for complex subsystems (e. g. , Ethernet MAC, functional safety, clock/reset/power, multicore interactions)
 - Define requirements-to-test traceability, functional coverage closure criteria, and sign-off readiness
 - Architect reusable validation frameworks spanning emulation platforms and silicon test environments
 - Lead first-silicon functional bring-up and silicon functional test execution
 - Lead complex root-cause analysis across firmware, RTL, emulation models, and silicon
 - Validate cross-peripheral interactions with DMA, interrupts, clock switching, and low-power transitions
 - Lead fault-injection campaigns and functional safety validation evidence (ISO 26262)
 - Define pre-silicon to post-silicon correlation and test reuse strategy
 - Architect and maintain automation and CI/CD-integrated regression infrastructure
 - Define and own performance and benchmarking strategy, including throughput, latency, and timing-margin target. 
 - Lead resolution of customer-reported issues through reproduction and root-cause analysis
 - Define fix or workaround recommendations for customers and drive them to closure
 - Lead validation reviews and provide sign-off recommendations
 - Mentor engineers and drive continuous improvement in methodology and tooling

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 5+ years of engineering experience working with silicon design and/or validation
 - Experience with digital/embedded design on emulation/FPGA platforms/RTL simulation

Preferred Qualifications

- Work experience with ARM architecture
 - Advanced embedded C and firmware architecture knowledge
 - MCU/SoC architecture understanding (multicore, coherency, boot, power domains)
 - Expert-level peripheral validation, including complex interactions and error recovery

Leveraging advanced Linux administration, Ansible, Terraform, and CI/CD practices, you will improve platform consistency, operational resilience, and security at scale. You will also drive automation initiatives that streamline patching, standardize system configurations, and strengthen production readiness across complex environments. Working closely with security, infrastructure, and application teams, you will troubleshoot critical issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced platform engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, modernizing operational practices, and building secure, scalable systems in an enterprise environment. 

Accountabilities

- Design, build, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise UNIX/Linux platforms throughout their lifecycle, from server provisioning and configuration to production readiness, maintenance, and retirement. 
 - Lead Linux vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance validation, and audit readiness across large-scale enterprise environments. 
 - Plan and execute operating system patching, kernel updates, platform upgrades, and fleet maintenance, using controlled rollouts, canary deployments, and reliable rollback procedures. 
 - Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code tools to improve operational efficiency and consistency. 
 - Manage Linux workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including server provisioning, bootstrap processes, platform images, private repositories, and lifecycle management. 
 - Build and maintain standardized, secure Linux images using Packer or AWS Image Builder, integrating security controls and automated configuration management into golden-image workflows. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, primarily with GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms, to automate patching, security hardening, compliance checks, and governed operational procedures. 
 - Implement and maintain CIS benchmark compliance using Ansible Lockdown, investigate failed controls, remediate configuration gaps, and manage documented policy waivers with appropriate business justification and variable mapping. 
 - Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, including Qualys vulnerability QIDs associated with CVEs and packages, as well as CIS compliance CIDs. 
 - Integrate security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, and StackHawk into CI/CD workflows where applicable. 
 - Improve platform reliability through monitoring, diagnostics, automated remediation, self-healing capabilities, and observability enhancements. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex operating system, networking, storage, authentication, and performance issues, leading root-cause analysis and implementing preventive measures. 
 - Manage secure access mechanisms, including SSH, sudo, Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), certificates, and privileged access controls. 
 - Support incident, problem, and change management processes, production operations, and on-call response to maintain service availability and operational stability. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, log analysis, scripting, root-cause investigations, documentation, and automation development. 
 - Maintain platform standards, technical documentation, operational runbooks, and reusable automation patterns while collaborating with security, infrastructure, and application teams to continuously improve platform services. 

Requirements

- At least 7 years of hands-on experience in platform engineering, including substantial experience administering and operating enterprise Linux environments. 
 - Expert-level Linux administration skills across RHEL 8/9, Ubuntu 22. 04/24. 04, and Amazon Linux 2/2023, including kernel and security patching, package management, service administration, user and permission management, SSH configuration, logging, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Practical experience with controlled patch deployments, canary rollouts, rollback procedures, and Linux lifecycle management, including tools such as dnf history. 
 - Strong knowledge of CIS security benchmarks and experience applying them through Ansible Lockdown, remediating failed controls, and managing documented policy exceptions with business justification and corresponding Ansible variable mappings. 
 - Advanced Ansible skills for configuration management, automated patching, security hardening, and platform provisioning. 
 - Experience integrating security hardening into golden images and onboarding third-party Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), including bootstrap configuration, automation keys, domain joining, and agent installation. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience managing Linux workloads across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, including EC2, user data, bootstrap automation, and private package repositories. 
 - Strong Terraform and Ansible expertise, along with practical experience building standardized Linux images using Packer or AWS Image Builder. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable tools, including workflows for patching, compliance validation, and controlled operational execution. 
 - Proven ability to remediate Qualys vulnerability QIDs involving CVEs and packages, address CIS compliance CIDs, and work with security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, and StackHawk. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering automated platform solutions, including large-scale vulnerability remediation, compliance diagnostics, policy-waiver registers, and repository or mirror troubleshooting. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose complex operating system, networking, storage, authentication, and performance issues and lead effective root-cause analysis. 
 - Solid understanding of secure access management, including SSH, sudo, PAM, certificates, and privileged access controls. 
 - Familiarity with incident management, problem management, change management, production support, and on-call operational practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve troubleshooting, scripting, log analysis, documentation, root-cause analysis, and automation workflows. 
 - Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate across infrastructure, security, and application engineering teams. 
 - AWS certifications or additional working knowledge of Azure and Google Cloud are advantageous. 
 - Experience with immutable infrastructure, autoscaling, observability, monitoring, GitOps, and progressive delivery is desirable. 
 - Familiarity with mixed Windows/Linux environments and IT operations, including DNS, load balancers, reverse proxies, Microsoft Active Directory, and Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), is a plus. 

Benefits

- Remote working: Opportunity to work remotely from India, subject to the applicable working arrangements. 
 - Full-time employment: A full-time opportunity to contribute to enterprise platform engineering initiatives. 
 - Competitive compensation: Salary aligned with experience, technical expertise, and the overall employment package.

 - Modern technology stack: Hands-on exposure to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, security tooling, and AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Technical ownership: Lead impactful platform improvements and influence infrastructure standards, automation strategies, and security practices. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration: Work with infrastructure, security, and application engineering teams on complex enterprise challenges. 
 - Continuous learning: Develop skills in cloud platforms, compliance automation, immutable infrastructure, observability, and progressive delivery.

data.description:
Role Description

The Identity Governance Administration Automation Engineer is responsible for administering, automating, and continuously improving the enterprise's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environment, with a focus on Saviynt. This role ensures that access certification, provisioning, and entitlement management processes are secure, auditable, and efficient across the enterprise and its Operating Companies (OpCos). 

This role acts as both a platform administrator and an automation engineer, building and maintaining workflows that connect Saviynt to enterprise identity sources, target applications, and downstream systems. The engineer partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Audit teams to ensure identity lifecycle events - joiner, mover, leaver, and access certification - are governed, automated, and evidenced consistently across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 

The role is hands‐on and execution‐focused while embracing the Ralliant Business System (RBS) by embedding operational discipline, staff training, and continuous improvement into tools, workflows, and standard work so endpoint management is scalable, measurable, and repeatable. The role operates in service to the enterprise and operating companies, ensuring standardized identity governance practices while adapting to regional and business-specific needs. 

Key Responsibilities

- Administer and support the Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform, including application onboarding, connector configuration, and control library management. 
 - Design, build, and maintain automated identity lifecycle workflows (joiner, mover, leaver) across Active Directory, cloud directories, and business applications. 
 - Configure and enforce access certification campaigns, segregation of duties (SoD) controls, and role-based access (RBAC) policies to manage least-privilege access at scale. 
 - Develop and maintain Saviynt connectors and integrations using REST APIs, SCIM, and native connector frameworks to onboard new applications and OpCo environments. 
 - Develop PowerShell, Python, and REST API scripts and workflows to automate provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement reconciliation tasks. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve provisioning, reconciliation, and workflow failures, including connector errors, data mismatches, and approval routing issues. 
 - Support authentication and authorization integrations across Active Directory/LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2. 0, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and Single Sign-On (SSO) to ensure accurate identity data flows into governance processes. 
 - Monitor and analyze Saviynt, system, and integration logs, supporting SIEM integration, performance monitoring, and incident response for governance-related events. 
 - Apply identity governance best practices and support compliance with frameworks such as SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST, and ISO 27001, including audit evidence generation and reporting. 
 - Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Audit teams to integrate identity governance solutions across enterprise and OpCo environments. 
 - Document procedures, configurations, and control workflows, and train end users and control owners on certification and access request processes. 
 - Continuously improve governance workflows and dashboards, applying RBS principles to drive measurable reductions in manual effort and audit findings. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree recommended; equivalent experience considered. 
 - 10+ years of experience in identity governance, identity and access management, or systems administration, with 5+ years hands-on experience with Saviynt (Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud or Saviynt IGA) or relevant experience. 
 - Strong understanding of identity governance architecture, including access certification, role mining, SoD controls, and entitlement management. 
 - Proficiency in REST APIs, SCIM, and connector development for onboarding applications into an IGA platform, across on-premises and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Experience with Active Directory/LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2. 0, MFA, and SSO as identity sources feeding governance and provisioning workflows. 
 - Scripting experience in PowerShell and Python, with working knowledge of REST APIs and Saviynt SDKs/APIs. 
 - Working knowledge of JSON, including reading, structuring, and troubleshooting JSON payloads for connector configurations, API requests, and workflow integrations. 
 - Experience with log analysis and SIEM integration, incident response, and root cause analysis for governance and provisioning issues. 
 - Knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST, ISO 27001) and zero trust security principles. 
 - Saviynt certification preferred; cloud platform or security certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CISM, Security+) a plus. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, control owners, and auditors. 
 - Ability to operate effectively across enterprise and OpCo environments, balancing global consistency with local context across multiple time zones and culture. 
 - Alignment with Ralliant values and the Ralliant Business System (RBS), including continuous improvement, transparency, and ownership. 

Ralliant Corporation Overview

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life - faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. Platform Architect, ServiceNow Platform

Job Description

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Platform Architect for ServiceNow to lead complex, cross-functional technology programs within the Corporate Applications Technology business unit under Global Engineering, specifically driving the ServiceNow platform capabilities. This role will be responsible for the overall technical vision, architecture, and integrity of our ServiceNow platform. This role will work closely with Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect, IT leadership, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to ensure our ServiceNow instance is reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. You will set technical standards, lead platform governance, and design solutions that meet complex business requirements while maintaining compliance with industry regulations. 

Experience Range: 15+ years Role Level: Principal, Arch Solutions

Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Define and evolve the ServiceNow platform architecture with the Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect, aligning technical decisions with enterprise architecture, technology strategy, and business objectives. 
 - Translate complex requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions, establishing reusable architectural patterns across applications, data, integrations, security, and automation. 
 - Provide architectural guidance across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, IRM, SecOps, HRSD, DevOps, and custom applications. 

Platform Modernization & Innovation

- Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, features, products, and capabilities, recommending adoption based on business value, architectural fit, and risk. 
 - Provide architectural leadership for platform upgrades and modernization, increasing adoption of strategic and native capabilities while reducing legacy customization. 
 - Stay current with ServiceNow innovation and industry trends, contributing to the platform technology roadmap and its ongoing evolution. 

Architecture Governance & Engineering Standards

- Define and enforce architecture principles, technical standards, design patterns, and engineering guardrails through architecture and design reviews. 
 - Champion configuration-first and out-of-the-box approaches, reducing unnecessary customization, technical debt, complexity, and architectural risk. 
 - Promote consistent engineering practices and provide architectural guidance to internal teams and implementation partners. 

Solution & Integration Architecture

- Design ServiceNow solutions for complex business requirements while maintaining platform integrity, scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Define architecture for enterprise integrations, APIs, MID Servers, data flows, and automation, establishing reusable patterns that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. 

Security, Risk & Compliance

- Partner with Information Security, Risk, Privacy, and Compliance teams to embed security, privacy, resiliency, auditability, and regulatory requirements into platform architecture. 
 - Assess security and architectural implications of new applications, integrations, plugins, and capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and security standards. 

Reliability, Scalability & Performance

- Ensure platform architecture supports enterprise requirements for availability, reliability, scalability, performance, and recoverability. 
 - Provide architectural direction for complex platform, integration, and performance challenges. 
 - Partner with engineering and operations teams to continuously improve platform health, resilience, and maintainability. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor, working closely with the Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect and Platform Engineering Leads to maintain a cohesive enterprise-wide architectural direction. 
 - Collaborate across Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Infrastructure, Product Management, Engineering, and business teams. 
 - Guide technical teams and clearly communicate architecture decisions, options, risks, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of IT experience, including significant ServiceNow architecture, engineering, or solution design experience. 
 - 5+ years as a ServiceNow Architect in a large enterprise environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, configuration, application development, integrations, data, and security. 
 - Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Experience establishing architecture standards, design patterns, governance, and engineering guardrails. 
 - Strong understanding of ITSM/ITIL, security, privacy, risk, and enterprise technology practices. 
 - Ability to translate complex business needs into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions. 
 - Strong communication and influencing skills across technology and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in financial services or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience across ServiceNow products such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, IRM, SecOps, HRSD, and DevOps. 
 - Experience with enterprise-scale ServiceNow modernization or transformation. 
 - ServiceNow CSA certification; CIS, CAD, or CTA certifications preferred. 

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs. com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with. 

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3, 000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe. 

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10, 000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 - Leading AI-driven development: testing agentic AI platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, hands-on with our own code; recommending one; and making it a daily practice, with rules for use, review of generated code, and automated quality and compliance checks. 
 - Allocating and growing the team: deciding who works on what across competing demand, removing single points of knowledge, coaching developers, and setting practical clean core rules for S/4HANA.

You will join a small, hands-on expert team where everyone builds, and everyone supports. AI is expected here, not merely tolerated. Done means in use by the business, not just transported, and an honest "I don't know yet" is welcome. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- You have 12+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with deep, current ABAP experience in ECC, and you still write code and can show recent work.

 - You have established skills in defining and enforcing development standards that others followed, including rules for AI-generated code, and in leading developers technically. 
 - You are passionate about getting things done through people you don't manage, and about keeping quality and security controls intact while moving fast. 
 - You are at ease communicating in English, verbally and in writing.

You will work hands-on with the newest agentic AI tools for SAP development and decide how a whole team uses them. You will shape the team's standards and tooling from the start, keep building rather than just reviewing, and see your decisions applied across the ERP landscape as we move to S/4HANA.

data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tech Lead
data.description:
Summary

Join Guidewire's Product Development & Operations (PDO) organization as a cornerstone of our Site Reliability Engineering team. We are the architects of stability for the Guidewire Cloud Platform, ensuring the world's leading P&C insurers can depend on our mission-critical applications. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tech Lead you aren't just maintaining systems; you are defining the technical vision for how we operate at scale, automating the complex, and leading a high-performing "pod" of engineers to deliver a resilient, self-healing cloud ecosystem. 

The Role

This is a dual-accountability leadership role. You will act as a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (P5)-providing deep technical expertise and cross-team architectural influence-and as a Tech Lead, where you will serve as the technical engine for your pod. You will bridge the gap between long-term reliability strategy and the daily execution of your team, ensuring that our applications are not only stable but also evolving through elite software engineering practices. 

Job Description

What You'll Do

- Technical Leadership: Serve as the primary technical authority for your SRE pod. You will own the technical design for pod deliverables, oversee production deployments, and act as the final point of escalation for complex technical impediments. 
 - Architectural Influence: Design and implement systemic improvements to our AWS and Kubernetes-based environments. You won't just fix incidents; you will lead the creation of frameworks that prevent them across the entire organization. 
 - Drive Engineering Excellence: Protect the pod's sprint goals by breaking down high-level requirements into actionable technical tasks. Lead by example through hands-on coding (AI, Python, Go, or Java), rigorous code reviews, and the promotion of "Clean Code" and testing standards. Triage and assign work. 
 - Toil Elimination & Automation: Champion the transition from manual operations to "Operations as Code. " You will lead the development of automated runbooks, self-healing systems, and advanced CI/CD pipelines (Terraform, GitOps) to reduce operational friction. 
 - Mentorship & Growth: Actively coach and mentor P1-P5 engineers. You are responsible for raising the "technical bar" of the team, fostering a culture of curiosity, and ensuring the professional growth of your peers through constructive feedback. 
 - Incident Management & Post-mortems: Lead the response to high-severity incidents. You will facilitate blameless post-mortems that go beyond "human error" to identify deep architectural weaknesses, ensuring Guidewire learns and hardens its systems after every event. 
 - AI & Innovation: Proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML and data-driven insights into our observability stack (Datadog/Resolve) to move from reactive monitoring to predictive reliability. 
 - Production Stewardship & On-Call Excellence: Participate in and provide technical oversight for a 24x7 on-call rotation. As a P5 Tech Lead, you will act as a high-level escalation point for complex production incidents, ensuring rapid restoration of service while driving the "blameless" culture and post-incident analysis required to eliminate recurring issues. 

What You'll Bring

- Deep Technical Mastery: 10+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or Software Engineering, with at least 3+ years in a Staff-level, Technical Lead, Manager or Sr. Manager capacity. 
 - Cloud Native Expert: Expert-level command of AWS ecosystem and Kubernetes (EKS) orchestration. You should have a proven track record of managing large-scale, distributed cloud environments. 
 - Automation Specialist: Advanced proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible/Puppet) within a GitOps framework. 
 - Software Engineering Acumen: Strong software engineering foundation with the ability to write production-grade code in languages like Python, Go, or Java or with tools such as Claude Code, CodeEx or CoPilot. 
 - Observability Visionary: Deep experience building comprehensive monitoring, SLIs/SLOs, and tracing strategies using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or Splunk. 
 - Leadership Mindset: Proven ability to manage "up and out"-communicating technical risks to stakeholders and collaborating with Product and Engineering managers to align reliability goals with feature delivery. 
 - Operational Discipline: Experience managing on-call rotations and a "safety-first" mindset. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any product. 

Your Impact

- In your first 90 days: You will take full ownership of your pod's technical roadmap, identifying "low-hanging fruit" for automation and establishing yourself as the go-to technical resource for your team. 
 - In your first 6 months: You will have successfully led a major cross-pod initiative-such as a significant application migration/upgrade, a new observability standard, or a breakthrough in deployment velocity-measurable by a decrease in MTTR and an increase in system uptime. 
 - Long term: You will shape the future of SRE at Guidewire, influencing our global cloud strategy and building a legacy of engineering excellence that enables our customers to transform the insurance industry. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. 

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. 

For more information, please visit www. guidewire. com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC. 

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position. 

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. data.title: SDET - Automation Testing
data.description:
Primary Technologies

- Test Automation: Playwright, Selenium WebDriver
 - Languages: TypeScript, Python, or C# (. NET)
 - API Testing: REST beyond basics: request chaining, payload validation, authentication
 - Data: Strong SQL for application databases, data validation, and test data setup
 - AI in QA: Hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar); prompt engineering
 - Test Management: Azure Test Plans
 - BDD (Optional): Cucumber, Gherkin, structured step definitions
 - CI/CD (Good to Have): Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Basic working knowledge is enough. 
 - ETL (Good to Have): Basic understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines
 - Databricks (Good to Have): Basic understanding of Databricks or similar data platforms

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior SDET who combines strong automation engineering with hands-on experience applying AI in a QA context. In this role, you own the quality of features and workstreams assigned to you, build reusable automation the team can rely on, and bring AI-assisted approaches into your day-to-day work. 

This is a senior individual contributor role. You take a technical direction and work through it independently, delivering working solutions with minimal hand-holding. You know when to ask clarifying questions and when to move. 

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to understand what quality means for your area, define the right testing approach, and deliver measurable coverage improvements using a mix of automation and AI-assisted approaches. 

If you enjoy solving hard technical problems, delivering quality that people can trust, and building your AI in QA skills through real work, this role is for you. 

What You'll Do

Quality for Your Features and Workstreams

- Own the quality of features or workstreams assigned to you, from planning through release readiness
 - Define the testing approach for your area, including what needs testing, at what depth, and using which methods
 - Partner with developers and product managers on requirement reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning to catch issues early
 - Track quality signals for your area (defects, coverage gaps, escaped issues) and act on them

Automation Framework Contribution

- Build and maintain scalable automation that covers the scenarios that matter for your area
 - Design reusable automation framework components (helpers, utilities, page objects, shared services) that are scalable and reliable enough for the team to depend on
 - Contribute to and evolve the team's automation framework, following established patterns and shaping new ones where needed
 - Write clean, production-quality automation across UI and API layers using Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools
 - Keep the automation suite healthy. Fix flakes, improve reliability, and remove tests that no longer earn their place. 

AI Implementation in QA

- Implement AI-assisted approaches within your area's QA workflow. Intelligent test generation, self-healing locators, automated step definitions, and AI-powered reporting. 
 - Work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) to build utilities the team actually uses
 - Apply practical understanding of how large language models work (context windows, prompt structure, response handling) to build reliable integrations
 - Evaluate AI tools critically. Adopt what genuinely improves quality outcomes. 

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

- Participate actively in code and design reviews. Give substantive feedback. 
 - Document your work well enough that others can build on it
 - Support and pair with less experienced SDETs when needed

Reporting and Execution

- Produce test reports and quality summaries that stakeholders trust and act on
 - Support execution strategy improvements where they help. Parallelism, environment configuration, flakiness reduction. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration if and when needed. This is not a heavy focus for us, so working knowledge is enough. 

What You Will Bring

Quality Engineering Foundation (Must Have)

- Proven track record of owning quality for features or workstreams. Not just executing test cases handed to you. 
 - Strong grasp of test strategy, risk-based coverage, and the tradeoffs between manual, automated, and exploratory testing
 - Experience partnering closely with developers and product managers
 - Comfortable making judgment calls on quality risk and communicating them clearly

Automation (Must Have)

- Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and/or Selenium WebDriver
 - Proficiency in TypeScript, Python, or C# (. NET). C# experience is a plus given our existing codebase. 
 - BDD experience (Cucumber, Gherkin, and structured step definitions) is desirable. Familiarity with any major BDD framework is acceptable. 
 - API testing proficiency alongside UI automation
 - Solid understanding of Page Object Model, component-driven design, and reusable test architecture

AI In QA (Hands-On Experience Required)

- You have built or integrated something using LLM APIs in a QA or automation context. Not just used AI as a productivity tool. 
 - Comfortable with prompt engineering. Structuring prompts for test generation, defect summarization, or coverage analysis. 
 - Working understanding of how large language models function, enough to design production-ready integrations that handle real-world conditions

Data And Backend Skills (Must Have)

- Strong SQL skills for querying application databases, validating data across layers, and setting up test data
 - Comfortable working with API testing beyond basic REST calls. Chaining requests, validating payloads, and handling authentication. 

Communication and Ownership

- Clear communicator. You explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and give real feedback in reviews. 
 - Reliable at delivery time. You step up when a release is at risk. 
 - Independent operator. You take direction and return with solutions. 

Engineering Ecosystem (Good to Have)

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps). Good to have, not a hard requirement. We are not heavily invested in CI/CD, so basic working knowledge is enough. 
 - Familiarity with any test management tool (Azure Test Plans or equivalent)
 - Basic understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines
 - Basic understanding of Databricks or similar data platforms

Qualifications

- B. E. / B. Tech / M. Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline
 - 5+ years of QA and test engineering experience with strong hands-on framework development
 - Demonstrable experience implementing AI solutions in a testing or software engineering context. Experimental projects count if you can show what you built and what it delivered. 

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- Has taken ownership of features or workstreams and is delivering quality that stakeholders trust
 - Has contributed reusable automation framework components that other engineers are using
 - Has shipped at least one AI-assisted utility that is helping the team work smarter
 - Is making technical decisions within their area independently and with confidence
 - Is a visible, reliable contributor across QA and engineering conversations
