Senior Product Software Engineer -AI FinOps & Platform
data.description:
About the Role: 

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead Software Development: Take the lead in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements. 
 - Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives. 
 - Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members. 
 - Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process. 
 - Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency. 
 - Application Design: Lead the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards. 
 - Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications. 
 - Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects. 
 - Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development. 
 - Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications. 
 - Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries. 

Skills: 

- Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues. 
 - Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality. 
 - Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++. 
 - Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action. 
 - Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together. 
 - Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality. 
 - Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes. 
 - Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers. 
 - Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and an understanding of database design principles. 
 - APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other. 
 - Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking. 
 - Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. 
 - Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding. 
 - Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency. 

Competencies: 

- Analytical Skills
 - Inclusive Collaboration
 - Drive to Perform
 - Accountability
 - Functional Expertise
 - Operational Expertise

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

data.title: Chief Technology Officer
data.description:
About the Company

Wastefull Insights is a robotics and AI company focused on developing intelligent automation solutions for waste segregation and material identification. The company integrates robotics, computer vision, AI, mechanical systems, and industrial automation to build technology solutions for real-world operational environments. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the company's overall technology strategy, engineering teams, product development, and technology deployment. 

The CTO will be responsible for converting business requirements into scalable, reliable, and commercially viable technology solutions. This role requires strong technical expertise across robotics, AI/ML, computer vision, embedded systems, mechanical engineering, and industrial automation, along with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver projects from concept to deployment. 

The ideal candidate should be capable of making critical technology decisions, building robust engineering processes, improving product performance, and aligning technology development with the company's business objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Leadership

- Define and execute the company's long-term technology roadmap in alignment with business goals. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, platforms, and architectures relevant to robotics and industrial automation. 
 - Make key technical decisions related to system architecture, technology selection, scalability, and product reliability. 
 - Establish engineering standards, development practices, documentation requirements, and technology governance. 
 - Identify opportunities for innovation, automation, cost reduction, and product differentiation. 2. Robotics & Product Development

- Lead the design, development, integration, and improvement of robotics-based products and systems. 
 - Oversee the integration of mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, actuators, sensors, controllers, and robotic mechanisms. 
 - Guide the development of robot control software, motion planning, perception systems, and hardware-software interfaces. 
 - Ensure products meet performance, reliability, safety, maintainability, and operational requirements. 
 - Drive product development from proof of concept and prototyping through testing, production readiness, and field deployment. 3. AI, Machine Learning & Computer Vision

- Lead the development and integration of AI/ML and computer vision capabilities into robotics products. 
 - Oversee image acquisition, data collection, annotation, dataset quality, model training, validation, and deployment. 
 - Define processes for model monitoring, performance evaluation, retraining, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure AI models perform reliably under real-world conditions, including changing lighting, materials, speeds, and operating environments. 
 - Guide the deployment of vision systems and AI inference solutions on cloud, edge, and on-site infrastructure. 4. Engineering Team Management

- Lead and mentor robotics, software, computer vision, AI/ML, mechanical, electrical, and automation engineering teams. 
 - Define team structures, technical ownership, responsibilities, and reporting mechanisms. 
 - Set engineering priorities, project milestones, technical deliverables, and quality expectations. 
 - Conduct technical reviews, architecture reviews, design reviews, and performance assessments. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 5. System Integration & Deployment

- Ensure seamless integration of robotics hardware, software, AI models, sensors, controllers, and industrial systems. 
 - Oversee factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and performance validation. 
 - Lead technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for failures occurring during development or deployment. 
 - Establish processes for field monitoring, preventive maintenance, upgrades, and technical support. 
 - Ensure deployed systems meet agreed performance and operational requirements. 6. Project & Product Delivery

- Translate business requirements and customer needs into technical specifications and executable development plans. 
 - Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and delivery priorities. 
 - Coordinate with project management, operations, procurement, vendors, and client-facing teams on technical dependencies. 
 - Monitor development progress, resolve technical bottlenecks, and manage delivery risks. 
 - Ensure timely delivery without compromising product quality, safety, or reliability. 7. Infrastructure, Quality & Reliability

- Oversee engineering infrastructure, source-code management, CI/CD, testing automation, and release management. 
 - Establish standards for software quality, hardware validation, cybersecurity, data security, and system reliability. 
 - Guide cloud and edge infrastructure for AI workloads, data pipelines, model deployment, and system monitoring. 
 - Define product performance metrics, uptime targets, failure analysis processes, and reliability improvement plans. 
 - Ensure technical documentation, design records, version control, and deployment procedures are maintained. 8. Cost Optimisation & Vendor Management

- Evaluate technology costs, component selection, vendor capabilities, and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Improve product design for manufacturability, serviceability, and cost-effective scaling. 
 - Work with procurement and operations teams to identify alternative components and reduce recurring costs. 
 - Evaluate and manage technical partnerships, external development partners, and equipment suppliers. 
 - Support budgeting and resource planning for R&D, engineering, and product deployment. 9. Business & Customer Collaboration

- Work closely with founders and leadership to align technology investments with business priorities. 
 - Participate in customer discussions to understand technical requirements and deployment constraints. 
 - Support technical proposals, feasibility assessments, product demonstrations, and solution design. 
 - Identify opportunities to convert customer feedback and field data into product improvements. 
 - Support business growth by building technology that can be replicated across multiple client locations. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related field. 
 - Typically 10+ years of relevant engineering or technology experience, with substantial experience leading multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Demonstrated experience in robotics, industrial automation, AI/ML, computer vision, or integrated hardware-software products. 
 - Proven experience taking complex technology products from development through real-world deployment. 
 - Strong understanding of system architecture, product engineering, testing, debugging, and reliability. 
 - Experience managing engineering teams, technology roadmaps, budgets, and project delivery. 
 - Strong decision-making, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

data.title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
data.description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast - and Brings You With It. 

At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn't a slogan - it's how we work. For over 140 years, we've improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions - but how we operate as a company. 

When you join Fuller, you're joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You'll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that's actively expanding - a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. 

If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it - Fuller is where that happens. 

About The Role

For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations: 

engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers. 

As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms - it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts. 

You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle - from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support. 

Your Responsibilities: 

- Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities. 
 - Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies. 
 - Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals. 
 - Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions. 
 - Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability. 
 - Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians. 
 - Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification. 
 - Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform. 
 - Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications. 
 - Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required. 

You bring

- Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes. 
 - Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation. 
 - Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage. 
 - Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis. 
 - Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
 - Willingness to travel (50-70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training. 

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. 

Application and contact

Please apply by clicking "apply" on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible. 

No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please. 

Build a better world

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for exceptional programmers to join our Human Capital Development (HC Dev) team based out of Gurugram, Hyderabad or Bengaluru, which is rebuilding its core infrastructure and applications to enhance efficiency, enable data-driven decision-making, and deliver next-generation analytics capabilities. The role offers an opportunity to provide technical and delivery leadership through active involvement in system design, architecture, and implementation, leading initiatives that evolve our platforms, improve maintainability, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing systems. You will align technology direction with business goals, guide teams toward architectural excellence, and strengthen the reliability, resilience, and performance of critical systems. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

In this role you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining high-quality web applications and supporting infrastructure by working closely with business and product managers. You will work on a range of back-end and front-end technologies including Java, Spring, TypeScript, React, and SQL Server, while participating actively in design and code reviews. You will remain hands-on in design and development while guiding the team in engineering best practices. You will also troubleshoot business-critical issues, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor junior team members on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related field with 6 to 9 years of work experience
 - Strong full-stack development experience with Java and Spring or similar frameworks on the back end, and TypeScript and React on the front end, with familiarity in SQL. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a demonstrated passion for technology, quality, and attention to detail. 
 - Proven experience in end-to-end project delivery, including planning, execution, and stakeholder communication; people management experience is a plus. 
 - Excellent reasoning ability, interpersonal, and communication skills, as the role involves frequent interaction with business groups. 

Advanced Qualifications: 

- Experience integrating GenAI workflows, including RAG pipelines, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent tools to build scalable AI applications is a plus. 

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https: //www. deshawindia. com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadHCDevSept26

We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative. 

The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https: //www. deshawindia. com/careers

Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

data.title: QA Platform Lead
data.description:
Experience: 7. 00 + years

Salary: INR 3000000-4500000 / year (based on experience)

Expected Notice Period: 7 Days

Shift: (GMT+05: 30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

Opportunity Type: Office ()

Placement Type: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: IndependenceOS (Roots Health))

(*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - IndependenceOS (Roots Health))

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

Healthcare or HIPAA experience, and mobile automation (Detox, API testing (pytest, Maestro or Appium). , ML or LLM features, Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium), Postman), REST clients

IndependenceOS (Roots Health) is Looking for: 

The role

This is a builder role, not a manual test-pass role. We run many services: backend-for-frontend APIs, AI

agents, an auth gateway, and integrations with EMRs and payers. They deploy on Kubernetes, with a local

cluster that mirrors our cloud environment. You will design how we prove all of it works and make that proof

automatic on every change, including eval frameworks for our AI features and regression suites for every

release. Roughly 80% hands-on building, 20% setting standards and coaching. 

What You Will Do

Design and build our test automation platform from scratch: framework, folder layout, reusable

components, reporting, and CI integration. 

Build an evaluation framework for our AI features (AI scribe, voice agent, medical coding): golden

datasets, automated scoring, and LLM-as-judge where it helps, run on every prompt or model change. 

Build regression suites that run on every release, and quality gates in CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Argo CD)

that are fast, reliable and trusted. 

Own end-to-end coverage of critical workflows on web and mobile: patient search, scheduling, eligibility, 

scribe notes, and claims. 

Build API and contract tests between frontends, APIs and backend services, so breaking changes fail

before merge. 

Test against realistic data in ephemeral or local environments, not mocks and fixtures, and build the data

seeding that makes this practical. 

Lead non-functional testing: performance and load, security, role and permission checks, and isolation

between tenants. 

Define release criteria and defect triage, and coach developers to own quality in their own code. 

What You Bring

7+ years in QA or SDET roles, including at least one framework or QA platform you built from the ground

up and ran in production. 

Experience testing ML or LLM features: evaluation datasets, scoring non-deterministic output, and

catching regressions after model or prompt changes. 

Strong code in TypeScript and/or Python. You write test code to the same standard as product code. 

Hands-on Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium), API testing (pytest, REST clients, Postman), and mobile

automation (Detox, Maestro or Appium). 

Experience testing microservices on Docker and Kubernetes, wired into CI pipelines. 

Contract testing (Pact or similar), test data management, and environment setup. 

A track record of cutting flaky tests and making test results something engineers trust. 

Nice to have

Healthcare or HIPAA experience, including PHI-safe test data practices. 

Testing HL7, FHIR, X12 or EMR integrations. 

Performance tools (k6, Locust) and observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana). 

Eval tooling such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas or LangSmith, including hallucination and safety

checks. 

Fluent use of AI coding tools to speed up test authoring.

data.title: Senior / Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior / Principal Software Engineer based in India. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior / Principal Software Engineer to help shape the evolution of an AI-powered revenue intelligence platform. In this role, you will design and develop sophisticated integrations, build intelligent workflows, and deliver scalable solutions that improve sales productivity and revenue visibility. You will work across a modern technology stack, including React, TypeScript, Next. js, Node. js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, solving complex engineering challenges in a growing SaaS environment. You will also help establish robust architectural foundations while leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. Working closely with a distributed team, you will contribute to product innovation and support an expanding international customer base. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an engineer who combines technical depth, strong architectural judgment, and a passion for building reliable software at scale. 

Accountabilities

As a Senior / Principal Software Engineer, you will drive the development of high-quality software, contribute to architectural decisions, and improve the scalability and reliability of an AI-driven SaaS platform. 

- Design, develop, and maintain complex integrations that connect the platform with Salesforce and other relevant systems. 
 - Build and optimize AI-driven workflows that automate revenue operations and improve visibility into deals, sales pipelines, and forecasting. 
 - Develop scalable, maintainable frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and Next. js. 
 - Design and implement backend services and APIs using Node. js, PostgreSQL, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Contribute to system architecture, applying sound software design patterns and distributed computing principles. 
 - Build, deploy, and maintain cloud-based solutions using AWS services and best practices. 
 - Improve software quality, reliability, and delivery speed through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and effective development workflows. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and automation to streamline engineering processes while maintaining high standards for security, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 - Identify technical challenges, troubleshoot complex issues, and continuously improve application performance and system reliability. 
 - Contribute to engineering standards, architectural decisions, and development practices that support long-term product growth. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an accomplished software engineer with strong full-stack development expertise, cloud architecture experience, and a product-oriented mindset suited to a fast-moving SaaS environment. 

- At least 5 years of professional software development experience. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in React, TypeScript, and Next. js. 
 - Strong backend development skills with Node. js and PostgreSQL. 
 - Practical experience with AWS services and cloud architecture. 
 - Solid understanding of software design patterns, system architecture, and distributed computing principles. 
 - Experience working with Agile methodologies and implementing CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience working in SaaS product companies, with an understanding of scalable product development and customer-focused engineering. 
 - Comfortable using AI tools in software development and motivated to automate workflows where doing so improves productivity without sacrificing code quality. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex engineering challenges independently. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams and communicate technical concepts clearly. 
 - Willingness to maintain working-hour overlap with Central European Time (CET ±2 hours). 

Benefits

- Annual compensation of €90, 000-€110, 000, with pay determined by market rates in the applicant's country. 
 - Fully remote work, with the flexibility to work from anywhere within your country of residence. 
 - Annual paid time off. 
 - Annual company off-site, with all expenses covered. 
 - Opportunity to work on an AI-powered SaaS platform serving a growing international customer base. 
 - Exposure to modern technologies, complex integrations, and challenging software architecture projects. 
 - A collaborative engineering environment that encourages AI-assisted development, workflow automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Equal opportunity employment, with consideration given to qualified applicants regardless of protected characteristics.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.title: Master Data Quality Manager
data.description:
Company Description DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide. 

Role Description

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation. The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained. 

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose. 

Key responsibilities

1. Data quality monitoring

- Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data. 
 - Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards. 
 - Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions. 
 - Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records. 
 - Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes. 
 - Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement. 

2. Data Cleansing and Remediation

- Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets. 
 - Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies. 
 - Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information. 
 - Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures. 
 - Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status. 
 - Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner. 

3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding

- Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data. 
 - Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment. 
 - Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data. 
 - Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements. 
 - Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions. 
 - Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information. 

4. Data governance and standardization

- Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data. 
 - Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained. 
 - Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality. 
 - Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures. 
 - Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams. 
 - Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation. 

5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support

- Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information. 
 - Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues. 
 - Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records. 
 - Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices. 

6. Reporting and continuous improvement

- Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress. 
 - Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action. 
 - Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes. 
 - Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation. 

Qualifications

- Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline. 
 - Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment. 
 - Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented. 
 - Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records. 
 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically. 
 - Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues. 
 - Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. 
 - Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions. 
 - A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products. 
 - Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases. 
 - Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms. 
 - Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting. 
 - Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes. 
 - Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

data.title: SOAR Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

Information Security Engineer Role

Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Python and security automation to join our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be adept at developing and implementing automated security solutions to protect our systems and data, as well as reviewing, validating, and hardening code and workflows produced by AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic systems. This role requires a proactive individual who can work independently and collaboratively to enhance our security posture in an environment where both humans and AI agents write and operate code. In addition, proficiency and experience using a SOAR for automation and security incident response is required. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain security automation scripts and tools using Python to a high standard of reliability and efficiency, including reviewing and hardening code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Integrate security tools and solutions, including developing and managing APIs, to automate security processes and workflows. 

Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential threats. 

Monitor security systems and respond to incidents with automated solutions, implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Tines, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect) to streamline response activities. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement security controls, and write clear technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for tools and processes. 

Govern enterprise use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including tenant restrictions, access scoping, and compliance/audit logging. 

Design and enforce security controls for agentic AI systems, including tool-permission boundaries, prompt injection defenses, and agent identity/access governance. 

Utilise Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for threat detection and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to analyse security data. 

Implement CI/CD pipeline automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) to ensure secure code deployment and infrastructure provisioning. 

Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field. 

Proven experience as a Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on Python and security automation. 

Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing automation scripts and tools, as well as reviewing and validating code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners. 

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes). 

Experience with API development and integration, including RESTful APIs. 

Proficiency in implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect). 

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint security. 

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication, including writing technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience securing AI/LLM-based agentic systems, including prompt injection defense, tool-permission boundaries, and agent identity governance. 

Experience governing enterprise AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), including compliance/audit logging, tenant restrictions, and CI/CD supply-chain hardening against AI-related risks. 

Desirable

Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) for querying and analysing security data. 

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or GIAC. 

Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). 

Understanding of network protocols and security architecture. 

Familiarity with the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e. g. , tool misuse, agentic supply-chain risk, unexpected code execution, human-agent trust exploitation). 

Experience with AI red-teaming and evaluation methodologies for agentic and LLM-based systems. 

Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and other agent-tool integration risks. 

Skills

AI Security, Python, Cloud Security, IDS/IPS, LLMs, Vulnerability Assessment, SOAR, Container Security, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

Our company is seeking an accomplished Head of AI Division to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. 

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions. 

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value.

- Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments. 
 - Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 - Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support. 
 - Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations. 7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

- Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows. 
 - Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery. 
 - Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Promote responsible adoption of AI development tools while maintaining software quality, intellectual property protection, and security standards. 8. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

 - Implement governance mechanisms for model evaluation, production approval, change management, incident response, and continuous monitoring. 9. Technology Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

- Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots.

 - Define measurable business cases for AI initiatives and track their impact on productivity, operating costs, quality, customer experience, and revenue opportunities.

Generative AI & Foundation Models

data.title: Java Developer
data.description:
Location: Mohali

Work Mode: 5 Days Work From Office

Shift Timing: 11 AM IST onwards

Experience: 4+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We're looking for a Java Developer with strong backend skills and experience building calculation-heavy, finance-related applications. 

Key responsibilities

- Design, build and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. Break requirements into modules, write the code end to end, and keep it maintainable as features grow. 
 - Build secure, well-structured REST APIs with proper request validation, error handling, status codes and versioning. Document APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI so other teams can use them easily. 
 - Write clean, readable and testable code that follows SOLID principles and team coding standards. Refactor older code when needed and keep technical debt under control. 
 - Implement business logic for multi-step calculations such as rates, slabs, percentages, fees, rebates and penalties. Make sure every result is accurate, repeatable and easy to trace. 
 - Implement double-entry postings, map each transaction to the correct finance/account codes, and handle reversals, refunds and adjustments without breaking ledger balances. 
 - Write and optimise complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and reports. Design tables and indexes that keep data consistent and queries fast as volume grows. 
 - Write unit and integration tests for all business logic, with extra focus on calculation edge cases and boundary values. Keep test coverage high so changes can be released with confidence. 
 - Investigate and fix production issues, including calculation or data mismatches. Do root-cause analysis and put permanent fixes in place, not just workarounds. 
 - Take part in code reviews, sprint planning and technical discussions. Work closely with QA, business analysts and finance teams to clarify rules and confirm expected results. Required skills and experience

- 4-8 years of hands-on Java development (Java 11 or later; Java 17 preferred), with at least 2 years on enterprise or transaction-heavy applications. 
 - Strong command of OOP concepts, Collections, Generics, Multithreading and concurrency utilities, Exception Handling, Streams and Lambdas. Able to explain why one approach is better than another, not just use it. 
 - Solid experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and Spring Security. Understands dependency injection, bean lifecycle, profiles and configuration management. 
 - Has built and consumed RESTful services, including authentication (JWT/OAuth2), validation, pagination and global exception handling. Has integrated with third-party APIs such as payment gateways or banks. 
 - Strong SQL on PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL - complex joins, subqueries, window functions, indexing, stored procedures and query tuning using execution plans. 
 - Clear understanding of ACID, isolation levels, optimistic and pessimistic locking, and idempotency. Knows how to prevent duplicate entries and race conditions in multi-user systems. 
 - Uses BigDecimal correctly for money, with defined scale and rounding modes. Knows why double/float must not be used for financial values. 
 - Understands ledgers, journal entries, debits and credits, chart of accounts and finance code structures. Can translate a finance rule into correct and testable code. 
 - Writes unit tests with JUnit 5 and Mockito, and integration tests for APIs and database layers. Comfortable with test-driven thinking for logic-heavy code. 
 - Comfortable with Git branching, Maven or Gradle, Jenkins or other CI/CD tools, and basic Linux commands for deployment and log checks. 
 - B. Tech / BE / MCA in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

data.title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
data.description:
Senior Manufacturing & Production Quality Lead - LifeBand

Location: India - predominantly on-site in Chennai

Engagement: Contract, Full Time

Reporting to: Equivital UK Product & Operations Leadership

Product: Equivital LifeBand - first high-volume production run of 2, 000 units

Role purpose

Equivital is seeking experienced electronics manufacturing professional to provide hands-on leadership and oversight of the first high-volume production run of approximately 2, 000 LifeBand devices at our manufacturing partner in India. 

This is a critical production-launch role. The successful candidate will act as Equivital's senior on-site manufacturing representative and will be responsible for ensuring that the production process is properly controlled, technically robust and capable of delivering a consistently high-quality product at the required yield. 

The individual will work closely with the manufacturing company in Chennai and quality teams, Equivital's UK engineering and product teams, and other technical stakeholders. 

The role requires someone who is comfortable working directly on the factory floor, identifying problems, challenging poor processes, implementing corrective actions and communicating clearly with both factory personnel and senior technical teams in the UK. 

Key objectives

The successful candidate will be accountable for: 

- Excellent build quality across the 2, 000-unit production run. 
 - High first-pass yield and minimal rework/scrap. 
 - Successful integration of the new ATE into the production process. 
 - Implementation and control of the new final DFT testing process. 
 - Robust control and verification of the LifeBand welding process. 
 - Ensuring welded assemblies meet the required mechanical and electrical specifications, particularly those affecting pogo-pin performance. 
 - Accurate material, component and finished-goods traceability. 
 - Improved stock control and production material management at Manufacturing plant. 
 - Rapid identification, containment and resolution of production issues. 
 - Accurate production reporting to the UK team. 
 - Establishment of a repeatable production process that Manufacturing company can continue to operate after the launch phase. Key responsibilities

1. Production launch and daily manufacturing oversight

- Be Equivital's principal technical and operational representative on-site during the production run. 
 - Work closely with Manufacturing company production, engineering and quality personnel. 
 - Review and approve production readiness before volume manufacturing begins. 
 - Establish clear daily production targets and monitor actual performance. 
 - Monitor production flow from incoming components through assembly, welding, programming, testing, final inspection and packing. 
 - Identify bottlenecks, recurring defects and process weaknesses. 
 - Challenge processes that are not producing the required quality or yield. 
 - Have authority to recommend or initiate a production stop where there is a significant quality or product-risk issue. 2. ATE implementation

The successful candidate will: 

- Work with Equivital engineering and manufacturing company to embed the ATE into the production process. 
 - Ensure operators understand the correct test procedure. 
 - Verify that the ATE is correctly configured and being used consistently. 
 - Establish appropriate test records and traceability. 
 - Monitor ATE failure rates and identified abnormal trends. 
 - Distinguish genuine product failures from test-equipment/operator/process failures. 
 - Ensure failed units are correctly quarantined and investigated. 
 - Ensure that production does not bypass required ATE testing. 
 - Work with engineering to refine the ATE process where necessary. 3. Final DFT implementation

Final Design-for-Test / DFT testing is a new element of the LifeBand production process. 

The role will be responsible for: 

- Implementing the final DFT test process on the production line. 
 - Ensuring appropriate test fixtures, equipment and procedures are available. 
 - Training and supervising operators. 
 - Ensuring 100% of required devices receive the defined final testing. 
 - Ensuring test results are recorded and traceable to individual units. 
 - Monitoring DFT failure modes and trends. 
 - Working with Equivital engineering to investigate recurring failures. 
 - Preventing units from progressing to final packing without completing the required tests. 4. Welding process control

A particularly important responsibility will be oversight of the LifeBand welding process. 

The successful candidate must have practical experience of manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies and understand the failure modes associated with welding/joining processes. 

They will: 

- Establish and document the required welding process parameters. 
 - Verify that the welding equipment is correctly set up and maintained. 
 - Ensure operators are trained and following the approved process. 
 - Establish appropriate first-off and periodic inspection requirements. 
 - Monitor weld quality throughout production. 
 - Identify potential weld defects before they become downstream failures. 
 - Ensure appropriate mechanical/electrical verification of the weld. 
 - Investigate weld-related failures and implement corrective actions. 
 - Pay particular attention to the impact of the welding process on the alignment, positioning and reliability of the LifeBand pogo-pin interface. 
 - Ensure the finished assembly meets the required mechanical tolerances and electrical performance requirements. Experience with welding or joining of small electronic assemblies, plastics, metals, flexes, contacts or similar precision components would be highly desirable. 

5. Quality and yield management

Establish and maintain a clear production-quality dashboard covering, at minimum: 

- First-pass yield (FPY)
 - Overall yield
 - Scrap
 - Rework
 - ATE failures
 - DFT failures
 - Welding defects
 - Pogo-pin/contact failures
 - Functional test failures
 - Component/assembly defects
 - Repeat failure modes
 - Units quarantined
 - Units released
 - Production throughputThe successful candidate will identify trends rather than simply report numbers. 

Where yield deteriorates, they will determine the likely root cause and drive corrective action. 

6. Factory process discipline and stock control

Manufacturing company currently requires improved production discipline and material control. 

The role will therefore include: 

- Verification of component availability before production starts. 
 - Physical verification of critical stock where required. 
 - Improving accuracy between recorded and actual stock. 
 - Ensuring components are correctly identified and traceable. 
 - Preventing uncontrolled substitution of components. 
 - Ensuring rejected/failed components are segregated. 
 - Establishing appropriate quarantine and disposition processes. 
 - Identifying shortages before they stop production. 
 - Ensuring finished and semi-finished units can be reconciled against production records. 7. Non-conformance and root-cause analysis

The individual will lead or coordinate investigation of manufacturing defects. 

They should be comfortable using appropriate techniques including: 

- CAPA
 - Non-Conformance

What you'll do: 

- Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.

data.title: Co-Founder & CTO
data.description:
I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me. 

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business. 

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising. 

What you'll be building: 

- Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development. 
 - Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure. 
 - Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future. 
 - Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users. 
 - Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow. 
 - Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions. 
 - Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features. Who I'm looking for: 

- 7-12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers. 
 - Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything. 
 - A problem solver who understands business as much as technology. 
 - Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow. 
 - Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee. One thing you should know. 

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort. 

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves. 

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5-10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there. 

This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement. We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently. 

I don't expect you to know everything. 

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers. 

I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me. 

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo. 

Kush Chauhan | Born at 41. 

kush@snapzo. in

data.description:
Engineering Manager

Accelerate Performance. 

About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner. 

With 6, 200+ active customers worldwide and a market-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45+ years of industry expertise with modern AI-driven execution - helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact. 

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company. 

CAI India

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust. 

CAI Software is seeking an **Engineering Manager** to join our Discrete Manufacturing business unit in Bangalore. This is a hands-on, full-stack, player-coach role owning engineering for two Microsoft-stack products: MatTrace (formerly Endeavor), our material traceability and shop-floor data collection platform, and LLumin CMMS, our maintenance management product. You will lead the team, serve as senior technical authority for architecture and difficult development issues, write and review code, own critical customer escalations, and drive modernization from . NET Framework 4. 8 to current . NET. The role reports to the VP of Engineering. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture of MatTrace and LLumin CMMS; review designs and resolve architectural and cross-service issues (API contracts, authentication, data model, mobile sync, ERP integration)
 - Lead the . NET modernization roadmap and set engineering standards (layering, DI, code review, CI/CD in Azure DevOps)
 - Fix the hardest defects, prototype architectural changes, and unblock the team on complex C#, SQL, Angular and React Native problems
 - Diagnose production issues end to end, from browser or device through Web API and Entity Framework to the database, including query tuning
 - Act as engineering owner for Severity 1/2 customer escalations: lead triage and root-cause analysis, communicate remediation plans to customers and stakeholders, and partner with Support and Professional Services on hotfix cadence and defect backlogs
 - Build, mentor and manage a multi-product team of full-stack developers, QA and DevOps engineers; own hiring and performance
 - Plan and deliver releases across both products with clear reporting to BU leadership
 - Own test strategy, automation coverage and production readiness (including mobile sync compatibility), and ensure secure SDLC practices
 - Champion AI-assisted development lifecycle (AI-DLC) practices across specification, code and QA automation

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineering teams and 3+ years as an architect or technical lead on enterprise web applications
 - Strong, current full-stack hands-on skills: C# and . NET (Framework 4. 8 and . NET 8+), ASP. NET MVC/Web API, Entity Framework, and SQL Server (schema design, T-SQL, query tuning); able to read, debug and write production code daily
 - Proficiency in at least one modern front-end technology (Angular, React or React Native), with the ability to review and contribute to TypeScript/JavaScript code
 - Proven ability to resolve architectural and difficult development issues in large, layered codebases, including . NET Framework to . NET migration or legacy modernization experience
 - Demonstrated ownership of customer escalations; experience with REST API design, OAuth2/OIDC authentication, background services and enterprise integration patterns (WCF/SOAP, REST, database-level)
 - Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD experience; effective across US and India time zones
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master's preferred)
 - Preferred: domain exposure to manufacturing execution, material traceability, barcode data collection, warehouse operations or CMMS/EAM
 - Preferred: ERP integration experience (IFS, Epicor, Syteline, Dynamics, SAP)
 - Preferred: familiarity with Oracle, Redis/SignalR, . NET MAUI, multi-tenant SaaS, VB. NET or WPF/WinForms
 - Preferred: team-scale use of AI coding assistants and AI-driven SDLC/QA automation

What Success Looks Like

- Predictable, high-quality delivery against roadmap commitments made with Product Management. 
 - Measurable adoption and impact of AI-led development practices within the team. 
 - A well-documented, well-governed engineering process in ADO, Aha!, and Confluence that stakeholders trust. 
 - An engaged, growing engineering team with clear goals and strong retention. 

Why Join CAI

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6, 200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like - and we are building the team to lead that work. 

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers - and how we work:
