Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). 
 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field.

Sangreen's vision is to delight the world through sustainable, scalable engineering solutions that foster innovation, empower communities, and positively impact the environment. 

1. JOB DETAILS

Job Title:   Manager - Process Excellence

Department / Business Unit:   Process Excellence / Business Excellence

Location:   Head Office / Project Sites, as required

Employment Type:   Full-time, Permanent

Experience Required:   5 to 7 years of relevant experience

Industry:   EPC / Infrastructure

Travel Requirement:   Travel to project sites and operating locations, as required

2. JOB PURPOSE

The Manager - Process Excellence is responsible for identifying operational problem areas, conducting structured root cause analysis and designing practical solutions that improve process effectiveness across the  organisation. The role facilitates development and implementation of operational processes at the Head Office and project sites, secures stakeholder alignment, monitors compliance, conducts regular audits and supports long-term process sustenance. 

3. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Problem Identification & Root Cause Analysis

•  Identify operational problem areas and opportunities for process improvement across functions and project locations. 

•  Conduct structured root cause analysis and define clear problem statements. 

•  Evaluate process gaps, recurring issues and barriers affecting operational flow and execution. 

Solution Design & Stakeholder Alignment

•  Design practical process solutions based on the identified problem statement and root causes. 

•  Develop detailed solution elements, operating requirements and implementation actions. 

•  Obtain buy-in from key stakeholders and align affected teams on the proposed solution. 

•  Coordinate with operational teams to incorporate functional and site-level inputs into process design. 

Process Development & Implementation

•  Facilitate the development of operational processes with inputs from relevant operational teams. 

•  Guide the establishment and implementation of processes at the Head Office and project sites. 

•  Define appropriate issue-escalation mechanisms to support timely resolution at the required  organisational  level. 

•  Support the transition of approved solutions into regular operating practices. 

Governance & Leadership Reviews

•  Conduct fortnightly and monthly steering committee meetings with leadership. 

•  Present initiative status, key issues, risks, decisions required and implementation progress. 

•  Align  organisational  efforts and stakeholder actions towards approved process-excellence initiatives. 

•  Track agreed actions and facilitate timely follow-up and closure. 

Process Compliance & Sustenance

•  Ensure compliance with agreed processes by relevant stakeholders. 

•  Understand flow-management principles and solutions developed for different business verticals. 

•  Conduct regular audits to reinforce approved systems and processes. 

•  Act as the custodian of agreed solution elements and process standards across the  organisation. 

•  Guide teams in sustaining implemented processes and addressing deviations. 

Continuous Improvement

•  Propose and deploy solutions to improve existing operational processes. 

•  Promote improvements that increase operational flow and strengthen process effectiveness. 

•  Use audit findings, stakeholder feedback and operating issues to identify further improvement opportunities. 

4. KEY RESULT AREAS / PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

•  Timely identification and structured analysis of operational problems and process gaps. 

•  Quality, practicality and stakeholder acceptance of proposed process solutions. 

•  Timely establishment and implementation of approved processes at the Head Office and project sites. 

•  Compliance with agreed processes across relevant stakeholder groups. 

•  Timely completion of process audits and closure of identified gaps. 

•  Effectiveness of fortnightly and monthly steering committee governance and action tracking. 

•  Sustenance of implemented process solutions and adherence to defined operating standards. 

•  Demonstrable improvement in operational flow and process effectiveness. 

•  Timely escalation and resolution of cross-functional or site-level process issues. 

5. JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Educational Qualification

•  B. E. /  B. Tech  from a  recognised  university or institution. 

•  MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution. 

Experience

•  5 to 7 years of relevant industry and functional experience. 

•  Experience in one or more EPC sectors, such as rural electrification, substations, transmission lines, telecommunication networks or other public infrastructure. 

•  Prior experience in the Project Management domain, including PMO, project planning or site-management roles. 

•  Exposure to operational process development, implementation, compliance monitoring or audit activities is preferred. 

Technical Knowledge

•  Root cause analysis and problem-statement definition

•  Process mapping, process design and process documentation

•  Operational flow-management principles

•  Process implementation and sustenance

•  Process compliance reviews and audits

•  Project-management, PMO, planning and site-management practices

•  Stakeholder alignment and steering committee governance

•  Issue escalation and action-closure mechanisms

•  EPC and infrastructure operating environments

•  Management reporting and presentation

6. TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

•  Problem Analysis:   Ability to identify process gaps, structure problems and establish underlying root causes. 

•  Solution Design:   Ability to translate analysis into practical, detailed and implementable process solutions. 

•  Process Development:   Ability to facilitate the creation of operational processes using cross-functional inputs. 

•  Implementation & Sustenance:   Ability to guide process deployment at the Head Office and sites and reinforce long-term adherence. 

•  Audit & Compliance:   Ability to assess compliance, identify deviations and facilitate corrective action. 

•  Flow Management:   Understanding of flow-management principles and their application across business verticals. 

•  Governance:   Ability to conduct steering committee reviews, present issues and track decisions and actions. 

•  Project Management:   Working knowledge of PMO, planning and site-management practices in EPC environments. 

7. BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES

•  Assertiveness

•  Problem-solving orientation

•  Passion for achieving results

•  Stakeholder influence and collaboration

•  Structured and analytical thinking

•  Facilitation and communication skills

•  Ownership and accountability

•  Persistence in driving closure

•  Adaptability across Head Office and site environments

•  Attention to process discipline and detail

8. KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Internal Interfaces:   Leadership team, operational teams, Project Management Office, Planning, Site Management and business vertical representatives

External Interfaces:   Project and process stakeholders, where applicable

People Responsibility:   No formal direct reports specified; functionally coordinates cross-functional stakeholders and process owners

9. TRAVEL & WORKING CONDITIONS

The role requires coordination across the Head Office and project sites. The incumbent may be required to travel to operational locations to understand processes, facilitate implementation, conduct audits and support process sustenance. 

10. CERTIFICATIONS / ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

•  Formal certification in Lean, Six Sigma, process excellence or project management would be advantageous. 

•  Strong working knowledge of presentation, reporting and process-documentation tools is desirable. 

•  Ability to work with senior leadership and operating teams across different functions and project locations.

data.title: QA/QC ENGINEER LECTRONICS
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

We are looking for a passionate QA/QC Engineer - Electronics to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware. 

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Quality Assurance Leadership: Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices. 
 - Design Phase Integration: Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design. 
 - Reliability & Circuit Analysis: Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities. 
 - AIT & Environmental Compliance: Review and validate environmental qualification test results-including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing-and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP). 
 - Audit & Configuration Control: Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control. 
 - Non-Conformance Management: Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems. 
 - Standards & Compliance: Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles. 
 - Technical Expertise: Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills. 
 - Methodologies: Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks. 
 - Core Competencies: Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes. 
 - Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices. 
 - Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads. 
 - Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt). 

WHY JOIN US?

- Pioneering Impact: Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit. 
 - End-to-End Exposure: Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness. 
 - Innovation Culture: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment. 
 - Career Growth: Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

You will also help optimize testing processes, communicate quality risks, and ensure that software releases meet established functional and technical standards.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Level Full Stack Engineer based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and deploy scalable, high-performance web applications from the ground up. In this role, you will combine strong frontend expertise in React or Angular with backend development skills in Python to build robust, user-focused digital solutions. You will take ownership of developing RESTful APIs, integrating services, and deploying applications to AWS cloud infrastructure. Working across the full software development lifecycle, you will contribute to architectural decisions, database optimization, testing, and production readiness. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable software while following modern development practices. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, exploring emerging technologies, and delivering high-quality products in a dynamic environment. 

Accountabilities

- Full Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Python for backend development and JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular for frontend implementation. 
 - API Development and Integration: Build RESTful APIs from scratch, integrate third-party services, and ensure secure, efficient, and reliable communication between application components. 
 - Cloud Deployment and Delivery: Deploy and maintain applications on AWS, using tools and workflows such as Jenkins or Maven to support build automation, continuous integration, and delivery. 
 - Frontend Engineering: Develop responsive, accessible, and user-friendly interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, AJAX, and relevant frontend libraries and frameworks. 
 - Backend Engineering: Build reliable backend services, apply object-oriented programming principles, and implement appropriate software design patterns to ensure maintainability and scalability. 
 - Database Management: Design and optimize database structures, write efficient SQL queries, and improve database performance using technologies such as MySQL and MongoDB. 
 - Quality Assurance and Testing: Develop clean, maintainable code, participate in unit and UI testing, troubleshoot defects, and validate application functionality before deployment. 
 - Debugging and Performance Optimization: Use browser developer tools and debugging utilities to identify and resolve frontend and backend issues, improve application performance, and enhance user experience. 
 - Technical Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and development tools to identify opportunities for improving engineering efficiency and product capabilities. 
 - Project Ownership: Manage assigned development tasks independently, maintain code quality, meet project deadlines, and collaborate effectively with team members throughout the development lifecycle. 

Requirements

- Professional Experience: Demonstrated experience in full stack software development, with the technical maturity to design, build, test, and deploy production-ready applications. 
 - Backend Development: Strong proficiency in Python, including experience building backend services and developing RESTful APIs from scratch. 
 - Frontend Development: Hands-on expertise in JavaScript and at least one modern frontend framework, preferably React or Angular. Experience with TypeScript, React Native, jQuery, AJAX, and other JavaScript libraries is an advantage. 
 - API Integration: Proven experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful web services and third-party APIs. 
 - Cloud and Deployment: Practical experience deploying web applications to AWS. Familiarity with Jenkins, Maven, and automated build or deployment pipelines is required. 
 - Node. js and Databases: Experience with Node. js and MongoDB, along with strong knowledge of relational databases, MySQL, SQL query development, and database performance optimization. 
 - Software Engineering Principles: Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, web application design patterns, clean coding practices, and maintainable software architecture. 
 - Frontend Technologies: Knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and CSS preprocessors such as Sass. Familiarity with UI testing tools and frontend debugging utilities is beneficial. 
 - Development and Debugging Tools: Experience using browser developer tools, including Chrome DevTools, to investigate application behavior, troubleshoot defects, and improve performance. 
 - SaaS Product Development: Experience building SaaS applications from the ground up, including framework selection, implementation, testing, and deployment, is a strong advantage. 
 - Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to understand complex requirements, evaluate technical alternatives, troubleshoot issues, and deliver practical, effective solutions. 
 - Communication and Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills, sound interpersonal abilities, and the capacity to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Professional Attributes: Self-disciplined, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently while managing priorities and meeting deadlines. 
 - Continuous Learning: Enthusiasm for staying current with modern development technologies and applying relevant innovations effectively. 

Benefits

- Full-time employment opportunity in a senior software engineering role. 
 - Opportunity to work across the full stack, from frontend development to backend architecture and cloud deployment. 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying scalable web applications and RESTful APIs. 
 - Opportunities to work with modern technologies, including Python, React, Angular, Node. js, MongoDB, and AWS. 
 - Scope to contribute to technical decisions, application architecture, and software engineering best practices.

Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

The Software Engineer will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to delivery predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety critical environment. The candidate will work on software that directly supports air traffic operations, applying AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and enhance system reliability. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of a team, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining source code within an Agile environment. 
 - Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, product owners, and other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into working software. 
 - Work within Agile/Scrum development environments and participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions. 
 - Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and services. 
 - Develop software using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, C#, or similar technologies. 
 - Develop automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality and reliability. 
 - Utilize modern DevOps and CI/CD practices to automate software builds, testing, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Troubleshoot complex software issues and continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and performance

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline with relevant professional software development experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience or a Master's Degree and 6+ years of relevant experience
 - Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to effectively collaborate with team members and present reports and status. 
 - Professional experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#. 
 - Experience with object-oriented programming, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and source control tools such as Git. 
 - Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, or distributed applications. 
 - Experience with modern software development methodologies and the SDLC. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases. 
 - Understanding of cloud-based application development using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Exposure to or experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application development. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in the aviation industry or a similar high-tech field is a plus. 
 - Experience with large-scale distributed systems
 - Experience working with safety critical or high availability software
 - Experience integrating with legacy systems
 - Experience reading and understanding large existing codebases
 - Experience working in a global or multicultural environment is a plus
 - Experience developing cloud-native applications and working with cloud-based AI services. 
 - Experience developing software in highly secure, regulated, mission-critical, or enterprise environments. 

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo - because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 - and moving faster than anyone else dares. 

Original Posting

For U. S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. 

Pay Range

Pay Range -

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. 

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. For more information, visit www. Leidos. com. 

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www. leidos. com/careers/pay-benefits. 

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos' name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i. e. , ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i. e. , send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos. com automated system - never from free commercial services (e. g. , Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e. g. , about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos. com. 

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U. S. Federal Trade Commission. 

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. data.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
data.description:
Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)

About The Role

What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress-test AI-powered applications and infrastructure - identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Conduct penetration tests against AI-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
 - Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
 - Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry-standard tools and methodologies
 - Simulate real-world attack scenarios - from reconnaissance through exploitation and post-exploitation
 - Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
 - Evaluate AI-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
 - Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
 - Work independently on task-based engagements on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK)
 - Proficient with industry-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
 - Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
 - Able to think like an attacker - creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
 - Strong written communication skills - you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
 - Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments

Nice to Have

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
 - Experience with AI/ML security testing - adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red-teaming
 - Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
 - Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
 - Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
 - Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
 - Experience conducting security assessments in compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc. )

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - work when and where it suits you
 - Freelance autonomy with access to high-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
 - Be at the forefront of AI security - a rapidly growing field with massive demand
 - Sharpen your skills against novel AI-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
 - Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

Benefits And Support

NORTH AMERICA

 - Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. 
 - Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field

- Previous technical internship(s).

 - Effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions. 
 - Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly.

data.title: Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Application Support & Testing Specialist (Radio Systems) based in India. 

We are seeking a technically minded specialist to support, test, and improve a radio communications application used in a professional telecommunications environment. In this role, you will combine application support, system and integration testing, JavaScript scripting, and defect management to ensure reliable application performance. You will help users resolve technical issues, maintain system rules and models, and contribute to continuous product improvement. Working within a small, established Agile team, you will collaborate with colleagues to identify issues, enhance functionality, and strengthen software quality. This remote contract opportunity is well suited to someone who enjoys troubleshooting, communicating with users, and developing their technical skills in radio systems and cloud-based testing. 

Accountabilities

- Application Support: Provide timely technical assistance to users, investigate application issues, guide users through troubleshooting steps, and deliver application training when needed. 
 - Integration and System Testing: Plan and execute comprehensive integration and system tests in cloud environments to validate application functionality, reliability, and performance. 
 - Defect Tracking and Resolution: Identify, document, track, and manage software defects using Jira, collaborating with the team to investigate issues and verify fixes. 
 - JavaScript Scripting and System Configuration: Develop and maintain Radio Online (ROL) system rules and models using JavaScript, including variables, loops, functions, and related scripting techniques. 
 - Agile Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members in an established Agile environment to refine application functionality, prioritize issues, and support iterative improvements. 
 - Application Quality and Continuous Improvement: Contribute to testing practices, troubleshoot recurring issues, and recommend improvements to application stability, usability, and support processes. 
 - Technical Learning and Development: Participate in advanced JavaScript training and specialized workshops covering ROL testing methods, continuous integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - User Communication: Explain technical concepts and troubleshooting procedures clearly, helping users understand solutions and use the application effectively. 

Requirements

- Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in engineering or a technical discipline, together with at least three years of engineering, IT, or technical experience; alternatively, five or more years of relevant engineering, IT, or technical experience. 
 - Application Support: Experience or demonstrated capability in technical troubleshooting, application support, and helping users resolve software-related issues. 
 - Testing and Quality Assurance: Understanding of integration testing and system testing, ideally with experience validating applications in cloud-based environments. 
 - JavaScript Fundamentals: Familiarity with JavaScript or the ability to develop scripting skills involving variables, loops, functions, and system logic. 
 - Defect Management Tools: Ability to document and track defects systematically; experience with Jira is valuable. 
 - Agile Collaboration: Willingness to work within an Agile team, collaborate on application improvements, and contribute to structured development and testing workflows. 
 - Communication Skills: Strong verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical steps in straightforward language and support users with patience, empathy, and professionalism. 
 - Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: A methodical approach to investigating issues, identifying root causes, validating fixes, and improving application reliability. 
 - Preferred Radio Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with digital or analog radio technologies, radio communications systems, or dispatch consoles is an advantage. 
 - Learning Mindset: Motivation to develop expertise in JavaScript, specialized radio application testing, and CI/CD practices. 

Benefits

- Health Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance coverage. 
 - Employee Wellbeing: A wellness program with a focus on mental health. 
 - Recognition and Rewards: Employee recognition initiatives and company incentive programs. 
 - Paid Leave and Time Off: A range of leave options, including holiday, maternity, paternity, birthday, bereavement, and paid personal leave. 
 - Remote Work: Remote working opportunities for greater flexibility. 
 - Work-Life Balance: A focus on supporting a healthy balance between professional and personal commitments. 
 - Learning and Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development, technical training, and continued learning. 
 - Immigration Support: An immigration program that may support relocation to Canada for eligible employees. 
 - Contract Opportunity: A remote contract position based in India. Specific compensation details and contract duration were not provided in the original job description.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

data.title: Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Validation Engineer based in India. 

Join an innovative cloud security engineering environment where you will help validate and strengthen the security of modern cloud infrastructure and runtime environments. In this role, you will design automated testing frameworks and ensure that advanced security features perform reliably across major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will work with Python, eBPF, Linux kernel technologies, containers, and Kubernetes to test security capabilities and identify complex technical issues. Collaborating closely with software and kernel engineers, you will investigate runtime behaviour, reproduce challenging issues, and improve the quality and reliability of security solutions. You will also contribute to continuous integration pipelines that enable faster, more consistent validation of new features. This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious engineer who enjoys automation, cloud-native technologies, and solving complex security challenges in a fast-evolving engineering environment. 

Accountabilities

- Cloud security validation: Design, implement, and maintain automated validation strategies for cloud security features and runtime protection capabilities. Ensure that security functionality performs as expected across different cloud environments and deployment configurations. 
 - Python test automation: Develop and maintain Python-based testing frameworks using tools such as pytest. Create reusable test cases, validate REST APIs, process JSON and YAML configurations, and automate repetitive validation tasks to improve test coverage and efficiency. 
 - eBPF and runtime observability testing: Build and maintain test hooks and validation frameworks for eBPF-based capabilities. Work with kernel-level observability mechanisms to verify runtime security functionality and help ensure accurate detection of relevant system and application behaviour. 
 - Multi-cloud environment management: Configure, deploy, and test security sensors and agents across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Validate feature behaviour under different infrastructure configurations and investigate platform-specific issues. 
 - Linux kernel investigation: Collaborate with kernel engineers to reproduce, investigate, and debug runtime security issues. Analyse relevant Linux kernel behaviour, system calls, namespaces, and control groups to identify root causes and support effective fixes. 
 - Continuous integration and automated pipelines: Integrate automated security validation into CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Improve test execution reliability, provide timely feedback on code changes, and help detect regressions early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Container and Kubernetes testing: Validate security functionality across Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, pods, and related cloud-native environments. Investigate issues involving container isolation, runtime behaviour, and infrastructure configuration. 
 - Infrastructure automation and observability: Use tools such as Terraform to provision and manage test environments. Leverage monitoring and visualisation tools such as Grafana to support troubleshooting, test analysis, and performance investigation. 
 - Serverless container validation: Test security capabilities in serverless container environments, including AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run, ensuring consistent behaviour across different deployment models. 
 - Cross-functional engineering collaboration: Work closely with security, platform, and kernel engineering teams to understand technical requirements, improve test coverage, investigate defects, and strengthen the quality and reliability of cloud security features. 
 - Continuous improvement: Identify gaps in existing validation processes, improve test frameworks and automation practices, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of cloud security testing methodologies and engineering standards. 

Requirements

- Cloud engineering experience: Hands-on experience configuring and working with at least one major cloud platform, with practical familiarity across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The ability to deploy infrastructure, configure cloud services, and troubleshoot cloud-based environments is important. 
 - Python automation expertise: Strong Python programming and test automation skills, including experience with pytest, REST API testing, and structured data formats such as JSON and YAML. You should be able to develop maintainable automation frameworks and reusable validation components. 
 - Linux internals: Familiarity with Linux kernel concepts, including system calls, namespaces, control groups (cgroups), and kernel modules. The ability to investigate low-level system behaviour and troubleshoot runtime issues is highly valuable. 
 - eBPF knowledge: Experience with eBPF technologies and kernel-level observability is highly desirable. An understanding of how eBPF-based instrumentation operates and how to validate its behaviour will be a strong advantage. 
 - Containerisation and orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, and pods. You should understand containerised application environments and be comfortable testing security functionality across cloud-native deployments. 
 - Infrastructure as code and monitoring: Practical familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and Grafana for monitoring and visualisation. Experience creating repeatable test environments and analysing system behaviour is beneficial. 
 - CI/CD and test integration: Experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable tools. Understanding test automation, regression detection, and pipeline reliability is important. 
 - Serverless technologies: Exposure to serverless container platforms such as AWS Fargate and Google Cloud Run is an advantage, particularly when validating security behaviour across different execution environments. 
 - Analytical and debugging skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a structured approach to investigating complex technical issues. You should be able to reproduce failures, identify potential root causes, and collaborate with engineers to validate fixes. 
 - Communication and teamwork: Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams, explain technical findings clearly, document test results, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Engineering mindset: A proactive, quality-focused approach to software validation, with an interest in cloud security, runtime protection, automation, and emerging infrastructure technologies. 

Benefits

- Full-time employment opportunity based in India. 
 - Opportunity to work on advanced cloud security and runtime protection technologies. 
 - Exposure to major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern technologies such as Python, eBPF, Linux kernel internals, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Opportunity to collaborate with experienced security, platform, and kernel engineers on complex technical challenges. 
 - Scope to influence automated testing frameworks, validation strategies, and the reliability of security products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native, containerised, and serverless infrastructure environments. 
 - Opportunities to deepen technical expertise in cloud security engineering, runtime observability, and test automation. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Operator
data.description:
HiveWatch is a tech-forward, inclusive organization fostering the evolution of the physical security industry. We are a diverse team of forward thinkers who empower each other to find creative and collaborative solutions in an industry ripe for modernization. We are passionate about the problems we're solving for our customers and equally passionate about the company we're building. 

HiveWatch is here to help security teams pivot from chasing threats to preventing them. We protect organizations, people, and property through the intelligent orchestration of physical security programs. With better communication, more insights, and less "noise", we are modernizing what it means for businesses and their employees to truly feel safe. 

The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our App Experience team. You'll design, build, and ship AI-powered features in the intelligence layer of our platform: the agents that triage alarms, assess incidents, and recommend or take action the way an experienced security operator would. That means composing frontier models (language, vision, audio) with our own data, tooling, and retrieval into production-grade agent workflows, and working across the full stack to do it, from model orchestration in our Kotlin / Spring Boot / Python services to the React/TypeScript surfaces where operators see and act on the results. 

You'll own the evaluation loop for what you build. You'll define what "correct" means for an agent decision, build the eval sets and harnesses to measure it, and use those results to drive changes to prompts, tools, and architecture. To get there, you'll dig into real customer data, including alarm streams, video, access control events, and operator actions, to form and test hypotheses about where agents get things right, where they drift from human judgment, and why. You'll build the guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and observability that let us trust agents with higher-stakes decisions over time, and that let customers understand why an agent did what it did. 

You'll prototype quickly to learn what works, then harden the winners into reliable, cost-aware features. You'll partner closely with our product team and in-house security operations experts to turn operator intuition into something an agent can act on and to find the next problem worth automating. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build agentic product features that assess security scenarios and make decisions human security operators make today, such as whether to triage, escalate, dismiss, or dispatch. 
 - Form hypotheses about our data, then validate them: query production datasets, analyze results, and turn findings into product and model decisions
 - Orchestrate calls to both self-hosted inference models and frontier models, including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, routing across models, and cost/latency tradeoffs
 - Ship end-to-end features: Python for LLM/inference orchestration and analysis, and our Kotlin / Spring Boot / GraphQL backend to integrate agent capabilities into the platform
 - Work with product, customers, and security operations experts to encode operator judgment into agent behavior
 - Reliably deliver features and services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and modern service delivery practices
 - Mentor junior engineers and drive technical decisions that influence the team's architecture and development practices
 - Support production systems through incident response, troubleshooting, and break-fix activities to maintain service reliability and customer trust
 - Participate in a 24/7 on call rotation approximately 1 week per month as needed. 

Our Tech Stack

- Languages: Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, and Rust
 - Deployments: GitHub Actions, Terraform, Terragrunt, and Helm
 - Infrastructure: AWS (Kinesis, Serverless, RDS, EKS), Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3 years in senior roles
 - Strong experience with at least one compiled, object oriented programming language such as Rust, Kotlin, Java, C#, or C++
 - Strong proficiency with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query tuning
 - Experience building full-stack applications in microservice architectures
 - Demonstrated ability to work hypothesis-first with data: framing questions, writing the SQL or analysis code to answer them, and drawing sound conclusions
 - Experience with modern cloud services and cloud-native development
 - Experience with containerization using Docker and deploying applications to Kubernetes
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows
 - Experience using monitoring tools to measure and alert on performance and reliability issues
 - Experience with and enthusiasm for AI native software development practices
 - Strong system design skills and experience with distributed, high-scale applications
 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work in agile environments
 - Data-driven individual who will use metrics to influence decision making

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong experience with AWS
 - Experience designing evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing for agent behavior
 - Experience with real-time or event-driven data (Kinesis, Kafka, or similar)
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code
 - Background in security technology or enterprise software
 - Experience with observability tools and performance optimization
 - Startup experience and/or early-stage SaaS experience

Additional Info

- Salary range for this position: $160, 000 - $200, 000 per year
 - Eligible to participate in HiveWatch Equity Incentive Plan
 - Final offer will be at the company's sole discretion and determined by multiple factors, including years and depth of relevant experience and expertise, location, and other business considerations. 

Benefits & Culture

At HiveWatch, we're passionate about taking care of our people - and it shows in the benefits we offer. Our team enjoys: 

- Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
 - Cutting-edge work in an emerging field with huge growth potential
 - Competitive compensation packages designed to reward top talent
 - A modern, newly renovated HQ right on Main Street in El Segundo, CA
 - 401(k) with a 4% company match to help you invest in your future
 - Flexible paid time off so you can recharge when you need it
 - A family-friendly, compassionate culture that values balance and belonging

We encourage you to challenge the status quo, share your perspective, and leave fear at the (access-controlled) door. 

Our EEO Statement

HiveWatch is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to cultivating a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. We execute our hiring practices so that they are merit-based and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, ancestry, military or veteran status, or other protected characteristic.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations-everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics. From small studios to the largest associations, we help thousands of fitness businesses streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and drive sustainable revenue growth. 

You'll join Grip Technologies Pvt. Ltd. , a Daxko subsidiary, working on FitnessForce, the club management platform used by gyms and fitness businesses around the world. 

About The Role

FitnessForce spans Angular web dashboards, two Flutter mobile apps, and a high-throughput . NET Core backend, all built to run the financial engine of fitness clubs worldwide. As a senior SET, you'll own the quality and reliability of that platform, with a sharp focus on the accuracy and security of our payment systems. 

You'll build and maintain our automation frameworks in Playwright and JMeter, using AI tools like Cursor to speed up test generation while keeping suites deterministic and easy to maintain. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and maintain end-to-end automation frameworks in Playwright, using page object models, custom fixtures, and network interception for reliable, multi-tenant test coverage
 - Design and run load testing strategies in JMeter to find backend bottlenecks and database locking issues under high concurrency
 - Build test suites that validate payment gateway integrations, including tokenization, webhook processing, transaction idempotency, and 3D Secure edge cases
 - Develop strategies to test our asynchronous Kafka architecture, confirming reliable real-time sync across access control, retail, and financial systems
 - Design and maintain test plans for complex, multi-system features, keeping clear traceability between epics, test cases, and bug reports
 - Organize test suites into smoke, sanity, and regression tiers, lead defect triage, and set clear entry and exit criteria for releases
 - Integrate Playwright and JMeter suites into our CI/CD pipeline to gate builds before deployment

What You'll Bring

- 6+ years of experience in software testing and automation within a complex SaaS environment
 - Deep, hands-on expertise with Playwright and TypeScript, including page object models, fixtures, and assertions
 - A proven track record configuring and analyzing distributed load tests with JMeter
 - Strong experience testing payment gateways and complex financial workflows like billing, refunds, and subscription logic
 - Experience using AI coding assistants to generate and maintain automated scripts, with the QA discipline to validate accuracy and eliminate flakiness
 - Solid understanding of testing RESTful APIs and asynchronous messaging systems

Nice To Have

- Experience with mobile test automation frameworks for Flutter apps
 - Familiarity with the fitness, gym management, or POS retail software industry
 - Knowledge of PCI-DSS compliance and its impact on software testing and data handling

You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction.

Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality. 

What You'll Do

- Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management. 
 - Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete.

data.title: Principle Systems Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component -- you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability. 

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements. 
 - Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management. 
 - Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement. 
 - Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure. 
 - Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented. 
 - Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates. 
 - Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management -- with a clear bias away from static credentials. 
 - Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, with demonstrated Principal-level scope (technical leadership without formal management). 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Azure, building cloud native architectures using managed services rather than defaulting to IaaS. 
 - Production experience running and operating Kubernetes at scale, ideally AKS specifically. 
 - Strong GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference. 
 - Experience leading or significantly contributing to a data center-to-cloud migration, including business continuity and disaster recovery planning. 
 - Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent) for security and compliance enforcement. 
 - Strong Identity and Access Management background: workload identity federation, least-privilege IAM design, secrets management patterns that avoid static credentials. 
 - Experience building and maintaining an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent). 
 - Solid Terraform experience, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams, not just single-project usage. 
 - Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers -- through review, pairing, or informal technical leadership -- without formal authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing or operating hub-and-spoke network architectures in Azure. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design for multi-team, multi-repo environments (e. g. , GitHub Actions-based runner infrastructure). 
 - Exposure to evaluating or building genuinely AI-driven operational tooling (as distinct from rules-based automation mislabeled as AI). 
 - Experience presenting technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders.

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar. 
 - Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization). 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

data.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations. 

Responsibilities

Problems the team works on: 

- Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load. 
 - API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs. 
 - Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time. 
 - Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams. 
 - Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed. 
 - Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work. 
 - Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries. 

What we're looking for: 

- Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production. 
 - A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services. 
 - Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management. 
 - Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production. 
 - A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
