data.title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished Application Dev Lead to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL), have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions. 

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Leadership & People Management

- Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms. 
 - Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization. 
 - Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs). 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals. 
 - SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery. 

Technical & Domain Responsibilities

- Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern). 
 - Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments. 
 - High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption. 
 - Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices. 
 - Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers. 
 - Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards. 
 - High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing. 

Recommended Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

- Java & Microservices: 
 - Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC). 
 - Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch). 
 - Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing). 
 - Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Database & Data Persistence: 
 - Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering. 
 - Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE). 
 - Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks). 
 - Enterprise Middleware & Messaging: 
 - Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5. x / 6. x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA. 
 - In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry). 
 - APIs & Protocols: 
 - Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC. 
 - Data formatting & transformation: JSON, XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, XSLT, and Canonical Data Modeling. 
 - Security & Cryptography: 
 - Solid foundation in transport and application security: SSL/TLS 1. 3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Keystores/Truststores, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and API Key/Token management. 
 - DevOps, CI/CD & Observability: 
 - Build & CI/CD toolchains: Git, Maven, Gradle, Harness, TeamCity, Jenkins, uDeploy. 
 - Comprehensive monitoring & logging: Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Micrometer, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin). 
Good To Have Skills

- Automated Testing & Quality Engineering: 
 - Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD). 
 - Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Spring Boot Test. 
 - Experience with API contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract) and performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling). 
 - Knowledge of automated code quality gates and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle). 
Banking Domain Expertise

- Deep expertise in banking and financial services integration architecture and enterprise application patterns. 
 - Proven experience with real-time fraud detection pipelines, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, NACHA/ACH, RTP), core ledger accounting, and trade/transaction processing systems. 
 - In-depth knowledge of real-time transactional flows, straight-through processing (STP), guaranteed exactly-once delivery, idempotency key patterns, and high-volume messaging resilience. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with global banking regulations, audit readiness, operational resilience standards, and data protection frameworks (GLBA, GDPR, PCI-DSS). 

Leadership & Management

- Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams of developers, backend engineers, and integration architects. 
 - Proven ability to manage full end-to-end technical delivery, including architectural roadmapping, scope definition, backlog grooming, estimation, and task prioritization. 
 - Track record of establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, reducing technical debt, and elevating team capabilities in modern technologies. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder management, technical communication, and presentation skills across technical teams and executive business sponsors. 
 - Strong proficiency in driving agile project delivery using Scrum/Kanban methodologies, sprint planning, and release governance.

 - Mentor team members and develop technical and leadership capabilities.

data.title: Senior Manager, Data & Integrations
data.description:
Job Description

Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations

Summary/Objective

The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U. S. -based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization. 

Core Job Duties

- Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines. 
 - Conduct 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team. 
 - Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization. 
 - Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively. 
 - Partner with U. S. -based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones. 
 - Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U. S. data and integrations teams. 
 - Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems. 
 - Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards. 
 - Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution. 
 - Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch. 
 - Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect. 
 - Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e. g. , Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards. 
 - Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e. g. , Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers. 
 - Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns. 
 - Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions. 
 - Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work. 
 - Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U. S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones. 
 - Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U. S. counterparts as needed. 
 - Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U. S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity. 

Job Complexity

Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities. 

Interaction

Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U. S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U. S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones. 

Supervision

Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently. 

Experience

Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work. 
 - 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 
 - Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U. S. -based counterparts across time zones. 
 - Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e. g. , Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato). 
 - Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work. 
 - Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e. g. , Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e. g. , Great Expectations, dbt tests). 
 - Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration. 
 - Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e. g. , Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require. 
 - Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization. 
 - Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution. 
 - Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations. 
 - Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic. 
 - Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently address complex, cross-regional challenges. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across geographies, time zones, and cultures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate global priorities and standards into local execution plans. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: 
 - Direct hands-on experience with Workato
 - Experience with Parabola. io or comparable low-code automation tools
 - Familiarity with streaming/real-time data technologies (e. g. , Kafka, Event Hubs) as a complement to batch pipeline experience
 - Hands-on experience with big data ecosystem services such as Hadoop, Hive, HBase, YARN, and Spark
 - Professional services or customer-facing implementation experience
 - Experience operating in a follow-the-sun or globally distributed delivery model
Position Details

Physical Demands: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 

Travel Required: Yes, up to 15% travel may be required, including periodic travel to the U. S. for team and stakeholder alignment. 

Work Authorization: Employee must be legally authorized to work in India. 

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Location: India (Hybrid/Remote)

data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead Architect to steer our technology team. This senior leadership position is responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of mission-critical, high-performance application systems. The ideal candidate is a thought leader with profound expertise in the Java ecosystem, distributed systems, and microservices architectures. You will set the technical direction and strategy, driving innovation and ensuring the delivery of robust, scalable, and secure solutions that align with our long-term business goals. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for major application systems. Lead feasibility studies, drive technology selection, and create the strategic roadmap for future development. 
 - System & Microservices Design: Lead the architectural design and implementation of complex, large-scale microservices ecosystems using the Spring Boot framework. Ensure designs are scalable, resilient, and maintainable.

data.description:
Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs. 

Qualifications

 - 10+ years of professional software development experience with Java.

data.title: Director of Engineering- Frontend
data.description:
About The Role

ThoughtSpot is looking for a bold, technically fearless Director of Engineering to lead the Connected Insights track - the heart of ThoughtSpot's visualization, navigation, and frontend experience. This track spans three high-impact teams: FE Infra (module federation, client caching, build systems, performance, and developer platform tooling), Charts (the rendering engine for ThoughtSpot's visualization library, from core charting primitives to agent-driven chart configuration via the Answer API), and Liveboard (the primary interactive canvas in ThoughtSpot - architecture, presentation & interactivity, agent integration, and the AI-driven Liveboard experience). 

This is a pivotal moment for the Connected Insights track. The frontend tech stack is deep and modern - React, GraphQL, module federation, complex state management - and the architecture is ready for a thoughtful rethink. We need someone who will question assumptions, challenge the status quo, and bring the curiosity and technical horsepower to redesign for the next era of ThoughtSpot's scale and AI-first product vision. 

Equally important: the bug backlog is real. This leader must approach quality differently - not just as a process checkbox, but as an engineering culture and operational discipline that the team owns and takes pride in. 

What You'll Do

Lead & Scale Three Frontend -Heavy Teams

- Own the engineering roadmap, headcount, and technical vision for FE Infra, Charts, and Liveboard - three teams with deep React and TypeScript DNA. 
 - Be an active presence in architecture forums and design reviews - not just signing off, but shaping technical direction hands-on. 
 - Build and develop engineering managers and senior ICs into the next generation of ThoughtSpot leaders. 
 - Hire relentlessly for intellectual curiosity, ownership mindset, and frontend depth. 

Rethink the Architecture

- Audit the current architecture across module federation, client cache design, state management, rendering performance, and component system - and build a compelling vision for what comes next. 
 - Lead the move to a scalable, maintainable, and AI-ready frontend foundation that can power ThoughtSpot's Spotter, SpotterViz, and next-generation Liveboard experiences. 
 - Drive architectural decisions with first-principles thinking, not convention - question every assumption about how the frontend is structured today. 
 - Define and own the technical north star for frontend infrastructure, charting capabilities, and interactive Liveboard experiences. 

Attack the Bug Backlog & Raise the Quality Bar

- Treat the bug backlog as a cultural and operational challenge, not just a ticket queue - instill a quality-first mindset across all three teams. 
 - Build operational systems (on-call hygiene, bug SLAs, regression prevention, automated testing frameworks) that structurally reduce bug accumulation. 
 - Define quality metrics that the teams live by - not just defect counts, but incident response time, customer-impacting regressions, and release reliability. 
 - Partner with customer success and support to close the loop between customer-facing bugs and engineering accountability. 

Drive Cross-Functional Impact

- Work tightly with Product, Design, and the AI/Spotter teams to ensure the frontend platform keeps pace with an increasingly AI-native product surface. 
 - Represent the Connected Insights track in R&D staff reviews, quarterly planning, and executive discussions with clarity, data, and conviction. 
 - Be the connective tissue between what customers experience in the UI and what engineering builds - customer obsession must be visible in every architectural and process decision. 

What You Have

Non-Negotiables

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (Director level or above) managing multiple teams. 
 - Deep hands-on frontend engineering background - production React, GraphQL caching patterns, module federation, and the modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem at scale. 
 - Proven track record of architectural reinvention - you've led a team through a meaningful frontend re-architecture, not just incremental improvement. 
 - Track record of raising quality standards in a team with a meaningful bug backlog - you know how to make this cultural, not just procedural. 
 - Excellent judgment in hiring, developing, and retaining senior IC and EM talent. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional influence - comfortable presenting to executive leadership and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product and design. 

Strongly Valued

- Experience building or scaling visualization/charting systems - chart rendering performance, SVG/Canvas tradeoffs, animation, responsive design at scale. 
 - Familiarity with AI-integrated product surfaces - building frontend systems that adapt to and expose LLM/NLP capabilities to end users. 
 - Experience in enterprise SaaS environments with multi-tenancy, embedded analytics (SDK, iframe, component embedding), and stringent performance/security requirements. 
 - Prior experience working in geographically distributed teams, particularly with India-based engineering centers. 
 - Exposure to backend services and data pipelines - enough to have informed conversations with backend counterparts and own end-to-end product quality.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Payments
data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join

Payments is key for any healthy marketplace, and is just as central to our product at Airbnb. The Payments organization at Airbnb is responsible for everything related to settling money in Airbnb's global marketplace and makes the Payment experience as delightful, magical, intuitive, and easy as possible. At the Payments team, our goal is to build and operate scalable systems that power payments ecosystems, host/guest protections as well as community partner experiences applying core engineering principles that leverage both time-tested and cutting edge technology. 

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Staff Engineering for Payments, you will provide overarching guardrails on evolution of the architecture with special focus on Community Partner experiences, catering evolving business needs and coaching other engineers on the team. You will envision and design decision support systems, knowledge management systems as well as workflow orchestration systems that can harness various AI advancements. You will define and drive the architecture strategy, work on cross-functional teams to align on organizational initiatives, set standards and help in governance. You will be a player-coach; in that you will be hands-on when a situation arises (player mode) and hands-off where there is opportunity for other engineers to grow and gain experience (coach mode). 

A Typical Day

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, Payments you will: 

- Collaborate with other senior leaders to define and drive long-term technical strategy and architecture that enables the company's future vision. 
 - Establish a technical vision and lead efforts to architect, build, and launch reliable, performant, and scalable solutions. 
 - Be a critic for existing and new technologies, providing a balanced view of the technology landscape and nurture a culture of sustainable innovation. 
 - Collaborate with and influence cross-functional partners to design and deliver high-quality products. 
 - Lead multi-team technical initiatives, and work cross-functionally to identify opportunities for business impact, refine, and prioritize requirements for engineering systems. 
 - Lead conversations that align technical efforts with business outcomes and product priorities. 
 - Uplevel engineering quality through design/code reviews, mentorship, and hands-on implementation. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers through design reviews, code walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning . 

Your Expertise

- 15+ years of experience in a hands-on software engineering role. 
 - Bachelor's and/or Master's degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience building, leading, and architecting production systems or features with broad impact. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership: hands on experience leading project teams, setting technical direction and strategy, prototyping to iterate ideas, and working cross functionally with Product, Design and Operations teams. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical partners, experience driving initiatives that span across teams, departments and leadership. 
 - Passion to level-up those around you through curiosity and fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment. 
 - Proven experience in defining product/technical strategy and driving alignment with cross-functional leaders and stakeholders. 

Your Location: 

This position is India - Remote (Eligible anywhere within India). The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

The SRE Lead - Emerging Payments is accountable for driving the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) transformation and reliability outcomes across the Emerging Payments Production Services portfolio, part of the wider Payments Services organization. You will lead and direct a virtual team of engineers globally, acting as a key technical delegate and reliability partner to the Global Head of Emerging Payments and part of the Management Team. 

This role requires a comprehensive end-to-end understanding of instant and high-throughput payments processing across both legacy and modernized architectures. You will apply an in-depth understanding of the business impact of technical contributions, leading cultural and engineering shifts from traditional application support to proactive, engineered reliability. 

As a technical leader, you will be instrumental in implementing advanced observability, chaos engineering, resiliency, self-healing, and end-to-end automation solutions. You will partner closely with Production, architecture, infrastructure, and application development teams across Citi to eliminate operational toil, drive down Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Recover (MTTR), and ensure the highest levels of stability, scalability, and performance for our global payments platform. 

Responsibilities: 

- SRE Transformation & Regional Leadership: Deliver best-in-class Site Reliability Engineering and production services function for Citi's Emerging Payments portfolio. Establish standard reliability engineering practices across all legacy, hybrid, and cloud-native application stacks. 
 - Observability & Telemetry Engineering: Provide hands-on technical leadership in designing and deploying unified, full-stack observability frameworks. Implement advanced distributed tracing, metrics aggregation, log analytics, anomaly detection, and synthetic monitoring to enable proactive detection and rapid triage of systemic payment issues. 
 - Resiliency, Auto-Healing & Chaos Engineering: Support the implementation of robust resiliency, self-healing, and disaster recovery (DR) solutions. Champion chaos engineering principles, active-active multi-region failover strategies, and automated recovery mechanisms to safeguard critical payment rails against disruption. 
 - Toil Reduction & Automation: Systematically identify, measure, and eliminate operational toil across legacy and modernized applications. Automate runbooks to optimize operational efficiency and minimize manual interventions. 
 - Production Readiness & Architectural Governance: Collaborate strategically with enterprise and solutions architecture teams to embed reliability, observability, and supportability standards into early development phases. Working alongside our Transition Lead enforce rigorous Production Readiness and non-functional requirements (NFRs) for onboarding and migrating applications. 
 - Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement: Drive operational excellence across the portfolio through systematic root cause analysis, capacity planning, performance tuning, and technical debt remediation. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with global business leads, product managers, and engineering leads to translate technical reliability metrics into business value. Transparently communicate system health, operational risks, and modernization progress to senior leadership. 
 - Risk & Compliance: Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi, its clients, and assets. Drive compliance and adhere to policy, and escalate control issues with full transparency. 

Qualifications: 

- 10+ YOE is a must have. 
 - Relevant extensive experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Production Engineering, with proven experience in instant payments, real-time transaction processing, or mission-critical financial systems.

 - Deep hands-on expertise in observability platforms (e. g. , ITRS, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics) and distributed tracing across hybrid environments.

 - Proven experience in building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing technical teams in a global delivery model.

data.description:
About us

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform.   With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability.   We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy - and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there. 

We have a great team and culture - picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.   

We are seeking a driven Mid-Senior AI Engineer with a proven track record of building, deploying, and managing modern AI applications. As a valuable contributor to our engineering team, you will work closely with peers and our product team to develop AI-forward features that support our core platform. You will build services and intelligent agents that help our customers automate their everyday tasks. Since we are in compliance, verifiable results, provable outcomes, and robust guardrails are all critical aspects of our AI feature development. You will play a crucial role in growing our AI capabilities, with an emphasis on high-precision RAG pipelines and spec-driven development to deliver responsible, customer-facing solutions quickly. This is a hands-on, highly technical role for someone passionate about agentic systems and creating tangible product impact. 

WHO YOU ARE: 

You are an AI Engineer who is passionate about building advanced, intelligent services and systems. You have hands-on experience designing and delivering AI applications, managing agents, and optimizing vector databases. You understand that the customer experience is critical, and AI features must deliver business value in order to be worthwhile. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a deep understanding of constraint spaces and AI safety guardrails, and are excited to develop reliable AI-centric features that redefine how users interact with our platform. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO: 

- Build and Manage Agents: Design, deploy, and manage AI agents using modern agentic technologies, ensuring robust performance within defined constraint spaces and safety guardrails. 
 - RAG Optimization: Develop and manage complex RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, actively tuning and optimizing for high recall and precision. 
 - Spec-Driven Development: Partner closely with product managers to translate industry requirements into technical specifications, utilizing spec-driven development to build reliable AI features. 
 - Model Integration & Evals: Work with foundation models via APIs to enable use cases like document summarization and intelligent search. Establish and apply evaluation design patterns to rigorously test, measure, and improve model outputs. 
 - Backend Architecture: Design and code robust backend architecture components heavily utilizing Postgres, REST APIs, queueing, storage systems, RBAC, encryption, and security. 
 - Quality & Operations: Write automated tests, manage version control and collaborative workflows via GitHub, and build monitoring and system health metrics. 
 - Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with AI advancements to ensure our engineering practices remain at the leading edge of AI adoption. WHAT YOU WILL BRING: 

- 4+ years of software engineering experience, including 18+ months working directly on AI-powered features, agents, or applications. 
 - Deep, practical experience using Claude Code. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI applications and integrating LLM-based features in production. 
 - Strong familiarity with measurement of AI agent performance (recall and precision metrics) Proven ability to build and manage AI agents, with a solid understanding of agent technologies, constraint spaces, and evaluation design patterns. 
 - Strong proficiency in backend development, featuring deep experience with Postgres and asynchronous programming (e. g. , Node. js, TypeScript, Python, Go, and/or Java). 
 - Experience managing codebases and collaborative workflows using GitHub. 
 - Experience working with REST APIs using JSON and delivering scalable, reliable, maintainable software. 
 - Familiarity with Azure and/or AWS for deployment, debugging, and operations. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, or a related field. LOCATION

Fully remote, working from India; To facilitate effective collaboration with our distributed engineering teams, this role requires availability to work during the afternoon and evening hours (India Standard Time). 

Compensation

- ₹2, 137, 000 - ₹3, 000, 000CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE

We respect your time and aim for transparency throughout the interview process. You can expect: 

- A Take Home Assessment
 - A 30-minute initial chat with our Principal People & Talent Partner. 
 - Three 60-minute 1: 1 interviews with members of our engineering team, one of them who will be the hiring manager. This process allows both parties to ask questions and gauge fit for the team. 

WHERE YOU'LL GO

- Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us. WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES

Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ

- Annual compensation reviews + equity
 - Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
 - Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
 - 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
 - 12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
 - Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects
 - $500 home office stipend - at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed. 
 - $100 quarterly  paid wellness stipend
 - Pet insurance discount
 - Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
 - Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)  It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof - we recently  raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space. 

At Hyperproof's core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.   

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) do the right things so the wrong things don't happen. 

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started. 

A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We're committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process. 

Here's what that means for you: 

- We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process. 
 - You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background. 
 - For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.                                                                                                               These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace  - it's one of our core values! Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.   

Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others. 

To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is not a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

AI Mindset for All Spotters

At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.

Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI. 

ThoughtSpot for All

At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you're a strong match, we encourage you to apply. 

What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?

ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

We are seeking a Lead, Data Validation Specialist to oversee a team of Data Validation Specialists responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data during new client onboarding. You'll manage daily workflows, ensure consistent data quality across projects, and serve as the primary liaison between the Data Validations team and cross-functional partners. 

This is primarily a non-client-facing role that plays a key part behind the scenes, requiring focus, consistency, and comfort with repetitive work. It's a great fit for someone who enjoys working with data in a structured way and takes pride in getting the details right. 

You'll be instrumental in fostering a collaborative team culture, driving consistency in our data conversions, and contributing to the growth of both your team and our global function. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position

What You'll Do

- Lead and mentor a team of Data Validation Specialists, supporting career development, delivering regular feedback, and helping individuals thrive in their role
 - Manage a team's work allocation, prioritization, and execution to ensure on-time, high-quality project delivery
 - Review and audit data validation projects to ensure adherence to standards and best practices
 - Drive process improvements to increase data occurrence, reduce turnaround time, and enhance scalability
 - Develop and maintain documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures for data validation
 - Collaborate cross-functionally across global teams, including Sales, Client Solutions, Product, and Engineering, to deliver integrated solutions
 - Foster a team culture that values collaboration, learning, and a shared commitment to client success
 - Maintain a personal set of data validation projects, performing hands-on review and reconciliation of client data alongside team leadership responsibilities

Who You Are

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, ideally in Business, Finance, Math, Economics, or another data-oriented field
 - 3+ years of experience in data validation, financial operations, data quality assurance, or a related field
 - 1+ year of people leadership or team coordination experience preferred
 - Strong organizational and analytical skills, with a proven track record of maintaining accuracy in high-volume data environments
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to guide and influence across teams
 - Proficiency with spreadsheets (e. g. , Excel), internal tools, and web-based platforms
 - Familiarity with financial data is a plus, but not required. Quick to learn new systems and follow structured processes for data navigation and validation
 - Process-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset and strong attention to detail

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.description:
VP - Engineering

Build. Own. Scale. 

Remote - India | Full-time

The Opportunity

Basis Vectors is seeking an entrepreneurial VP - Engineering for a leadership opportunity within its portfolio ecosystem. This is a hands-on role with substantial autonomy, direct access to senior business leadership, and the potential to grow into a CTO position based on demonstrated impact. 

What You'll Own

1. Build and Scale Great Products

• Lead the architecture, development, and evolution of scalable B2B SaaS products. 

• Own the full product lifecycle-from customer problems through launch, adoption, and improvement. 

• Balance speed, reliability, scalability, and cost in technical decisions. 

• Stay hands-on with engineering and difficult technical problems. 

• Build with the resourcefulness and urgency of a startup founder. 

2. Make Customers Love Using What You Build

• Understand how customers discover, adopt, and engage with products. 

• Track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion through product analytics. 

• Identify friction points and opportunities to improve customer experience. 

• Develop onboarding, lifecycle communications, and re-engagement initiatives. 

• Run experiments to improve repeat usage and customer satisfaction. 

3. Let Customers Shape the Product

• Speak directly with customers to understand needs and frustrations. 

• Establish feedback loops through interviews, surveys, and usage analytics. 

• Turn patterns in feedback into meaningful product improvements. 

• Prioritize customer value over feature counts and measure results. 

4. Turn Technology into Commercial Success

• Understand the economics of successful B2B SaaS businesses. 

• Work with business leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, and commercialization. 

• Connect engineering decisions to acquisition, retention, and recurring revenue. 

• Join customer discussions and product demonstrations. 

• Own business impact, not just software delivery. 

5. Lead Like a Founder

• Build and mentor a small, exceptionally capable engineering team. 

• Maintain high technical standards while moving quickly. 

• Make decisions amid ambiguity and take responsibility for outcomes. 

• Use modern technology, including AI and automation, where it creates value. 

• Develop the technical vision and leadership to scale a business. 

Who We're Looking For

We're less interested in years of experience or titles than in what you've built-and what happened when customers started using it. 

• Built a B2B SaaS product from scratch or played a pivotal role from MVP to commercial traction. 

• Can demonstrate paying customers, recurring revenue, growth, retention, or significant adoption. 

• Exceptional hands-on engineering and architectural judgment. 

• Uses customer feedback and usage data to improve products. 

• Worked in a startup, founded something, or operated entrepreneurially in a larger organization. 

• Comfortable working with customers and commercial teams. 

• Enjoys ambiguity, moves quickly, and takes ownership. 

• Can attract and lead talented engineers while remaining technically involved. 

Especially Interesting Backgrounds

• Technical founders or cofounders who launched products. 

• Founding engineers who helped startups achieve commercial success. 

• Engineering leaders at high-growth SaaS companies seeking greater ownership. 

• Exceptional engineers in established technology companies who led new-product initiatives and want an entrepreneurial challenge. 

• Builders with strong technical foundations and commercial instincts. 

Strong academic credentials from IITs, IISc, BITS, IIITs, and other leading institutions are welcome, but achievements matter more than pedigree. 

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

Understand the business, customers, and technology; identify high-impact opportunities; establish meaningful product and engineering metrics; deliver initial improvements and experiments. 

First 6 months

Demonstrate improvements in adoption, engagement, and retention; connect customer feedback to engineering priorities; strengthen technical execution; validate commercial opportunities. 

First 12 months

Demonstrate meaningful commercial impact; establish a scalable, customer-driven engineering organization; align the technology roadmap with growth; demonstrate readiness for broader CTO responsibilities. 

Why This Opportunity Is Different

- Real ownership. Success is measured by the value you create, not features shipped. 
 - Freedom to build. Make decisions without unnecessary layers. 
 - Direct influence. Shape both technology and commercial strategy with entrepreneurial leadership. 
 - Startup energy with an established business platform. Pursue ambitious ideas with access to experience and resources. 
 - A path to CTO. Earn broader leadership responsibilities through results. 
 - Remote flexibility. Work from anywhere in India with international teams. 
 - Performance-linked upside. Compensation designed to reward meaningful contributions and outcomes. 

How to Apply

Interested ones should write to: 

Recruit@basisvps. com and neelmani@basisvps. com

data.title: Technical Expert - Agentic Systems
data.description:
Location: Bangalore. 

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Manager, Esko AI

About The Role

The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions - and invoke expert human judgement when required. This is a complex engineering problem that goes beyond the boundaries of standard agentic scenarios. 

We're looking for a Technical Expert to take technical ownership of core agentic capabilities within Esko's AI Platform, from experimentation and design through production implementation. be a senior authority and author on agentic AI across Esko's AI Platform. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business. 

You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a 'sixth sense' for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains. 

What You Will Do

- Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems. 
 - Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation. 
 - Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction. 
 - Diagnose and resolve the platform's toughest technical issues - performance, reliability, correctness, and edge-case failures - where specialist knowledge is the difference between a real fix and a workaround. 
 - Contribute into architecture discussions, stress-testing designs against hard technical realities (scaling limits, failure modes, subtle correctness issues) that come from real specialist experience. 
 - Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting. 
 - Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial time as a senior/staff/principal-level individual contributor architecting and operating production agentic AI systems involving multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, or orchestration, where alignment and dependability of the agent's output is a key success factor. 
 - Experience across multiple distinct agentic AI projects, able to draw on that breadth to guide technical decisions in unfamiliar contexts. 
 - Deep, hands-on expertise in: LLM agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and validation-before-action patterns, RAG and retrieval architecture, evaluation and observability for AI systems. 
 - A track record of setting technical direction and shaping outcomes across teams without formal management authority. 
 - Sound engineering judgement on production concerns at platform scale: reliability, security, multi-tenancy, performance, and observability for services consumed by many internal teams. 
 - Excellent technical communication - able to write RFCs and architectural documents that align diverse stakeholders, and to move fluently between deeply technical and business audiences. 
 - Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and autonomy, including defining the right problem as much as solving it. 
 - Undergraduate, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 

Preferred Experience

- Public technical-leadership signals: conference talks, published papers or blog posts, significant open-source contributions, or patents in AI/agentic systems. 
 - Semantic and symbolic tooling (RDF/OWL, SHACL, Datalog, DMN, production rule engines, policy-as-code) as one of several tools in a broader agentic toolkit. 
 - Experience in high-accountability, regulated domains (pharmaceutical or food labelling, legal technology, financial services) or the packaging/graphic arts industry. 
 - Experience scaling an AI or data platform from a handful of internal consumers to many, including the governance and support model that requires. 

What Success Looks Like

- The platform's hardest technical problems get solved correctly and durably. 
 - The team turns to you as the deep technical authority on agentic AI and LLM systems - for the "how" and "why it breaks, ". 
 - The components you build are robust, well-tested, and well-documented, with edge cases and failure modes properly accounted for rather than discovered in production. 
 - Your specialist expertise ends up embedded in the platform itself - in code, designs, and documentation - not just in advice given in meetings, and also reflected in growing knowledge and capabilities of more junior team members. 
 - Emerging techniques and tools get properly evaluated on their technical merits, so adoption decisions are grounded in real hands-on assessment rather than hype. 
 - Agents built on components you own reliably apply the correct context, explain their reasoning, justify / evidence actions, and escalate rather than guess when evidence is ambiguous or absent. 

Esko is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17, 000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital ResourcesTM-and building rewarding careers along the way. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

data.title: Senior Circuit Silicon Correlation DFT Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI - the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human imagination and intelligence. Make the choice to join us today. 

What Will You Be Doing

- Participate in ground breaking Processor design and debug in deep submicron technologies. 
 - Work in a multi functional team passionate about Silicon characterization and correlation to pre-Silicon Performance and Power models. 
 - Responsible for generating ATPG patterns for Silicon speed path debug. 
 - RTL and gate level verification for ATPG, non-ATPG patterns. 
 - Correlating diagnosis result to map to real design failures. Root cause the same feed learnings to pre-silicon design sign off parameters. 
 - RAM correlation by studying RAM circuit failure mechanisms and understanding their limits on silicon
 - Bring in more circuit understanding into the RAM testing methods across RAM types, chips and processes and improve correlation in the long run
 - Develop new methodologies using DFT infrastructure to analyze components of mis-correlation in logic and in/around RAM. 

What We Need To See

- BSEE required/MS preferred in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with 8+ years experience; Prior leadership experience a certain plus. 
 - Good understanding of Design-for-test(DFT) and logic design is required. 
 - Must possess a solid understanding of DFT including scan, BIST, on-chip scan compression, fault models, ATPG, and fault simulation. 
 - Must have some experience in bringing up RTL/gate level simulation, writing testcase and debugging it. 
 - Basics of circuits and RAM functionality/architecture will be helpful. 
 - Experience in VLSI simulation tools like VCS etc
 - Experience with pattern generation using tools such as tessent. 
 - Proficiency in scripting language, such as, Python, Perl, Tcl, Make and automation methods/algorithms would be good. 
 - Prior experience in STA and basic understanding of circuit concepts will help in the role. 
 - Post-Silicon data gathering experience is a plus. 

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you.

 - System-First Thinker-you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

Why Join Us?

data.title: Senior Investigation Specialist, Last Mile - Flex VoD
data.description:
Description

The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of the Voice of Driver (VoD) organization within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). VoD is responsible for identifying, interpreting, and acting on signals that indicate friction in the Delivery Partner (DP) experience across the Amazon Flex journey. 

RABT owns the operational mechanism for identifying, validating, and triaging potential defects in the Rabbit application. The team consolidates feedback from multiple sources, including Driver Support contacts, station escalations, country teams, social media, and app reviews, and converts those signals into structured, evidence-based technical investigations. 

The team's role is not limited to defect intake. RABT determines whether a reported issue is actionable, reconstructs the affected DP journey using available operational and technical signals, assesses recurrence and potential blast radius, removes duplicate noise, and provides engineering teams with sufficiently complete evidence to accelerate root-cause analysis and resolution. The team also identifies systemic gaps in product behavior, operational mechanisms, and diagnostic coverage, and works with partner teams to improve both defect detection and the quality of upstream signals. 

RABT is looking for a Senior Investigation Specialist who can independently manage complex investigations, work through incomplete or ambiguous information, and translate large volumes of DP feedback and operational data into clear technical findings. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong investigative judgment with analytical capability and operational rigor. The role requires regular use of SQL, dashboards, logs, case history, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools to validate hypotheses and quantify impact. The successful candidate will also work closely with Program Managers, Product Managers, Software Development Managers, Engineers, Operations teams, and other stakeholders across geographies. 

In addition to managing individual investigations, the role will contribute to improving RABT's broader operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomy, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect-intake processes. 

Key job responsibilities

- Independently investigate and triage complex Rabbit app issues using DP feedback, operational data, logs, system signals, and internal diagnostic tools. 
 - Determine issue actionability, identify failure patterns, distinguish product defects from operational or expected behavior, and assess potential blast radius. 
 - Create clear, evidence-backed technical tickets that enable Product and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Analyze trends and recurring defects using SQL, Excel, dashboards, and other analytical tools to identify emerging risks and systemic problems. 

Partner with Program, Product, Engineering, Operations, and country teams to drive high-impact issues through investigation, escalation, and closure. 

- Improve RABT operating mechanisms, including SOPs, quality controls, taxonomies, investigation frameworks, and knowledge repositories. 

Support automation and AI-driven triage by defining investigation logic, validating outputs, identifying failure modes, and reducing repetitive manual work. 

About The Team

The Rabbit App Bug Triage (RABT) team is part of Voice of Driver (VoD) within Worldwide Flex Driver Partner Insights & Experience (WW DPIX). RABT Team identifies, validates, and triages potential Rabbit app defects using feedback from Driver Support, stations, country teams, social media, and app reviews. The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Program teams to improve issue actionability, reduce defect-resolution time, and strengthen the DP experience. RABT also develops scalable mechanisms across quality, automation, AI-assisted triage, and defect detection to improve how app issues are identified and resolved globally. 

Basic Qualifications

- high school diploma or bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience pulling data from databases using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems
 - Experience using SQL
