data.title: Head of Product and Engineering - Director
data.description:
Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering

Location: Pune (Hybrid)

Line of Business: Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology

About The Role

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?

At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms. 

In this dual-hatted role, you will: 

Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms. 

Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site. 

This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Strategy , Platform Unification and Product Management
 - Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform. 
 - Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency. 
 - AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine. 
 - Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability. 
 - Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
 - Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
 - Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
 - Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99. 999% platform availability. 
 - Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes. 
 - India Site Leadership
 - Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs. 
 - Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies. 
 - Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies. 

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture

We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack: 

- Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
 - Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e. g. , Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
 - Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
 - AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We're Looking For (Qualifications)

Basic Qualifications: 

- Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
 - Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications. 
 - Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale. 
 - Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects. 
 - Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience. 
 - Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e. g. , Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Why Join Citi?

- Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk. 
 - True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals. 
 - Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery. 

And many more reasons. . .

data.title: Sr. Test Analyst
data.description:
Job Summary

Sr Test Analyst will plan and execute complex manual testing for Azure IoT based solutions with strong domain understanding to ensure high quality delivery for global clients. The role involves designing thorough test scenarios for connected systems validating functional and nonfunctional behavior collaborating with cross functional teams in a hybrid work model and ensuring stringent quality standards for safety critical and business critical applications. 

Responsibilities

- Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test plans for Azure IoT based applications and platforms to ensure resilient performance and functional accuracy across diverse deployment environments. 
 - Execute end to end manual test cycles including test case preparation test data creation and systematic test execution to validate core workflows interfaces integrations and user journeys. 
 - Analyze complex requirements and technical specifications to derive robust test conditions ensuring complete coverage of domain flows edge scenarios and regulatory or compliance expectations. 
 - Coordinate closely with product owners business analysts and engineering teams to clarify requirements resolve ambiguities and refine test scope for high impact releases in a hybrid work model. 
 - Document precise test cases test results and defect logs using structured templates and enterprise tools to maintain traceability from requirements through test execution and defect closure. 
 - Investigate defects with detailed root cause analysis collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and track resolution while continuously improving defect prevention practices. 
 - Perform regression testing and validation of fixes across multiple versions to safeguard critical Azure IoT features including data collection processing device connectivity and alerting functions. 
 - Validate integration of sensors devices gateways and cloud services from an end user and operational perspective ensuring reliable communication secure data handling and accurate reporting. 
 - Apply strong domain knowledge to simulate realistic operational scenarios assess impact on business processes and confirm safe and reliable behavior of connected solutions. 
 - Contribute to test process optimization by proposing improvements in test design review practices risk based testing and metrics driven reporting to enhance efficiency and quality outcomes. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to produce clear test status dashboards summarize risks and recommend release readiness decisions that align with organizational objectives and client expectations. 
 - Assist in refining acceptance criteria and nonfunctional expectations such as usability and reliability to ensure that tested solutions deliver meaningful benefits to customers and society. 
 - Support knowledge sharing through documentation of best practices mentoring junior testers and promoting standardized test approaches across projects. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong manual testing expertise with the ability to design and execute detailed test cases and articulate clear defect descriptions for complex application ecosystems. 
 - Possess solid practical experience working with Azure IoT solutions including device management telemetry validation data flows and monitoring features in real world scenarios. 
 - Show advanced domain understanding to interpret business processes and user needs transforming them into meaningful and testable requirements that improve product value. 
 - Bring experience or exposure to medical devices or similar regulated domains which enables deeper appreciation of safety quality and compliance demands in connected products. 
 - Utilize enterprise test management and defect tracking tools efficiently while maintaining disciplined documentation and traceability practices.

Recommended certifications include ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Test Analyst and Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals for cloud and IoT familiarity.

data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Lead Python AI/ML Engineer with Generative AI Capabilities to lead the design, development, and deployment of next-generation artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions based out of our Chennai center (operating in a Hybrid work model). With 10 to 12 years of hands-on software and machine learning engineering experience, the ideal candidate will drive the convergence of traditional predictive ML models and modern Foundation Model / GenAI architectures. 

In this role, you will be instrumental in building high-scale, low-latency AI solutions applied to Fraud Mitigation, Risk Scoring, and Loss Prevention across US Retail Banking products

- Key Responsibilities

AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture

- Architect, build, and deploy production-grade Generative AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous agents, semantic search pipelines, and multi-modal AI workflows. 
 - Integrate state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs)-including Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models (Llama, Mistral)-optimizing for latency, cost, and accuracy. 
 - Build domain-specific prompt engineering frameworks, fine-tuning pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA), model evaluation benchmarks, and guardrails to minimize hallucinations and bias. 
 - Lead the architecture of predictive ML algorithms (anomaly detection, graph neural networks, supervised/unsupervised classifiers) tailored to real-time risk assessment. 

Software Engineering & System Scalability

- Design resilient, low-latency, and horizontally scalable microservices and APIs in Python (FastAPI, Flask, AsyncIO) handling high-throughput transactional traffic. 
 - Integrate vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, pgvector) with distributed caching and event streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ). 
 - Implement robust MLOps and LLMOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, automated model retraining, observability with MLflow/Weights & Biases, model drift monitoring). 

Fraud Analytics & Domain Innovation

- Collaborate closely with US-based and global Risk, Compliance, and Loss Prevention teams to build AI solutions targeting identity theft, account takeover (ATO), synthetic identity fraud, card-not-present (CNP) fraud, and transaction anomaly detection. 
 - Utilize unstructured data (investigator notes, SAR filings, customer interaction logs) via GenAI to automate fraud triage and investigative summarization. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to US Banking regulatory standards (FCRA, GLBA, Model Risk Management SR 11-7, Fair Lending, Explainable AI / XAI). 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

data.description:
EngRadar / Stripe

Software Engineer, Payin

Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. 

Stripe is the employer - EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs. 

Bengaluru Posted today fintechpayments

Apply directly →

Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Organization

Payments is at the core of Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We are expanding our payments footprint in India and we are looking for Backend Engineers to own the technical architecture behind our next generation of payment offerings in India. 

As part of the India Payments team, you will build on top of Stripe's robust foundational platforms, driving complex integrations and contributing to the architectural evolution of the critical services that handle money movement every millisecond. You will engineer the entire horizontal payments stack, driving every phase of a transaction's journey: integrating with local payment rails, managing initiation and intelligent routing, ensuring reliable completion and automating reconciliation and payouts. 

Partnering with cross-functional engineering hubs globally, you will tackle high-stakes technical challenges requiring low-latency execution, strict transactional idempotency, zero-downtime migrations and resilient distributed state management at scale. 

If you thrive on taking ambiguous product mandates and turning them into fault-tolerant, self-healing distributed systems, you will feel right at home here. 

What You'll Do (Core Responsibilities)

- Architect and operate low-latency, fault-tolerant backend microservices that integrate with Indian payment methods
 - Map complex, India-specific payment flows into Stripe's global, unified API platforms, ensuring a seamless integration experience for developers worldwide
 - Design highly reliable adapter layers that interact with domestic banking partners and payment networks, building systems that gracefully handle external API latency and asynchronous callbacks
 - Own end-to-end service health, implementing shadow rollouts, distributed tracing, automated failovers and proactive alerting for 99. 99% uptime
 - Collaborate with Product, Regulatory/Legal, Risk and Partner Integration teams across global engineering hubs while delivering seamless developer-facing APIs
 - Mentor and empower engineers to contribute independently through ongoing technical guidance and actionable feedback

Other Responsibilities

- Independently scope, build and ship medium-to-large projects from ambiguous requirements to production
 - Build robust APIs that hide the extreme complexity of Indian payment rails behind simple, elegant developer experiences
 - Partner with product and data teams to proactively identify, size and solve the most impactful problems for our users
 - Engineer highly reliable, scalable infrastructure that consistently meets strict SLAs for all internal and external systems
 - Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term
 - Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes
 - Accelerate team velocity through high-quality code reviews and architectural collaboration

Who You Are

Minimum requirements

- 7+ years of experience designing, implementing and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services
 - You have implemented server-side APIs in languages like Ruby, Java, or Go, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL)
 - Empathetic, collaborative and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
 - Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates and subject matter experts
 - The ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs
 - Excellent oral and written communication

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building large-scale financial systems, payments infrastructure or working in the broader fintech industry is a plus
 - Experience building distributed systems or operating within a complex microservices architecture
 - Proficiency in Ruby, Java, or Go, with deep experience modeling data in relational and document databases (e. g. , MySQL, Mongo)
 - Experience driving technical alignment across global, cross-functional teams

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay And Benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

data.description:
Citi is looking for an experienced e-Trading Technology Quality Assurance (QA) Senior Analyst to play a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of electronic trading platforms within a high-velocity, globally connected Capital Markets technology environment. In this role, you will own quality assurance across the full testing lifecycle - from UAT strategy through to production rollout - directly influencing the reliability and regulatory compliance of trading systems used at scale. You will operate as a senior quality leader, mentoring colleagues, shaping testing standards, and coordinating across global technology and business teams to drive consistent, measurable quality outcomes. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end quality assurance across UAT and production rollout cycles for electronic trading platforms, including validation of Futures and Options products, algorithmic Trading and Execution Platform, and electronic order management workflows. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain automated test suites using Java and Cucumber within a Behavior-Driven Development framework, ensuring test coverage aligns with system and regulatory requirements. 
 - Define and enforce quality standards and testing procedures across the software development lifecycle, conducting annual reviews and recommending improvements to keep practices current and effective. 
 - Monitor products and processes for conformance to established standards, identify quality risks, perform root cause analysis, and deliver clearly documented remediation recommendations. 
 - Validate system behavior against FIX protocol specifications and electronic trading regulatory obligations, ensuring trading platform outputs meet both technical and compliance benchmarks. 
 - Act as a quality advisor and mentor to junior team members, providing guidance on testing approaches, standards adherence, and professional development within IT Quality. 
 - Assess quality-related risks in business and technology decisions, escalating control issues transparently and ensuring all corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and resolved to completion. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- 9-13 years experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle from test strategy through to production validation. 
 - Must - Hands-on experience testing electronic trading platforms, including a solid working knowledge of Futures and Options products, Capital Markets and Derivatives domains, order types, and electronic trading processes. 
 - Must - Demonstrated experience testing e-Trading lifecycles and workflows as well experience of trading algorithms such as TWAP, VWAP, Iceberg etc. with the ability to validate algorithmic behavior against defined specifications. 
 - Proficiency in test automation using Java and Cucumber within a BDD Behavior-Driven Development framework, including the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts independently. 
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments such as ECS, and version control using GitHub, enabling effective integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows. 
 - Good understanding of the FIX protocol and regulatory obligations for electronic trading, with the ability to validate system behavior against these standards in a structured and auditable way. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication and coordination skills, with the ability to align project teams, vendors, and global counterparts on quality outcomes across complex, multi-geography programs. 

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

- Project management experience in a fast-paced, time-to-market driven technology environment, with the ability to manage quality workstreams across concurrent deliverables. 
 - Experience contributing to the development of new testing standards and procedures in collaboration with cross-functional technology teams. 
 - Familiarity with process audit methodologies and the ability to conduct structured product evaluation and conformance assessments.

data.title: Quality Engineering Lead – Data & Reporting Platforms
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced VP, Quality Engineering Lead to define, build, and drive our automated data and report testing strategy. In this role, you will lead the Quality Engineering (QE) initiatives for our next-generation, AI-powered data and reporting ecosystem. 

As a hands-on leader, you will design robust automated test suites to validate complex data architectures-specifically focusing on data virtualization, massive data federation, data contract testing, and the verification of emerging natural language/conversational AI query interfaces. You will manage a talented team of quality engineers, establish testing standards, and collaborate closely with engineering, and product teams to ensure high-quality, secure, and performant data and report delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
 - Data & Reporting Test Strategy: Architect and execute a comprehensive, end-to-end automated testing strategy covering data virtualization, federated queries, BI/reporting, and AI-enabled analytical interfaces. 
 - Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and functionally manage a specialized team of Data & Report Quality Engineers, fostering a culture of modern Quality Engineering (QE) and continuous improvement. 
 - Governance & Compliance: Define operating standards, automated quality gates, and data verification protocols across the analytics and reporting delivery lifecycle. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Own the reporting of quality metrics, pipeline coverage, and test automation maturity to senior global technology and engineering leaders. 
 - Data Virtualization & Federation Testing
 - Federated Query & Virtualization Validation: Develop automated testing frameworks to validate query execution, latency, and data integrity across massive federated query engines and data virtualization platforms (e. g. , Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill) connecting dozens of heterogeneous catalogs without physical data movement. 
 - Data Contract & Schema Validation: Implement automated schema validation and data contract testing to ensure curated, virtualized data products strictly adhere to published business definitions and system requirements. 
 - Access Control & Security Testing: Design data-driven security tests to verify that centralized data access governance (e. g. , Apache Ranger, role/attribute-based access controls) and data masking are flawlessly applied. 
 - AI & Conversational Intelligence Testing
 - Natural Language Query Testing: Establish frameworks to test conversational AI interfaces that allow users to query data using natural language. Validate natural language processing (NLP) models, intent recognition, NLP-to-SQL translation logic, and the accuracy of the underlying datasets returned. 
 - Autonomous Agent Verification: Design testing patterns for non-deterministic AI agents (e. g. , automated alerting systems and contextual research assistants), validating logical outputs, threshold actions, and boundary limits. 
 - Big Data & Reporting Platform Testing
 - Report & Dashboard Verification: Devise automated strategies to test visual correctness, performance, and backend data reconciliation for BI platforms (e. g. , Tableau, custom web-based dashboards) during large-scale migration phases of legacy systems (comprising hundreds of reports). 
 - Data Lakehouse & Pipeline Testing: Lead automation efforts validating complex data pipelines across hybrid databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and modern analytical lakehouses. 
 - Data Reconciliation: Design and automate source-to-target data reconciliation, schema drift detection, and data lineage validation to ensure reports match underlying source systems perfectly. 
 - CI/CD & Test Automation Engineering
 - Continuous Quality Pipelines: Seamlessly integrate data and report automation suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab, etc. ) to trigger continuous verification with each deployment code path. 
 - Triage & Defect Management: Champion structured defect triage, prioritizations, and root cause analysis across complex, multi-tiered data and reporting infrastructure environments. 

Technology Skills

Required Technical Skillsets

- Data Virtualization & Federation: Hands-on experience with enterprise data virtualization or query federation platforms, such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill. 
 - BI & Reporting Platforms: Deep expertise in testing BI and reporting platforms (e. g. , Tableau, custom web-based dashboards, Aspose, or similar reporting engines). 
 - Database Querying & Testing: Advanced SQL expertise with hands-on experience testing relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases. 
 - Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python or Java to build, maintain, and scale custom test automation frameworks. 
 - API Testing: Strong experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and data contract validation using tools like Postman, RestAssured, or custom scripts. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Experience integrating automated data test suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing. 
 - Test Methodologies: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, functional, integration, regression, and parallel-run testing for large-scale migrations. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skillsets

- Modern Lakehouse & Warehouse Platforms: Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms, such as Databricks or Snowflake (experience with Google BigQuery is also valued). 
 - Distributed Data Processing Engines: Familiarity with distributed compute engines, specifically Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink for large-scale data processing. 
 - Data Quality Automation: Experience implementing automated data quality frameworks using industry-standard tools such as Great Expectations, dbt test, Soda / SodaCL, or Deequ / PyDeequ. 
 - AI/ML & NLP Testing: Experience testing LLM-backed applications, validating Natural Language-to-SQL engines (e. g. , conversational query interfaces), prompt validation, and autonomous agent testing. 

Leadership & Methodology

- Agile QE Leadership: Strong experience running QA cycles within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint closures, and collaborating with cross-functional Dev/Product leads. 
 - Test Strategy Design: Proven track record of designing multi-layered testing strategies (unit, integration, regression, system, and regression parallel runs for migrations). 

Experience & Qualifications

- Total Testing Experience: Minimum 10-12 years of relevant experience in software testing, quality engineering, or data engineering. 
 - Data Automation Experience: Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on experience in automated data testing, ETL testing, or data pipeline quality engineering. 
 - BI & Analytics Verification: Minimum 5-8 years of experience in report/BI testing, data reconciliation, and source-to-target data validation. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent engineering field.

As a Senior Software Engineer - Monitoring Engineer at H&M Business Tech, you will work in an agile context and take responsibility for continuously evolve and create value adding monitoring and visibility into production from a customer experiences perspective, maintain monitoring guiding principles for the domain, perform analytics and audits on what's in production, act as an enabler to our colleges and teams within the domain to help drive adoption of the monitoring principals and help us achieve commercial execution excellence.

- Set up, continuously improve and innovate around application and customer experience monitoring. 
 - Data driven based on understanding of common goals and identify gaps.

 - Work to incorporate AI to improve value-adding insights by identifying possible candidates and finding those opportunities. 
 - Review outcomes and assist product teams in analyzing data to drive positive changes. 
 - Closely interact with our operation teams to get real-life input. 
 - Create insightful reports and audit reports and present results to various stakeholders. 
 - Drive our overall framework for Customer Experience Monitoring.

- A good understanding of retail and e-commerce and large international organizations.

You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices. 

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in: 

- Engineering or operations
 - Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
 - Analysis
 - Project management

More About This Role

Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion. 

What you need to know about this position: 

Experience

5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food & beverage preferred). 

PLC / SCADA

Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards. 

Electrical

Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives. 

Instrumentation

Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology. 

Digital and Cybersecurity

Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations. 

OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools. 

Process and Equipment Safety. 

Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes. 

Leadership

Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting. 

Project Mgmt

Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope). 

Communication

Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English. 

Education / Certifications: 

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 

Job specific requirements: 

Electrical Systems

- Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion & Plant projects. 
 - Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e. g. , NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements). 

Automation for plant projects

- Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc. ), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion. 
 - Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps. 

Project Delivery

- Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification. 
 - Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the E&A scope. 

People Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers. 
 - Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments. 
 - Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team. 
 - Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning. 

Safety & Compliance

- Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements. 
 - Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation. 

Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd. ) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. data.title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
data.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering - from Agentic AI flow testing and RAG pipeline validation to AI safety, test automation, and performance & reliability engineering. 

You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines. 

Responsibilities

Agentic AI Testing

- Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e. g. , ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion). 
 - Test tool-use correctness - ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time. 
 - Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions. 
 - Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph). 
 - Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops. 

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing

- Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines - covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages. 
 - Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance - ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query. 
 - Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora. 
 - Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval. 
 - Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality. 
 - Validate context window management - ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality. 
 - Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes. 
 - Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns. 

Test Automation

- Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation. 
 - Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation. 
 - Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data. 
 - Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes. 
 - Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions. 
 - Automate vector database validation - index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks. 

AI Safety & Security Testing

- Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems. 
 - Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior. 
 - Validate privilege escalation controls - ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources. 
 - Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness. 
 - Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas. 
 - Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies. 
 - Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including: 
 - Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
 - Insecure Output Handling
 - Training Data Poisoning
 - Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
 - Sensitive Information Disclosure
 - Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity. 
 - Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management. 
 - Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations. 
Performance & Reliability Testing

- Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services. 
 - Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines - from query to final response. 
 - Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure. 
 - Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions. 
 - Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation. 
 - Test vector database performance - query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency. 
 - Conduct cost efficiency analysis - measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task. 
 - Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates. 
 - Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems. 
 - Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures. 

Domain Knowledge

- Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns - naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG. 
 - Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers). 
 - Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization. 
 - Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards. 
 - Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents). 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements. 
 - Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos). 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Master's degree is a plus. 

Experience

- 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI. 
 - Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. 
 - Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

data.title: Senior Engineer - Tosca Automation Tester (Retail Domain Mandatory)
data.description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!

Who Are We?

For 115 years, L'Oréal, the world's leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world. 

For more than a century, L'Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L'Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty. 

Today, L'Oréal includes more than 2, 000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future. 

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L'Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure. 

A Day in the Life of Senior Engineer - QA Automation (Tosca)!

We are seeking highly motivated, well-rounded, and fast-learning QA Automation Engineers to join our growing Quality Assurance (QA) team at ITH. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic environment where agility, rapid learning, and technical versatility are key. 

The ideal candidates are not just specialized automation engineers, but complete QA professionals who understand the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) and are ready to leverage modern technologies. We are looking for testers who are forward-thinking, skilled in both custom scripted frameworks and industry-leading enterprise tools like Tricentis Tosca, and capable of integrating AI-powered testing techniques to optimize our workflows. You will be responsible for defining test strategies, writing comprehensive manual test cases when needed, and designing, developing, and executing robust automated test suites to ensure the highest quality for our applications. 

As a fast-paced team, we value individuals who can rapidly grasp complex business logic, adapt to changing technologies, and proactively bridge the gap between development and business requirements. 

In this role, You will. . 

- Test Automation Development: Design, build, maintain, and scale automated testing frameworks for web, mobile, and API applications (REST/GraphQL) using both enterprise model-based platforms and open-source scripting frameworks. 
 - Enterprise Test Automation (Tricentis): Set up, configure, and execute test cases using Tricentis Tosca. Maintain and structure model-based modules, test sheets, and execution lists to ensure robust, reusable test coverage. 
 - AI-Enhanced Quality Assurance: Leverage AI-driven testing tools and generative AI utilities (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or specialized autonomous QA agents) to accelerate test case generation, automate script maintenance, and conduct intelligent log/defect analysis. 
 - End-to-End Quality Ownership: Own the QA process from requirements analysis to post-release monitoring. Perform a mix of automated (70-80%) and structured manual/exploratory testing (20-30%) based on project needs. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites (including Tosca execution lists and open-source frameworks) into modern CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to support continuous testing. 
 - Agile Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Software Developers in an Agile/Scrum environment to clarify requirements, define acceptance criteria (BDD/Gherkin), and identify edge cases early in the design phase. 
 - Defect Management & Reporting: Identify, document, isolate, and track bugs systematically. Provide clear, detailed, and actionable bug reports, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues quickly. 
 - Rapid Knowledge Acquisition: Quickly master complex internal systems, configurations, and business flows. Be ready to pivot across different technology stacks and applications within the L'Oreal ecosystem as project demands evolve. 

What are we looking for?

Technical & Automation Skills

- Enterprise Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca (Model-Based Test Design, test sheets, requirements synchronization, and execution lists). Knowledge of other Tricentis suite tools (like qTest or LiveCompare) is a strong plus. 
 - Open-Source Automation Frameworks: Strong familiarity with modern test automation tools and frameworks (such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Cypress. io). 
 - Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in at least one major programming or scripting language used in automation (e. g. , JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java) to customize test scripts when required. 
 - API Testing: Extensive experience testing RESTful APIs and microservices using tools like Postman, SoapUI, or automated libraries (e. g. , SuperTest, Requests, or Tosca API Scan). 
 - Database Knowledge: Solid understanding of databases and ability to write SQL queries to verify data integrity and perform backend testing. 
 - Version Control: Comfortable using Git for source code management and collaborative development of test scripts. 

AI & Modern Testing Skills

- AI Tooling & Coding Assistants: Practical experience using AI-powered tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Tabnine) to write and debug test automation code more efficiently. 
 - Prompt Engineering for QA: Ability to leverage large language models (LLMs) to write detailed test plans, generate diverse test data sets, draft complex test scenarios, and accelerate test development. 
 - AI-Driven Testing Concepts: Familiarity with modern self-healing test automation tools, automated visual regression testing, or predictive test analytics is highly desirable. 

Professional & Core Attributes

- Well-Rounded QA Mindset: Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes. Ability to perform functional, regression, integration, security, and performance testing. 
 - Rapid Learner: Proven capability to quickly absorb new business domains, functional flows, and tech stacks with minimal supervision. 
 - Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills: Exceptional analytical thinking to dissect complex system workflows and pinpoint potential failure modes. 
 - Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical defects to developers and business impact to non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

- Tricentis Certifications: Tosca Automation Specialist (AS1/AS2) or Test Design Specialist (TDS1/TDS2) certifications are highly preferred. 
 - Experience with Cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP). 
 - Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber or SpecFlow. 
 - Prior experience in retail, supply chain, beauty-tech, or large corporate IT environments. 
 - Knowledge of mobile application testing (iOS/Android) using Appium or similar tools. 

What's In It for You?

- Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers. 
 - A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup, and Shift time is 2PM - 11PM
 - Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive. 
 - Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best. 
 - Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L'Oréal's collective success. 
 - L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That's the beauty of L'Oréal.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

data.title: Software Developer IV ( Python + Openstack)
data.description:
Software Developer IV-IN (Python + Openstack)

Immediate Joiners only

About The Role

Rackspace Technology has been a foundational contributor to OpenStack since its inception. The Private Cloud Product Software Engineering organization is looking for a Software Developer IV with deep OpenStack expertise to join our Bare Metal Infrastructure team. 

In this role, you will write and maintain custom backends and drivers for core OpenStack projects - Ironic, Cinder, Nova, and Neutron - tuned specifically for bare metal infrastructure deployment at data center scale. You will work directly in the OpenStack codebases, own the full lifecycle of driver development from design through production operation, and contribute improvements upstream where your work benefits the broader community. 

This is a senior individual contributor and technical leadership role. You will shape the architectural direction of our OpenStack integrations, raise the bar for quality and reliability in the services we run, and help other engineers grow their platform expertise. 

About Private Cloud Product Software Engineering

Private Cloud Product Software Engineering at Rackspace Technology owns the design, build, and operational responsibility for: 

- Programmatic bare metal infrastructure platforms, including hardware provisioning, lifecycle management, and data center automation
 - Custom OpenStack backends and drivers that extend core services to meet the demands of large-scale private cloud operations
 - Internal enablement tooling that accelerates product delivery across engineering teams
 - The interaction layer between Private Cloud customers and the products and services Rackspace Technology provides

How We Work

We work closely with product owners and infrastructure teams to deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers. Our services run in Kubernetes-native environments and we own them end-to-end - from application logic and driver code to deployment and operational health. We practice continuous integration and delivery, and we take operational responsibility for what we ship seriously. 

At the Dev IV level, we expect you to lead technical decisions, not just execute on them. That means proposing architectural approaches, driving alignment across teams, reviewing and raising the quality of your peers' work, and maintaining a strong point of view grounded in real production experience. 

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain custom drivers and backends for OpenStack Ironic, Cinder, Nova, and Neutron, targeting bare metal provisioning and lifecycle automation use cases
 - Contribute improvements and bug fixes to upstream OpenStack projects, working within the OpenStack community review and governance process
 - Own the full lifecycle of your driver and backend work: design, code review, testing, deployment, and ongoing operational health
 - Collaborate with infrastructure, networking, and storage teams to deeply understand the requirements that shape driver behavior
 - Architect integrations between OpenStack services and internal systems, including DCIM/IPAM tooling such as NetBox or Nautobot
 - Establish and uphold engineering standards for driver development: testing strategies, error handling, observability, and upgrade safety
 - Investigate production incidents in OpenStack services; drive root cause analysis and durable fixes, including upstream patches where appropriate
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship across the team, particularly around OpenStack internals and bare metal infrastructure patterns
 - Evaluate new OpenStack features and upstream developments; assess impact on our platform and make recommendations for adoption

Requirements

Experience

- Ten or more years of software development experience, with at least four years of hands-on production work with OpenStack
 - Deep working knowledge of at least two of: Ironic, Cinder, Nova, or Neutron - including their driver interfaces, plugin architectures, and internal request flows
 - Demonstrated experience writing, debugging, or extending OpenStack drivers or backends in a production environment
 - Strong Python skills, including proficiency with async patterns, testing frameworks (pytest, tox), and OpenStack SDK/client libraries
 - Five or more years working in Linux/Unix environments, including systems-level debugging and network troubleshooting
 - Experience operating services in Kubernetes or similar container orchestration environments

Technical Skills

- Solid understanding of bare metal provisioning concepts: PXE, IPMI/Redfish, BMC management, network boot workflows, and hardware lifecycle states
 - Familiarity with OpenStack's shared infrastructure: oslo. config, oslo. messaging, oslo. db, Keystone auth, and service deployment patterns
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and test automation in the context of OpenStack or infrastructure software development
 - Working knowledge of networking fundamentals relevant to data center environments: VLANs, bonding, LACP, routing, and DHCP/PXE interaction
 - Strong debugging and observability skills in distributed systems - log analysis, tracing, and metric-driven incident investigation

Soft Skills

- Ability to own and drive complex technical work from ambiguous requirements through to delivered, production-grade outcomes
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable writing design documents and presenting technical proposals to engineers and stakeholders
 - Effective collaborator in a globally distributed engineering organization
 - Strong sense of ownership: you treat the services and drivers you build as production responsibilities, not just code deliverables

Highly Desirable Skills

- Prior upstream OpenStack contribution: merged patches, active code review participation, or engagement with project governance (PTL, core reviewer, or similar)
 - Familiarity with the OpenStack development workflow: Gerrit, Zuul CI, OpenStack Discuss, and project-specific contributor guidelines
 - Experience with Ceph or other distributed storage systems and their integration with Cinder or Nova
 - Proficiency in Go (Golang) - applicable to tooling, automation, or Kubernetes Operator work adjacent to this role
 - Experience with DCIM or IPAM platforms such as NetBox or Nautobot, including automation against their APIs
 - Exposure to hardware attestation, secure boot, or firmware management workflows in a bare metal context
 - Experience with network automation tooling or SDN integration relevant to Neutron ML2 drivers or agent development

About Rackspace Technology

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world's leading technologies - across applications, data and security - to deliver end-to-end solutions. We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future. 

More on Rackspace Technology

Though we're all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. data.title: Software Engineer - C/C++ Networking(Layer2/Layer 3) | 4-8 Years
data.description:
Meet the Team

Cisco Networking builds industry-leading switching, routing, wireless, and cloud-managed networking solutions used by customers worldwide. We are looking for a hands-on senior firmware engineer with strong systems programming and networking expertise to help develop the next generation of high-performance switching software. 

Join the Network Connectivity team, where you will design and develop production-grade firmware and system software for enterprise switching platforms. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently own significant features, contribute to technical design and architecture decisions, and work closely with networking, platform, quality, and product teams. 

Your Impact

In this role, your work will directly enhance the connectivity, reliability, and configuration of L2/L3 protocols on Cisco switching platforms. You will own medium-to-large features from design through delivery, troubleshoot complex device and customer issues, and help raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment and mentorship. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and own networking components that are simple, scalable, reliable, and supportable. Develop firmware and system software for Cisco switching products. 
 - Analyze requirements and problem statements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and produce clear software designs, detailed design documents, and functional specifications. 
 - Write high-quality C/C++ code and unit tests. Apply strong white-box testing and automation practices. Triage, debug, and root-cause software bring-up issues, regressions, crashes, performance problems, and customer failures. 
 - Work with local and remote teams to review product requirements, software functional/design specifications, unit and integration test plans, and validation strategy. Partner closely with system test and quality teams to ensure feature readiness. 
 - Contribute innovative ideas that improve product architecture, debuggability, performance, reliability, and engineering productivity, including opportunities to create intellectual property. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, EE/ECE, or a related field, with typically 4-8 years of relevant software/firmware development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in C/C++ with solid data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, memory management, and debugging skills. 
 - Hands-on experience developing firmware, embedded software, or system software for networking products. 
 - Strong experience with concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization, and IPC/RPC mechanisms. 
 - Strong L2/L3 networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP/LAG, ARP, IPv4/IPv6, routing fundamentals, packet flow, and network troubleshooting. 
 - Strong Linux/system programming fundamentals and hands-on debugging experience using tools such as GDB, core dumps, packet captures, Wireshark/tcpdump, and traffic generators/analyzers such as IXIA or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of medium-to-large technical features, including design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production/customer support. Ability to mentor engineers and contribute effectively to design and code reviews. 
 - Hands-on experience using GenAI-assisted development tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and security. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on development and debugging experience with networking protocols and switching features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MST, LACP/LAG, UDLD, Storm Control, QoS, OSPF, BGP, ECMP, multicast, DHCP relay, SLAAC, or VRRP. 
 - Experience with Python or another scripting language for test automation, debugging, tooling, or developer productivity. 
 - Experience with hardware/software bring-up, SDK/ASIC interaction, packet processing, or high-performance data-plane software is a plus. Cisco networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE are desirable. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. data.title: Engineer II – Control Software
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

When you join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will become part of a highly collaborative team that is passionate about building software platforms that power advanced scientific instruments and solutions. With industry-leading investment in innovation, we provide our teams with resources and opportunities to make meaningful contributions to the world. 

How will you make an impact?

As an Engineer in the Vacuum Software Team, you will contribute to the software that keeps TEM microscopes accurate, reliable, and ready for advanced scientific use. You will work on the design, development, and maintenance of vacuum control software for High-End and Mid-Range TEM products, partnering with engineers and stakeholders to deliver dependable, high-quality solutions. 

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with 4-6 years of experience in the development and maintenance of Control Software. You should have hands-on expertise in Embedded C++, COM, MFC, Qt, C#, and test frameworks such as GTest/GMock. Experience with WPF will be an added advantage. 

In this role, you will help drive the enhancement, modernization, and quality of software systems used in advanced scientific instruments. You will contribute to software development, system integration, and engineering best practices, while also supporting collaboration and continuous improvement across the team. 

What will you do?

- Develop, enhance, and maintain Microscope Control Software and related Windows-based components using Embedded C++, COM, MFC, and C# as core technologies, with WPF and Qt exposure where applicable. 
 - Develop software layers that interface with supplier-provided hardware APIs. 
 - Implement and maintain hardware abstraction layers (HAL). 
 - Integrate SCU, PLC, and IO-Link based devices into microscope control platforms. 
 - Develop device communication and control modules. 
 - Drive integration across native and managed components, including interoperability between legacy COM/MFC-based systems and newer software components. 
 - Establish and improve engineering quality practices using unit, integration, and system-level testing frameworks such as GTest/GMock. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and performance issues across application, framework, and platform layers; drive root-cause analysis and preventive fixes. 
 - Support the introduction of advanced testing approaches such as BDD and model-based testing where appropriate, while recognizing that specialized knowledge in MBT (Axini), Dezyne, and ASD may be learned on the job. 
 - Contribute to release readiness, technical risk management, and long-term platform roadmap planning. 
 - Promote best practices in documentation, code reviews, quality engineering, and cross-team collaboration. 

Required Skills

- 4-6 years of software engineering experience with mandatory hands-on expertise in Embedded C++, COM, and C#. 
 - Required experience in Windows application development using MFC, Qt, with WPF considered good-to-have skill. 
 - Good understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, design patterns, and development methodologies, with experience in multi-module application development and integration of legacy and modern software components. 
 - Hands-on experience with unit and component test frameworks such as GTest/GMock. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across control software, desktop applications, system integrations, and performance-sensitive environments. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum and SAFe, with experience operating effectively in sprint-based and cross-team planning environments. 
 - Experience operating in structured product-development environments with strong quality and delivery expectations. 

Desired Skills

- Exposure to Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and an understanding of how it can improve functional collaboration and test coverage.
