data.title: Sr Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis
data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking an experienced Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence & Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet. 

This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high-impact, recurring, and fleet-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective-action validation and fleet-risk closure. 

The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance & Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis. 
 - Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria. 
 - Lead investigations of complex, high-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces. 
 - Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem-solving methods. 
 - Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence. 
 - Drive immediate containment, short-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners. 
 - Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence. 
 - Maintain a fleet-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments. 
 - Partner with Fleet Performance & Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective-action effectiveness. 
 - Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation. 
 - Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive-level issue reviews. 
 - Ensure customer-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates. 
 - Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings. 
 - Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet-risk reduction. 
 - Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field. 
 - Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed-base engineering, or a related technical function. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross-functional engineering programs. 
 - Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment. 
 - Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

data.title: Head of Operations, Voice of
data.description:
Head of Operations, Voice of IndiaJosh Talks · Voice of India · Full-time · Gurgaon

About Josh TalksJosh Talks helps enterprises, governments and not-for-profits make better decisions about which AI services to buy and deploy, through independent, human-powered evaluation. Voice of India, its evaluation platform, sits at the centre of this work. 

Josh Talks began as one of India's largest regional-language storytelling platforms, and the reach it built over a decade now underpins its work in AI. 

About Voice of IndiaVoice of India is India's first human-powered multimodal evaluation platform, built by Josh Talks and co-developed with IIT Madras. It measures how well AI models work for the people of India, in their own languages and on the tasks they care about. 

Our founding principle is that AI should be judged by people, not by other AI systems. Every ranking is backed by independent human evaluation, a published methodology and transparent evidence, rather than vendor claims or automated judges. 

Live leaderboards today cover speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and text to image, across 15 Indian languages. Leaderboards for language models, translation, legal tasks, document OCR, video and AI agents are in development. What sets the platform apart: 

- Independent human judgment. Evaluations are carried out by people under blind conditions. Model names remain hidden until a judgment is recorded, the order of answers is randomised, and no vendor evaluates its own model. 
 - Built for procurement. Results are designed to inform procurement and deployment decisions. Scores are broken down by language, domain, geography and use case. 
 - Academically rigorous. Every benchmark follows a published protocol with sound statistics and reproducible experiments. 
 - Built from how India speaks. The speech to text benchmark uses 536 hours of unscripted telephone conversations from 36, 691 speakers across 139 regional clusters. Its test set is closed, so models cannot be trained on it. 
 - Sovereign and global models side by side. Indian and global, open-source and proprietary models are ranked on the same boards. 

Milestones so farSince its launch, Voice of India has established itself as an independent reference for AI evaluation in India: 

- Government engagement at launch. Launched in New Delhi on 4 August 2026. Shri S. Krishnan, Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, attended the launch. 
 - Financial regulators in attendance. Representatives of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) attended the launch. 
 - Peer-reviewed research. The speech to text benchmark is described in a paper accepted at Interspeech 2026. 
 - Trusted by model providers. Global and Indian model providers submit their models to Voice of India for evaluation and re-evaluation. Press coverage: Business Standard, 4 August 2026

About the roleJosh Talks is hiring a Head of Operations to own Voice of India end to end. You will decide what Voice of India evaluates, run every evaluation from methodology to publication, make each release widely cited, and build the engine that keeps it rigorous and low-cost to run. 

The pace is the defining feature of this role. Voice of India aims to publish a new evaluation almost every week, and to be the first in the world to put numbers on every major new model for India. You will set that cadence and hold it. 

This role requires a high agency person who is hands on and not afraid to get their hands dirty. You will work directly with the founders of Josh Talks, our research and engineering teams, and the leads for enterprise partnerships and policy, and you will be accountable for what Voice of India publishes and its influence on AI deployment in the country. 

How we workThis is a senior role by title, but it does not sit above the work. Our founder is deeply hands-on and involved in every detail of the company, from the wording of a methodology to the timing of a release, and expects the same of you. 

- Know every moving part. You will understand how every evaluation works, from the data and the raters to the leaderboard, and know every word of every methodology document. 
 - Own every evaluation. Every evaluation Voice of India publishes is either written by you or thoroughly reviewed by you before it goes out. 
 - Stay close to the detail. You will work side by side with the founder on the details that decide whether a release is credible, rather than managing from a distance. 

How this role is measuredWe believe the companies that matter in AI right now will be the ones that move fastest without losing rigour. Speed is therefore the primary measure of this role: 

- Speed of releases. How quickly you ship new evaluations and put numbers on every major new model. 
 - Speed of partnerships. How quickly you turn conversations with labs, enterprises and government into working partnerships. 
 - Speed of impact. How quickly Voice of India's evaluations come to shape how AI is deployed in India. If you would rather read the methodology than a summary of it, if a late release keeps you up at night, and if you want to work with a founder who cares about every detail as much as you do, you will feel at home here. If you are looking for a role where you manage from a distance, this is not it. 

In this role, you willShip a new evaluation almost every week
 - Decide what to evaluate. Choose the models, tasks, languages and use cases that matter most, and own the evaluation calendar. 
 - Design the methodology. Work with our research team to define the protocol, test sets, rater instructions and statistics for each evaluation. 
 - Run production. Coordinate raters, vendors, data and engineering so each evaluation is delivered on time and to standard. 
 - Publish. Release results, leaderboards and methodology notes that stand up to scrutiny. 

Be first in the world to put numbers on every major new model
 - Track every major release. Follow new models from global and Indian labs as they launch. 
 - Keep evaluations ready to run. Maintain the pipelines, test sets and rater capacity needed to evaluate a new model within days of its release. 
 - Publish first. Make Voice of India the first credible source of results for how each major model performs in Indian languages and conditions. 

Make every release widely cited
 - Plan each release. Give every evaluation a clear headline finding and a release plan, working with our communications team. 
 - Reach the people who matter. Ensure labs, researchers and the press see, discuss and cite each release. 
 - Build credibility quickly. Respond to questions on methodology openly, establish collaborations across industry and government and publish corrections where needed. 

Get Voice of India adopted by enterprises and government
 - Make scores part of AI decisions. Work with our Lead - AI Partnerships, India and our VP, Policy Programs & Partnerships so that a Voice of India score becomes part of how Indian enterprises and government choose AI. 
 - Shape evaluations around real decisions. Turn what enterprises and government need to know into evaluations Voice of India can deliver. 

Build a low-cost, rigorous evaluation engine
 - Raters. Build and manage a reliable network of human raters across Indian languages, with clear quality controls. 
 - Vendors. Select and manage data, annotation and technology vendors, and get quality work from people you do not fully control. 
 - Tooling. Work with engineering to build the tools that make each evaluation faster and cheaper to run. 
 - Cost and quality. Track the cost and quality of every evaluation, and reduce cost without losing rigour. 

What success looks likeWe expect the following milestones, which we will refine together in your first month: 

- First 90 days. Own the evaluation calendar, ship 6 evaluations at a regular cadence, and map the raters, vendors and tooling behind each one, with a clear view of its cost. 
 - Six months. A new evaluation published almost every week, major new models evaluated within days of release, and a lower cost per evaluation with no loss of rigour. 
 - Twelve months. Voice of India regularly cited by labs, researchers and the press, its scores used in enterprise and government AI decisions, and a repeatable engine that runs at low cost. 

Who we are looking for
 - A builder's track record. A past founder or early operator who shipped something every week. 
 - Technical rigour. Semi-technical and rigorous enough to defend a methodology to a researcher at a frontier AI lab. 
 - Senior credibility. Credible in conversation with a bank CTO or a ministry official. 
 - Ownership. You treat Voice of India as your own, and you hold a weekly cadence without cutting corners. 
 - Communication. Excellent writing, and the judgment to turn evaluation results into findings people cite. 
 - Quality through others. Experience getting quality work out of freelancers, vendors or contractors you did not fully control. Experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, research operations or Indian-language AI is an advantage, but not required. 

Why join
 - Own a national benchmark. Run the platform that shows how AI performs for the people of India. 
 - Work at the frontier. Evaluate new models from the world's leading labs as they launch. 
 - Shape how India chooses AI. See your work used by enterprises, government and researchers. 
 - Build from the ground up. Define how Voice of India operates, its team and its standards. 

Working setup and assessmentThe role reports to the founder and CEO of Josh Talks and works closely with research, engineering, partnerships, policy and communications. It is a full-time position based in Gurgaon. 

Assessment will cover something you shipped on a weekly cadence and a tight budget, how you managed people you did not fully control, and a short case exercise on designing and publishing an evaluation of a newly released model within one week. 

How to applySend your CV and a short note to amritansh@voiceofindia. ai. Tell us about something you shipped every week on a tight budget, and what it achieved.

- 4-7 years of experience in software testing, preferably across mobile, web, or gaming products. 
 - Strong familiarity with mobile and web platforms from a QA perspective. 
 - Good understanding of client-server architecture, APIs, application data flow, and network debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience in test design, test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and risk-based testing. 
 - Strong exploratory testing skills, with the ability to select the right test approach based on feature complexity and risk. 
 - Experience using QA tools such as Jira, TestRail, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, browser developer tools, or similar tools. 
 - Ability to create clear and comprehensive QA documentation, including test cases, test plans, test reports, and training material. 
 - Good understanding of software testing processes, SDLC/STLC, and Agile methodologies. 
 - Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts. 
 - Strong communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills. 

Bonus Points

- Experience testing mobile games, web games, or live-service products. 
 - Passion for gaming, with a genuine interest in playing and understanding casual games. 
 - Strong gaming mindset, including an understanding of player behaviour, engagement mechanics, progression, rewards, and LiveOps. 
 - Prior experience testing Slots, Casino, or other real-money/social casino-style games.

data.title: Sub System Test Engineer – ATS - Railway Infrastructure
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. We are looking for a Sub System Test Engineer: ATS - Railway Infrastructure

Work assignments: 

Responsibility for the test execution and test management of mass transit rollouts of ATS for CBTC/ Non-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for ATS domain in CBTC/ Non-CBTC application projects. Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes. 

Exploration of further business opportunities: 

Identification and exploitation of additional business opportunities during project implementation, e. g. identifying Change Requests or extending the scope towards project needs. 

You'll make a difference by: 

- Preparation of test checklist specific to project and Create test specification / test cases as per ATS design requirement specifications. 
 - Responsible for lab data testing of ATS Sub-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments. 
 - Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing. 
 - Evaluation of project, customer, internal requirements towards implementing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation. 
 - Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of ATS and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and IxL with CBTC/non-CBTC projects. 
 - Knowledge about testing and commissioning process and Strategy. 
 - Work with development team to identify and capture test cases, ensure version management
 - Knowledge of test automation for HMI/UI testing
 - Setting up of test environments, writing test scripts and implementing test cases/scenarios. 
 - Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned people. 
 - Reviewing test logs and results to identify failures, raising CFXs in the change and defect management tool, participating in CCB meetings, and providing test inputs. 
 - Interfacing/Clarification with senior test engineer, test manager, System Manager/Sub PM, Validation, RAMS and project teams. 
 - Collaborating with HQ teams towards tooling requirements, developing/adapting templates/schematics, and parameterization. 
 - Able to support installation and tests activities/teams onsite if required. 
 - Understanding of other subsystems like Interlocking, ATC, Communication and Diagnostic Systems. 
 - Knowledge of Projects Support functions (RM/DM/CM) and Quality Management. 

Essential Soft and Hard skills for IXL Functional Tester: 

- Basic Knowledge of Linux. 
 - Experience with VMware. 
 - Networking knowledge. 
 - Troubleshooting skills for the Test Environment. 
 - Ability to understand and implement IP addressing, subnetting, interface configuration, routing principles, and gateway setup. 
 - Fundamental understanding of server environments, including ESXi and Windows. 
 - Practical experience with Siemens products, particularly WKII, R9k, TGMT, and TG200, will be an added advantage. 

You'll win us over by: 

- Degree in electrical or electronics engineering. 
 - Professional experience of minimum 5 years in railway transportation systems (Main line / Mass Transit) with the focus on testing on ATS sub-system (CBTC / Non CBTC). 
 - Performed hands on testing activities for ATS subsystem besides understanding of operational scenarios, requirements, and interfaces. 
 - Experience with Functional testing, lab testing, test setups. Experience with Integration tests and SAT would be an added advantage.

At project44,   we believe in better.     

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn't just possible-it's essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world.     With our  Decision Intelligence Platform,   Movement,   we're redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.     Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse  global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.     If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team - we should talk.   

  

AI at project44

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers. 

If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team - we should talk. 

In-office Commitment: Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. We are looking for candidates who are enthusiastic and committed to joining our team on-site, in our beautiful office four days a week. Together, we're building something extraordinarily learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment. 

  

About the Roleproject44's Global IT Services team is looking for an IT Automation Engineer to own the automation and integration backbone connecting our HR, Finance, Sales, and Security systems - while also building and running two business-critical internal platforms from the ground up. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable writing a Workato recipe, querying Snowflake, standing up a small internal application, and jumping into a helpdesk ticket or production incident when it matters. 

What You'll DoSystems Integration & Business Process Automation

- Own the Workato platform: build, monitor, and maintain the recipes, connections, and AI agents that automate cross-system business processes; triage and fix failed or runaway jobs
 - Co-own the HR-to-IT identity lifecycle, driving the UKG Pro ↔ Azure AD sync that powers joiner/leaver/employee-change automation, including edge cases and downstream SSO coordination
 - Maintain finance systems automation, including NetSuite ↔ Salesforce integrations

- Design, build, and operate project44's internal Project Registry - the system of record for every internal app, integration, dashboard, and AI component, along with its governance workflows
 - Design, build, and operate project44's AI/Claude spend governance platform - a business-critical system for monitoring and controlling company-wide Anthropic Claude spend, including data pipelines, dashboards, Slack bot workflows, and the policy engine behind it
 - Harden both systems for production use: rate limiting, kill switches, phased rollouts, and data-quality safeguards
 - Author architecture documentation and decision records to support review and long-term ownershipIT Support, Endpoint Security & Compliance

 - Administer SSO/security configuration for vendor tools and troubleshoot integration issues

 - SQL and Snowflake experience (schemas, views, service accounts, performance/data-quality troubleshooting)
 - Familiarity with Salesforce and NetSuite data models and integration patterns
 - Experience with UKG Pro and Azure AD/Entra ID identity flows
 - Depth in Microsoft Entra ID: dynamic groups, Conditional Access, enterprise applications, SCIM/SAML provisioning
 - Azure hosting experience: Automation runbooks, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, managed identities
 - Microsoft Intune / endpoint management and device compliance experienceApplication Development / Low-Code

- Experience with Retool for building and maintaining internal apps
 - Experience with Lovable or similar AI-assisted app builders
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and basic backend service design (auth, RBAC, rate limiting)
 - Azure fundamentals: Runbooks, Table Storage, Static Web Apps, storage/containers
 - Familiarity with Azure DevOpsAI / LLM Operations

- Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or similar LLM platforms, including usage/cost monitoring and governance
 - Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and standing up or reviewing MCP servers
 - Experience with Slack API/bot development (slash commands, DMs, interactive workflows)IT Support, Security & Compliance

- Experience with Freshservice or a comparable ITSM/helpdesk platform
 - Endpoint management and security experience (e. g. , Microsoft Defender)
 - SOC 2 or similar compliance audit support experience
 - Scripting for operations/automation: PowerShell and PythonOther

- Power BI experience (report/dashboard consumption and troubleshooting)
 - GitHub and general version-control literacyIdeal Candidate Profile
 - A full-stack "builder" mindset - as comfortable writing a Workato recipe or SQL query as designing a small internal application end-to-end and documenting the architecture behind it
 - A high degree of ownership and independence, including comfort with production incident response
 - A strong written communicator, able to produce clear status updates, handover documentation, and architecture decision records
 - Comfortable working across HR, Finance, Sales, Security, and Engineering stakeholders
 - Prior IT support/helpdesk background is a plus
 - In-office Commitment: Employees are expected to contribute to our collaborative culture by working in the office Four days weekly.   

Compensation and Benefits: 

We continually evaluate our pay ranges to reflect skills, experience, and market conditions. The base salary offered will be determined by assessing a candidate's experience and skills relative to the scope and responsibilities of the position, as well as the specific geographic location where the job will be performed. Base salary is one component of project44's total compensation package, which also includes stock options for all EOR and project44-employed team members, bonus or commission eligibility depending on role, and a benefits package tailored to your country of employment. Specific benefits package offerings vary by country and may include health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, and paid time off, in line with local market standards and statutory programs. The base salary range for this position is  152, 500. 00 PLN - 228, 500. 00 PLN.   

  

Diversity & Inclusion

We're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. data.description:
About Albertsons Companies Inc. : 

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. operates over 2, 200 stores across 35 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U. S customers each week.

Our success is built on a one-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging. 

About Albertsons Companies India: 

At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company's technology journey to support millions of customers' lives every day. 

At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Senior Engineering Manager, AI-SDLC at Albertsons. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Skills Required: Gen AI, Agentic AI, Autonomous Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence

Experience Range: 12 - 15 years

Job Title: Sr. Manager - AI-SDLC (Autonomous Software Engineering Platform)

Role Overview: 

- The Sr. Manager - AI-SDLC will lead the design, engineering, and rollout of Albertsons' next-generation AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI-SDLC) platform - a system where autonomous AI agents plan, write, test, review, and ship software collaboratively with human engineers in the loop. 
 - This role is pivotal in reimagining how Albertsons builds software: shifting from developers writing every line of code to developers directing, reviewing, and governing fleets of autonomous coding agents that handle requirements analysis, code generation, testing, code review, deployment, and incident triage - with humans retaining control at critical decision points. 
 - You will lead an engineering team responsible for architecting and operationalizing platform components including agent orchestration for the SDLC, autonomous coding/testing agents, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, code-quality and safety guardrails, CI/CD integration, and developer experience tooling that lets engineering teams safely delegate work to AI agents. 
 - This is a hands-on leadership role ideal for someone who has built agentic AI platforms, developer tooling, or autonomous automation systems in large enterprises or high-velocity startup environments, and who is excited to redefine how software gets built. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Platform Architecture & Engineering: 

- Lead end-to-end design and engineering of Albertsons' AI-SDLC platform, enabling autonomous, semi-autonomous, and human-in-the-loop software delivery workflows. 
 - Architect core components including: 
 - Agent orchestration layers for the software development lifecycle (planning, coding, testing, review, deployment) using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Assistants, or similar frameworks. 
 - Autonomous coding and testing agent frameworks (e. g. , patterns similar to OpenGPTs, n8n workflows) capable of executing multi-step engineering tasks. 
 - Human-in-the-loop checkpoints and approval gates that let engineers review, correct, and approve agent-generated code, tests, and deployments before they progress. 
 - Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, We aviate, Chroma, pgvector) for codebase retrieval, context grounding, and RAG over internal engineering knowledge. 
 - Prompt engineering libraries, reusable agent tools, code-review templates, and evaluation harnesses to measure agent code quality. 
 - Secure tool/function calling into source control, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure, with policy-as-code and responsible AI guardrails. 
 - Build scalable APIs, SDKs, and services that make autonomous SDLC capabilities reusable across engineering and product teams. 

Team Leadership: 

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI platform engineers, LLM engineers, MLOps engineers, and agentic workflow developers building the AI-SDLC platform. 
 - Establish engineering best practices, code quality standards, and DevOps processes for AI-authored and AI-assisted software. 

Innovation & Architecture: 

- Evaluate and integrate emerging open-source technologies (e. g. , LangChain, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, Dust, n8n, OpenGPTs, Haystack) for autonomous software engineering use cases.

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers.  - Build features for secure and performant asset delivery, including CDN delivery, caching, and event driven integrations with other platform services. 
 - Build and enhance image editing capabilities such as cropping, resizing, rotation, format conversion, compression, and on-the-fly image transformations for delivery. 
 - Build and enhance video editing and processing capabilities such as trimming, transcoding, thumbnail generation, and optimized streaming and playback. 
 - Explore and integrate AI-powered media features such as smart cropping, background removal, auto-tagging, and automated metadata generation for images and videos. 
 - Build and improve asset usage tracking, so users can see where assets are referenced before changing or deleting them. 
 - Contribute to upcoming roadmap areas around security, collaboration, and sharing. Roles & Responsibilities

AI-Native Engineering Practice

- Use AI tools and agents as your primary development partners for designing, writing, refactoring, testing, and reviewing code, while staying fully accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. 
 - Break down product requirements into technical designs and implementation plans with AI assistance, and validate them against the existing architecture and constraints. 
 - Build and maintain reusable prompts, agent workflows, and project context so the rest of the team can adopt the same AI SDLC practices. 
 - Use AI agents for multi-step work such as large refactors, API changes, test generation, and bug triage. 
 - Measure and share the impact of AI-driven workflows on cycle time, quality, and defect rates, and continuously improve the team's practices.

 - Investigate and resolve production issues and customer-reported bugs, using AI to speed up log analysis, root-cause analysis, and fix verification. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, and contribute to runbooks and postmortems. 
 - Keep technical documentation current, including API docs, design documents, and onboarding guides, using AI to draft and maintain them. 

Collaboration

- Work closely with Product, Design, and partner engineering teams on cross-team features. Mentor other engineers on effective, responsible AI-assisted development. 

Mandatory Skills

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services and APIs. 
 - Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents in daily work, with concrete examples of shipping production features through AI-driven workflows. 
 - Strong skills in prompt design, providing effective context to AI tools, and critically evaluating AI output. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, REST and gRPC APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Solid understanding of access control, data security, and multi-tenant SaaS systems. 
 - Strong testing discipline and debugging skills, with experience owning quality without a dedicated QA function.

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.

We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining. . .

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering (AIDLC) at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & responsibilities: 

- Build and own production agents end to end for the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) pod: design, build, evals, release, monitoring and on-call. 
 - Build agents for stages of the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Design and build multi-agent workflows with clear task decomposition, handoffs, shared state and failure handling, following the architecture patterns set by the Senior Staff engineer. 
 - Build and use MCP servers and tools, including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP, so agents can work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Implement memory and state management, context engineering and RAG for your agents. 
 - Write the evals for your agents: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring and regression suites. Agent changes ship only when evals pass. 
 - Instrument your agents with tracing and logging, and use traces to find and fix failures in production. 
 - Implement guardrails: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop approval points. 
 - Review agent pull requests from SE I and SE II engineers and mentor them on agent design and debugging. 
 - Write production code every week. Use agentic coding tools daily (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor). 
 - Report the effect of your agents against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings and cycle time. 
 - Track token and compute cost for your agents and keep it within budget. 
 - Work with Security, Cloud, Data and Product partners so your agents meet security, risk and compliance standards. 

Experience Required: 

- AI experience is a MUST. You have built and deployed at least one LLM agent or agentic workflow in production, used by real users, with evals and tracing in place, and you owned it end to end. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 9-12 years of software engineering experience. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Multi-agent orchestration is required: delegation, handoffs, shared state and failure handling. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Hands-on experience with tool/function calling, MCP (building and using servers), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. 
 - Experience writing evals: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and regression testing for agents. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor). 
 - Experience reviewing others' code and mentoring engineers. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost and operating agents in production. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, fine-tuning where it is justified. 

Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason 
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions 
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help.

 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work 
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens 
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required: 

- Production Agents and Multi-Agent Orchestration 
 - MCP, Memory and State Management, Context Engineering, RAG 
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability 
 - Python / Java / TypeScript (hands-on) 
 - Cloud Platform Experience (Azure and/or Google Cloud)

data.description:

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!

What you will be working on

- Reliability of a multi-tenant platform under growth: Defining SLIs and SLOs for the services in your area, instrumenting them honestly, and having the error-budget conversation when one is at risk. 
 - Making releases boring: Progressive delivery through Argo CD - canary and blue/green, automated verification, fast rollback - so a bad change is contained in minutes rather than escalated. 
 - Release management at pace: Coordinating what ships and when across [N] services, with change gates that catch problems without becoming a queue. 
 - Helm as a product, not a pile of charts: Reusable, tested, versioned charts that other teams can depend on. 
 - Incident response and what happens after: Leading incidents on the platform, then writing the postmortem and landing the follow-up work - the part most teams skip. 
 - Removing toil rather than absorbing it: Every recurring manual task is a candidate for automation in Python, Bash, or Ansible, and you'll have the time budget to actually do it. 
 - Deciding what AI should and shouldn't touch in our delivery path: Reviewing AI-authored Helm and pipeline code before it reaches production, keeping secrets and customer data out of agent context, scoping the credentials our CI agents hold. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Service level management: Define and operate SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for platform services; make reliability legible to engineering and product; drive the follow-through when budgets are burned. 
 - Production on-call and incident response: Hold primary on-call, act as incident commander, and run blameless postmortems with tracked actions. Escalate cleanly to Infra SecOps where infrastructure or credential changes are required. Use AI-assisted analysis to improve triage, root-cause identification, anomaly detection, and MTTR. 
 - Observability: Build and maintain the instrumentation, SLO monitors, and dashboards in Datadog that make failure visible before customers see it; reduce alert noise as deliberately as you add alerts. 
 - CI/CD engineering: Design, operate, and optimise build and deployment pipelines - caching, parallel execution, automated testing, security scanning, deployment verification. Manage artifacts and dependencies in the Artifactory. 
 - Release management and progressive delivery: Own the release process end-to-end; implement GitOps with Argo CD including canary and blue/green rollouts, automated validation, and rollback; run change management so that shipping is routine rather than an event. 
 - Helm and deployment configuration: Build and maintain production-grade Helm charts and libraries with testing, versioning, policy validation, and reusable standards across services. 
 - Kubernetes day-2 operations: Operate and troubleshoot production Kubernetes - scheduling, autoscaling, resource management, add-on lifecycle, workload networking - at a depth that holds up at 3am. Cluster provisioning sits with Infra SecOps; you'll partner with them on upgrades and capacity changes. 
 - Toil reduction and automation: Identify and eliminate recurring operational work with automation in Python, Bash, and Ansible. 
 - Capacity and resilience: Workload-level capacity planning and resource tuning, resilience and failover testing, and feeding infrastructure capacity requirements into Infra SecOps ahead of need. 
 - AI guardrails and review: Define how AI-generated deployment and pipeline code is reviewed before it reaches production, keep secrets and customer data out of prompts and agent context, scope CI agent credentials to least privilege, and maintain provenance for generated code. 
 - Cross-team partnership: Review and raise pull requests against Infra SecOps' Terraform where platform changes are needed, and keep the interface between the two teams working. 
 - Technical leadership: Contribute to design and architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the bar on availability, deployment speed, and developer experience. 

Mandatory Skills

- Production on-call ownership: You've held the pager for a SaaS platform, led incidents end-to-end, and written the postmortems. 
 - SLO practice, not SLO vocabulary: You've defined SLIs and SLOs for real services and can describe a decision and an error budget changed. 
 - Kubernetes in production: Deep, hands-on day-2 operation and troubleshooting of EKS - scheduling, autoscaling, resource management, add-ons - not just deploying onto it. 
 - Helm depth: You've written charts and libraries that other teams depend on, with tests and CI behind them. 
 - CI/CD engineering: You've built and owned pipelines at scale, not just consumed them - and you can talk about what you did to make them fast and trustworthy. 
 - Release engineering judgement: Practical experience with progressive delivery and rollback - Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent. 
 - Observability: Hands-on with Datadog or equivalent - you've built the monitors and dashboards, not just read them. 
 - Systems fundamentals: Strong Linux, load balancing, and application clustering; you can debug from logs, stack traces, and core dumps. 
 - Demonstrated AI-assisted workflow: Show us something you built - an agent or MCP integration, a prompt/context library your team uses, an AI-assisted review or incident workflow - and tell us where you decided not to use it. 
 - Works well across a boundary: You've operated in a model where some remediation needs another team, and you know how to make that fast rather than resentful. 

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a**hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected. 

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining. . .

Role Title : AVP, Principal Software Engineer (L11)

Company Overview : Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry's most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more. 

- We have recently been ranked #2 among India's Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India's Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies. 
 - We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being. 
 - We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles. 

Organizational Overview

This role sits within Synchrony's Front-End Engineering organization, which builds and maintains the web applications that power digital experiences for over 60 million customers and hundreds of brand partners. Our teams are focused on delivering seamless, accessible, and high-performance user experiences at scale - from consumer-facing product interfaces to partner integration portals. As AI dissolves the traditional boundaries between front-end, back-end, and platform engineering, this organization is evolving beyond its front-end anchor. Engineers increasingly work fluidly across the full stack, leveraging AI-assisted development and agentic workflows to deliver end-to-end solutions. This Tech Lead will help drive that evolution within their team while keeping user experience excellence at the center of everything we build. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Billions of transactions-and you'll touch all of them if you join our IT team as a Principal Front-End Engineer. Imagine the sheer scale of what we impact every second of every day. Now imagine what you can do with that influence-this is where you can shape the future of payments. 

Responsibilities

You'll work within multi-disciplinary teams to deliver on business goals. This person will be responsible for both the development of new features and the overall success of deliveries including analysis and design, development, deployment, optimization, and day to day operations. The role can be broken down into the following key aspects: 

- Communicator: You act as a translator between business stakeholders and your engineering team, ensuring no miscommunications. 
 - Coach: You are a mentor to your engineering team, taking every opportunity to up-skill our developers-including on AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Quality control: You have battle-tested JavaScript knowledge and can dive deep into the code-whether human-written or AI-generated-to provide thoughtful feedback and ensure the highest quality. 

It's the ideal time to come aboard-we're focused on the future as we continue to evolve as a company. With so many opportunities available, this is where you can make your mark and help define the FinTech industry. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead development teams through all phases of the Agile development life cycle. 
 - Coach and mentor junior talent, including pair-programming and reviewing AI-generated code with engineering judgment. 
 - Influence and collaborate with software developers, UX designers, product managers, application architects, and customer application experts to create amazing apps. 
 - Champion responsible adoption of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) on the team-setting prompt patterns, distinguishing AI Skills (deterministic capabilities) from Agents (autonomous, multi-step workflows), and following Synchrony's guidance for data handling, PII protection, IP compliance, and code provenance in regulated financial services contexts. 
 - Ensure compliance with architecture, security, and technology standards set by Synchrony. 
 - Participate in addressing root cause analyses, incident reports, and provide direction in problem resolution. 
 - Ability to analyze production defects, troubleshoot systems, identify root cause, and implement fixes. 
 - Provide 24x7 on-call support periodically throughout the year. 
 - Identify ways to increase efficiency and improve system performance, including by piloting AI tools and agentic workflows for repetitive engineering tasks. 
 - Work with third party vendors to develop software and/or integrate their software into Synchrony's products. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years in full stack development with a strong focus on JavaScript (React JS in particular) OR, in lieu of degree, with 7 years of experience in the same. 
 - Hands-on experience using at least one AI coding assistant (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as part of regular development workflow. 
 - Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, Styled-Components, and RTL or Cypress. 
 - Familiarity with AI-native concepts-RAG patterns, vector databases, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and agent orchestration-and how they differ from traditional architecture. 
 - Awareness of the open-source AI tooling ecosystem (Continue. dev, Aider, Cline, Ollama). 
 - Exposure to building or customizing AI agents/skills using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI) for engineering automation such as code review, documentation, or migration assistants. 
 - Live and breathe testing. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Knowledge of industry-wide technology trends and best practices. 
 - Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals. 
 - Advanced knowledge of application, data, and infrastructure architecture disciplines. 
 - Extremely self-driven and can work autonomously. 
 - A desire to be in the FinTech space. 
 - Start-up or consulting experience. 

Eligibility Criteria

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, plus 5+ years of experience in software development, design, and architecture. Proven track record as a tech lead or senior individual contributor. 

WORK TIMINGS: 2: 00 PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. 

For Internal Applicants

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. 

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. 

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients' systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that's shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Summary

As a Senior AI Native Engineer (IC3) at Keyloop, you will be a technical leader within your team, owning complex, multi-sprint projects and setting the standard for engineering quality. You will design and implement robust, scalable solutions, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and be a key driver of team culture and process improvements. We are tech stack agnostic: we believe a strong engineer with deep fundamentals and AI-assisted tooling can master any technology. This role is for engineers who combine deep technical expertise with strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence technical direction at the team level. 

Competency Expectations

Competency Expectations

Aligned with the Keyloop Engineering Career Framework, this role is assessed across five core competency domains: 

Competency Domain

What We Expect

Technical Mastery & Innovation

Designs and implements robust, scalable solutions for complex, team-sized projects. Is a recognized technical expert within the team. Drives architectural decisions and champions engineering best practices. 

Execution & Delivery

Owns the delivery of large, complex, multi-sprint projects. Is accountable for the operational health of the team's systems. Proactively identifies and mitigates technical risks. 

Leadership & Influence

Consistently mentors and coaches IC1s and IC2s. Is a key driver of team culture and process improvements. Builds consensus around technical decisions and influences team direction. 

Communication & Collaboration

Communicates complex technical ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Facilitates technical discussions, design reviews, and cross-functional alignment. 

Product & Business Impact

Deeply understands the team's product domain and user needs. Actively participates in product planning, shaping technical approaches based on business context and customer value. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement robust, scalable software solutions for complex, team-sized projects spanning multiple sprints
 - Lead technical design and architecture discussions within the team, ensuring solutions align with platform strategy
 - Own the end-to-end delivery of major features: from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
 - Drive engineering best practices including code quality standards, testing strategies, CI/CD improvements, and effective use of AI-assisted development tools
 - Mentor and coach IC1 and IC2 engineers, accelerating their technical growth through pairing, code reviews, and guidance
 - Be accountable for the operational health and reliability of the team's systems, including incident response and post-mortems
 - Facilitate technical discussions and build consensus on architectural and design decisions
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and stakeholders to shape the team's roadmap and technical approach
 - Identify and drive process improvements that increase team velocity, quality, and developer experience
 - Proactively identify technical debt, risks, and opportunities, proposing and leading initiatives to address them
 - Produce high-quality technical documentation including design documents, ADRs, and runbooks
 - Represent the team's technical perspective in cross-team discussions and planning forums

Technical Skills & Qualifications

Required: 

- . net AWS cloud . NET 8+, . NET Core, ASP. NET MVC, ASP. NET Web API, Entity Framework
 - Deep software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns, system design, and distributed systems principles
 - Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, with a proven track record of picking up new languages, frameworks, and paradigms quickly
 - Proven ability to design and implement scalable, maintainable, and well-tested software systems regardless of the underlying tech stack
 - Strong experience with modern development practices: TDD/BDD, CI/CD, code reviews, and automated testing
 - Solid understanding of cloud-native concepts, infrastructure patterns, and platform-level thinking
 - Experience with data modelling, query optimization, and working across different database paradigms
 - Understanding of API design, service-oriented architectures, event-driven patterns, and integration strategies
 - Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management practices
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted and AI-driven development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, agentic coding workflows) to accelerate development, architectural exploration, and technical problem-solving
 - A tech stack agnostic mindset: we value engineers who master fundamentals and use AI-assisted tooling to work effectively across any technology

Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated growth in scope and complexity

Nice to Have: 

- Experience working across multiple programming languages, frameworks, or tech stacks in production environments
 - Experience with containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code concepts
 - Experience leading or contributing to cross-team technical initiatives
 - Experience in the automotive, DMS, or SaaS product domain
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-driven development workflows (agentic coding, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering) to solve complex engineering problems
 - Experience coaching or enabling teams to adopt AI-assisted development practices
 - SAFe or Agile certifications

Soft Skills & Behaviours

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex ideas to diverse audiences
 - Strong mentoring and coaching ability, with a genuine commitment to developing others
 - Proven ability to build consensus and influence technical direction without formal authority
 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with accountability for the team's technical outcomes
 - Ability to facilitate productive technical discussions and navigate disagreements constructively
 - Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to user value and business outcomes
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first 3 months, you have a deep understanding of the team's domain, codebase, and systems, and you are already leading design discussions and delivering complex features
 - Within 6 months, you are the go-to technical authority on your team, owning multi-sprint projects end-to-end and driving measurable improvements to code quality and engineering practices
 - Within 12 months, you have mentored IC1 and IC2 engineers with visible growth in their capabilities, and you have led at least one significant initiative that improved team velocity, reliability, or developer experience
 - You consistently identify and address technical debt and risks before they become blockers, and you proactively propose solutions
 - You are recognized across the team as someone who builds consensus, facilitates productive discussions, and connects technical decisions to product and business outcomes
 - You leverage AI-assisted and AI-driven tools not just for your own productivity, but to elevate the team's engineering practices and adoption of modern workflows

What Sets This Role Apart

- confined to one. We invest in senior engineers who master fundamentals and leverage AI-assisted tooling to work effectively on any stack
 - AI-first engineering culture: as an IC3, you will shape how your team adopts AI-driven development practices within Keyloop's AI-Driven Development Program, influencing the next generation of engineering workflows
 - True technical ownership: you will own the architecture, delivery, and operational health of critical systems, with the autonomy to drive meaningful change
 - A clear, transparent career framework with defined competency expectations and pathways to Staff Engineer (IC4), Engineering Lead (M1), or other tracks that match your ambitions
 - Real platform impact: you will work on the Fusion Automotive Retail Platform, designing solutions that connect every phase of the vehicle lifecycle at scale
 - Investment in your leadership growth through continuous coaching, a Personal Development Plan (PDP), and the AI Champions enablement program

Our Guiding Principles

We are Bold: We challenge the status quo, explore new technologies, and champion high standards for quality. 

We are Authentic: We engage in open, honest, and respectful dialogue. We admit when we are wrong and are transparent about risks. 

We are United: We adopt a platform-first mentality, collaborate seamlessly across teams, and actively mentor others to elevate the entire team. 

Why join us?

We're on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. 

An inclusive environment to thrive

We're committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day. 

Be rewarded for your efforts

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. 

Keyloop doesn't require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials. 

We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. 

"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity. "

data.title: On-Site Installation Lead
data.description:
About the role

You will own how Wakefit Home Interiors gets installed in customers' homes: on time, right the first time, at a sustainable cost. 

This is a 0 to 1 role. There is no inherited playbook to run. You will build the systems for on-site quality and timely execution, then lead a team of carpenters and work with external agencies to deliver against them. 

Expect unknowns. The right person treats each new problem as a reason to build a repeatable, cost-effective solution rather than a one-time fix. 

Key responsibilities

Build the on-site quality system

- Define installation quality standards and site checklists for each stage of installation. 
 - Create SOPs that carpenters can follow consistently, with minimal dependence on any one person. 
 - Set up snag capture, root-cause tracking and closure, so repeat issues are fixed at the source. 
 - Own the handover standard: what "complete" means before the customer signs off. Build the timely execution system

- Plan and schedule installations so sites are ready, material is on site and crews are assigned before work starts. 
 - Track every installation against its committed timeline and flag delays early. 
 - Work with production and dispatch so what reaches the site matches what was designed. Lead the carpenter team

- Hire, onboard and train carpenters on Wakefit standards and SOPs. 
 - Allocate crews across sites to balance quality, timelines and productivity. 
 - Build skill development and accountability into how the team works. Manage external stakeholders

- Be the on-site point of coordination for customers and other external parties involved in installation. 
 - Resolve escalations at site and feed recurring issues back into the system. Keep it sustainable and cost-effective

- Track installation cost and find ways to reduce it without lowering quality. 
 - Choose solutions that scale with volume rather than adding headcount for every problem. KPIs Targets are to be set once baselines are established.

data.title: Sr Network DevOps Engineer - Operations
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

About Five9

Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results. 

Role Overview

To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. 

In this role you will: 

- Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics. 
 - Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design. 
 - Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale. 
 - Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments. 
 - Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers. 
 - Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues. 

Key Responsibilities

- Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure. 
 - Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash. 
 - Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico. 
 - Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia). 
 - Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes. 
 - Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment. 
 - Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e. g. , NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization. 

Qualifications & Skills

- 5+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC). 
 - Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM). 
 - Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico. 
 - Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale. 
 - Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet). 
 - Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e. g. , F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS). 
 - Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing. 
 - CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays. 
 - Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e. g. , GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes. 
 - Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics. 
 - Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives. 
 - Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous. 
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture.

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century.
