Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering. 

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
 - Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
 - Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
 - Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal )
 - L09+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.

 - Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring, and integration observability. 
 - Troubleshoot complex integration, API, authentication, and data-flow issues. 
 - Partner with architects, developers, business analysts, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable automation solutions.

 - Extensive experience developing: 
 - Workato Recipes 
 - Custom Connectors 
 - API Platform/API Recipes 
 - Webhooks 
 - Callable Recipes 
 - Error handling and monitoring 
 - Complex data transformations 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience with Python. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - REST APIs 
 - JSON 
 - OAuth 
 - Webhooks 
 - API authentication 
 - Event-driven architecture 
 - Data integration patterns 
 - Experience designing enterprise integration architecture and system-to-system data flows. 
 - Experience integrating multiple SaaS and enterprise applications. 
 - Experience with AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs). 
 - Experience with prompt engineering and AI-powered automation. 
 - Understanding or hands-on experience with: 
 - AI Agents 
 - Agentic workflows 
 - MCP 
 - RAG 
 - Vector databases / embeddings 
 - Ability to independently design and implement end-to-end automation solutions.

data.title: Engineering Manager - System Design
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst Ansätze, Projekte und Programme im Funktionsbereich oder der betroffenen Unternehmensorganisation und die Arbeitsweise. Beeinflusst die Qualität, Effizienz und Effektivität des eigenen Teams. Hat wesentlichen Einfluss auf die Prioritäten. Geleitet von professionellen Praktiken und Richtlinien, die von der Rolle selbst geprägt sind. Die Rolle verfügt über eine moderate Autonomie und erfordert ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem. 
 - Entwicklung von Fachwissen in der eigenen Disziplin. Dient als Ressource für bewährte Verfahren/Qualität. Hat Kenntnis der neuesten technischen Entwicklungen im eigenen Bereich. Trägt zur Strategie- und Richtlinienentwicklung bei und gewährleistet die Umsetzung im Verantwortungsbereich. 
 - Verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse zu Best Practices und über die Integration des eigenen Bereichs in andere Bereiche; verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
 - Verwendet Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen oder moderat komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb/Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen. Betrachtet bestehende Lösungen aus einer neuen Perspektive. Verwendet technische Erfahrung und Fachwissen für die Datenanalyse, um Empfehlungen zu unterstützen. Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung. Kann kleine Projekte mit moderaten Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten. Erklärt schwierige oder vertrauliche Informationen; arbeitet, um einen Konsens zu schaffen. Entwicklung von Überzeugungsfähigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um andere bei Themen innerhalb des Fachgebiets zu beeinflussen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule. 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description Summary

The Sr Engineer - Systems Architecture and Design is a senior technical role within PCS Hardware Platforms, providing shared systems-design leadership for Common OS and Common UI platform releases. The role ensures that both platforms meet system and product needs, comply with applicable medical-device standards and internal quality-system requirements, and are released with appropriate quality, traceability, risk controls, and technical evidence. 

The role aligns subsystem requirements, architecture, interfaces, design controls, verification strategies, technical reviews, release evidence, and lifecycle decisions across Common OS and Common UI. The Sr Engineer works with System Architects, Product Owners, platform and component architects, verification leaders, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, program teams, and consuming product teams. 

The position coordinates cross-platform dependencies, compatible baselines, integration milestones, product adoption, and consolidated release readiness. The role requires strong systems thinking, embedded software and Linux platform knowledge, reusable UI platform understanding, medical-device development rigor, and the ability to lead complex technical work through influence. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own subsystem requirement definitions derived from system requirements, user needs, intended use, and platform strategy; ensure flow-down to design outputs, component requirements, interfaces, and verification evidence. 
 - Provide shared systems-design leadership for coordinated Common OS and Common UI releases, including joint planning, dependency management, integration milestones, readiness reviews, and release decisions. 
 - Lead system decomposition, interface definition, architecture-to-requirement traceability, critical-to-quality attributes, non-functional requirements, and documented technical trade-offs. 
 - Balance safety, security, privacy, usability, performance, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, cost, reuse, and lifecycle sustainability. 
 - Own the subsystem Design History File strategy and ensure completeness, consistency, traceability, and audit readiness of engineering evidence. 
 - Define subsystem verification strategies and ensure bidirectional traceability among requirements, risks, verification methods, results, anomalies, and release decisions. 
 - Ensure subsystem and component Technical Design Review strategies align with system plans and the needs of Common OS and Common UI. 
 - Lead product and subsystem risk profiling based on intended use, safety, privacy, and cybersecurity; drive FMEA, FTA, risk-benefit analysis, and risk-control traceability. 
 - Define and monitor platform-health metrics covering quality, reliability, cybersecurity, defect trends, performance, technical debt, obsolescence, and adoption. 
 - Review product-to-platform and Common OS-to-Common UI interface requirements; maintain clear interface ownership, compatibility expectations, and supported version combinations. 
 - Drive integrated validation with product teams, including interface, compatibility, performance, upgrade, failure-recovery, cybersecurity, and regression considerations. 
 - Establish integrated Common OS and Common UI release-readiness reviews covering dependencies, risks, verification evidence, deviations, known limitations, and product-consumption readiness. 
 - Coordinate defect triage and technical decisions for issues crossing operating system, UI framework, middleware, application, hardware, or product boundaries. 
 - Conceptualize and drive proofs of concept for new platform capabilities and influence Common OS, Common UI, process, and engineering-tool roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and emerging system designers in systems engineering, design controls, risk management, technical reviews, and evidence-based decision making. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related STEM discipline. 
 - Typically 10+ years of engineering experience, including substantial experience in systems architecture and design, embedded software, platform engineering, or medical-device development. 
 - Demonstrated experience translating system and product needs into subsystem requirements, interfaces, design outputs, verification strategies, and traceable release evidence. 
 - Experience with regulated product development, design controls, risk management, quality systems, and cross-functional technical reviews. 
 - Technical depth in embedded Linux architecture and development, middleware or application architecture, cybersecurity, reusable platform technologies, and Qt/QML application development. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as C or C++, with scripting experience using Python and/or shell. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, products, sites, or business stakeholders through influence. 

Desired Characteristics

- Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Experience developing and sustaining reusable platforms consumed by multiple medical-device products. 
 - Experience coordinating releases across interdependent operating-system and user-interface platform areas. 
 - Experience with Yocto Project or Buildroot, Linux BSPs, bootloaders, device drivers, NXP or TI application processors, and hands-on Qt/QML development for embedded user interfaces. 
 - Working knowledge of INCOSE-aligned systems-engineering practices, requirements modelling, interface management, CTQs, FMEA, FTA, and risk-benefit analysis. 
 - Experience with Agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, automated verification, configuration management, SBOM practices, lifecycle vulnerability management, and defect management. 
 - Experience across concept, new product introduction, sustaining engineering, installed-base support, obsolescence, and end-of-life phases. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams, quality and regulatory partners, product stakeholders, and senior leadership. 
 - Demonstrated commitment to acting with humility, leading with transparency, delivering with focus, driving ownership, and operating with unyielding integrity.

data.description:
About Albertsons: 

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub in India: 

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & responsibilities: 

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required: 

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others.

If you're looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

Business Descriptor

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC's purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world's most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. 

Role Purpose

Providing superior customer service and ensuring operational efficiency in all Teller and clearing functions like withdrawals, deposits, transfers, customer queries on transactions

Principal Accountabilities: Key activities and decision making areas

Impact on the Business

- Increasing PIB registrations and migrating teller queues to the ATMs. 
 - Ensure that a Cross sell attempt is made for every customer interaction at the teller counter 
 - Process cash payments and accept cash deposits after carrying out all necessary operational checks as per guidelines. 
 - All operational requirements like bundling, labeling, sorting of notes is done and no soiled notes are handed over back to the customer. 
 - Ensure that his/her cash position is as per the laid down cash control procedures, and cash till is balanced end of day every day. 
 - Minimize cash differences and ensure that they are informed immediately to the Teller Supervisor. 
 - Maintain control over all deliverables like cheque books, Cards, pins, welcome packs, IWPs. Ensure that all collect items are handed over to the customers as per the laid down operational guidelines and after carrying out all necessary checks as mandated from time to time. 
 - Ensure satisfactory implementation of all audit recommendations with the assistance of the Teller Supervisor. To identify process gaps with a view to ensure compliance of the procedures. 
 - Ensure that ATMs are replenished and all ATM related facilities are available to the customer as required by the internal policy of the bank. 

Typical Targets And Measures

- Transaction migration to ADCs 
 - Cross Sell of bank products 
 - Teller Operations 
 - Error Rates

Customers/Stakeholders

- Ensure effective service of customers by providing prompt and qualitative service 
 - Through effective service delivery, which would include prompt reply to customer queries and complaints, identifying and implementing initiatives to reduce customer waiting time, monitoring customer service scores on an ongoing basis and driving improvements in these scores 
 - Ensure that customer complaints are handled within defined TATs, and all staff is sensitised to proactively manage customer service issues 
 - Dockable complaints should be kept within acceptable benchmarks 
 - VOC on the Teller Parameters

Leadership & Teamwork

- Teamwork 
 - By effective communication and by regular discussions and feedback

Operational Effectiveness & Control

- Teller functions

( applicable for CSMs in smaller branches)

- Audit and operational responsibility. Maintain HSBC internal control standards. 
 - Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations 
 - Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures. 
 - Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities 
 - Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required 
 - Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe 
 - Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC; 
 - Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager 
 - Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP. 
 - To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc 
 - Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down. 
 - Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers 
 - Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures 
 - To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same 
 - Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP 
 - Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification 
 - The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner 
 - Reduction in customer waiting periods, and accurate transaction processing. 
 - Ensuring zero error rates, and minimization of cash shortages, frauds, etc. 
 - To ensure exception reports are monitored to ensure adequate control on the branch operations 
 - To ensure satisfactory audit ratings/no adverse comments from internal, external and RBI auditors by exercising caution while handling foreign currency transactions. 

Major Challenges

Constant pressure of customer queries

Role Context

Service proposition is a key differentiator in any retail business, and the jobholder needs to ensure a positive customer experience on a consistent basis in basic retail banking operations

Management of Risk

Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks. 

Observation of Internal Controls (Compliance Policy / FIM requirements)

- Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner. 

Role Dimensions

- Is well organized and depicts professional image 
 - Displays close bonding with immediate team members and skillful association with support group colleagues

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

- University (BA) or (BS) 
 - Knowledge of operational integrity required by the Group 
 - Holistic understanding of the Branch Operations 
 - Through Knowledge of Branch operations, various matrices and Processes of the bank

Additional Notes

- Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage. 
 - Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required. 

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable. 

You'll achieve more at HSBC. 

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

data.title: Manager Threat Research (Integration-Detections)
data.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you will not just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you will help lead the change. Our global team is made up of people who thrive on solving complex problems, moving quickly, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and International Data Corporation MarketScape. What matters most is the work behind these recognitions: delivering real outcomes for customers through award-winning innovation such as our Aurora Platform. 

If you are looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth company that is redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you. 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. 

We are looking for a Manager - Detection Engineering, XDR to lead detection development activities and help achieve our mission of End Cyber Risk. 

The Manager - Detection Engineering, XDR plans and directs all aspects of detection development activities within their team. This includes ensuring that engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are aligned with the organization's established policies and objectives. 

The Manager reports to a Senior Manager of Research and Development and works closely with Research and Development Leadership, Product Management, and Security Services (S2) to ensure the team is building what our customers and users need in a timely manner. 

This is a detection development team responsible for building generalized detections across multiple telemetry sources, including endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email, to provide broad Extended Detection and Response (XDR) coverage for customers. Managers may also have specialized subject matter expertise within the technical areas their teams support. 

SCOPE OF ROLE

- Generate and manage the day-to-day work for the team. 
 - Work with the Product Team to define and deliver the six-month roadmap. 
 - Contribute to longer-term planning and strategy in partnership with the Director. 
 - Provide direction, clarity, and support to the team to ensure detection development activities remain focused on organizational and customer needs. 

In This Role, You Will

Team Leadership and Detection Development

- Manage teams responsible for delivering high-quality, innovative detection content spanning multiple telemetry sources. 
 - Work collaboratively with architects, developers, Product Managers, data engineers, and security analysts. 
 - Support the team by providing direction, clarity, and removing obstacles. 
 - Instill the Foundations of Research and Development within the team by living them on a daily basis. 
 - Set and maintain a high technical bar for detection quality, coverage, and false-positive rates across the team's output. 
 - Ensure teams are highly motivated, performing well, and delivering work on time. 
 - Ensure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve. 
 - Work with team members to deliver key features. 
 - Build collaborative relationships with other teams and stakeholders within the organization. 

Product Roadmap and Detection Strategy

- Execute the Product roadmap. 
 - Work with the Product Team to define and deliver the six-month roadmap. 
 - Work with Architects to define and execute on the company's technical roadmap. 
 - Drive detection coverage expansion across telemetry sources, ensuring breadth and depth of XDR detection capabilities. 
 - Champion cross-telemetry detection strategies that maximize coverage while minimizing false positives across diverse customer environments. 
 - Own detection quality metrics and continuously raise the bar on precision, recall, and mean-time-to-detect. 
 - Represent the team's work to senior leadership with data-driven reporting on detection coverage, efficacy, and operational impact. 

Detection Development Lifecycle

- Oversee the full detection development lifecycle, from research and hypothesis through implementation, testing, tuning, and retirement. 
 - Establish and enforce rigorous peer review processes for all detection content before production deployment. 
 - Ensure the team delivers high-quality detection content across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email telemetry. 
 - Ensure detection development processes and engineering initiatives remain aligned with organizational policies and objectives. 

Team Execution and Delivery

- Remove blockers preventing teams from getting their work done. 
 - Make sure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve. 
 - Support the team in delivering key features and detection capabilities. 
 - Drive continuous development process improvements. 
 - Continuously improve team velocity and delivery predictability. 
 - Lead Agile development practices across the team. 

Research and Development Responsibilities

- Implement the Research and Development Department and Team Responsibilities. 
 - Ensure teams are following Information Security Management System (ISMS) regulations, including: Secure Coding Practices Acceptable Use
 - Establish and maintain processes that support technical excellence and secure detection development. 

People Development and Mentoring

- Develop the careers of team members. 
 - Mentor each team member and help them grow their technical and leadership skills. 
 - Establish career development plans and achievable goals for direct reports. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-ones. 
 - Provide career and personal development coaching. 
 - Build a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence. 
 - Maintain a clear history of learning and skills development across the team. 
 - Regularly help detection developers develop their skills in a variety of ways. 
 - Support and mentor individuals toward senior and lead roles. 

Administrative and Financial Responsibilities

- Manage employee compensation and vacation time. 
 - Manage and approve conference and training budgets. 
 - Participate in helping set and manage the Directorate-level budget. 
 - Apply strong financial management skills to team and organizational responsibilities. 

Recruitment

- Lead recruitment efforts for the team for both full-time and co-op employees. 
 - Be a key contributor to planning, hiring, and recruitment strategy for the team. 
 - Maintain a high hiring bar by assessing candidates for both depth of security knowledge and breadth of cross-domain thinking. 

We're Looking For Someone With Experience In

- 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on detection engineering, threat detection, or security analytics at scale. 
 - 3+ years of management or team lead experience in a cybersecurity or detection engineering role, with demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing teams. 
 - Deep understanding of diverse telemetry sources, including: Endpoint and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) Network and Network Detection and Response (NDR) Cloud, including Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP) Identity Provider (IdP) telemetry Email security
 - Hands-on experience normalizing and correlating signals across diverse telemetry sources. 
 - Proven track record of developing detection content using correlation rules, behavioral analytics, and machine learning-based approaches across heterogeneous data sources in production environments. 
 - Expert-level familiarity with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) platforms and query languages such as Splunk Processing Language (SPL), Kusto Query Language (KQL), SQL, Sigma, or equivalent. 
 - Ability to evaluate detection efficacy through metrics-driven approaches. 
 - Strong knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and demonstrated experience applying it to detection coverage mapping, gap analysis, and prioritization. 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell, with the ability to build tooling and automation for detection development workflows. 
 - Experience leading Agile development teams, preferably with formal Agile training. 
 - Track record of continuously improving team velocity and delivery predictability. 
 - A clear history of technical influence, such as public conference talks, published research, open-source contributions, patents, or similar contributions. 
 - A clear history of learning and skills development. 
 - Experience regularly helping detection developers develop their skills and mentoring individuals into senior or lead roles. 
 - Professional security certifications are required, such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCED, GREM, or OSCP. 
 - Permanently located in Bengaluru, India. 

Nice To Have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field. 
 - Formal Agile training. 
 - Experience with machine learning-based detection approaches. 
 - Experience building and managing generalized detection capabilities across multiple telemetry sources. 
 - Experience with cross-telemetry detection strategies and XDR coverage. 
 - Experience with detection quality metrics, including precision, recall, and mean-time-to-detect. 
 - Experience with technical research, public speaking, published research, open-source contributions, or patents. 

Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good. 

We celebrate diverse perspectives through our Pack Unity program and encourage employees to participate in or create new alliances. 

We also believe in corporate responsibility and have joined the Pledge One Percent movement to give back to our communities. 

All Employees Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

- Equity for all employees
 - Flexible annual leave, paid holidays, and volunteer days
 - Training and career development programs
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance equal to three times compensation, and personal accident insurance
 - Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under applicable law. We are committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, and inclusive environment. 

Security Requirements

- Conduct duties in accordance with Arctic Wolf information security policies, standards, processes, and controls
 - Background checks are required for this position
 - This role may require access to information protected under United States export control laws and regulations

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Lead Data Engineer to lead data migration, data engineering, and data governance initiatives supporting our next-generation Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform. 

This role is responsible for defining migration strategies, designing scalable data architectures, establishing governance frameworks, and leading teams responsible for migrating and integrating data from legacy platforms into Salesforce and Enterprise Service Management ecosystems.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - IPv6 Networking exp is a must**
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

About the Role

SonicWall is seeking a Senior Software Engineer  with deep IPv6 expertise to lead the design, implementation, and hardening of IPv6 capabilities across the Sonicwall firewall firmware stack. As a Principal Engineer, you will be the technical authority for IPv6 feature parity, protocol correctness, and interoperability across SonicWall Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms. This role is ideal for engineers with hands-on experience delivering IPv6 in high-performance router, switch, or carrier-grade networking products who are looking to apply that expertise in the embedded network security domain. 

Responsibilities

- Lead IPv6 Architecture & Feature Delivery - Own end-to-end design and implementation of IPv6 features across the Sonicwall frewall networking stack, including IPv6 routing, interface addressing, DHCPv6, NDP, MLDv2, and IPv6 Policy-Based Routing (PBR). 
 - Drive IPv6 Feature Parity - Identify and close gaps between IPv4 and IPv6 feature sets across subsystems - including VPN Tunnel Interfaces, IPsec/IKEv2, SSL-VPN, Syslog, SNMP, and NAT64 - ensuring consistent dual-stack and IPv6-only operation. 
 - Design High-Performance IPv6 Packet Processing Paths - Architect and optimize the IPv6 dataplane for packet forwarding, classification, ACL matching, and session lookup within the sonicwall high-performance packet-processing pipeline. 
 - Resolve Complex IPv6 Protocol Issues - Diagnose and resolve deep-rooted interoperability, conformance, and performance issues involving IPv6 neighbor discovery, prefix delegation, ICMPv6 error handling, and fragmentation edge cases. 
 - Establish IPv6 Protocol Conformance Standards - Define and drive compliance with IETF IPv6 RFCs (RFC 2460, RFC 4291, RFC 4861, RFC 4862, RFC 6724, RFC 8200, and related extensions) within the Sonicwall frewall codebase. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Platform, Security, Data Platform, and QA teams to integrate IPv6 changes safely across subsystems and validate correctness at scale. 
 - Prototype and Evaluate IPv6 Technologies - Evaluate emerging IPv6 transition mechanisms (464XLAT, MAP-T, CLAT, SRv6) and contribute to next-generation NGFW networking capabilities. 
 - Influence Technical Direction - Drive architectural decisions, IPv6 scalability strategies, and long-term technical roadmap for protocol parity and government/federal compliance (USGv6, IPv6-ready certification, DoD IPv6 mandates). 
 - Mentorship & Technical Leadership - Serve as the IPv6 subject-matter expert (SME) for the Sonicwall frewall engineering org; mentor senior and mid-level engineers and lead cross-team IPv6 technical design reviews. Requirements

- 7- 9+ years of hands-on C/C++ systems-level development for networking platforms - with a strong emphasis on routers, Layer-3 switches, carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) devices, or network security appliances. 
 - Deep IPv6 Protocol Expertise - Proven, production-level implementation experience with: 
 - IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and prefix delegation (DHCPv6-PD)
 - Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP), Router Advertisements (RA), and MLDv2
 - IPv6 routing protocols (OSPFv3, BGP with IPv6 AFI/SAFI, RIPng)
 - IPsec/IKEv2 over IPv6 transport
 - IPv6 ACLs, PBR, and traffic classification at line rate
 - IPv6 transition and coexistence mechanisms (Dual-Stack, 6in4, 6rd, NAT64/DNS64, 464XLAT)
 - L2/L3/L4 Networking Depth - Solid understanding of Ethernet, VLANs, 802. 1Q, bridging, routing (static and dynamic), NAT, firewall state tables, and VPN tunneling in the context of both IPv4 and IPv6. 
 - High-Performance Packet Processing - Experience with DPDK, ODP, OFP, XDP/eBPF, or comparable frameworks for low-latency, high-throughput packet forwarding is a strong advantage. 
 - Protocol Conformance & Testing - Experience validating IPv6 implementations against IETF RFC requirements and government IPv6-ready test suites (USGv6, IPv6-Ready Logo Phase-2) is highly desirable. 
 - Strong Debugging & Diagnostic Skills - Proficient with tcpdump, Wireshark (IPv6 dissectors), GDB, kernel trace tools, and network emulation environments (GNS3, EVE-NG, or equivalent) for root-cause analysis of IPv6 issues. 
 - Communication & Leadership - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to lead cross-functional IPv6 design discussions, write technical specifications, and represent engineering in product and architecture reviews. Nice to Have

- Experience with government / federal IPv6 compliance requirements (DoD IPv6 mandate, NIST SP 500-267, USGv6 Profile). 
 - Exposure to SRv6 (Segment Routing over IPv6) or MPLS over IPv6 architectures. 
 - Familiarity with Sonicwall frewall, SonicWall NGFWs, or similar embedded network security firmware. 
 - Working knowledge of WireGuard over IPv6 transport. 
 - Experience with automated IPv6 test frameworks (RFC 2544, IXIA, Spirent, or similar). 

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries. 

Applicant Privacy Notice

Also, you're expected to architect solutions, mentor junior developers, and own entire features from design through production. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Frontend Development: Building responsive, performant user interfaces with React, managing state, and implementing complex UI interactions
 - Backend Development: Designing and implementing APIs using . NET (C# with ASP. NET Core or Framework), managing business logic, and ensuring system reliability
 - Database Design: Creating efficient SQL Server schemas, optimizing queries, and ensuring data integrity
 - System Architecture: Contributing to decisions about application structure, scalability, and integration patterns

 - Collaboration: Working with designers, product managers, QA, and other developers
 - Performance Optimization: Ensuring fast load times, efficient database queries, and optimized React rendering
 - Documentation: Maintaining API documentation and architectural decision records

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Full-Stack Microsoft Expertise: You need strong knowledge across the entire Microsoft stack-React for frontend, . NET/C# for backend, and SQL Server for data. You should understand how these technologies integrate and optimize across all layers. 
 - Enterprise-Level Thinking: Enterprise applications require scalability, security, maintainability, and reliability. You should think about long-term implications of technical decisions, not just short-term solutions. 
 - Database Optimization: SQL Server expertise with understanding of query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design patterns that support high-performance applications. 
 - Communication: Explaining technical decisions about architecture, technology choices, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Problem-Solving Across Layers: Ability to diagnose whether a performance issue is in the React UI, . NET API, the database, or network layer-and fix it systematically. 

Ideally, you'll also

- 5+ Years in . NET and React Development should have spent substantial time building production applications with both technologies. This typically means multiple projects where you've seen different architectural patterns, scaling challenges, and business requirements. 
 - C# Expertise: Deep knowledge of C# including LINQ, async/await, delegates, events, generics, and modern language features (nullable types, records, tuples, etc)
 - API Design: Building RESTful APIs following best practices, versioning strategies, and proper HTTP status codes
 - Authentication & Authorization: Implementing authentication (JWT, OAuth, Windows Auth) and role-based access control
 - React Proficiency: Modern component-based UI development with hooks, state management, and performance optimization. React is the standard for building dynamic user interfaces in this stack. 
 - . NET Mastery: Deep knowledge of C# and the . NET ecosystem, including async/await patterns, dependency injection, middleware, and entity framework. Understanding both . NET Framework and . NET Core is valuable. 
 - Database Optimization: SQL Server expertise with understanding of query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design patterns that support high-performance applications. 
 - Advanced React Knowledge: Deep proficiency with React hooks (useState, useContext, useReducer, custom hooks), functional components, and lifecycle methods
 - JSX & Component Architecture: Building reusable, well-structured components with proper prop management and composition patterns
 - State Management: Experience with major state management solutions
 - CSS & Styling: Proficiency with CSS-in-JS solutions (styled-components, Emotion) or CSS modules, responsive design, and styling best practices
 - Performance Optimization: Understanding React performance (memorization, lazy loading, code splitting, virtualization)
 - Testing: Writing unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, integration tests, and snapshot testing

 - Version Control: Expert-level Git proficiency including branching strategies and workflows

 - Azure: Proficiency with Azure services commonly used with . NET. 
 - Monitoring & Logging: Setting up logging (Serilog, NLog), monitoring, and alerting
 - Design Patterns: Understanding and implementing common patterns (Repository, Factory, Observer, Strategy, etc)
 - SOLID Principles: Writing code that follows Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion principles
 - Clean Architecture: Building applications with clear separation of concerns across layers

What We Look For

EY People Consulting is likely seeking someone who: 

- Enterprise-Ready Developer: Someone who writes production-quality code that scales and is secure

Are you a customer-obsessed software engineer and technical architect who is passionate about applying AI to complex, real-world problems? You will write production code, lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, and guide engineers across organizational boundaries through technical influence rather than people management. 

This is a deeply technical individual contributor role with broad architectural scope and direct accountability for production outcomes. You will turn ambiguous customer and business problems into scalable systems, make critical design decisions, build foundational components, and help teams ship secure and reliable AI services that handle thousands of customer cases per month.

Lead through hands-on engineering: Write, review, and maintain production-quality C# and Python code. Build critical components, reference implementations, prototypes, and reusable platform capabilities that accelerate delivery across the engineering organization. 

- Own end-to-end technical delivery: Translate ambiguous customer support scenarios into clear technical requirements and take solutions from architecture and experimentation through implementation, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.

Drive technical consistency while allowing teams to evolve their solutions.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

As part of the Azure AI Foundry Customization team, you'll help build the cutting-edge platform that powers Azure's innovation-and all of Microsoft's flagship products, from GitHub and Microsoft 365 to Xbox. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to empower every AI application on the planet. 

Here, you'll work at the heart of a deeply technical environment, designing systems that enable AI to learn, improve, and scale in production. You'll tackle some of the toughest industry challenges - making frontier models not just powerful, but also accessible, efficient, and cost-effective for enterprises everywhere. By developing pre-training, mid-training, and post-training solutions, you'll help organizations build AI systems that continuously learn and adapt, using the models most relevant to their workloads. 

This role gives you end-to-end ownership and exposure, from high-level APIs to granular reinforcement learning controls, and from Azure ML flexibility to deploying LoRA models and inferencing at scale. You'll deliver services, pipelines, ML recipes, evaluations, and integrations-supported by Azure's world-class data centers and GPU infrastructure. With innovations like single-click training data generation, dynamic model routing, and a global partner ecosystem, you'll help close the loop between deployment and learning, unlocking massive improvements in cost, speed, and reliability.

data.title: E-Commerce QA Engineer (SAP Commerce Cloud – B2B)
data.description:
Job Description: E-Commerce QA Engineer (SAP Commerce Cloud - B2B)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced E-Commerce QA Engineer to join our B2B digital commerce team. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our SAP Commerce Cloud (CCV2) platform, which integrates with an ECC backend via SAP Datahub and is configured through Backoffice. The ideal candidate will thrive in an agile environment, balancing hands-on functional testing with test automation to support continuous delivery, while maintaining rigorous quality gates and providing visibility into deployment health through dashboards and metrics. 

Key Responsibilities

Sprint-Based Testing & Agile Collaboration Work closely with Business Analysts and Tech Leads to review and clarify sprint stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs. Translate business and technical requirements into comprehensive test cases covering both positive and negative scenarios. Participate in sprint ceremonies (planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint review, retrospectives) to represent QA perspective and raise risks early. 

Functional & Platform Testing Perform functional, integration, and end-to-end testing across SAP Commerce Cloud (CCV2) storefronts, ECC backend transactions, Datahub integration flows, and Backoffice configuration changes. Validate B2B-specific workflows such as account hierarchies, contract pricing, approval workflows, punchout, quoting, and order management. Test data flow integrity between Commerce Cloud, Datahub, and ECC (e. g. , pricing, inventory, order sync, customer master data). 

Regression Management & Test Automation Build and maintain a robust regression suite covering core storefront and integration scenarios to support continuous delivery. Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for ongoing development, prioritizing high-risk and high-frequency regression areas. Continuously expand automation coverage as new features are delivered, reducing manual regression effort over time. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast feedback on builds and deployments. 

Quality Gatekeeping & Documentation Document test plans, test cases, execution results, and defects in a structured, traceable manner. Own quality gate decisions for sprint deliverables and releases, ensuring no critical defects or unresolved risks pass into production without sign-off. Maintain clear defect logs with root cause classification (e. g. , requirement miss, development miss, QA miss) to support continuous process improvement. 

Reporting & Metrics Prepare and maintain dashboards tracking release/deployment quality, test coverage, automation progress, and defect trends. Track and report failure metrics by category (requirement gaps, development defects, QA escapes) to identify systemic improvement areas. Present quality summaries to stakeholders (BA, Tech Leads, Product Owners, Management) at sprint and release milestones. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ years of QA experience in e-commerce, with at least 2+ years working on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) or similar platforms
 - Solid understanding of B2B e-commerce workflows (account management, contract pricing, quotes, approvals, punchout)
 - Experience testing integrations involving SAP ECC and middleware/integration layers (SAP Datahub or similar, e. g. , MuleSoft, Boomi)
 - Familiarity with SAP Commerce Backoffice for configuration validation
 - Hands-on experience with test automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar; SAP Commerce-specific test frameworks a plus)
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum sprint cycles and CI/CD-driven delivery
 - Strong test case design skills covering positive, negative, edge, and boundary scenarios
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e. g. , JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, ALM)
 - Ability to build reporting dashboards (e. g. , JIRA dashboards, Power BI, Excel, or similar) for tracking quality metrics
 - Strong analytical skills to classify and root-cause defects (requirement, development, or QA origin)
 - Excellent communication skills to collaborate with BAs, Tech Leads, Developers, and Product OwnersPreferred Qualifications

- SAP Commerce Cloud certification or hands-on Hybris platform experience
 - Experience with API testing tools (Postman, SoapUI) for Datahub/ECC integration validation
 - Familiarity with performance/load testing concepts for e-commerce platforms
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI) and version control (Git)
 - Experience in a B2B manufacturing, distribution, or industrial commerce environmentWhat Success Looks Like

- A stable, expanding automated regression suite that keeps pace with sprint velocity
 - Clear, traceable documentation supporting confident go/no-go release decisions
 - Dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into release quality and defect trends
 - Reduced production escapes through strong quality gatekeeping and early defect detection

Below are the must haves (as per the client): 

- Sprint Testing & Agile Collaboration with Dev Team
 - SAP Commerce CCV2 Functional & Platform Testing
 - Regression Testing
 - Automation (Playwright/Selenium/Cypress) - Enables continuous automation once sprint testing is complete

Good to have: 

- Reporting & Dashboard for Quality Metrics
 - Test Management Tools
 - Defect Classification & Triaging
 - Middleware Testing

Summary

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. Our environment is collaborative, customer-obsessed, and innovation-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform. 

As a Guidewire Architect focused on ClaimCenter / Jutro, you will define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for complex Guidewire implementations, modernization programs, and digital transformation initiatives across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will provide architectural leadership for ClaimCenter implementations, claims transformation programs, and digital experience solutions built using Jutro, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions that accelerate customer value. 

This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers' path to value while contributing to Professional Services' mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation. 

Job Description

What you'll do

- Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro-based digital solutions across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with customer enterprise architecture and Guidewire best practices. 
 - Lead solution design and implementation, including ClaimCenter configuration and customization (Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, integrations, and plugins) and/or Jutro digital experience architecture, UI design, and portal development, delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Architect and oversee complex integrations between Guidewire applications and enterprise systems such as policy administration, billing, CRM, document management, data platforms, and third-party services using APIs, web services, messaging, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Provide technical leadership to cross-functional delivery teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering governance, driving quality, reusability, automation, and best-in-class delivery practices. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, architects, and customer teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions that address performance, availability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence. 
 - Champion cloud adoption, AI-enabled delivery, and automation initiatives to accelerate implementation timelines, improve productivity, and establish repeatable delivery patterns across programs. 
 - Contribute to organizational assets including accelerators, reference architectures, technical standards, and thought leadership while promoting knowledge sharing across Guidewire, customer, and partner teams globally. 
 - At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI-empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes. 

Required

What you'll bring

- Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, automation, and data-driven insights to improve delivery efficiency, solution quality, and customer outcomes. 
 - 10-18 years of software engineering and architecture experience, including significant hands-on expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro, with experience leading at least two large-scale implementation, modernization, or cloud transformation programs. 
 - Deep expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter configuration and architecture, including Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, activities, integrations, plugins, and Guidewire development best practices; or strong expertise in Jutro architecture and development, including digital portals, UI frameworks, component design, and customer-facing insurance applications. 
 - Guidewire ClaimCenter ACE Certification, Jutro certification, or equivalent Guidewire implementation credentials preferred. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering complex integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging frameworks, and event-driven architectures across Guidewire and enterprise ecosystems. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, cloud-native architecture, performance optimization, security best practices, scalability, resiliency, and non-functional requirements for mission-critical applications. 
 - Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences in Agile delivery environments. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, customers, and time zones. 

Preferred

- Experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP), including cloud-native implementation patterns, observability, DevOps, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Proven success leading ClaimCenter Cloud, Jutro digital transformation, or Guidewire modernization programs leveraging automation and AI-enabled delivery approaches. 
 - Familiarity with other Guidewire products such as PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Data Platform, and Analytics. 
 - Experience with modern microservices, API-first architectures, event-driven systems, and digital experience platforms. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Your Impact

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services' priorities around AI-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery. 

You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire's cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world's P&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire's ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

About This Job

Verve's Systems Engineering team keeps a high-throughput, real-time ad-serving platform fast and available, running on GCP and Kubernetes (GKE) and serving traffic around the clock. We're looking for an engineer who treats reliability as a software problem, measuring it, engineering for it, and automating away whatever gets in the way. The role combines hands-on ownership of production systems with building tools and services that other engineers rely on every day. You'll define what "reliable" means for our services, build the observability to prove it, and write the code that keeps systems healthy at scale. When something is manual, fragile, or slow, you're the person who writes the code to fix it. You'll have real ownership: shaping how our platform evolves, making architectural calls on reliability and scalability, and working closely with backend and data teams to design services that hold up under real-world load. 

What You'll Do

- Define, measure, and uphold SLOs and error budgets for critical services, and use them to guide engineering priorities
 - Design and operate highly available, fault-tolerant infrastructure on GCP and Kubernetes for high-throughput, latency-sensitive workloads
 - Build observability across metrics, logs, tracing, and alerting that surfaces real user impact and cuts noise
 - Lead incident response, run blameless postmortems, and drive the fixes that stop problems from recurring
 - Reduce toil by writing tools, services, and automation (in Go, Python, or similar) that replace manual operational work
 - Own capacity planning, performance tuning, and cost efficiency as traffic grows
 - Partner with product, backend, and data teams on production readiness, resilient architecture, and safe release practices (progressive rollouts, automated rollback)
 - Participate in on-call and continuously improve its sustainability

What You Will Bring

- Hands-on experience keeping large-scale, cloud-native production systems reliable
 - Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes (GKE) in production, including how they behave under load and how they fail
 - Practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and incident management
 - Solid software development skills in Go / Python / Rust, or similar, with good coding practices (testing, code review, maintainability) and a track record of shipping tools or services others depend on
 - Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform and cloud APIs
 - Experience with observability tooling such as Grafana, VictoriaLogs, and PagerDuty
 - Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD and GitHub Actions
 - Experience operating databases in production
 - Good understanding of networking, event messaging, and distributed systems failure modes
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across the stack, from Linux and networking up to application behavior
 - Full business proficiency in English
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

What We Offer

 - Keep healthy through our Apollo Health Check-ups, and stay covered with our Medical Insurance for you and your family
 - Pick what matters most to you in our INR 4100/month Personalized Benefits Platform: Travel, entertainment, food, fitness, and healthcare
 - Have us cover your office lunches 3 times a week through Zomato, and enjoy office sweets, snacks, and beverages
 - Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars, and level up your language skills through our German/English classes

 - Strengthen team connections while exploring new cultures through our monthly Work&Travel raffle, offering a chance to work from one of our global offices (after 2 years of employment)

Behavioral Competencies

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience in designing, building, and deploying multi‐layered application architectures across on‐premises and AWS cloud environments using services such as EC2, ECS, S3, VPC, RDS, SQS, ELB, Auto Scaling, CloudFront, CloudFormation, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and SNS.

Proficiency across multiple frontend and backend technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular or React, Java, Python, and Node. js.

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.
