data.description:
#RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we're on a mission to end cyber risk. 

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity. 

More than 3, 000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference. 

We're constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level. 

About The Position

Job Description

About The Role

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 600 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our Realtime analysis and threat detection systems. These services distil the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers. 

We are looking for experienced quality engineers to join our pack and work with us to build and expand the capabilities of our testing platform. 

You Will

- Create and extend software frameworks and tools to run, monitor, and report on automated tests. Have experience building and maintaining Automation frameworks and CI/CD pipeline. 
 - Review testing strategies, approaches, and test plans and provide insight to development teams. 
 - Architect, design and build software to automate a variety of testing methods (e. g. API validation, performance/load testing, fuzzing, etc. ) 
 - Develop and maintain test frameworks for GenAI-based and AI/ML applications, including model validation, LLM prompt-response consistency, hallucination detection, and regression testing for AI inference APIs. 
 - Implement evaluation pipelines to test LLM accuracy, latency, bias, toxicity, and reliability. 
 - Work as part of a team of highly skilled software professionals. 
 - Continuously learn and expand your technical horizons 
 - Our Technology Stack: Selenium, Playwright, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, SQS, S3, etc. ), LangChain, LLM evaluation frameworks (e. g. , Ragas), OpenAPI, Postgres, Linux. 

You

- Are excited to work at the intersection of AIML, Big Data and the Cybersecurity problem space 
 - Have 2 - 4 years of experience shipping quality software 
 - Love driving high software quality 
 - Have experience deploying services on cloud computing platforms (e. g, AWS, Azure, GCP) 
 - Are an expert using common tools for executing functional, load and fuzz testing (e. g. Locust, CATS) 
 - Have worked on distributed systems and microservices architecture (preferred)

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we're cultivating a collaborative and productive work environment that welcomes a diversity of backgrounds, cultures, and ideas to make our teams even stronger as we grow globally. We've been named one of the 50 Most Innovative Companies in the world for 2022 (Fast Company)-and the 2nd Most Innovative Security Company. Top Workday USA (2021-2024)

Great Place to Work (2022-2024) & Best Workplaces for Women (2024) in Canada

Best Workplaces in Tech & For Women in the UK (2023)

Top Company by Kununu in Germany (2024)

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf. com. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. 

Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. 

We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

Security Requirements

Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN's Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies). 

Background checks are required for this position. 

Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business and customer information.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran's test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques. 

As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran's testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results. 

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. 

Technologies You'll Use

- Java11, JUnit5, 
 - Docker and Kubernetes
 - AWS, GCP
 - Terraform, WireMock, RestAssured
 - Bazel, BuildKite

What You'll Do

- Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback. 
 - Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness. 
 - Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments. 
 - Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions. 
 - Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to: 
 - Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
 - Generate high-quality test scenarios
 - Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
 - Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
 - Enhance developer and QA productivity
 - Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines. 
 - Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes. 
 - Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking. 

Skills We're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence. 
 - Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, Buildkite. 
 - Experience working with backend automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of database testing and ETL/data pipeline validation is a strong plus. 

AI & Productivity Engineering

- Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities. 
 - Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines. 
 - Ability to design prompt strategies, validate LLM outputs rigorously and implement safeguards to prevent hallucinations or unsafe automation. 
 - Experience streamlining workflows using AI to improve measurable engineering productivity. 
 - Comfortable feeding, tuning and orchestrating AI agents to solve real engineering problems. 
 - Strong outcome orientation, measures success through impact, reliability gains and velocity improvements rather than output volume. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*
 - Professional development and training opportunities
 - Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
 - Monthly cell phone stipend
 - Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 

We're honored to be valued at over $5. 6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. 

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. 

To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. 

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here. 

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

data.title: Staff Quality Engineer - SDET
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- We are looking for a Staff level SDET to support our product development teams. As the Staff SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products. 

Your Mission

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team. 
 - Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures. 
 - Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks. 
 - Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing. 
 - Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support. 
 - Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans. 
 - Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements. 
 - Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality. 
 - Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories. 
 - Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues. 
 - Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle. 
 - Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings. 
 - Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks. 

You Are

- You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company. 
 - You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team. 
 - You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours. 
 - You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence). 
 - You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions. 
 - You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions. 

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field. 
 - 10+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET. 
 - 8+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles. 
 - 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG. 
 - 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application. 
 - 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs. 
 - 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment. 
 - 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab. 
 - 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix. 
 - 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters. 
 - 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack. 
 - 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India. 
 - Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others. 
 - Passion for high quality work and attention to detail. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills. 

Extra Awesome

- Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent. 
 - Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications. 
 - Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve. 

Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies. Candidates must be comfortable working across modern cloud-native platforms, enterprise integrations, legacy systems, APIs, and emerging AI-enabled solutions. 

Role Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with domain engineering teams and deliver solutions that align with existing engineering standards, delivery processes, and operational models. 
 - Drive a consistent experience between Delta only and mixed metal itineraries through understanding the end-to-end ecosystem and nuances of Alliances partner travel. 
 - Forge a new way of working through building trust, collaboration and quality of development that seamlessly integrates with other pipeline deliverables. 
 - Build a deep and broad understanding of interdependencies between internal & external systems to architect efficient and scalable solutions. Must be able to conduct root cause analysis to generate creative solutions enabling velocity of delivery.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related technical field is preferred

 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities. 
 - Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery. 
 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Lead initiatives with high accountability, create a collaborative environment with a solution-based approach. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor and mentor for the team offering technical advice. 
 - Ability to communicate with precision, engaging team and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships across cross-functional teams and geographies enabling organizational alignment. 
 - Ability to set priorities with the team by understanding interdependence, inspiring team members with consistent focus, quality output, and timelines. 
 - Constantly keep oneself updated on current technology & trends to drive innovative decisions through piloting forward-thinking approaches to complex problems in one's own area of work. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer priorities and business challenges while creating value for technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to break down complex problems into concise impact statements. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Experience with a modern front-end framework is a plus
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platforms
data.description:
We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer for Arm's AI Platforms team in Bangalore. You will help shape technical direction, build production software, and establish the engineering practices of a growing team. Working with the Director of Engineering and technical leaders across Arm, you will take responsibility for significant platform capabilities and remain closely involved in their implementation. 

We are looking for an exemplary practitioner whose code, technical decisions, and approach to difficult problems set the standard for the team. You will combine systems engineering depth with hands-on expertise in agentic AI across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), helping engineers embrace new methods and assess their effect on delivery and quality. 

Responsibilities

- Define technical direction with engineering leadership. Assess platform needs, explore design options, and turn decisions into software the team can deliver and operate. 
 - Design and implement distributed platform services. Write critical code, review implementations, and rapid prototyping to test uncertain assumptions before committing to a design. 
 - Shape the engineering culture through daily practice. Help the team deliver frequent changes with clear ownership, useful design and code reviews, and verification appropriate to the software being built. 
 - Build and use agentic AI workflows across the SDLC. Give agents useful project context, connect them to development tools, and establish feedback through tests and code review. Measure their effect on delivery speed and software quality. 
 - Keep current with developments in software engineering, AI development tools, and cloud systems. Evaluate promising approaches through hands-on experiments and adopt them when the results justify the change. 
 - Resolve difficult design and production problems involving concurrency, data consistency, performance, and failure recovery. Use what you learn to improve the architecture and the team's engineering practices. 
 - Help recruit staff and senior engineers, and develop their judgment through shared technical work. Support engineers in taking ownership of complete capabilities and working through unfamiliar problems. 
 - Partner with Arm teams in the US and UK on architecture and shared interfaces. Make technical decisions understandable and establish clear ownership across teams. 

Required skills and experience

- 12+ years building distributed software, cloud platforms, or production infrastructure, or equivalent experience demonstrated through the scope and impact of your work. 
 - Strong programming skills in Go, C++, Rust, Python, or a comparable language. Experience designing service interfaces, working with concurrency and persistent data, and debugging complex failures. 
 - Experience building and operating software on Kubernetes and Linux, with an understanding of workload lifecycle, networking, resource management, and failure recovery. 
 - Hands-on expertise with agentic AI tools and harnesses for the SDLC. Experience configuring and extending workflows, assessing generated code, and verifying changes through automated checks and engineering review. 
 - A record of technical leadership grounded in your own engineering work, including mentoring experienced engineers, explaining design choices, and improving how a team develops software. 

Preferred skills and experience

- Experience with AI inference infrastructure or model serving, including how workload and hardware choices affect latency, throughput, and resource use. Knowledge of inference performance and resource-efficiency considerations. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, Ray, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or Dynamo or experience qualifying accelerators and tuning distributed workloads. 
 - Kubernetes controllers or operators, deployment systems, or software that manages releases across different compute environments. 
 - Developer productivity tools, build and test infrastructure for large scale distributed systems. 
 - Distributed tracing, observability, diagnostics, or data processing systems used to understand production behavior. 

In Return: 

We provide an opportunity to learn about the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with a highly skilled engineering team on ground-breaking technology!

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Equal Opportunities

To design & development of Test Automation framework for verification and Validation of embedded firmware.

- Bachelor's degree or above in power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent

Responsible for the formulation of test stresses, test forms and test specifications for new functions of power supply products. 

Responsible for the maintenance and development of the communication power supply automation test program. Being part of Global Engineering Function, it is expected to follow the defined processes and adhere to defined communication plan.

Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering [T500-30261]
data.description:
Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

About DIRECTV: 

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer. 

About DIRECTV India GCC: 

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what's next. It's a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world's most dynamic talent markets. 

Our Purpose: 

We're here to reimagine what's possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer's needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day. 

Our Values and Culture: 

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate. 

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we're building a future better than yesterday - for our colleagues, our customers, and our company. 

Functional EVP: 

Engineer quality into every stage of delivery

Quality at DIRECTV starts long before a product reaches the customer. As part of DQE, you'll work alongside engineering teams to strengthen how software is designed, tested and released. You'll drive automation, testing and quality practices across products and platforms, helping teams identify issues earlier, improve reliability and deliver with greater confidence. 

Position Summary: 

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a talented and innovative Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering to join our Non-Functional Quality Engineering organization. This role is responsible for designing, executing, and advancing security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and AI application security capabilities that support DIRECTV's enterprise technology ecosystem. You will partner with engineering, architecture, security, and quality engineering teams to improve application resilience, identify vulnerabilities, and strengthen enterprise security posture. 

The ideal candidate combines strong offensive security expertise, a passion for application security, and a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous innovation. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Security Engineering: 

- Perform application, API, and infrastructure security assessments. 
 - Conduct penetration testing against web, mobile, API, cloud, and enterprise systems. 
 - Identify vulnerabilities and work with engineering teams to implement remediation strategies. 
 - Support ongoing security validation efforts across critical technology platforms. 

Quality & Security Delivery: 

- Partner with developers, architects, and platform teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Conduct threat assessments, vulnerability reviews, and security validation activities. 
 - Support secure development practices and DevSecOps initiatives. 
 - Contribute to continuous testing and enterprise quality engineering objectives. 

Security Automation & Innovation: 

- Develop and support automation solutions that improve security testing effectiveness. 
 - Evaluate emerging security technologies and tooling. 
 - Contribute to AI application security and LLM security testing initiatives. 
 - Support continuous improvement efforts across quality and security engineering practices

Qualifications: 

Required Experience: 

- 4-6 years of software engineering, cybersecurity, or application security experience. 
 - Experience performing offensive security and penetration testing activities. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software development principles. 
 - Experience identifying and remediating application vulnerabilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. 
 - Experience working within Agile software delivery environments. 

Required Technical Skills: 

- Offensive Security & Penetration Testing
 - Web Security
 - API Security
 - OWASP Top 10
 - OWASP API Security Top 10
 - Network & Cloud Security
 - Security Automation & Tooling
 - AI / LLM Application Security

Preferred Skills & Experience: 

- Threat Modeling
 - Security Frameworks
 - Vulnerability Remediation Programs
 - Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
 - DevSecOps Practices
 - Cloud Security Assessment Experience
 - Security Automation Initiatives

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent

Note: This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune. 

Talent Value Proposition statement: 

At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey. 

Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that. 

DIRECTV is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, qualifications, merit, and performance, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics under applicable laws.

data.title: AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation
data.description:
AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation - Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6: 00 PM and 12: 00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule. 

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About The Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. Our products include Assess and Zenflow, which support assessments, care management, clinical workflows, and operational delivery . 

We are a startup, not a department. We are building an AI-native engineering team where quality must scale at the same speed as development. 

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Software Engineer focused on QA Automation. 

This is not a manual testing role. 

This is not a role for someone who simply clicks through test cases. 

This is a software engineering role for someone who builds systems that prove whether the product works. 

Our developers build with AI agents. That means code can arrive faster than traditional QA can review it by hand. We need a QA automation engineer who can build the testing harness, automated checks, synthetic data, test environments, and agent-driven QA workflows that keep up with agent-speed development . 

Here is the test: can you build a test system, seed a real bug, prove the test catches it, and explain what is still unverified?

We are not looking for someone who signs off work because it "looks fine. " We are looking for someone who demands evidence. 

Our AI-Native QA Vision

QA at Zenara is not a downstream gate. It is an engineering platform. 

We are building toward a system where product requirements can become test plans, test data, automated browser and API checks, evidence reports, failure routing, and release confidence - with agents helping create and run the work, and engineers governing the quality. 

You will help design and operate this QA system, including: 

- Browser and API test runners
 - Synthetic test data
 - Isolated test environments
 - Requirement-to-test workflows
 - Automated checks on every change
 - Agent-driven QA workflows
 - Evidence generation for releases
 - Flaky-test reduction
 - Failure routing and debugging
 - Quality metrics and release confidence

The goal is not to automate bad testing. The goal is to build a system that catches real defects before customers do. 

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain the QA automation harness across browser, API, data, and workflow layers. 
 - Create automated checks that run on every meaningful change. 
 - Build synthetic test data and isolated test environments. 
 - Own the UAT/QA automation pipeline from requirement to test plan to run to evidence
 - Use AI agents to help generate, execute, improve, and debug tests. 
 - Build independent agent-driven QA workflows that test the work of code-writing agents. 
 - Prove tests work by reintroducing known bugs and showing they fail correctly. 
 - Reduce flaky tests and distinguish real product failures from environment noise. 
 - Produce reliable QA evidence for releases. 
 - Work with engineering and product to define quality gates for critical user journeys. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong software engineering ability: you can design, write, debug, and maintain code. 
 - Experience with test automation using Playwright, Cypress, API testing frameworks, or similar tools. 
 - CI/CD experience and comfort wiring tests into build and release workflows. 
 - Practical experience using AI agents to create or improve tests. 
 - Strong judgment about whether a test actually proves anything. 
 - Ability to seed a bug, run a test, and demonstrate that the test catches the failure. 
 - Comfort debugging flaky tests, environment issues, and test data problems. 
 - Skeptical, evidence-driven thinking. 
 - Clear communication around risk, coverage, and release confidence. 

Our Current Stack

- TypeScript 
 - Node. js, Hono 
 - React 
 - Prisma, PostgreSQL 
 - Redis, BullMQ 
 - Playwright 
 - Azure AKS, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry 
 - Terraform, Helm, CI pipelines 
 - Medplum / FHIR 
 - Flowable 
 - Claude Code, Codex 
 - Dify-based AI workflows

What "AI-Native QA" Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can: 

- Use agents to generate test ideas, test code, and edge cases
 - Review agent-created tests critically
 - Build workflows where agents test independently from the agents that wrote the code
 - Use AI to analyze failures and propose debugging paths
 - Create repeatable quality gates that scale with development speed
 - Measure whether AI-generated tests are actually useful
 - Avoid false confidence from tests that pass without proving behavior

The point is not to have more tests. The point is to have trustworthy evidence. 

Nice to Have

- Healthcare or regulated-software experience. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered features, including output quality. 
 - Experience building test environments and synthetic data. 
 - Performance or load testing experience. 

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will map the current QA setup, agree the highest-risk user journeys, and deliver one automated end-to-end QA lane that runs on every change and catches a known bug . 

Within your first 90 days, key journeys for Assess and Zenflow will be covered automatically, every release will have QA evidence, and flaky-test rate and run time will be measured and improving . 

Over time, success means building a mature agentic QA platform where escaped defects are low and QA throughput keeps pace with agent-speed development . 

Outside required collaboration, we care about output, reliability, and quality. 

Compensation And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
 - Fully remote work
 - Equipment allowance
 - Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
 - The opportunity to build the QA function as an engineering platform from the ground up

Who Will Thrive In This Role

This role is well suited to someone who: 

- Thinks like an engineer, not a manual checklist executor
 - Enjoys building tools, systems, and automation
 - Is naturally skeptical and evidence-driven
 - Cares about proving behavior, not just producing green checkmarks
 - Wants to make QA scale with AI-native development
 - Likes working in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments

You may struggle if you only have manual testing experience, cannot code, sign off work without evidence, or write tests that pass regardless of whether the product is correct . 

If you want to build the quality system for an AI-native software team, we would love to hear from you.

Description

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6: 00 PM and 12: 00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule. 

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

About The Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns - they are part of the product . . 

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us. 

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations. 

This is not a narrow DevOps ticket role. 

This is not a compliance paperwork role. 

This is a hands-on platform ownership role. 

Today, platform, security, and compliance work is spread across people who are already covering other responsibilities. We need one full-time owner who keeps systems running, backed up, updated, monitored, secure, and HIPAA-ready . . 

You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and a part-time senior security and compliance consultant . . 

Here is the test: can you prove that backups restore, deployments roll back, secrets are controlled, alerts work, access is locked down, and compliance evidence exists before a customer asks for it?

We are looking for a calm, methodical operator who automates the boring things, finds the scary things, and closes the important gaps. 

Our Platform Vision

We are building an AI-native healthcare software company. That means our platform must support speed without creating unacceptable risk. 

The platform should make the safe path the easy path: reliable deployments, observable systems, tested recovery, controlled access, documented evidence, automated checks, and continuous security awareness. 

You will help build this operating system, including: 

- Deployment and rollback workflows
 - Monitoring and alerting
 - Backups and restore verification
 - Secrets and access management
 - Cloud configuration reviews
 - Security checks on new code and infrastructure
 - HIPAA compliance evidence
 - Vendor and AI-tool risk tracking
 - Daily automated security and compliance checks
 - Incident response basics
 - Platform documentation and runbooks

The goal is to create a platform that lets a small engineering team move fast without gambling with production or patient data. 

What You'll Do

- Own production platform operations: deployments, monitoring, alerts, updates, and reliability. 
 - Own backups and regularly prove restores work . 
 - Manage access control, secrets, cloud configuration, and security checks. 
 - Organize HIPAA-related policies, controls, audit evidence, and customer security documentation . 
 - Identify, prioritize, and close platform and security gaps. 
 - Build a daily security and compliance agent that sweeps systems and reports findings . 
 - Work weekly with a senior security and compliance consultant. 
 - Create runbooks, checklists, and automation for repeatable operational work. 
 - Support incident response, recovery, and prevention. 
 - Help free other team members from ad hoc platform and security work. 

What We're Looking For

- Hands-on experience keeping startup systems and platforms running
 - Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, and recovery experience
 - Experience with access control, secrets management, cloud configuration, and security basics
 - Ability to prove backups restore and systems recover
 - Ability to code and automate routine platform or security tasks
 - Comfort using AI agents to build automation and operational workflows
 - Calm judgment during incidents and production issues
 - Strong ownership and documentation habits
 - Practical mindset: you can prioritize risks rather than create endless theoretical lists

Our Current Stack

- Azure AKS / Kubernetes
 - Azure Blob Storage
 - Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
 - Terraform
 - Helm
 - CI pipelines
 - PostgreSQL
 - Redis
 - Some AWS
 - TypeScript applications using Node. js / Hono and React
 - Medplum / FHIR
 - Healthcare data, HIPAA, patient-data protection, vendor risk, and AI-tool risk

What "AI-Native Platform Engineering" Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can: 

- Use agents to inspect configurations, draft runbooks, and automate checks
 - Build recurring security and compliance sweeps
 - Use AI to accelerate infrastructure review without blindly trusting it
 - Create workflows that surface risks before humans remember to check
 - Automate operational evidence gathering
 - Maintain human approval for sensitive actions
 - Keep permissions, secrets, and production access tightly controlled
 - AI should help you create a more reliable platform, not become another unmanaged risk

Nice to Have

- Healthcare or HIPAA experience
 - Security background, such as cloud security, SOC, or incident response
 - Compliance framework experience, especially HIPAA or SOC 2
 - Azure and AKS production experience
 - Kubernetes at production scale

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review the current setup, agree the top platform and security gaps, demonstrate a backup restore and deployment rollback, and produce a prioritized improvement list . . 

Within your first 90 days, monitoring and alerting will be in place, top security gaps will be closed, the first version of the daily security/compliance agent will be running, and compliance evidence will be organized . . 

Over time, success means Zenara has a reliable, secure, HIPAA-ready platform, clean customer security reviews, and platform work no longer depends on non-specialists. 

Schedule

Live collaboration requires overlap with the US team. For engineering roles, the current collaboration window is approximately 6: 00 PM to 12: 00 AM IST, though final expectations should be confirmed during the hiring process. 

Production incidents and critical deployments may occasionally require availability outside normal collaboration windows. 

Compensation And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
 - Fully remote work
 - Equipment allowance
 - Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
 - Support from a senior security expert

Who Will Thrive In This Role

This role is well suited to someone who: 

- Is calm, methodical, and reliable
 - Likes automating operational work
 - Cares about security but can still move pragmatically
 - Wants broad ownership across DevOps, security, and compliance
 - Can operate independently without a large platform team
 - Understands that healthcare data requires discipline

You may struggle if you want a large ops team around you, only want one narrow specialty, treat compliance as paperwork only, cannot automate, or are careless with secrets and access. 

If you want to build the operating foundation for an AI-native health-tech company, we would love to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, industrial networking, and machine automation using Siemens, Beckhoff, Bosch Rexroth, B&R automation platforms or a combination of these automation platforms. 

Essential duties and responsibilities: 

- Design and develop machine control software for custom automation systems from concept through commissioning.

 - Configure and integrate servo drives, VFDs, robotics, vision systems, and field devices. 
 - Prepare Functional Design Specifications (FDS), I/O lists, software architecture, and technical documentation. 
 - Perform software testing, debugging, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and customer support. 
 - Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Project Engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle. 
 - Participate in the review of electrical designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 
 - Troubleshoot control systems and optimize machine performance. 
 - Participate in software code reviews and maintain software quality standards. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives, software standardization, and engineering best practices. 
 - Maintain project schedules and communicate technical progress to project stakeholders. 

Requirements & Experience

- Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, controls development, and machine commissioning. 
 - Experience designing and implementing control systems for custom automation projects. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, and motion control. 
 - Experience integrating servo systems, drives, motors, robotics, sensors, and vision systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols including: 
 - Profinet
 - EtherCAT
 - Ethernet/IP
 - Modbus TCP

data.description:
About Us: 

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12, 000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 

Job Description: 

Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business. 

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies. 

What truly sets us apart is our culture-rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results. 

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services-providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide. 

Our culture is built on: 

- Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. 
 - Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. 
 - Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. 
 - Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. 

Career Development and Global Exposure

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. 

If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Controls with 8+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff automation platforms. Experience in printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries is highly preferred. 

The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment. 

The role will be responsible for the interface between electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine-level automation. 

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms: 

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs
 - Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
 - ControlLogix
 - CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff PLC / IPC-based control systems
 - TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT
 - Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms. 

PLC & HMI Development

- Hands-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards. 
 - Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using: 
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram
 - Structured Text
 - Sequential Function Chart
 - Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems. 
 - Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs. 
 - Experience with machine-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications. 
 - HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C#, or similar technologies is an added advantage. 

Siemens Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with Siemens S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Experience with TIA Portal V15. 1 or above. 
 - TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred. 
 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start-up. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues. 
 - Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support. 

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage. 

Tool Skills

Mandatory / Core

- Siemens TIA Portal - V15. 1 or above
 - Siemens S7-1500 PLC
 - Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
 - ControlLogix / CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT

Preferred

- TIA Portal V17+
 - FactoryTalk View
 - Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
 - OPC UA
 - Industrial Ethernet networking
 - HMI scripting / C# / JavaScript
 - EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in PLC and HMI programming. 
 - Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch. 
 - Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage. 
 - Experience in machine commissioning and customer-site support is preferred. 

Key Result Areas

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements. 
 - Integrate Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues. 
 - Follow software development, change-management, and version-control procedures. 
 - Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes. 
 - Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope. 
 - Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine start-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required. 

Soft Skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Logical and systematic approach to problem-solving. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements. 
 - Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms. 

Travel

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to 15%, for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a multi-platform Controls Engineer with strong practical experience in: 

Siemens + Allen-Bradley + Beckhoff

with hands-on capability in: 

PLC Programming → HMI Development → Drives/Motion → Industrial Communication → Machine Integration → FAT/SAT → Commissioning

Experience with OEM/discrete machinery, particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage.
