data.title: Manager/Sr. Manager, Engineering - AI Platform
data.description:
We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering for our AI Platform team. Someone who can take ownership of a fast-growing, high-visibility team building the agentic foundation for SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how AI agents get built, governed, and shipped across the company. 

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will partner closely with the Product Manager for AI Platform to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Team leadership and development

- Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
 - Develop individual engineers through regular 1: 1s, coaching, and honest feedback
 - Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast-moving workstream as scope grows

Delivery and operations

- Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
 - Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
 - Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

- Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
 - Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
 - Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders

Strategy and growth

- Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
 - Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
 - Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development

What We Value

Ownership and independence You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through. 

Management experience You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement. 

Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off. 

Communication clarity You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums. 

Result orientation and a growth mindset You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's. 

Distributed team experience and empathy Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus. 

Structured thinking in ambiguous situations AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision. 

Collaborative by default You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back - and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

About DHL Blue Dart Express India: 

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55, 000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India's only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader's network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India's Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group's Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it's a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet "Blue Darter" with honour. 

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India's supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 

Position Overview: 

The Service Centre Incharge - Operations (Non Metro / BDO) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities across one or more assigned Non Metro Branches, Business Development Offices (BDOs) or Service Centres. The role oversees inbound and outbound shipment processing, pickup and delivery coordination, customer service support, manpower deployment and operational governance to ensure seamless day-to-day operations. 

Reporting to the Assistant Manager - Operations (Area Operations), the incumbent provides frontline leadership to operational teams, ensuring adherence to service commitments, operational productivity, safety, compliance and Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures while delivering consistent customer experience and supporting business continuity across the assigned locations. 

Job Purpose: 

To lead and manage end-to-end shift operations across assigned Non Metro Branches and BDO locations by ensuring efficient shipment processing, timely pickups and dispatches, optimal workforce utilisation, operational discipline and consistent service delivery while maintaining safety, compliance and customer satisfaction.

Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement

 - Support implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

 - Support implementation of new operational initiatives, business priorities and process improvements. 
 - Act as the primary operational contact for assigned locations during the shift.

Experience:

 - Proven experience in leading frontline operational teams and coordinating shift operations. 
 - Exposure to shipment processing, scanning, sorting, reconciliation, dispatch and customer service operations.

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you're not just taking a job-you're becoming part of a purpose-led movement that's reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don't just deliver parcels-we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

data.title: DevOps Lead
data.description:
Why Techjays

At Techjays, we're helping companies reimagine how they build, operate, and scale with AI at the core. We're part of the small percentage of companies globally building secure, production-grade AI systems that drive measurable business outcomes. Our team brings together engineers and leaders who have built and scaled products at organizations like Google, NetApp, ADP, Cognizant Consulting, and Capgemini. 

We're looking for a DevOps Lead who can own cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, reliability, and engineering practices for modern software and AI-enabled platforms. The ideal candidate will be deeply specialized in either AWS or Azure, with strong hands-on DevOps experience and practical exposure to AI workloads or AI-driven products. 

Key Skills

- Cloud Technologies (Expert): Strong hands-on expertise in either AWS or Azure, with deep practical experience designing, deploying, and operating production cloud environments. 
 - AWS: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, EKS, Lambda, ECR, CloudWatch, and related infrastructure services. 
 - Azure: Azure VMs, VNets, AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Container Registry, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, and related infrastructure services. 
 - CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including multi-stage pipelines, approvals, artifact management, and deployment automation. 
 - Containers & Kubernetes: Docker, Kubernetes, AKS or EKS, Helm, scaling, networking, secrets, and production workload management. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Strong Terraform experience preferred. Exposure to CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM, or similar IaC tools is valuable. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Strong Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell skills for infrastructure automation, deployment, and operational tooling. 
 - Monitoring & Reliability: CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, alerting, incident management, and performance optimization. 
 - AI Exposure: Prior experience supporting AI/ML applications, GenAI platforms, AI services, LLM applications, or AI-enabled products. This is an exposure requirement, not an MLOps-specialist role. 

Experience - 10+ Years

Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead the design, implementation, and operation of scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure. 
 - Own DevOps strategy and technical direction across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automation, and production operations. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and AI-enabled workloads across development, staging, and production. 
 - Design and manage Kubernetes environments using AKS, EKS, Docker, and Helm. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and relevant cloud-native tools. 
 - Establish deployment standards, reusable pipeline templates, and automated release processes. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational practices to maintain reliability and performance. 
 - Work closely with engineering and AI teams to provide the infrastructure required to deploy and operate AI-enabled applications. 
 - Support cloud environments used by AI/ML applications, including compute, networking, containers, storage, security, and observability. 
 - Drive cloud security practices covering IAM/RBAC, secrets, networking, access controls, and infrastructure governance. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues, lead root cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent fixes through automation and engineering improvements. 
 - Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud costs while maintaining reliability and scalability. 
 - Evaluate and introduce DevOps tools and practices that improve engineering productivity and deployment quality. 
 - Mentor DevOps engineers and provide technical leadership across projects and teams. 

What We're Looking For Beyond Skills

- Cloud Specialist: Deep hands-on expertise in either AWS or Azure. You do not need to be an expert in both. 
 - Strong DevOps Foundation: Proven experience owning CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, containers, automation, and production operations. 
 - AI Exposure: Experience working with or supporting AI/ML, GenAI, LLM, or AI-enabled applications and an understanding of their infrastructure needs. 
 - Builder Mindset: Ability to design, implement, and improve systems rather than only manage existing environments. 
 - Ownership: Willingness to take responsibility for reliability, delivery, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Leadership: Ability to mentor engineers, drive technical decisions, and work effectively with engineering and product teams. 
 - Location & Availability: Willingness to work onsite from the Coimbatore office and availability to join immediately or at short notice. 

Good to Have

- Experience supporting AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM or AI-agent based applications in production. 
 - Experience with GitOps and Argo CD. 
 - Experience with cloud security, governance, networking and enterprise landing zones. 
 - Experience with blue/green, canary and automated rollback strategies. 
 - Experience with Python-based automation or AI integrations.

Understand and explain the effect of product architecture decisions on distributed systems. Professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies. 

Responsible for the operation of production environments, including systems and databases, supporting critical business operations. Will perform administration and analysis for multiple production environments and recommend new and novel solutions to improve availability, performance, and supportability. This is an opportunity to bring a combination of deep technical knowledge with administration/analysis knowledge of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure to provide escalation support to a wide range of complex production environment problems related to immense growth, scaling, leveraging the cloud, extremely high performance, and high availability requirements. 

Responsibilities

Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize all production server hardware and software. Provide escalated technical support for complex technical issues which may include leading problem management cases and providing management status. Coordinate escalated support cases and lead appropriate internal technical resources and/or third party vendors to resolution and coordinate a storage infrastructure of Oracle system and database appliances. Responsible for Oracle production environments; assist with server operating system and application upgrades, bug fixes, and patching; and work on standardization projects for both hardware and software under the Oracle technology stack while providing consistent system uptime as expected in a Cloud environment. - Incident Management
 - Support and troubleshooting of Staging/Production environments
 - Response and Resolve incidents as per SLA's
 - Organise, Anticipate, Plan and work as On-Call in shifts for multiple services (Open to work in shifts & shows flexibility)
 - Maintain Service High Availability
 - Release Management
 - Test and Deploy solutions and automate to replace manual processes
 - Build and maintain deployment tools/procedures
 - Zero downtime deployments and a high availability mindset
 - Define and build innovative solution methodologies and assets around infrastructure, cloud migration and deployment operations at scale. 
 - Work with service teams to resolve complex issues that require troubleshooting and knowledge of code. 
 - Keep documentation up to date and resolving similar tickets with lower turnaround time and within SLA
 - Ensure production security posture
 - Ensure monitoring is robust and effective
 - Change Management
 - Perform Root Cause Analysis

Required Skills: 

- 5+ years overall experience in IT industry
 - Minimum 4 years of experience as a Sys Admin/Support
 - Strong systems architecture skills
 - Strong Linux administration (Understanding of different Hardware family)
 - Virtualisation Technologies
 - Scripting Language (Python/Bash/Shell etc, basic understanding of Java / Go will be good to have)
 - Understanding of Networking, Cloud Computing, Load Balancers
 - Hands on experience at Monitoring/Instrumentation tools (Prometheus/Grafana, new relic, elastic or equivalent). 
 - Experience with maintaining high scale deployments, managing high throughput and IO intensive services. 
 - Strong knowledge of system configuration tools such as Chef, Terraform, GIT, Jenkins/Hudson, Artifactory
 - Continuous Integration development/deployment, e. g. Docker, Kubernetes

Responsibilities

Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize all production server hardware and software. Provide escalated technical support for complex technical issues which may include leading problem management cases and providing management status. Coordinate escalated support cases and lead appropriate internal technical resources and/or third party vendors to resolution and coordinate a storage infrastructure of Oracle system and database appliances. Responsible for Oracle production environments; assist with server operating system and application upgrades, bug fixes, and patching; and work on standardization projects for both hardware and software under the Oracle technology stack while providing consistent system uptime as expected in a Cloud environment. Provide on-call support, on a rotating basis. 

Qualifications

Career Level - IC3

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
data.description:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100, 000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at  www. digicert. com

Job summary

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience and strong full-stack expertise in Java backend development and React frontend engineering. The ideal candidate will independently design, develop, and own scalable, secure, and reliable applications across the full technology stack. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, React, microservices, relational databases, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies. Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards such as OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, and SAML, along with Okta or similar identity providers, is highly desirable. 

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, system design capability, production ownership, and the ability to make sound technical decisions. The engineer will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Security, and Engineering teams, contribute to architecture and technical direction, and mentor other engineers. 

Experience with event-driven architectures, observability, and AI/LLM integration is a strong plus. 

  

What you will do

- Design, develop, and maintain Java/Spring Boot services and RESTful APIs, taking end-to-end ownership of features and services. 
 - Design and implement scalable, reliable, and secure microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Make technical design decisions considering scalability, availability, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Build and maintain React applications and reusable UI components, following best practices for state management, routing, accessibility, and frontend performance. 
 - Design and implement authentication and authorization flows using OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, and SAML, including integrations with Okta or other identity providers. 
 - Apply security best practices including secure token handling, RBAC, input validation, secrets management, and secure API design. 
 - Take ownership of features through the complete lifecycle - requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools. 
 - Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, with experience in Helm and/or Terraform. 
 - Monitor and troubleshoot production applications using observability tools such as New Relic, Splunk, or Datadog. 
 - Participate in incident response, perform root-cause analysis, and drive preventive and corrective actions. 
 - Write comprehensive unit, integration, and API tests and continuously improve code quality and test coverage. 
 - Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews, providing technical guidance and constructive feedback. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to improving engineering practices across the team. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Design, Security, and other engineering teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, API specifications, architecture decisions, and operational runbooks. 
 - Identify and drive opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Evaluate and integrate AI/LLM capabilities into product features where appropriate, including LLM APIs, RAG-based solutions, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.   

What you will have

- 6+ years of professional software development experience with strong hands-on full-stack development experience. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and microservices architecture. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, hooks, component design, and state management. 
 - Solid understanding of OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, and SAML. Experience with Okta, Azure AD, or similar identity providers is highly desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and software architecture. 
 - Experience designing and developing applications for scalability, availability, reliability, performance, and security. 
 - Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, SQL optimization, and troubleshooting. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with Helm and/or Terraform and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Experience with production troubleshooting, observability, monitoring, and incident management. 
 - Strong understanding of automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. 
 - Ability to independently own complex features and make effective technical decisions with minimal supervision. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Design, Security, and other cross-functional teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction.   

Nice to have

- Experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, digital certificates, or PKI. 
 - Experience with Kafka or other event-driven/event-streaming architectures. 
 - Experience designing and operating highly available distributed systems at scale. 
 - Familiarity with feature flags, blue/green deployments, canary releases, or progressive delivery strategies. 
 - Experience building AI-powered product capabilities using LLM APIs, RAG, prompt engineering, or generative AI. 
 - Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into Java and/or React applications. 
 - Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives or architecture improvements. 
 - Contributions to engineering standards, technical strategy, or developer productivity initiatives. 
 - Experience leading technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams.   

Benefits

- Generous time off policies
 - Top shelf benefits
 - Education, wellness and lifestyle support  

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

data.description:
Senior Software Engineer

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like

what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

You will join a team in Platform Product Development. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will leverage your expertise as a full stack engineer both front and backend technologies and the Azure cloud ecosystem. This role requires a comprehensive blend of practical engineering, architectural thinking, and leadership to ensure both immediate delivery and long-term sustainability. 

You will be part of a scrum team working closely with Product Owner and business stakeholders

Besides your team you will work with other colleagues across our unit. Our teams are culturally diverse, English speaking, inclusive and we are all looking forward to getting a new colleague onboard. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- You will apply your skills to all stages of the development lifecycle, including review of user stories, development, design, code reviews and writing automated tests. 
 - Work closely with product owner and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide technical insights. 
 - Setting up engineering excellence inside your team and continuously improving it
 - Development of new functionalities. 
 - Managing quality assurance, refactor existing code, research tools and frameworks to enable future innovations. 
 - Work as part of your scrum team to reach the definition of done within each sprint. 

Knowledge & Experience: 

Essential

- Over 3 years of practical experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SASS, Angular framework, and Node. js
 - Over 2 years of direct experience utilizing . NET technologies, with a focus on C# and Microsoft . Net. 
 - Familiarity with front-end build tools (Webpack, NX, Angular CLI)
 - Experience building responsive, accessible, and mobile-friendly web applications. 
 - Solid understanding of REST APIs, state management (NGRX), and browser performance tuning
 - Knowledge of design patterns and principles (OOP, SOLID) and ability to use them in practice
 - Knowledge of cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, and architecture on Azure

 - Practical experience doing peer reviews and utilizing code quality tools like SonarQube
 - Experience in CI/CD and understanding of DevOps principles
 - Proficient fundamentals in software testing tools, techniques and methodologies. 
 - Experience in building unit tests and integration tests (like Selenium, NUnit, Jasmine, Jest)

 - Proficient problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound technical decisions. 

DESIRABLE

- Knowledge of writing VS Code extensions or Electron-based applications
 - DB experience - SQL
 - Experience in FinTech industry

Personal Skills: 

- Experience working in an international setting with people from many different cultures
 - Proactive and reliable approach
 - Positive and constructive mindset
 - You prioritize your team and prioritize having an enjoyable working environment

Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. 

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

For any questions you are welcome to contact Swati Pal(Swati. pal@simcorp. com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Lead - Digital Construction [T500-28816]
data.description:
About Suffolk: 

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment through Suffolk Technologies. 

With more than $10 billion in annual revenue and projects across healthcare, life sciences, higher education, mission critical, aviation, transportation, commercial, and other complex sectors, Suffolk is redefining how America builds through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. 

About Suffolk Global: 

Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds. 

By partnering closely with teams across the United States, Suffolk Global will help drive quality, scalability, and innovation while creating new opportunities for technical professionals to contribute to some of the most complex construction projects in North America. 

About Digital Delivery: 

Suffolk is building the next generation of Digital Delivery capabilities to transform how buildings are designed, coordinated, and constructed. By combining Building Information Modeling (BIM), data-driven workflows, automation, and emerging technologies, our goal is to create a more connected, efficient, and predictable project delivery process. 

As part of this vision, Suffolk Global is establishing a high-performing Digital Delivery team in Bangalore that will partner directly with project teams across the United States. Together, we will develop scalable modeling standards, improve coordination workflows, enhance quality through digital reviews, and create innovative solutions that support some of the most complex construction projects in North America. 

This is an opportunity to help build a new capability from the ground up and play a leadership role in defining how Digital Delivery services are delivered globally. 

Lead - Digital Construction

Title: Digital Delivery Lead

Location: Bangalore, India (Onsite)

Role Summary; 

The Digital Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple projects and teams. This role provides technical oversight, resource coordination, quality management, and team leadership to ensure the successful delivery of BIM models, coordination services, constructability reviews, and digital project deliverables. 

The Digital Delivery Lead serves as the primary connection between project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and production staff, ensuring that work is delivered efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with Suffolk standards. This role is responsible for developing team capability, driving accountability, and establishing a culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Delivery Leadership: 

- Lead execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple concurrent projects. 
 - Coordinate project assignments, priorities, and workloads across Digital Delivery Engineers and Senior Digital Delivery Engineers. 
 - Monitor project schedules, deliverables, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution. 
 - Identify delivery risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for technical and project delivery challenges. 

Team Leadership & Development: 

- Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentoring for Digital Delivery team members. 
 - Support onboarding and development of new staff. 
 - Conduct regular reviews of work quality and performance. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Support career development planning and technical skill growth across the team. 

Quality & Standards Management: 

- Ensure compliance with Suffolk Digital Delivery standards, workflows, and governance processes. 
 - Oversee QA/QC reviews across assigned projects. 
 - Monitor model quality, coordination performance, and deliverable consistency. 
 - Drive adoption of standards, templates, content libraries, and best practices. 
 - Review lessons learned and implement corrective actions where needed. 

Technical Oversight: 

- Provide technical guidance related to BIM modeling, coordination, constructability analysis, and content development. 
 - Support resolution of complex technical issues and project challenges. 
 - Collaborate with Senior Digital Delivery Engineers to maintain standards and technical consistency. 
 - Ensure proper application of modeling workflows and coordination processes. 

Stakeholder Management: 

- Collaborate with U. S. -based project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and project stakeholders. 
 - Support project planning and workload forecasting activities. 
 - Communicate project status, risks, resource needs, and delivery performance. 
 - Build strong working relationships across project and operational teams. 

Operational Excellence: 

- Monitor team utilization and workload balancing. 
 - Support staffing and resource planning activities. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and delivery performance. 
 - Drive implementation of process improvements and operational best practices. 
 - Contribute to the growth and scalability of Suffolk Global's Digital Delivery organization. 

Required Qualifications: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline. 

Experience: 

- 8-12 years of experience in BIM, Digital Delivery, VDC, architecture, engineering, or construction technology. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading BIM delivery teams or coordination teams on complex building projects. 
 - Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities. 

Technical Skills: 

- Expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit. 
 - Strong experience with BIM coordination and clash detection workflows. 
 - Deep understanding of BIM standards, model governance, QA/QC processes, and digital delivery best practices. 
 - Experience with BIM content development, template management, and standards implementation. 
 - Strong understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP systems. 

Leadership Skills: 

- Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams. 
 - Strong organizational and planning skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance technical quality with delivery commitments. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with Navisworks Manage. 
 - Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360. 
 - Experience with point cloud and Scan-to-BIM workflows. 
 - Experience developing BIM standards and enterprise delivery processes. 
 - Experience supporting global or distributed project teams. 

Success Measures: 

A successful Digital Delivery Lead will: 

- Deliver projects on schedule and in accordance with quality expectations. 
 - Maintain high levels of team productivity and utilization. 
 - Improve model quality, QA/QC performance, and coordination outcomes across projects. 
 - Successfully develop and mentor Digital Delivery team members. 
 - Ensure consistent adoption of Digital Delivery standards and workflows. 
 - Build strong partnerships with project teams and stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the growth, scalability, and operational maturity of the Digital Delivery organization.

The role drives customer-specific Flex Platform development and leads cross-functional teams spanning platform, ADAS software, validation, and build engineering. The role also models and assesses system performance for digital cockpit and ADAS workloads by comparing projections with real-world implementations. 

The principal engineer shall enable successful, scalable adoption of Qualcomm Digital Cockpit Platform and ADAS solutions across OEM programs by orchestrating multi-party alignment, ensuring robust integration, and driving safety, performance, and time-to-market outcomes.

 - Manage multiple OEM Flex and ADAS program solution teams, supported by technical leads reporting to this role. 
 - Provide senior technical leadership across Qualcomm Automotive engineering teams to shape and deliver customer-specific features. 
 - Define the Flex Solutions team's technical roadmap to anticipate evolving customer needs for automotive middleware across Flex and ADAS systems. 
 - Perform Flex‐based Digital Cockpit system integration using QNX RTOS, AUTOSAR Classic and Adaptive stacks and Android including configuration, integration, and validation.

 - Develop deep, practical expertise in Qualcomm Digital Cockpit and ADAS platforms at the SoC, system, and software stack levels.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Flex Solution integration on Reference and Customer Hardware

 - Experience working directly with major global OEMs on large-scale mixed critical Digital Cockpit/ADAS programs. 
 - Strong background in Tier 1 automotive systems engineering with focus on: 
 - BSP Integration, Performance analysis, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) management (multi virtual machine)
 - Compute platform architecture (SoC, GPU/DSP, accelerators) - Hypervisor /Virtual Machine
 - Embedded SW stacks (OS such as QNX/Linux/Android, middleware, frameworks, toolchains, AUTOSAR (Classic/Adaptive))

data.title: Engineer - Receiving Quality
data.description:
Job title: Receiving Quality Engineer

Location: Ghaziabad

About Us

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www. irco. com. 

Job Overview

This position will be responsible for Bought out parts Quality Assurance to ensure high quality product & on time delivery for Power Tools and Lifting products manufactured in Sahibabad plant. This person will also support for the customised project parts qualification for quality aspect. This involves understanding the part & product requirements, preparing Quality assurance plan, resolving technical challenges, lead Quality issues resolution. This person must be a team player, form strong ties with a cross functional team, manage a multitude of tasks, communicate clearly, and be effective and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

Responsibilities

- To ensure that incoming materials and products meet required quality standards. 
 - Maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, and quality issues. 
 - Interacts frequently with internal and external contacts (such as Procurement, Solutions Engineering, Operations and suppliers) to ensure the completion of strategic AQP activities. 
 - Completes Qualification of materials and components (Project Procurement), development/ improvement of supplier parts for CTQ's, Incoming process control plans; ensuring that the supplied part meets specifications, and the control limits/tolerances for CTQ parameters are met. 
 - Collect, analyze, and interpret data related to quality, using statistical tools and methods. 
 - Responsible to address field Issue received due to supplier parts & Perform Root Cause analysis & ensure corrective actions on time. 
 - Collaborate with suppliers and internal operations team for product build and validation. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying and implementing process enhancements. 
 - Improve Assembly & Machine shop DSA
 - Improve Assembly FPY 
 - Reduction in COPQ due to Supplier Parts
 - Receipt Material clearance in 1 Day

Requirements

- Relevant degree, B. Tech. /BE or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a reputed university. 
 - 10+ years' experience in Engineering/Automotive Industry. 

Core Competencies

- Proficient in Engineering Drawing reading & GD&T. 
 - In-depth Knowledge of the manufacturing processes (machining, plastic, casting, sheet metal). 
 - Strong understanding of quality control principles, inspection methods, and statistical analysis. 
 - Handling knowledge of CMM, Contour Tracer, Roughness Tester, Hardness Tester & 2D height Gauge. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills 
 - Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage time and complete simultaneous multiple assignments. 
 - Proven ability to interact with suppliers and convince on Quality aspects. 

Preferences

- Relevant degree, B. Tech. /BE/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

- Travel (As and When required)

What We Offer

- We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success. 
 - Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication 
 - Leave Encashments 
 - Maternity/Paternity Leaves 
 - Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance 
 - Employee Assistance Program 
 - Employee development with LinkedIn Learning 
 - Employee recognition via Awardco 
 - Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

data.title: Finance Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
data.description:
Job Title

Finance Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe

Job Description

Are you a finance professional with a strong background in tax, compliance, and financial governance? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership, process improvement, and collaboration across multiple European countries?

At Vanderlande, we are looking for a Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe who will lead the regional Tax & Compliance team and help ensure a strong and compliant tax framework across our European operations. 

In this role, you will contribute to managing tax risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving processes and controls, and supporting the business with practical tax solutions in a dynamic international environment. 

What will you be doing?

As Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe, you report to the Team Lead Tax & Compliance EU / LATAM and lead a team of tax and compliance professionals supporting the European organization. 

You will oversee day-to-day tax compliance activities within Europe and provide guidance on tax matters across multiple countries, working closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders. 

You will combine solid tax expertise with people leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, ensuring tax compliance processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across the region. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you will

- Lead, coach, and develop the Europe Tax & Compliance team. 
 - Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of tax compliance and reporting activities across Europe. 
 - Coordinate corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant tax compliance activities in cooperation with Group Tax and local Finance teams. 
 - Support transfer pricing compliance activities and documentation requirements. 
 - Act as a key contact for tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and internal stakeholders on operational tax matters. 
 - Identify and manage tax risks, ensuring issues are escalated and addressed appropriately. 
 - Translate changes in tax legislation into practical guidance and actions for the business. 
 - Maintain and improve tax controls, documentation, and compliance processes. 
 - Drive standardization and process improvements across European tax and compliance activities. 
 - Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions. 
 - Support business projects and operational activities with practical tax advice. 
 - Contribute to finance transformation, compliance, and process improvement initiatives. 
 - Build strong relationships with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business teams. 
 - Support knowledge sharing and consistent application of Group Tax policies across Europe. 

What do we ask from you?

We ask you to bring experience, education, and personality

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 8 years of experience in tax, tax compliance, or a related finance function within an international environment. 
 - Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team. 
 - Good knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and general tax compliance requirements. 
 - Experience working with tax authorities, auditors, and external advisors. 
 - Experience with process improvement and standardization initiatives. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
 - A proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset. 
 - A collaborative leader who combines technical expertise with a strong service-oriented approach. 

About The Team

You will join the global FSSC organization and become part of a collaborative international finance community. The Europe Tax & Compliance team supports the region in meeting tax and regulatory obligations while helping the business operate efficiently and compliantly in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. 

The team works closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, mitigate risks, and continuously improve ways of working. 

What We Offer

We offer a position in an international and professional working environment with room for personal development and growth. 

This position offers a competitive salary range of € 6. 500 to € 7. 600 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance). 

On top of your fixed salary, you'll receive the following secondary benefits

- 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days)
 - Flexible working hours
 - A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office)
 - A Health & Wellbeing budget worth € 300 per calendar year. 
 - Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport
 - Working from home allowance
 - Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance
 - On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists
 - Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills
 - A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives

About Vanderlande

Vanderlande designs, delivers and supports automation solutions, operational software and lifecycle services for leading airports and parcel operations worldwide. Our solutions help customers improve performance, reliability, and sustainable growth in more than 100 countries. How we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values, Every Day Better, We Care, and Team Play, guide how we collaborate, support each other, and create value for our customers. 

Ready to apply?

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV. 

Questions about this role? Contact Carlijn Kneepkens (Recruiter) at carlijn. kneepkens@vanderlande. com. 

Diversity & inclusion

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Clinical Line Manager-CRA, to lead our Clinical Monitoring team in Navi Mumbai, India. As the sole CRA Manager in India, this role presents an opportunity to build and lead your own team and to take your career to the next level as you work closely with the Senior Director of Clinical Monitoring. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and line-manage a team of Clinical Research Associates (CRAs); 
 - Recruitment, training (initial and continued) and development of CRAs; 
 - Oversee and guide CRAs to ensure they meet expectations of core monitoring responsibilities; 
 - Provide regular 1: 1 coaching and constructive feedback; 
 - Track and manage CRA resourcing and allocation of assignment; 
 - Support retention and engagement of CRAs to meet company objectives; and
 - Collaborate with other functions, regional and local operations. 

Qualifications

- Holds a Bachelor's degree or higher in Life Sciences or related discipline; 
 - Is a line manager with 1-2 years or an experienced CRA, with at least 4 years of clinical monitoring experience, looking to make the next step into line management; 
 - Will have strong leadership, mentoring, and motivational skills. You enjoy working with people and relish in their success; 
 - Experience in global CRO is preferred; 
 - Advanced knowledge of Good Clinical Practice; 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills; and

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next-generation, highly scalable, low-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) - operating at a scale of 1 trillion+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team's roadmap, in one of the fastest-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we'd love to talk to you. 

What You'll Do

- Product & Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion-scale. 
 - Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization. 
 - Standards & Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams. 
 - Own end-to-end technical direction for the AdServer platform - partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi-quarter technical roadmap. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on. 
 - Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof-of-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point across teams - auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross-cutting problems. 
 - Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long-range technical planning - new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform. 
 - Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar. 
 - Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, and documentation - and help set the standard for AI-enabled engineering across the org. 

We'd Love for You to Have

- 14+ years of hands-on development experience in C/C++ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team. 
 - Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles. 
 - Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low-latency, high-throughput systems. 
 - A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly. 
 - Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open-ended technical problems. 
 - Strong working knowledge of generative AI-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level.

Qualifications

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

data.title: Platform Architect & Backend Lead
data.description:
About The Role

We are building a multi-tenant, hardware-agnostic IoT platform from the ground up. We need a senior engineer who can design the system architecture in the morning and write production backend code in the afternoon. This is not an architecture-only role and not a coding-only role - it is both, simultaneously, in a fast-moving early-stage environment. You will also own cloud infrastructure as interim DevOps until we scale. 

The Ideal Candidate

You have built IoT backend platforms before - not just used them. You understand the hard problems: device auth at scale, MQTT broker design, time-series ingestion performance, multi-tenant data isolation, and real-time delivery to web clients. You are comfortable making architectural decisions autonomously, documenting them clearly, and standing by them. You work remotely with discipline - you flag risks before they become problems. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture

- Design the full end-to-end IoT platform architecture: device connectivity layer → MQTT/protocol ingestion → stream processing → time-series storage → REST/GraphQL API layer → real-time WebSocket delivery
 - Define the multi-tenant data model: strict data isolation between customers, tenant-scoped API tokens, row-level security
 - Design the device lifecycle system: provisioning, X. 509/JWT authentication, device registry, status tracking, decommissioning
 - Architect the protocol abstraction layer so MQTT, Modbus, OPC-UA, CoAP, and HTTP devices all normalise to the same internal data model
 - Design a configurable rule engine: event-condition-action rules for alerts, automations, and integrations - no code required from customers
 - Plan OTA firmware update management: secure delivery, versioning, rollback, fleet orchestration
 - Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for every major technical choice - nothing undocumented
 - Design the scaling path from 100 devices (pilot) to 500, 000+ (production) without structural rework

Backend Development

- Build core platform services from scratch: device management, telemetry ingestion, rule engine, notification/alerting, OTA update, multi-tenant API gateway
 - Develop REST and GraphQL APIs with full OpenAPI specification - version-controlled from Day 1
 - Implement WebSocket and SSE endpoints for real-time telemetry delivery to web and mobile clients
 - Build device command-and-control with acknowledgement, retry logic, and timeout handling
 - Implement device shadow service: last-known state of every device accessible even when offline
 - Write unit, integration, and load tests - no service reaches staging without test coverage
 - Own service reliability: SLO definitions, alerting runbooks, on-call incident response

Cloud Infrastructure (Interim)

- Provision and manage all AWS environments (dev, staging, production) using Terraform - no click-ops
 - Configure AWS IoT Core: MQTT endpoint, topic namespace, rules engine, certificate management
 - Set up CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions for all backend services
 - Configure CloudWatch monitoring, log aggregation, and automated health alerts
 - Manage IAM for all team members - least-privilege access, no shared credentials
 - Hand off infrastructure fully documented when a DevOps engineer joins in Phase 2

Requirements

- 7-12 years software or systems engineering; minimum 4 years specifically building IoT platform backends or connected product infrastructure
 - Expert-level, hands-on experience with AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub - production deployments, not tutorials ⚑ NON-NEGOTIABLE
 - Expert MQTT knowledge: v3. 1 and v5. 0, topic hierarchy design, QoS levels, retained messages, Last Will & Testament, broker sizing and clustering ⚑ NON-NEGOTIABLE
 - Proficiency in Python and Node. js/TypeScript for production backend services - Go is a strong advantage
 - Hands-on experience with a time-series database: InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, or AWS Timestream
 - Terraform or AWS CloudFormation - you provision cloud infrastructure programmatically, not through the console
 - Multi-tenant SaaS backend architecture: data isolation patterns, tenant-scoped access control, shared infrastructure design
 - Security fundamentals applied in practice: TLS/mTLS, X. 509 certificates, OAuth 2. 0, JWT, secrets management (Vault or AWS Secrets Manager)
 - Message broker or streaming experience: Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS Kinesis, or AWS IoT Rules Engine
 - Proven ability to work autonomously at a senior level - makes decisions, documents rationale, flags risks without needing to be prompted ⚑ REMOTE DISCIPLINE

Nice to Have

- Industrial protocol knowledge: Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, BACnet - even as a consumer or integrator
 - EMQX, HiveMQ, or VerneMQ broker deployment and production operation
 - Edge computing runtimes: AWS Greengrass v2, Azure IoT Edge, or Balena
 - Digital twin frameworks: AWS IoT TwinMaker, Azure Digital Twins
 - Container orchestration: Kubernetes, ECS, or equivalent for future Phase 2 migration
 - Open-source IoT contributions or published technical writing on platform architecture

Skills At a Glance

Architecture: IoT platform end-to-end design

- Multi-tenant SaaS patterns
 - Device lifecycle management
 - Protocol abstraction
 - Rule engine design
 - Horizontal scaling strategy

Backend: Python / Node. js / TypeScript / Go

- REST + GraphQL API design
 - WebSocket / SSE real-time delivery
 - MQTT broker configuration
 - Time-series DB (InfluxDB / Timestream)
 - PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS

Cloud & DevOps: AWS IoT Core / Azure IoT Hub

- Terraform / CloudFormation
 - GitHub Actions CI/CD
 - Docker containers
 - CloudWatch monitoring
 - IAM and security policy management

Security: TLS / mTLS configuration

- X. 509 certificate management
 - OAuth 2. 0 / JWT implementation
 - Secrets management
 - Device authentication at scale

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer (DevOps)
data.description:
About Us

Are you ready to shape the financial future of a rapidly growing fintech that's transforming lives across Southeast Asia and beyond?

We're not your typical company - we're a rocketship! At FINN, established in 2022 by experienced serial founders, we're on a mission to transform financial well-being for underbanked employees. Our product provides early wage access, financial education, budgeting tools, part-time job opportunities, and micro-insurances. We've hit product-market fit and are scaling aggressively across multiple markets. 

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our small, growing Platform team and help scale our infrastructure across multiple markets. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you'll own critical cloud infrastructure serving hundreds of thousands of users across Southeast Asia and Africa. 

You'll be part of the Platform squad - responsible for platform-level infrastructure, shared services, observability, and security tooling. We're in the middle of a major infrastructure maturity push: closing IaC gaps, hardening CI/CD, improving observability, and preparing our platform for rapid expansion across multiple markets in Southeast Asia and Africa. 

This isn't a role where you maintain dashboards. You'll architect, build, and operate the infrastructure that powers a high-growth fintech with high-throughput production systems. 

What You'll Do

- Own and operate cloud infrastructure - compute, networking, identity, and security controls - using Infrastructure-as-Code
 - Manage container orchestration workloads, including cluster upgrades, deployment management, and autoscaling
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - automated testing, deployment automation, and quality gates
 - Drive observability - implement and improve monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing across all services
 - Harden security posture - cloud security posture management, automated scanning in CI, access policies, network security, and contributing toward industry security certifications
 - Manage multi-cloud infrastructure - we run workloads across multiple cloud providers
 - Operate messaging infrastructure - event-driven architectures, including retry strategies and dead-letter queue management
 - Standardize market launches - build repeatable infrastructure provisioning so new markets can go live in days, not weeks
 - Support the engineering team - be the go-to person for infrastructure questions, unblock developers, and create self-service tooling
 - Participate in on-call rotation - respond to production incidents and drive root-cause analysis and prevention

Must-Have Experience

- 5+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering role
 - Strong cloud infrastructure expertise - compute, networking, identity management, queuing, monitoring, storage, and databases (we use AWS primarily)
 - Container orchestration in production - cluster operations, package management, debugging, resource management (we use Kubernetes)
 - Infrastructure-as-Code at scale - writing, reviewing, and managing IaC with proper state management and modularization (we use Terraform)
 - CI/CD pipeline design - deployment automation, testing integration, and deployment strategies (blue-green, canary)
 - Linux systems administration - comfortable debugging at the OS level
 - Monitoring and observability - setting up alerting, dashboards, log aggregation, and incident response
 - Security mindset - experience with access control best practices, network security, secrets management
 - Strong communication - able to explain infrastructure decisions to non-infra engineers
 - Reliable internet and hardware, able to work ≥40h/week with decent overlap with UTC+8 (Singapore time)

Nice-to-Have

- Multi-cloud experience (GCP, Firebase, or similar alongside AWS)
 - GitOps deployment experience (e. g. ArgoCD or similar)
 - Event streaming operations and tuning (e. g. Kafka)
 - Compliance frameworks - ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar
 - Cost optimization - experience reducing cloud spend without sacrificing reliability
 - Pen testing coordination or security audit experience
 - Experience at a fintech or financial services company
 - Experience with multi-region or multi-market infrastructure

What We Use Today

Here's what we work with today - familiarity is a bonus, not a requirement: 

- Cloud: AWS (primary) + GCP/Firebase
 - Orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS), Helm, ArgoCD
 - IaC: Terraform
 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions
 - Messaging: Kafka, SQS
 - Monitoring: Grafana, Sentry, CloudWatch
 - Security: Prowler, Trivy, SonarCloud, Cloudflare WAF
 - Backend: Node. js/TypeScript, Python, PHP
 - Frontend: Angular, Ionic/Capacitor

Why Join

- Real ownership - you'll shape the infrastructure of a company scaling across continents
 - Small team, big impact - a growing platform team, no layers of bureaucracy
 - Growth trajectory - rapidly expanding across Southeast Asia and Africa
 - Modern stack - container orchestration, IaC, GitOps, event-driven architecture
 - Fully remote - work from anywhere with good overlap to Asia timezones #EMEA #APJ
 - Competitive salary + meaningful equity (early-stage package)

We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
