data.title: AI Tooling Engineer - Remote
data.description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 225 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. 

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3, 000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web. 

This role sits in Zyte's Tooling team, working side by side with our Principal Engineer in Tooling on an internal agentic platform: one place that brings together what the company knows, today spread across many systems, so that people and their AI agents get that context in one place, each seeing only what they are allowed to see. 

We are looking for a builder: someone who has built AI agents and shipped them to real users, and who likes owning a product end to end, from talking with the people who use it to the code, the deployment and the numbers that say whether it works. The first version is already in use inside the company and grows every week. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Build the platform with the Principal Engineer in Tooling: new capabilities every week, from design to production
 - Connect new internal systems and SaaS tools to the platform: their APIs and data, how they fit a shared model, and who may see what
 - Build agents and the tools they use, including MCP servers that agents across the company can call, and the context they need to answer well
 - Own quality: evaluation sets and benchmarks, tracing, cost per answer, and fixing what users run into
 - Turn proofs of concept into internal tools that run in production in the cloud, with security and access done properly
 - Build with AI coding agents as the main way of working, with the specs, tests and reviews that keep the code sound
 - Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives: evaluating and standardising internal AI tools, cost and usage tracking, and agreed standards for AI-built internal apps; help other teams build on the platform
 - Talk with the people who use the platform, across the company, to learn what to build next, and explain what was built to technical and non-technical audiences

Requirements

- 3+ years building and shipping production software, mostly in Python, with relational databases
 - Has built and shipped with LangGraph at least one agent that real people use: tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt and context design
 - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from the main providers, cost and token optimisation
 - Hands-on with MCP or similar tool protocols, as a server and as a client
 - Evaluates AI systems properly: test sets, LLM-as-judge, regressions when a prompt or a model changes; tracing and observability with Langfuse or similar
 - Integrates APIs and data: SaaS APIs, SQL, data warehouses
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or AWS): containers, managed databases, identity and access, CI/CD
 - Uses AI coding agents every day and knows how to keep their output in check
 - A sense for security and permissions: identity, least privilege, people see only what they are allowed to see
 - Comfortable with version control (GitHub/Bitbucket)
 - Excellent written and spoken English, technical and non-technical

Desired Skills: 

- Familiarity with web data or web scraping
 - Django and Postgres, including vector search with pgvector
 - Enough frontend to build and change a chat interface (React, Next. js)
 - Has built internal tools that colleagues adopted
 - Semantic layers or knowledge graphs
 - Memory for agents, multi-agent setups
 - Previous remote/distributed team experience

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will: 

- Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
 - Freedom and flexibility to work remotely
 - Work with cutting-edge, open-source technologies and tools - and shape the AI tooling the rest of the company relies on

data.title: Junior MERN Stack Developer
data.description:
Experience: 2-5 years

About General Tech Works

General Tech Works builds custom software, enterprise applications, web and mobile applications, SaaS platforms and AI-powered business solutions. 

We work with businesses to understand their operational challenges and develop software that solves real problems. Our projects range from internal business systems and operational dashboards to customer-facing platforms, integrations and scalable digital products. 

We are looking for a MERN Stack Developer who can take ownership of features across the frontend, backend and database layers and help us deliver reliable, production-ready software. 

About the Role

You will build and maintain full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express. js, React. js and Node. js. 

You will work closely with our project managers, designers and engineering team to develop new features, integrate external services, improve existing applications and resolve technical issues across multiple client and product projects. 

We value developers who understand business requirements, write maintainable code, communicate clearly and can independently take a feature from implementation through testing and deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Development - React. js

- Build responsive and interactive web applications using React. js. 
 - Develop reusable components, dashboards, forms, tables and complex business workflows. 
 - Implement designs with attention to usability, responsiveness, accessibility and performance. 
 - Manage application state, routing, form validation and API integration. 
 - Debug frontend issues and optimise application performance. 
 - Work with modern JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS. 2. Backend Development - Node. js & Express. js

- Develop REST APIs and backend services using Node. js and Express. js. 
 - Implement business logic, authentication, authorisation and role-based access control. 
 - Build secure, maintainable and well-structured backend applications. 
 - Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, messaging services and external business systems. 
 - Implement file uploads, notifications, background processing and scheduled jobs where required. 
 - Handle validation, errors, logging, rate limiting and other production concerns. 
 - Write API documentation and support frontend/backend integration. 3. Database Development - MongoDB

- Design MongoDB collections, schemas, relationships and indexes. 
 - Implement efficient CRUD operations, aggregations and data retrieval workflows. 
 - Use Mongoose or the appropriate MongoDB driver. 
 - Optimise queries and investigate database performance issues. 
 - Implement pagination, filtering, sorting and search. 
 - Maintain data consistency and handle migrations or schema changes safely. 
 - Understand embedding versus referencing and choose appropriate data models for the use case. 4. Application Security & Performance

- Implement secure authentication and session or token management. 
 - Apply appropriate access controls and protect sensitive information. 
 - Follow secure coding practices for APIs and database operations. 
 - Prevent common web vulnerabilities, including injection, cross-site scripting and insecure access control. 
 - Optimise API response times, database queries and frontend rendering. 
 - Use caching, pagination and asynchronous processing where appropriate. 5. Integrations & Business Applications

- Integrate payment gateways such as Razorpay. 
 - Develop notification workflows using email, SMS and WhatsApp providers. 
 - Implement webhooks, external API integrations, imports and exports. 
 - Build admin panels, reporting dashboards and operational management systems. 
 - Work on multi-user, role-based applications and multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Contribute to AI-enabled features and LLM integrations where relevant. 6. Testing, Deployment & Maintenance

- Write unit and integration tests for critical application functionality. 
 - Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs and databases. 
 - Use Git effectively for branching, pull requests and code reviews. 
 - Deploy and maintain applications on platforms such as Vercel and suitable cloud infrastructure. 
 - Understand environment variables, build processes, logs and production troubleshooting. 
 - Work with CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. 
 - Document setup instructions, API behaviour and important technical decisions. 7. Project Ownership

- Convert requirements into manageable development tasks. 
 - Estimate implementation effort and communicate risks early. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, QA engineers, designers and other developers. 
 - Maintain code quality while working within delivery timelines. 
 - Take ownership of assigned features from requirements to release. 
 - Work across multiple projects while respecting agreed priorities. Required Technical Skills

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and ES6+. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB, Express. js, React. js and Node. js. 
 - Strong understanding of REST API development and integration. 
 - Experience with React hooks, component architecture and state management. 
 - Knowledge of database design, indexing, aggregation and query optimisation. 
 - Understanding of authentication, authorisation and web application security. 
 - Experience with Git, debugging, testing and production deployment. 
 - Strong understanding of asynchronous JavaScript, promises and error handling. 
 - Ability to write clean, reusable and maintainable code. Preferred Skills

- TypeScript. 
 - Next. js. 
 - Redux Toolkit, Zustand or comparable state management tools. 
 - Socket. IO or other real-time communication technologies. 
 - Redis, queues and background workers. 
 - Docker and CI/CD. 
 - React Native. 
 - Razorpay and other payment gateway integrations. 
 - AI APIs and LLM-based application features. 
 - Experience building SaaS platforms, ERP systems, CRM applications, POS systems or other business software. What We're Looking For

We want an engineer who can think beyond individual components and understand how an entire application works. 

You should be comfortable designing a MongoDB data model, building the Express API, implementing the React interface, integrating the pieces, testing the result and helping deploy it to production. 

You should be able to debug unfamiliar codebases, ask the right questions when requirements are unclear and take responsibility for the quality of your work. 

We value practical engineering ability, problem-solving, ownership and communication more than the number of technologies listed on a CV. 

First 90 Days

First 30 days

- Understand GTW's development standards and active projects. 
 - Set up development environments and become familiar with existing codebases. 
 - Resolve bugs and deliver well-scoped features. Days 31-60

- Independently implement features across React, Express, Node. js and MongoDB. 
 - Integrate external services and contribute to testing and deployments. 
 - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. Days 61-90

- Deliver complete, appropriately scoped features from requirements through deployment. 
 - Demonstrate reliable estimation, debugging and communication. 
 - Identify improvements to application performance, reliability and maintainability. How to Apply

Please share: 

- Updated CV. 
 - GitHub profile or code samples, where available. 
 - Links to applications you have personally built or contributed to. 
 - A brief explanation of a feature you developed across the MERN stack. 
 - Current CTC and expected CTC. 
 - Notice period. 
 - Confirmation of availability for on-site work in Gurugram. General Tech Works Private Limited

Understand the business. Build the software. Own the outcome.

data.title: Manager/Sr. Manager, Engineering - AI Platform
data.description:
We are looking for a Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering for our AI Platform team. Someone who can take ownership of a fast-growing, high-visibility team building the agentic foundation for SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how AI agents get built, governed, and shipped across the company. 

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will partner closely with the Product Manager for AI Platform to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Team leadership and development

- Lead and grow the AI Platform team, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
 - Develop individual engineers through regular 1: 1s, coaching, and honest feedback
 - Hire and onboard new engineers into an already fast-moving workstream as scope grows

Delivery and operations

- Own delivery of the AI Platform roadmap: production readiness for Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo, the Agent Development Stack, evaluation/trust/safety/guardrails, multi-agent orchestration, and MCP for SCD APIs
 - Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health, keeping delivery and engagement strong
 - Remove blockers before they slow the team down, and hold a high bar on security, compliance, and operational readiness

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

- Partner with the Product Manager to translate product strategy into an executable engineering plan
 - Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks
 - Collaborate across Product Development, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders

Strategy and growth

- Help shape SimCorp's agentic platform strategy as scope expands beyond today's capabilities
 - Anticipate where the team needs to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
 - Bring an informed point of view on responsible, safe, and governed AI agent development

What We Value

Ownership and independence You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through. 

Management experience You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement. 

Technical grounding in AI and platform engineering You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with agent orchestration, LLM-based systems, APIs, and the trust/safety layer around them. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off. 

Communication clarity You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums. 

Result orientation and a growth mindset You focus on outcomes, not just activity, and drive your own growth and your team's. 

Distributed team experience and empathy Leading a distributed team takes clear communication, inclusive practices, and genuine attention to people's wellbeing. Experience with Scandinavian or European teams, and comfort with remote work, is a plus. 

Structured thinking in ambiguous situations AI technology and the team's scope are still evolving. You create clarity, manage capacity with discipline, and align with stakeholders without escalating every decision. 

Collaborative by default You know when to align, when to decide, and when to push back - and do all three constructively, fitting naturally with how we work

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

 - Experience with EDA tools (e. g. , Synopsys FusionCompiler, TestMax, Mentor Tessent) and scripting languages (e. g. , Python, TCL, Makefile, etc). 
 - Knowledge of IC design flows, verification tools, SDC, fault models.

 - Hands-on experienced and successful taped out several ASICs. 
 - Self-motivated team player with strong problem-solving skills to collaborate with various teams to achieve desired goal. Responsibilities

Job Description

Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer (DevOps + AI + . NET)

Work Mode: Hybrid

Shift Timings: 12PM - 9PM

Overall Objectives

As IT Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building and continuously improving automation products that enhance the laboratory end user experience when interacting with IT services. The role focuses on the creation and development of scalable, secure and cost-effective automation solutions, including but not limited to AI driven chatbots and intelligent automations built using Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft AI Foundry, aligned with business needs and Eurofins standards. 

You will work hands on across the full lifecycle of automation products, from ideation and architectural design through development, integration and operational support. A key part of the role is the integration of these automation solutions with the in house self service automation platform, as well as the continuous development and evolution of the platform itself, including its frontend, backend and underlying automation pipelines, to address the evolving requirements of the internal IT organisation and laboratory users. 

You will apply and promote Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code practices using Terraform and Ansible, ensuring that automation solutions and underlying platforms are reliable, reusable and maintainable. An important responsibility of the role is to cross train and enable operational teams on the effective use of these IaC and CaC practices, increasing adoption, consistency and operational maturity across IT. 

In addition, you will act as a product owner for the in house automation platform by shaping the roadmap, prioritising features based on business value and user experience, and ensuring alignment between technical capabilities and organisational needs. You will set technical direction, define best practices and provide hands on leadership and mentoring to other technical teams, acting as a recognised reference for automation and AI within the organisation. 

Specific Assignments

Cloud Management

Manage and enhance DEV/TEST subscriptions in Azure Development tenant used by IT organization, including environments used for automation product development and AI experimentation. 

Support cloud enablement for automation and AI solutions built on Azure, Microsoft Copilot extensibility and Microsoft AI Foundry. 

Provide guidance and technical consultations for teams across IT on cloud usage, automation platforms and AI based solutions. 

Infrastructure as Code

Translate existing static Azure infrastructure into Terraform managed code, with a focus on enabling reusable platforms for automation products. 

Drive Infrastructure as Code best practices using Terraform and Terraform Cloud within production landing zones in collaboration with operational support teams. 

Design, test and evolve Terraform modules supporting automation platforms, AI services and self-service capabilities. 

Cross train operational teams on Terraform usage, patterns and operational ownership, increasing autonomy and consistency across environments. 

Configuration as Code

Automate deployment and configuration of infrastructure and services using Ansible, including components supporting automation platforms and AI services. 

Maintain and enhance the existing Ansible codebase and configuration pipelines. 

After migration to Terraform, further refine the Ansible codebase and decompose it into specialized, service specific micro pipelines. 

Enable and upskill operational teams on Configuration as Code practices using Ansible, PowerShell and Bash. 

Automation Products and AI Solutions

Design and build automation products aimed at improving laboratory end user experience when interacting with IT Infrastructure support crews. 

Develop AI driven chatbots and intelligent automation using Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft AI Foundry and associated Azure services. 

Integrate AI and automation products with the in-house self-service automation platform and underlying automation pipelines. 

Ensure automation solutions are scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards. 

Self-service portal development

Maintain and evolve the in-house automation platform codebase using C#, . NET, MudBlazor, PowerShell, Bash and Ansible. 

Manage and operate supporting platform components including Cosmos DB, App Services, Azure DevOps pipelines, DNS records, technical accounts, application secrets, TLS certificates and Application Gateway configurations across production landing zones. 

Enhance platform capabilities based on business requirements, user feedback and product roadmap priorities. 

Act as coproduct owner for the in-house automation platform by defining vision, maintaining backlog, prioritizing features and aligning development with business value. 

Security

Ensure strong security posture of all maintained code and automation solutions, preventing exposure of secrets or infrastructure misuse. 

Apply secure coding and DevSecOps practices including static and dynamic code analysis, SonarQube integrations and automated testing. 

Ensure AI and automation solutions comply with security, identity and access management standards. 

Architecture Team Support

Support infrastructure and enterprise architects in proofs of concept, design activities and evaluations requiring automation, DevOps or AI expertise. 

Contribute to platform and automation architecture decisions, ensuring long term sustainability and operability. 

Assist Infrastructure architects in POCs and other activities that require Automation/DevOps specific skillset. 

Required Skills

General

Ability to understand business and end user requirements and translate them into technical and product level priorities. 

Strong product mindset with focus on user experience, value delivery and continuous improvement. 

Motivation to deliver modern, innovative automation and AI based solutions for a global IT organization. 

Strong collaboration skills with engineers, architects, product stakeholders and operational teams. 

Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise

Deep practical knowledge of Azure IaaS and PaaS services including Virtual Machines, Networking, Storage, AKS, App Services, Cosmos DB, API Management and AI related services. 

Practical experience with Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams and Intune, especially in automation and integration scenarios. 

Strong understanding of Azure Active Directory and identity services including RBAC, conditional access, MFA and hybrid identity. 

Experience with DevOps and automation platforms using Terraform, Ansible, ARM and CI: CD pipelines in Azure DevOps. 

Solid knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, LDAP directory structures and Kerberos protocol. 

Infrastructure as Code

Strong ability to design and write Terraform code interacting with Azure and on premises services. 

Experience with Terraform state management, security best practices and governance. 

Ability to manage Terraform Cloud organizations, projects and workspaces. 

Experience with managing and supporting Terraform execution environments and worker nodes. 

Ability to coach and mentor operational teams on Infrastructure as Code adoption. 

Configuration as Code

Strong ability to design and implement Ansible automation embedded in Azure DevOps pipelines. 

Experience managing Linux and Windows environments using Ansible, PowerShell and Bash. 

Ability to troubleshoot, debug and optimize CI CD pipelines and configuration automation. 

Experience enabling operational teams through documentation, training and shared practices. 

Automation Platform and Product Development

Ability to write secure, maintainable code in C#, . NET and MudBlazor. 

Experience integrating frontend applications with backend services, automation pipelines and APIs. 

Familiarity with building and integrating AI driven automation such as chatbots using Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft AI Foundry. 

Experience managing application secrets, certificates, DNS records and platform related configurations. 

Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical product owner, balancing roadmap, stakeholder needs and technical quality.

data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we're looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don't shy away from humanity's challenges but are determined to help solve them. 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. 

Leadership Role - DFT

The Role

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) in the IODC SoC DFT organization, you will lead end-to-end ATPG strategy, implementation, and pattern validation for complex, multi-million gate SoCs powering next-generation SOCs. You will be responsible for driving all ATPG execution activities from DFT architecture definition through pre-silicon verification, production test enablement, silicon bring-up, and manufacturing ramp. 

This role requires close collaboration with RTL, DFT RTL, DFT Verification, Physical Design, Product Engineering Operations (PEO), ATE, and Silicon Validation teams to ensure high-quality test content, optimal coverage, tester readiness, and successful silicon deployment. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in ATPG, scan methodologies, and pattern validation with proven experience delivering production-quality test solutions for large-scale SoCs. 

The Person

You are a highly motivated technical leader with extensive experience in SoC DFT and ATPG execution. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex debug challenges, and possess a strong track record of driving cross-functional execution from design conception through manufacturing. 

You are comfortable working across multiple organizations, influencing technical direction, mentoring engineers, and serving as the key technical expert for ATPG signoff and silicon test readiness. 

IMPACT

This role serves as the technical owner for ATPG execution across critical SoC programs and directly influences product quality, manufacturing yield, test cost, and time-to-market. The successful candidate will play a key role in enabling first-silicon success and scaling robust DFT methodologies across future AMD SoC generations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end ATPG execution for large-scale SoCs from architecture phase through silicon production. 
 - Define and drive ATPG methodologies, test strategies, coverage closure plans, and pattern signoff criteria. 
 - Generate and validate scan, transition fault, cell-aware, bridge, chain diagnosis, and compression-based ATPG patterns. 
 - Drive pattern quality improvements, tester efficiency optimization, and test cost reduction initiatives. 
 - Partner closely with DFT RTL, DFT Verification, RTL, Physical Design, and Timing teams to ensure robust DFT implementation and testability. 
 - Collaborate with PEO and ATE teams to enable tester bring-up, pattern correlation, tester debug, and manufacturing deployment. 
 - Lead pattern validation activities across simulation, emulation, ATE, and platform environments. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of ATPG, tester, silicon, and yield-related issues. 
 - Ensure high-quality pattern delivery meeting schedule, coverage, power, and manufacturing requirements. 
 - Support silicon bring-up, diagnosis, yield learning, and production ramp activities. 
 - Develop automation flows and AI-enabled solutions to improve ATPG productivity and debug turnaround time. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and drive ATPG best practices across the organization. 

Preferred Experience

- 16+ years of experience in SoC DFT with strong expertise in ATPG and manufacturing test. 
 - Proven ownership of ATPG execution for multiple successful high-volume SoC products. 
 - Extensive experience with multi-million gate SoCs and hierarchical ATPG methodologies. 
 - Deep understanding of Scan, EDT/Compression, LBIST, MBIST, Boundary Scan, and DFT architecture. 
 - Strong experience with pattern validation, tester correlation, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Hands-on experience working with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, and ATE teams. 
 - Experience debugging silicon failures and supporting yield improvement initiatives. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, Shell, or similar languages. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across geographically distributed teams. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- ATPG tools such as Tessent, Modus, TestMAX, TetraMAX, or equivalent.

Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer

Role Overview: As a Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to set production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Set production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. 
 - Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Role Description

The Senior Penetration Tester defines and leads the execution of highly technical and specialized engagements and designs new techniques of testing based on the evolution of industry best practices over time, including emerging areas such as AI and machine learning-driven systems. 

They are both performing hands-on technical testing without requiring supervision and are coordinating teams of testers to ensure that the engagement objectives are met. The Senior Penetration Tester provides critical input to the Senior Manager - Threat Management with the development of the security assurance strategic plan based on subject matter expertise to increase the impact and value added through this area of focus. 

The Senior Penetration Tester also helps further grow the security assurance area by mentoring other team members and members of other technical non-pentester communities within Booking. The Senior Penetration Tester has strong stakeholder management skills that enable effective communication of technical information to multi-level (up to CISO/CSO level), technical and non-technical audiences both within Booking and the broader Booking Holdings organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Defines and leads the execution of highly technical penetration tests and security assurance engagements that deliver value to Booking by independently performing hands-on, detailed technical tests without requiring supervision.

data.title: Motion Control Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

Who we are: 

At UST, we help the world's best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30, 000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact-touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at . 

Summary

UST is looking for core Motion Control Engineer

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking a Motion Control Engineer to own the design, configuration, and optimization of multi-axis motion systems built on ACS Motion Control platforms. You will select the right motor, encoder, drive, and controller architecture for each application, then bring those systems to life - wiring, commissioning, programming, and tuning them to meet demanding accuracy, throughput, and reliability targets. 

This role sits at the intersection of electrical design and controls software. You should be equally comfortable reading a schematic, pulling a scope trace on a servo loop, and writing ACSPL+ code. 

What You'll Do

Motion system architecture and selection

- Size and select servo/stepper motors, linear and rotary, based on load, duty cycle, inertia ratio, and thermal budget
 - Specify feedback devices - incremental and absolute encoders, resolvers, linear scales - matching resolution, interface (EnDat, BiSS, Sin/Cos, A/B), and accuracy to the application
 - Define the controller and drive architecture: ACS controller family, EtherCAT network topology, drive sizing, power supply and regen requirements
 - Perform trade studies on cost, performance, and lead time; produce bills of material and vendor comparisons

Configuration, programming, and tuning

- Configure ACS controllers and drives using MotionBoot, SPiiPlus MMI Application Studio, and related toolchains
 - Develop motion applications in ACSPL+ - multi-axis coordinated motion, gantry and master/slave configurations, gearing, camming, PVT and spline trajectories, registration and triggered motion
 - Tune servo loops - current, velocity, and position - using frequency response analysis, notch and low-pass filters, feedforward terms, and disturbance rejection techniques
 - Characterize and correct settling time, following error, resonance, backlash, and cogging; validate against spec with data
 - Implement safety and fault handling: limits, E-stop chains, STO, homing strategies, error recovery

Electrical integration

- Produce and review motion control schematics, panel layouts, cable and harness drawings, and I/O maps
 - Debug wiring, grounding, shielding, and EMI issues on the bench and on the machine floor
 - Support panel build, wiring checkout, and power-on of new systems

PLC and machine integration

- Program and integrate PLCs (Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or equivalent) that supervise or coordinate with the motion controller
 - Implement fieldbus communication - EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP - between PLC, motion controller, HMI, and upper-level software
 - Work with mechanical, software, and manufacturing engineering through design reviews, integration, and production ramp
 - Document designs, tuning parameters, and commissioning procedures; support transfer to manufacturing and field service

Required

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline
 - 7-8 years of hands-on experience in industrial motion control and automation
 - Demonstrated experience with ACS Motion Control hardware and software - SPiiPlus controllers/drives, ACSPL+ programming, MMI Application Studio
 - Strong working knowledge of servo control theory: control loop structure, gain tuning, frequency response, stability margins, feedforward
 - Proven ability to size and select motors, drives, and feedback devices from first principles rather than by catalog matching
 - Solid electrical fundamentals: ability to create and interpret schematics and wiring diagrams, and to troubleshoot with a multimeter, oscilloscope, and controller trace tools
 - PLC programming experience in at least one major platform, including ladder and structured text
 - Familiarity with industrial networks, especially EtherCAT, and with machine safety concepts and standards
 - Comfortable working hands-on in a lab or machine floor environment, including bring-up and debug of prototype hardware

Preferred

- Experience with multi-axis gantry systems, dual-loop feedback, or direct-drive linear and torque motors
 - Experience with other motion platforms (Beckhoff, Aerotech, Delta Tau/Power PMAC, Siemens, Rockwell) for comparison and migration work
 - Knowledge of vibration analysis, mechanical resonance, and structural dynamics as they affect closed-loop performance
 - Exposure to machine vision or sensor-triggered motion
 - Experience supporting equipment through design-to-production transition

data.title: Head - QA & RA
data.description:
Key Responsibilities

  

1.       Quality Management System (QMS)

  

QMS Leadership

·            Lead the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System. 

·            Ensure compliance with ISO 13485 and other applicable regulatory requirements. 

·            Develop and maintain Quality Policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, and Quality Manuals. 

·            Monitor QMS performance through defined quality metrics and management reviews. 

·            Ensure document control and record retention systems remain effective. 

  

  

  

Quality Performance Management

·            Establish quality objectives aligned with organizational goals. 

·            Monitor process performance and product quality across all manufacturing operations. 

·            Drive quality improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, rework, customer complaints, and waste. 

·            Review quality trends and initiate preventive actions. 

2.       Regulatory Affairs & Compliance Management

  

Regulatory Compliance

·            Ensure compliance with Medical Devices Rules (MDR) 2017. 

·            Maintain regulatory licenses, registrations, and certifications. 

·            Manage interactions with CDSCO and other regulatory authorities. 

·            Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and implement necessary actions. 

·            Support international regulatory submissions where applicable. 

Product Registration and Documentation

·            Review and approve regulatory documentation. 

·            Ensure accuracy and completeness of Technical Files. 

·            Maintain Device Master Records (DMR) and Device History Records (DHR). 

·            Support new product registrations and market authorization activities. 

3.       Audit & Inspection Management

  

Internal and External Audits

·            Lead Internal Audit Programs. 

·            Act as Management Representative during external audits. 

·            Coordinate ISO 13485 audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and regulatory inspections. 

·            Ensure effective closure of audit observations and non-conformities. 

·            Maintain audit readiness across all departments. 

  

Inspection Readiness

·            Develop systems to achieve continual inspection readiness. 

·            Conduct compliance assessments and gap analyses. 

·            Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions. 

4.       CAPA, Risk Management & Change Control

  

Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA)

·            Lead investigations related to complaints, non-conformities, deviations, and audit findings. 

·            Ensure robust root cause investigations using: 

o    5 Why Analysis

o    Fishbone Analysis

o    8D Methodology

o    Fault Tree Analysis

·            Verify effectiveness of implemented CAPAs. 

  

Risk Management

·            Facilitate risk assessments using FMEA and other risk management tools. 

·            Ensure identified risks are adequately controlled and monitored. 

·            Review risk management documentation periodically. 

  

Change Control

·            Chair Change Control Review meetings. 

·            Review quality and regulatory impact of proposed changes. 

·            Ensure validation requirements are adequately addressed. 

·            Approve implementation and closure of changes. 

5.       Supplier Quality Management

  

Supplier Qualification

·            Establish supplier qualification and approval processes. 

·            Review supplier capability assessments and audit reports. 

·            Approve critical suppliers. 

  

Supplier Performance Monitoring

·            Develop supplier scorecards and performance metrics. 

·            Lead supplier development initiatives. 

·            Monitor supplier corrective actions and effectiveness. 

  

Incoming Quality Assurance

·            Ensure effective raw material inspection programs. 

·            Review supplier-related quality trends and complaints. 

·            Drive supplier quality improvements. 

6.       Product Development & Validation Support

  

New Product Development

·            Participate in product design and development reviews. 

·            Ensure quality requirements are integrated into product development activities. 

·            Support design verification and validation programs. 

  

Validation Programs

·            Lead: 

o    Process Validation

o    Equipment Qualification

o    Packaging Validation

o    Cleaning Validation (if applicable)

o    Software Validation (where required)

·            Ensure validation activities meet regulatory and quality requirements. 

7.       Medical Textile Process Quality

  

Manufacturing Quality Oversight

Provide quality leadership across: 

·            Warping

·            Weaving

·            Knitting

·            Lamination

·            Coating

·            Confectioning

·            Packaging

Process Improvement

·            Monitor process capability and quality performance. 

·            Implement Statistical Process Control (SPC). 

·            Reduce process variation and improve product consistency. 

·            Lead root cause investigations related to textile and medical textile manufacturing defects. 

8.       Customer Quality & Complaint Management

  

·            Review customer complaint investigations. 

·            Ensure timely closure of complaints. 

·            Analyse complaint trends and implement preventive actions. 

·            Participate in customer quality reviews and technical discussions. 

·            Support customer audits and business development initiatives. 

9.       Leadership & Team Development

  

Team Management

·            Lead and manage QA & RA teams. 

·            Establish departmental objectives and KPIs. 

·            Monitor productivity and employee performance. 

  

Talent Development

·            Develop succession plans within the department. 

·            Provide coaching and mentoring to team members. 

·            Conduct training programs on: 

o    Quality Systems

o    Regulatory Compliance

o    Risk Management

o    Product Specifications

o    Audit Requirements

10. Strategic & Cross-Functional Leadership

·            Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Product Development, Engineering, and Commercial teams. 

·            Support business expansion projects and technology transfers. 

·            Participate in management reviews and strategic planning activities. 

·            Drive quality culture initiatives throughout the organization.

Educational Qualification

  

Essential

Preferred

Experience

  

Essential

About Company: 

We are redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by significantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems - a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

About the CompanyBase Set Design Co (India) provides architectural documentation and BIM services for international projects, with a strong focus on the Australian architecture and construction industry. 

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented BIM QA/QC Analyst to ensure that all architectural BIM models, drawings, and documentation meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and compliance before being delivered to clients. 

Key Responsibilities1. BIM Quality Assurance & Quality Control
 - Perform detailed quality checks on architectural BIM models and documentation produced using Autodesk Revit. 
 - Review drawings for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance with project requirements. 
 - Identify modelling errors, documentation discrepancies, coordination issues, and missing information. 
 - Ensure that all deliverables comply with established BIM standards, client requirements, and project-specific documentation guidelines. 
 - Establish and maintain QA/QC checklists for different project stages. 2. Architectural Documentation Review
 - Review architectural documentation across various project stages, including: 
 - Development Application (DA)
 - Design Development (DD)
 - Preliminary Documentation
 - Tender Documentation
 - Issued for Construction (IFC)
 - Verify floor plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, annotations, dimensions, and sheet coordination. 
 - Ensure consistency between drawings, models, schedules, and specifications. 
 - Review documentation for compliance with relevant Australian building codes, NCC requirements, and applicable Australian Standards. 
 - Identify constructability issues and potential design or documentation conflicts. 3. BIM Model Auditing & Coordination
 - Conduct regular audits of Revit models for model health, file structure, naming conventions, and modelling standards. 
 - Review model organisation, worksets, families, parameters, linked models, and documentation setup. 
 - Identify clashes and coordination discrepancies between architectural, structural, and MEP models. 
 - Use Navisworks and other BIM coordination tools where required. 
 - Ensure modelling accuracy appropriate to the project's specified Level of Development (LOD). 4. Quality Reporting & Corrective Actions
 - Prepare QA/QC reports identifying errors, observations, and required corrections. 
 - Categorise issues based on severity, priority, and impact on project deliverables. 
 - Coordinate with BIM architects and project leads to resolve identified issues. 
 - Verify corrections before approving documentation for client submission. 
 - Track recurring errors and recommend preventive measures. 
 - Maintain records of internal quality reviews, client markups, and corrective actions. 5. Team Training & Quality Improvement
 - Provide technical feedback and guidance to BIM architects and documentation teams. 
 - Identify knowledge gaps and conduct training sessions to improve documentation standards. 
 - Develop standardised QA/QC procedures and best practices. 
 - Analyse client feedback and implement measures to minimise repeated errors. 
 - Work closely with project leads to improve team productivity without compromising quality. Required Skills & Qualifications
 - Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B. Arch) or a relevant qualification in architectural design or construction. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in architectural BIM modelling and documentation, preferably with quality control responsibilities. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit. 
 - Strong understanding of architectural drafting, detailing, construction methods, and documentation practices. 
 - Experience reviewing Australian architectural projects and familiarity with the National Construction Code (NCC) and Australian Standards. 
 - Ability to independently review complete architectural drawing packages. 
 - Strong knowledge of BIM workflows, documentation standards, and model coordination. 
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD, Navisworks, Bluebeam Revu, and BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud. 
 - Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and technical communication. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Preferred Qualifications
 - Previous experience working with Australian architecture firms. 
 - Experience in retail, commercial, hospitality, and fit-out projects. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 19650 BIM information management principles. 
 - Experience developing BIM QA/QC checklists and standard operating procedures. 
 - Familiarity with automated Revit model auditing, Dynamo, and BIM validation tools. 
 - Experience mentoring junior architects or BIM modellers. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be assessed based on: 

- First-Time Quality: Percentage of drawing packages approved during initial QC review. 
 - Client Markup Reduction: Reduction in technical errors and repeat observations from clients. 
 - Documentation Accuracy: Accuracy and completeness of architectural drawings and BIM models. 
 - QC Turnaround Time: Timely completion of quality reviews without affecting project deadlines. 
 - Corrective Action Closure: Timely identification, tracking, and verification of corrections. 
 - Process Improvement: Implementation of preventive measures, quality standards, and team training. What We ExpectWe are seeking someone who takes complete ownership of documentation quality rather than simply checking drawings against a checklist. 

The ideal candidate should have a strong architectural understanding, be capable of identifying potential issues independently, and proactively guide the design team towards delivering accurate, coordinated, and professionally documented projects. 

- Our objective is to achieve consistently high-quality, client-ready BIM deliverables with minimal errors, reduced rework, and improved client confidence.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Full Chip SoC Timing Lead in ASIC/SoC design implementation and timing closure. The ideal candidate will lead full-chip timing activities from synthesis through place-and-route, signoff, and tapeout for complex SoCs in advanced technology nodes. This role requires deep expertise in STA, timing constraints, MMMC flows, SI/crosstalk analysis, ECO closure, and cross-functional collaboration with RTL, PD, CTS, DFT, power, and signoff teams. 

The Person

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead full-chip timing closure for complex SoC/ASIC designs across all modes and corners. 
 - Own and drive timing signoff from synthesis to final tapeout. 
 - Develop, validate, and maintain timing constraints including SDC for full-chip and block-level integration. 
 - Perform and review static timing analysis (STA) for setup, hold, recovery, removal, clock gating, and async paths. 
 - Drive MMMC timing methodology and ensure robust timing convergence across PVT corners. 
 - Work closely with physical design teams on floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and post-route timing optimization. 
 - Analyze and resolve timing violations related to datapath, clock path, cross-talk, noise, OCV/AOCV/POCV, derates, and variation effects. 
 - Lead timing ECO strategies and execute closure with minimal impact to power, area, and performance. 
 - Collaborate with RTL/design teams to identify architectural or logic changes required for timing improvement. 
 - Coordinate with IP/block owners for timing budgeting, interface timing closure, and hierarchical timing signoff. 
 - Ensure signoff quality using industry-standard tools and methodologies. 
 - Drive correlation between implementation timing and signoff timing. 
 - Lead tapeout readiness reviews and provide timing risk assessment to program leadership. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and define best practices for timing methodology and closure.

- 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics / Electrical Engineering / VLSI / Microelectronics / Computer Engineering.

 - Strong expertise in full-chip STA and timing signoff for large-scale SoCs. 
 - Proven experience in advanced technology nodes (such as 7nm, 5nm, 3nm or similar). 
 - Strong knowledge of synthesis, place-and-route, extraction, and signoff flows. 
 - Experience with timing budgeting and hierarchical/full-chip integration.

data.description:
Description

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good- you've come to the right place. 

Department Overview

The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows. 

Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation-not experimentation without operational accountability. 

Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator

We are seeking a Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node. js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software. 

Core Responsibilities

- Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule. 
 - Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications. 
 - App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node. js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS). 
 - Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs. 
 - Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance. 
 - Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces. 

Technical Profile

- Core Data Engineering Foundations: 
 - Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting). 
 - Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts. 
 - Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge: 
 - Practical experience with Node. js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO). 
 - AI & Agentic Engineering: 
 - Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain. 
 - Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms. 
 - Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e. g. , Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure: 
 - Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 

Qualifications

- Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth). 
 - Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation. 
 - Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node. js/APIs). 
 - Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

Overview: 

We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer with deep expertise in Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS) technologies and strong specialization in aviation weather data, weather information systems, or weather-enabled aerospace applications. 

This is a senior technical role within an Applied Research & Technology team, focused on identifying, shaping, and maturing technologies that can influence the next generation of aerospace products and capabilities.

Shape the future of aerospace CNS and weather-enabled aviation systems by turning emerging technologies and strong domain fundamentals into differentiated capabilities for next-generation aircraft and airspace operations.

Partner with product and engineering organizations to transition promising research outcomes toward technology maturation, new product development and product enhancement. 

Develop technology roadmaps, research proposals and investment recommendations based on industry trends, customer needs and evolving aerospace architectures. 

Establish collaborations with universities, research institutions, startups, government organizations and technology partners where appropriate. 

Generate and protect intellectual property through patents, technical publications, invention disclosures and internal technology assets. 

Represent the organization in relevant technical forums and contribute to building organizational thought leadership in CNS and aviation weather technologies. 

Mentor researchers and engineers and help develop the next generation of technical talent in aerospace CNS and weather-related disciplines. 

What We Are Looking For

Master's or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Communication Engineering, Atmospheric Science, Meteorology, Avionics, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Typically, 15+ years of significant industry or research experience in one or more Communication, Navigation and Surveillance domains, with demonstrated depth in aerospace applications. 

Strong experience or specialization involving aviation weather, atmospheric/weather data, airborne weather systems, weather information services, meteorological data processing, or weather-enabled aviation applications.

Strong analytical thinking and ability to make engineering decisions when dealing with uncertainty, incomplete information and emerging technologies. 

Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to influence senior engineering leaders, researchers, customers and business stakeholders. 

Research Mindset

Beyond expertise in today's technologies, we are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about what comes next. 

The ideal candidate continuously explores developments across aerospace, atmospheric science, sensing, AI, communications and computing and asks: 

What new capability does this technology make possible for an aircraft, pilot, airline or airspace operator?

They should be comfortable challenging existing approaches while remaining grounded in first principles, aerospace physics, operational realities and safety considerations. 

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a credible pipeline of research that connects: 

Aerospace & Weather Fundamentals → Emerging Technologies → Research Demonstrators → Differentiated Capabilities → Future Products
