data.title: Sr. Platform Engineer II-Datastore
data.description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008. 

You will join the Datastore Team, a core component of the Smarsh Fabric platform that underpins our enterprise applications. The team enables self-service, next-generation data capabilities across the engineering organisation, ensuring long-term scalability, reliability, and innovation. 

This role focuses on designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed data platforms supporting petabyte-scale environments across hundreds of clusters. You will own complex technical initiatives end-to-end and play a key role in ensuring our data infrastructure remains reliable, scalable, secure, and highly automated. 

Core Responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate highly available, scalable clusters supporting core data technologies including MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Apache Kafka. 
 - Own major platform components and deliver complex initiatives from design through to production. 
 - Implement and enhance architectural patterns and platform standards for reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex distributed systems issues across multi-cluster environments. 
 - Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines to ensure repeatable, scalable deployments. 
 - Contribute to observability, reliability, and operational excellence across the data platform estate. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams and Product Management to align platform capabilities with product needs. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Participate in on-call rotations to support platform reliability and continuous improvement. 

Skills & Experience

We're looking for an experienced Platform Engineer with strong expertise in cloud-native and DevOps practices. The ideal candidate will have: 

- 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure-focused roles. 
 - Strong experience operating at least one of MongoDB, Kafka, or ElasticSearch in production environments, including day-2 operations. 
 - Solid experience designing and operating Kubernetes environments and ecosystem tooling (e. g. Helm, ArgoCD) is a significant plus. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java, or similar). 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. 
 - Hands-on experience working with major cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
 - Experience implementing, maintaining and evolving observability solutions (e. g. Prometheus/Grafana or ELK). 
 - Good understanding of security principles and experience embedding security best practices into production environments and code promotion systems. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills. 
 - Strong problem-solving ability and attention to detail

Desirable Experience

- Experience contributing to internal platform APIs or automation tooling. 
 - Exposure to regulated environments. 
 - Interest in advancing platform engineering practices such as self-service infrastructure. 
 - We're especially interested in candidates that may have transitioned from Software
 - Engineering into Platform Engineering. 

About Our Culture

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world's leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably. com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

data.title: Assistant Manager Quality Assurance
data.description:
Company Description Autoline Industries Limited is a leading automotive sheet metal component manufacturer in India, known for its integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing capabilities. The company supplies high-quality components to major global and domestic OEMs, including Tata Motors, Volkswagen, Ford, Daimler India, Ashok Leyland, GM, and Cummins USA. Autoline focuses on innovation, reliability, and customer-centric solutions, supporting complex vehicle platforms and demanding quality standards. Team members benefit from exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies and collaboration with renowned automotive brands, creating strong opportunities for professional growth. 
Role Description The Assistant Manager Quality Assurance is a full-time, on-site role based in Mahesana. This role is responsible for overseeing day-to-day quality assurance activities on the shop floor and within the quality department, ensuring that sheet metal components meet customer specifications and internal standards. Typical tasks include monitoring production quality, conducting inspections and audits, analyzing defects and root causes, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. The role also involves maintaining quality documentation, supporting process improvements, coordinating with production, engineering, and suppliers, and preparing reports for internal management and customer reviews. The Assistant Manager Quality Assurance will help drive continuous improvement initiatives and support compliance with relevant automotive quality frameworks and certifications. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong knowledge of quality assurance methods, including in-process inspection, final inspection, and audit practices within automotive manufacturing. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in quality tools and systems such as SPC, control plans, FMEA, root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and documentation management. 
 - Candidates should possess abilities in reading engineering drawings, understanding sheet metal processes, and collaborating with design and production teams to resolve quality issues. 
 - Candidates should possess familiarity with automotive quality standards and certifications (e. g. , IATF 16949, ISO 9001) and supplier quality requirements for global OEMs. 
 - Candidates should possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, along with attention to detail and a structured approach to process improvement. 
 - Candidates should possess effective communication and stakeholder management skills to interact with cross-functional teams, customers, and suppliers. 
 - Relevant academic qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field are preferred. 
 - Prior experience in automotive component manufacturing, particularly in sheet metal, in a quality or quality assurance leadership role will be an added advantage.

data.title: Director - Cloud Platform Operations, Reliability & Security
data.description:
Location Chennai, India; relocation can be discussed

Experience 15+ years in technology, including substantial executive leadership

Reporting Senior technology leadership

The mandate

An established enterprise software organization is strengthening the way it builds, protects, and operates its cloud services. It is looking for an executive who can bring platform engineering, production resilience, and security outcomes under clear leadership, while working closely with product and engineering teams. 

The successful leader will set direction and build a capable organization that delivers dependable services, reduces security exposure, and automates routine operational work. This is a leadership appointment with real technical accountability: the executive will challenge design decisions, examine service and security evidence, and personally engage in critical events when needed. 

What you will own

An integrated operating model for cloud platforms, service operations, SRE, secure software delivery, and security engineering. 

Organization design, leadership development, and measurable accountability across managers and specialist teams. 

The executive view of service health, operational risk, security posture, major incidents, and investment priorities. 

A close partnership with engineering leaders so reliability and security are built into architecture, development, release, and support. 

Areas of impact

Service resilience and operational leadership

Define how critical services are measured and operated, including SLOs, error budgets, availability, performance, capacity, and release risk. 

Lead high-severity incident response and 24x7 escalation. Set expectations for command, communications, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective work. 

Use telemetry, service reviews, readiness practices, and resilience exercises to identify weak signals and prevent customer-impacting failures. 

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement. 

Cloud platform and financial stewardship

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle. 

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled. 

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results. 

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend. 

Security engineering and threat response

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments. 

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services. 

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure. 

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through. 

Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning. 

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable. 

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses. 

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions. 

Experience and leadership profile

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering. 

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams. 

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant. 

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning. 

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness. 

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response. 

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control. 

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews. 

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders. 

Additional strengths

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable. 

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment. 

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor. 

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

data.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

Join NetApp's Cloud Platforms organization and help build the next generation of cloud-native infrastructure, software-defined storage, and virtualization platforms powering enterprise-scale data management solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Software Development Engineer with deep expertise in Linux systems, distributed storage virtualization technologies, and cloud infrastructure platforms. 

Job Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in systems software engineering, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or storage platform development. 
 - Strong programming expertise in C/C++ and Python. 
 - Deep understanding of operating systems internals, concurrency, memory management, performance optimization, and systems-level debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience with software-defined storage systems, distributed storage platforms, or enterprise infrastructure software. 
 - Strong experience with virtualization technologies including KVM/QEMU, libvirt, virtio, and virtualized networking/storage infrastructure. 
 - Experience developing or troubleshooting storage and networking subsystems, kernel modules, or device drivers. Strong knowledge of storage technologies and protocols such as NVMe, iSCSI, NFS, SMB/CIFS, S3, or distributed block/object/file storage systems. 
 - Hands-on operational experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI infrastructure environments. 
 - Experience with CI/CD systems, automation frameworks, observability, and infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and performance tuning skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical discussions across teams. 
 - Ability to independently resolve most technical blockers while escalating major risks proactively. 

Education

4-8 years of professional experience in software development, Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. 

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment-you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. 

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. 

Submitting an Application

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. 

AI Disclosure

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support-rather than replace-human decision-making.

 - Experience contributing to or leading code reviews with a focus on quality, security, and knowledge sharing

data.title: Head of Product & Technology
data.description:
Job Description: Head of Product & TechnologyCompany: ISCAP

Department: Product, Technology & Engineering

Experience: 5-10+ years

Qualification: Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, Product Management, or a related field

Industry: SaaS, EdTech, Digital Platforms

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana / Hybrid / Remote, depending on business requirements

Key Responsibilities1. Product Strategy & Roadmap
 - Define ISCAP's product vision, technology strategy, and phased development roadmap. 
 - Convert business objectives and user feedback into product requirements, user stories, and release plans. 
 - Prioritise features based on business value, user needs, cost, and scalability. 
 - Collaborate with academic, operations, sales, marketing, and leadership teams. 2. Learning Platform & Course Delivery
 - Develop, implement, integrate, or optimise ISCAP's Learning Management System (LMS). 
 - Support course discovery, enrolment, payments where applicable, learning content, assignments, assessments, progress tracking, and certification. 
 - Establish workflows for course creation, publishing, cohort management, and content updates. 
 - Enable trainers and administrators to manage courses, assessments, and learner progress efficiently. 3. Student, Trainer & Partner Portals
 - Student portal: Registration, enrolment, learning resources, assessments, progress tracking, certificates, and career opportunities. 
 - Trainer portal: Course management, cohort tracking, assignment evaluation, learner feedback, and progress monitoring. 
 - College portal: Institution onboarding, student nominations, bulk enrolments, cohort tracking, and program reporting. 
 - Employer portal: Internship and hiring requirements, eligible learner profiles, candidate shortlisting, and application tracking, subject to permissions and consent. 
 - Administrator portal: User management, role-based permissions, course administration, approvals, reporting, and operational monitoring. 4. Product Design & User Experience
 - Design intuitive, user-friendly experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 
 - Map user journeys, identify friction points, and improve registration, enrolment, learning, and partner workflows. 
 - Collaborate with designers and stakeholders on wireframes, prototypes, and product specifications. 
 - Conduct user testing and continuously improve usability and accessibility. 5. Technology Architecture & Engineering
 - Establish secure, scalable, and maintainable technology architecture. 
 - Evaluate programming frameworks, databases, cloud infrastructure, hosting, and third-party solutions. 
 - Lead or coordinate frontend, backend, QA, DevOps, and external development teams. 
 - Establish coding standards, version control, testing, documentation, and release management. 
 - Make informed build-versus-buy decisions to balance cost, speed, flexibility, and long-term ownership. 6. Automation & Integrations
 - Identify manual processes across admissions, enrolments, course delivery, assessments, certification, partnerships, and reporting. 
 - Automate notifications, reminders, approvals, task assignments, and status updates. 
 - Integrate relevant CRM, LMS, payment, communication, analytics, and support systems. 
 - Build reliable APIs, data synchronisation, error handling, and self-service workflows. 
 - Reduce duplicate data entry while retaining human oversight for decisions requiring review. 7. Security, Privacy & Reliability
 - Implement authentication, role-based access control, encryption, and appropriate security measures. 
 - Establish backup, recovery, monitoring, logging, and incident response procedures. 
 - Coordinate security testing, vulnerability remediation, and software updates. 
 - Protect student records, partner information, and confidential business data. 
 - Consider applicable privacy, data protection, accessibility, and contractual requirements. 8. Analytics & Continuous Improvement
 - Define KPIs for platform adoption, enrolment conversion, learner engagement, completion, satisfaction, and reliability. 
 - Use analytics, support tickets, and user feedback to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Develop dashboards for platform usage, enrolments, learner progress, course performance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Evaluate AI-enabled features where they deliver measurable value and can be implemented responsibly. 9. Team, Vendor & Budget Management
 - Build and manage product and technology teams as business needs evolve. 
 - Coordinate developers, designers, testers, consultants, and implementation partners. 
 - Define milestones, responsibilities, quality standards, and delivery expectations. 
 - Manage technology budgets, infrastructure costs, software subscriptions, and vendor performance. 
 - Ensure critical systems are properly documented and not dependent on a single person or vendor. Mandatory Deliverable: ISCAP Unified Digital PlatformWithin the first 90 days, the selected candidate must establish a practical roadmap and deliver or demonstrate an agreed working product increment. 

Key deliverables: 

- Technology audit: Review the existing website, applications, infrastructure, databases, integrations, and manual workflows. 
 - Product requirements document: Define user journeys, functional requirements, permissions, and priorities. 
 - Technology architecture: Document the proposed architecture, data model, hosting, security, integrations, and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Unified user management: Define registration, authentication, onboarding, roles, and account management. 
 - LMS roadmap: Plan course management, learning content, assignments, assessments, progress tracking, and certification. 
 - Partner workflows: Define institutional onboarding, student nominations, employer requirements, and partnership tracking. 
 - Automation roadmap: Identify and prioritise manual processes for automation. 
 - Operational dashboard: Define reporting requirements for enrolments, course progress, assessments, platform usage, and support. 
 - Security and reliability plan: Establish security controls, backups, monitoring, and recovery requirements. 
 - Working pilot/MVP: Deliver or demonstrate a testable solution for an agreed high-priority workflow. 
 - 6-12-month roadmap: Present milestones, budget estimates, resource requirements, dependencies, and success metrics. The objective is to establish a reliable foundation within 90 days, not necessarily to build the entire platform from scratch. The approach must account for ISCAP's existing technology, budget, and team capacity. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 - Delivery of approved product milestones. 
 - Adoption and successful usage of core platform workflows. 
 - Reduction in manual administrative effort and duplicate data entry. 
 - Platform uptime, performance, and incident resolution. 
 - Reliable course delivery, assessment, and certification workflows. 
 - User satisfaction across students, trainers, colleges, employers, and administrators. 
 - Integration reliability and reporting accuracy. 
 - Timely remediation of identified security risks. 
 - Development delivery predictability and budget adherence. 
 - Reduction in recurring support issues through product improvements. Numerical targets will be established following the initial technology audit. 

Required Qualifications & Experience
 - 5-10+ years of experience in SaaS, EdTech, software engineering, or digital product development. 
 - Demonstrated experience building, implementing, or scaling web applications and digital platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of product roadmaps, requirements gathering, and agile delivery. 
 - Experience with architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and software quality. 
 - Familiarity with security, access controls, monitoring, backups, and privacy requirements. 
 - Experience leading technical teams or managing development vendors. 
 - Strong business understanding, communication, analytical thinking, and execution skills. A relevant degree is preferred. Equivalent practical experience and demonstrated product delivery are also valued. 

Preferred Candidate Profile
 - Experience with LMS platforms, SaaS products, multi-role portals, marketplaces, or B2B/B2C platforms. 
 - Familiarity with CRM, payment integrations, analytics, and workflow automation. 
 - Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, and API-first development. 
 - Experience working in startups or managing technology within budget constraints. 
 - A hands-on, product-minded leader who avoids unnecessary complexity and focuses on measurable business outcomes. First 90-Day Success PlanDays 1-30: Audit & Discovery

- Audit existing technology, tools, integrations, workflows, and risks. 
 - Understand requirements across students, trainers, colleges, employers, and administrators. 
 - Prepare the initial product requirements document and prioritised roadmap. Days 31-60: Architecture & Planning

- Finalise architecture and build-versus-buy recommendations. 
 - Define user roles, workflows, integrations, security requirements, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Prepare resource plans, cost estimates, and delivery milestones. 
 - Begin implementation of the highest-priority product increment. Days 61-90: Pilot & Validation

- Deliver or demonstrate the agreed working MVP or priority workflow. 
 - Conduct functional testing, user acceptance testing, and appropriate security checks. 
 - Gather user feedback and document improvements. 
 - Present the 6-12-month roadmap, risk register, delivery dashboard, and resource plan. 
How to ApplyInterested candidates should submit their resume and a brief overview of their experience in product development, SaaS platforms, technology architecture, or digital transformation. 

Candidates should highlight a product or platform they have built, scaled, or improved, their individual contributions, key technical decisions, and measurable results. Confidential information need not be disclosed. 

ISCAP seeks a product-minded technology leader who can combine strategic thinking, technical judgement, and hands-on execution to build a reliable, scalable digital ecosystem.

Preferred: Ph. D. with substantial experience in higher education administration, academic quality assurance, or institutional governance. 

Good to Have: Training or certifications related to NAAC accreditation, NBA accreditation, quality management systems, academic auditing, outcome-based education, or institutional assessment frameworks. 

Additional Preference: Experience in multidisciplinary institutions covering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education. 

Detailed Job Description

Role Overview

The Head of IQAC will be responsible for establishing, leading, and strengthening the institution's internal quality assurance framework. The role will oversee institutional quality processes, accreditation readiness, NAAC-related data and documentation, institutional ranking submissions, academic and administrative audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

The position will work closely with senior management, academic leaders, department heads, faculty, and administrative teams to ensure institutional performance is measured, documented, evaluated, and improved in line with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

Institutional Quality Assurance & Governance

Develop and implement institution-wide quality assurance policies, frameworks, procedures, and annual quality plans. 

Lead the functioning of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell and establish mechanisms for continuous academic and administrative improvement. 

Define quality indicators, monitoring systems, review mechanisms, and accountability structures across departments. 

Ensure quality initiatives are aligned with institutional objectives and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements. 

NAAC Accreditation & Assessment

Lead institutional preparedness for NAAC accreditation, assessment, and applicable quality assurance processes. 

Coordinate the collection, verification, consolidation, and presentation of data and supporting evidence required for accreditation. 

Oversee preparation and review of relevant institutional submissions, including the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR), Self-Study Report (SSR), and other applicable documentation. 

Track accreditation criteria, performance indicators, evidence gaps, and improvement requirements. 

Coordinate with academic and administrative departments to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines. 

Institutional Rankings & Performance Data

Lead institutional ranking-related data collection, validation, analysis, and submission activities for relevant national and other applicable ranking frameworks. 

Coordinate with departments to compile verified information relating to academics, research, faculty, student outcomes, infrastructure, outreach, and institutional performance. 

Establish centralised data repositories and evidence-tracking mechanisms to improve data accuracy, consistency, and auditability. 

Analyse ranking performance, identify gaps, and recommend initiatives to strengthen institutional outcomes. 

Monitor ranking criteria, submission timelines, and applicable framework updates. 

Academic Quality & Continuous Improvement

Monitor academic quality indicators, teaching-learning processes, curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and student outcomes. 

Promote outcome-based education, programme outcome mapping, feedback mechanisms, and academic quality enhancement initiatives, where applicable. 

Facilitate internal academic audits, administrative audits, and periodic departmental reviews. 

Identify performance gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans. 

Encourage evidence-based decision-making and a culture of continuous quality improvement. 

Data Management, Documentation & Reporting

Establish standardised processes for data collection, validation, documentation, and record maintenance. 

Develop dashboards and institutional reports to track quality indicators, accreditation readiness, ranking performance, and improvement initiatives. 

Ensure the availability of reliable supporting evidence for audits, assessments, accreditation reviews, and ranking submissions. 

Implement document control, version management, and evidence verification practices. 

Present periodic quality performance reports and improvement recommendations to institutional leadership. 

Stakeholder Coordination & Capacity Building

Work closely with senior management, academic leadership, faculty, department coordinators, and administrative teams on quality-related initiatives. 

Establish departmental quality coordinators and define clear responsibilities for data submission, verification, and compliance. 

Conduct awareness sessions and capacity-building programmes on accreditation criteria, documentation standards, quality metrics, and institutional ranking requirements. 

Facilitate internal quality review meetings and monitor the closure of agreed action items. 

Build institution-wide ownership of quality assurance and accreditation readiness. 

Regulatory Compliance & Quality Audits

Monitor applicable quality assurance and accreditation requirements relevant to the institution and its academic programmes. 

Coordinate internal reviews to assess compliance with prescribed academic, administrative, and documentation standards. 

Ensure timely identification, escalation, and closure of quality-related gaps. 

Maintain readiness for external assessments, inspections, audits, and accreditation visits. 

Coordinate with relevant institutional departments to ensure consistency between submitted data, supporting evidence, and official records. 

Strategic Planning & Institutional Improvement

Translate accreditation and ranking findings into measurable institutional improvement plans. 

Benchmark institutional performance against relevant peer institutions and applicable quality frameworks. 

Recommend process improvements, governance mechanisms, and digital tools to strengthen quality management. 

Track implementation of improvement initiatives and report progress to institutional leadership. 

Contribute to long-term institutional planning through quality analytics and performance insights. 

Key Skills

Mandatory Skills

IQAC leadership and institutional quality assurance. 

NAAC accreditation and related documentation. 

Institutional rankings and performance data management. 

Academic and administrative quality audits. 

Data validation, evidence management, and institutional reporting. 

Quality indicators, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Stakeholder coordination and institutional governance. 

Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration. 

Good-to-Have Skills

Exposure to NBA accreditation and other applicable programme-level accreditation frameworks. 

Experience in multidisciplinary universities offering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes. 

Knowledge of outcome-based education, programme outcome assessment, and academic quality frameworks. 

Experience with institutional dashboards, data analytics, and digital documentation systems. 

Exposure to national ranking frameworks, benchmarking, and institutional performance improvement. 

Research, academic administration, and university-level governance experience. 

Other Specific Remarks

Candidates should have substantial experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, and ranking-related activities, rather than general academic administration alone. 

Demonstrated ownership of NAAC-related data, documentation, assessment readiness, and institutional quality processes is preferred. 

Strong expertise in data accuracy, evidence validation, reporting, and coordination across academic and administrative departments is essential. 

Candidates should be capable of leading institution-wide quality initiatives and presenting performance insights to senior leadership. 

Experience in a university or large multidisciplinary higher education institution will be an advantage. 

Candidates with exposure to both Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education are preferred. 

The role requires a detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong analytical, documentation, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities.

data.title: Senior Staff, Emulation Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Connectivity Business Unit at Marvell is at the forefront of delivering high-performance silicon for the world's most demanding data infrastructure, spanning Optical DSPs, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices. Within the BU, the Pre-Silicon Emulation team plays a critical role in program execution-bridging RTL design and real-world system behavior before a single chip is taped out. Our team owns emulation model development, test execution, and system-level debug across Marvell's emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), enabling early firmware bring-up, hardware/software co-validation, and risk reduction on the path to silicon. We work closely with design, verification, firmware, software, and post-silicon teams to ensure emulation is a productive, schedule-driving resource-not a bottleneck. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems at the intersection of hardware and software, and want your work to directly impact the success of next-generation connectivity silicon, we'd love to hear from you. 

What You Can Expect

Execute emulation model bring-up, test development, and debug for connectivity silicon programs, including ODSP, high-speed Ethernet PHYs, and AEC/AOC enablement devices, on platforms such as Palladium, Veloce, and Zebu. 

Work with design, validation, and firmware teams to understand emulation hardware and software requirements, and implement platform configurations, transactors, speed bridges, protocol adapters, and firmware/software stacks. 

Engage with EDA and emulation hardware vendors to resolve platform, tooling, and model issues and maintain a productive emulation environment. 

Develop and maintain HW/SW enablement flows and scripts to support RTL validation and improve emulation model usability for firmware, driver, and system software development. 

Collaborate with pre-silicon validation, design, firmware, and post-silicon teams to identify and resolve emulation bottlenecks and improve validation coverage. 

Build and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure to improve emulation environment productivity, reliability, and utilization within assigned programs. 

Minimum Requirements

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's/PhD with 3+ years of experience. 

Hands-on experience with one or more SoC emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, Zebu), including building and maintaining emulation models for SoC designs. 

Background in test planning, simulation, and debug in Verilog/SystemVerilog environments. 

Experience with SoC development flows, emulation-based debug, and system-level validation. 

Scripting and automation skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, and/or UNIX shell. 

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including design, validation, firmware, and vendor partners. 

Good to Have

Experience with emulation of networking devices or mixed-signal designs, including systems containing PHY or Layer-2/Layer-3 functionality. 

Exposure To Connectivity-focused Silicon, Such As

Optical DSPs (ODSP)

High-speed Ethernet PHYs

AEC/AOC enablement devices

Familiarity with firmware or software bring-up using emulation platforms. 

Experience contributing to or improving emulation infrastructure within a project or product line. 

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

More about Crowe: 

Crowe Capability Center - India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U. S. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

Our products integrate precision signal chains and highly efficient power components into ultra-small form factors, enabling TI's best-in-class customers to translate their ideas into high-value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market. 

In this team, you will work with and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders who have influenced TI's technology, productivity, and way of working in creative and impactful ways. You will directly interact with one of TI's most valued, high-volume customers through intense technical reviews and architecture discussions!

By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path. 

About The Job

If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous & ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you!

data.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - Rust
data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Sr. Director of Software Engineering in the Platform Convergence department. In this role, you will design and scale high-performance backend services to drive the evolution of our converged platform. You will collaborate across teams to build robust distributed systems while mentoring engineers to uphold technical excellence. 

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

- Design and build a low-latency, high-throughput data forwarding plane using Rust and async/await models for efficient service-oriented infrastructure
 - Develop distributed, scalable systems with a heavy focus on concurrency, fault tolerance, and messaging
 - Implement and maintain gRPC-based APIs and services to integrate forwarding plane capabilities with control and orchestration layers
 - Optimize system performance through deep profiling across kernel-space and user-space
 - Drive technical excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, documentation, and mentoring junior engineers

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. 
 - You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. 
 - You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. 
 - You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. 
 - You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. 

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 14+ years of software development experience with specific expertise in systems programming and Rust
 - Extensive experience with async frameworks such as Tokio or async-std
 - Proven track record of building resilient, observable, and horizontally scalable distributed systems
 - Deep understanding of Linux fundamentals, networking, container-based environments, CI/CD, and kernel-user space interaction

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience leveraging AI-assisted developer tools, automated profiling, or AI acceleration libraries to optimize low-latency software architecture
 - Professional experience with systems languages like C/C++ or Go in performance-critical environments and kernel-space technologies like eBPF, XDP, or DPDK
 - Hands-on experience with gRPC, Protobufs, and L2-L4 networking protocols including TCP/IP, UDP, and QUIC

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. 

Benefits

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: 

- Various health plans
 - Time off plans for vacation and sick time

 - In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

Job Description

Job Description

Fresher - ERP Full Stack Developer (MERN & NestJS)

Company: Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited

Department: Product Development

Experience: Fresher

Employment Type: Full-Time

- Role Overview

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is looking for enthusiastic, analytical, and technology-driven freshers to join our ERP development team. 

The selected candidates will work on GwayERP and other enterprise application projects, gaining practical experience in developing scalable business applications using NestJS, Node. js, React. js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and modern AI-assisted development tools. 

This role is suitable for candidates who have a strong foundation in programming, a genuine interest in software development, and the willingness to learn new technologies, understand business processes, and contribute to real-world ERP applications. 

Candidates will participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirement understanding, development, debugging, testing, deployment support, and maintenance. 

We are looking for individuals who can combine strong technical fundamentals, rapid learning, AI-assisted development, problem-solving, ownership, and accountability to deliver quality software efficiently. 

Our Development Philosophy: 

Understand the Requirement → Develop Rapidly → Validate Thoroughly → Deliver Quality → Continuously Improve

Candidates are not expected to know every technology on their first day. However, they must demonstrate a strong willingness to learn, experiment, solve problems independently, and apply their knowledge to practical development challenges. 

- Key Responsibilities
 - ERP Application Development
 - Understand ERP requirements and business workflows. 
 - Develop and maintain ERP modules under the guidance of experienced developers. 
 - Understand the relationship between different ERP modules. 
 - Implement new features and enhancements. 
 - Fix bugs and resolve application issues. 
 - Follow established development standards. 
 - Ensure new developments do not unnecessarily affect existing functionality. 
 - Participate in the complete development lifecycle. 
 - Learn how enterprise applications support real-world business operations. 

The candidate will gain exposure to integrated ERP applications covering multiple business functions. 

- Understanding ERP Business Processes

Develop An Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows, Including: 

- Sales
 - Purchase
 - Procurement
 - Inventory
 - Production and Manufacturing
 - Finance and Accounts
 - Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
 - Service Management
 - HR and Payroll
 - Project Management
 - Reports and Dashboards
 - Master Data Management
 - Approval Workflows
 - User and Role Management
 - Notifications
 - API Integrations
 - Document Management

The candidate should learn to translate a business requirement into a technical implementation. 

Business Requirement → Workflow → API → Database → User Interface → Validation → Testing

A willingness to understand why a feature is required, rather than simply implementing instructions, is essential. 

- Full Stack Development

The candidate will work on both backend and frontend development. 

Backend Development

Learn, Develop, And Maintain Backend Services Using: 

- NestJS
 - Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - REST API development
 - Mongoose ODM
 - MongoDB
 - API integration
 - Request validation
 - Error handling
 - Authentication and authorization
 - Business logic implementation
 - Backend debugging and optimization

Responsibilities Include: 

- Developing backend functionality.

 - Integrating APIs with frontend applications. 
 - Debugging backend errors. 
 - Following existing architectural patterns. 
 - Writing clean, reusable, and maintainable code. 

Frontend Development

Develop And Maintain User Interfaces Using: 

- React. js
 - JavaScript
 - TypeScript
 - Redux
 - Redux-Saga
 - Formik
 - React Hook Form (RHF)
 - Reusable React components
 - State management
 - REST API integration
 - Form validation

- Developing reusable frontend components.

 - Integrating APIs. 
 - Managing application state. 
 - Debugging UI issues. 
 - Implementing appropriate validation and error handling. 
 - Following existing UI/UX designs.

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding MongoDB collections and documents. 
 - Working with Mongoose schemas. 
 - Developing database queries. 
 - Implementing CRUD operations. 
 - Understanding relationships between ERP entities. 
 - Learning MongoDB aggregation pipelines. 
 - Debugging database-related issues. 
 - Following data validation standards. 
 - Understanding data integrity and consistency. 
 - Learning basic database performance optimization. 

The candidate must handle database changes carefully, particularly when working with existing ERP data. 

- AI-Assisted Development

Active use of AI tools for software development is an important expectation of this role. 

The candidate should learn to use AI-assisted development tools to improve development speed, accuracy, and problem-solving ability. 

AI Tools Should Be Used To Support: 

- Understanding unfamiliar code. 
 - Generating code suggestions. 
 - Debugging errors. 
 - Explaining technical concepts. 
 - Refactoring code. 
 - Developing API functionality. 
 - Creating test cases. 
 - Understanding database queries. 
 - Preparing technical documentation. 
 - Investigating implementation approaches. 
 - Identifying potential edge cases. 
 - Improving repetitive development activities. 

The candidate must understand that AI-generated code should never be accepted blindly. 

All AI-assisted code must be reviewed, understood, validated, and tested before being used in the application. 

The Candidate Should Continuously Learn To Answer: 

- Can this requirement be implemented more efficiently?
 - Can AI help identify the root cause of this bug?
 - Can repetitive development work be automated?
 - Can the solution be made more accurate and maintainable?
 - Have the generated changes been properly tested?

The expectation is not simply to use AI, but to use it intelligently to produce better software in less time. 

- Rapid Development & Productivity

The candidate should develop the ability to complete assigned development tasks efficiently without compromising quality. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding requirements before coding. 
 - Breaking tasks into manageable steps. 
 - Reusing existing components and services. 
 - Following established coding patterns. 
 - Avoiding unnecessary code duplication. 
 - Identifying and resolving development blockers. 
 - Minimizing avoidable rework. 
 - Completing assigned tasks within agreed timelines. 
 - Using AI tools appropriately to accelerate development. 
 - Continuously improving technical skills and productivity. 

The objective is to deliver more useful, reliable functionality in less time, rather than simply writing more code. 

- Ownership & Accountability

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding assigned requirements clearly.

 - Providing progress updates. 
 - Communicating blockers promptly. 
 - Meeting agreed delivery timelines. 
 - Testing completed functionality. 
 - Fixing issues identified during testing. 
 - Following tasks through to completion.

- Code Quality & Development Standards

The candidate must learn and follow established software development standards. 

Responsibilities Include:

 - Implementing proper error handling.

data.description:
About Turing: 

- Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. 
 - Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. 

Role Overview: 

- We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative. 
 - In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5-10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks. 

What you'll do: 

- Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks. 
 - Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests. 
 - Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems. 
 - Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning. 
 - Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability. 
 - Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results. 
 - Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues. 
 - Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior. 
 - Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations. 
 - Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval. 
 - Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices. 

What we're looking for: 

- Ph. D. , postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design. 
 - Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs. 
 - Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results. 
 - Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions. 
 - Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams. 
 - Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards. 

Nice to have: 

- Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm. 
 - Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest. 
 - Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems. 
 - Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions. 
 - Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions. 
 - Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems. 
 - Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

data.title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
data.description:
Job Description

Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is inviting applications from 2026 graduates and a limited number of 2025 graduates for our 2027 project expansion plans. 

We are looking for passionate, self-motivated individuals who aspire to build a successful career by gaining practical industry experience through real-time software development and business projects. 

Internship Opportunities Are Available In The Following Departments

- MERN Stack Development
 - Software Testing (Manual & Automation)
 - Executive Assistant
 - Product Design (UI/UX)
 - Human Resources (HR)
 - DevOps
 - IT Support

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career. 

Unlike conventional training programs, this is a real-time industry learning opportunity where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects. 

Who Should Apply?

This Internship Is Ideal For Candidates Who

- Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch. 
 - Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain. 
 - Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career. 
 - Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training. 
 - Want genuine industry exposure through real-time projects. 
 - Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement. 
 - Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance. 
 - Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments. 
 - Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development. 

This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary. 

Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance. 

Who Should Not Apply?

Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying. 

Candidates Should Not Apply If They

- Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry. 
 - Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship. 
 - Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity. 
 - Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate. 
 - Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage. 
 - Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation. 
 - Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance. 
 - Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills. 
 - Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance. 
 - Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization. 
 - Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment. 

Important

This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience. 

Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program. 

This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to: 

Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career

If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a Fresher employment opportunity, we encourage you to apply. 

Nature of the Internship

This internship follows a Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model. 

Candidates Will Be Expected To

- Learn independently with guidance from mentors. 
 - Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks. 
 - Work on real client and internal projects. 
 - Take ownership of assigned responsibilities. 
 - Continuously improve technical and professional skills. 
 - Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program. 
 - Accept feedback positively and implement improvements. 
 - Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship. 

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform. 

Selection Process

Stage 1 - Five-Day Assessment Program

Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a 5-working-day assessment. 

During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities. 

The Evaluation Includes

- Learning ability
 - Problem-solving approach
 - Discipline and punctuality
 - Sincerity and commitment
 - Professional ethics
 - Ownership and accountability
 - Communication skills
 - Adaptability
 - Consistency in task completion
 - Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions. 

Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility

The internship will be for 150 working days, divided into six blocks of 25 working days each. 

Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1-3 75 working days No stipend Block 4 25 working days ₹5, 000* Block 5 25 working days ₹5, 000* Block 6 25 working days ₹5, 000* Total 150 working days Up to ₹15, 000*

Stipend eligibility is directly connected to the candidate's performance and successful progression through the internship blocks. 

Candidates Who Successfully Progress To

Block 4 → ₹5, 000 stipend

Block 5 → ₹5, 000 stipend

Block 6 → ₹5, 000 stipend

will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block. 

The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment. 

Block-Wise Performance Assessment

At the end of every 25-working-day block, candidates will undergo a strict performance assessment. 

Each Assessment Will Evaluate

- Technical learning progress
 - Practical implementation skills
 - Quality of work
 - Discipline and attendance
 - Professional behaviour
 - Ownership of responsibilities
 - Ability to improve based on feedback
 - Team collaboration
 - Communication
 - Problem-solving ability
 - Commitment towards career development
 - Overall performance

Candidates who successfully clear the assessment will be allowed to continue to the next block. 

Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block. 

Performance-Based Continuation

Continuation in the internship is entirely based on performance. 

Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate

- Learning capability
 - Professional conduct
 - Improvement mindset
 - Discipline
 - Accountability
 - Positive attitude
 - Technical and practical improvement
 - Consistency
 - Commitment to excellence

will continue through the internship program. 

Candidates who fail to meet the expected standards at any stage may be discontinued from the internship without progressing to the next block. 

Completion of a particular number of days does not automatically qualify a candidate for the next block. Successful assessment is mandatory for progression. 

Employment Opportunity

Candidates who successfully complete all six internship blocks (150 working days) with strong, consistent, and proven performance will be considered for a Fresher employment opportunity with the organization. 

Candidates Who Demonstrate

- Strong learning capability
 - Consistent performance
 - Better assessment ratings
 - Technical and practical competency
 - Professional discipline
 - Ownership and accountability
 - Positive attitude
 - Adaptability
 - Ability to contribute effectively to the organization

may offered a Fresher role with a starting CTC of ₹1. 8 LPA, subject to the organization's final assessment, available positions, and business requirements. 

The employment opportunity is intended for candidates who successfully demonstrate strong performance and achieve the required assessment standards throughout the complete internship program. 

Terms & Conditions

By applying for this internship, candidates acknowledge and agree to the following: 

- Successful completion of the 5-working-day assessment is mandatory before joining the internship. 
 - The internship consists of six assessment blocks of 25 working days each, totaling 150 working days. 
 - The first three blocks, totaling 75 working days, are unpaid and no stipend will be provided during this period. 
 - Candidates must successfully clear the assessment of each block to continue to the subsequent block. 
 - Candidates who successfully progress to Blocks 4, 5, and 6 may be eligible for a stipend of ₹5, 000 per block, subject to satisfactory performance and successful completion of the respective block. 
 - The maximum stipend payable during the final three blocks is ₹15, 000. 
 - Stipend eligibility is performance-based and is not guaranteed merely by attendance or completion of the block. 
 - Candidates who fail to meet the required performance standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be permitted to proceed to the next block. 
 - Candidates are expected to possess strong self-learning capability, discipline, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude towards continuous improvement. 
 - Candidates should remain fully focused on learning, performing, and building their careers throughout the internship. 
 - Any form of indiscipline, groupism, misconduct, unethical behaviour, misuse of company resources, or activities that negatively impact the learning environment will not be tolerated and may result in immediate discontinuation from the internship. 
 - Candidates are expected to maintain complete confidentiality regarding company information, projects, clients, intellectual property, and internal processes. 
 - Performance evaluations conducted by the organization shall be final and binding. 
 - Completion of the internship does not automatically guarantee employment. 
 - Candidates who successfully complete all six blocks with strong and consistently demonstrated performance may be considered for a Fresher position with a starting CTC of ₹1. 8 LPA, subject to business requirements and available openings. 
 - Candidates who voluntarily discontinue the internship or whose internship is terminated due to unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or violation of company policies will not be eligible to receive an Internship Completion Certificate or Experience Certificate for the period served. 
 - Candidates seeking only a certificate, immediate stipend, or immediate salary should not apply for this program. 
 - Certification is not guaranteed merely based on joining or attending the internship. 
 - All decisions made by the organization regarding assessment results, continuation, discontinuation, stipend eligibility, certification, and employment shall be final. 

Ready to Build Your Career?

If You Are

- Self-motivated
 - Disciplined
 - Passionate about learning
 - Interested in the ERP domain
 - Willing to work hard
 - Willing to learn through practical experience
 - Ready to undergo strict performance assessments
 - Looking for genuine industry exposure
 - Committed to building a long-term career
 - Interested in proving yourself through performance

we encourage you to apply and begin your professional journey with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited. 

Learn. Perform. Improve. Prove Yourself. Build Your Career. 

Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Us. 

Important Information

Limited Vacancies

Please Note: Internship positions are limited. Applications will be processed on a first-come, first-preference basis, subject to eligibility and successful completion of the selection process. 

We encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible. 

Assessment & Internship Details

Location: Office-Based (On-Premises only)

Office Address: Chromepet, Chennai

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Office Hours: 9: 30 AM - 7: 30 PM

Attendance: Continuous participation throughout both the Assessment and Internship is mandatory. 

This internship is a full-time, office-based learning program. Candidates should ensure they can commit to the complete schedule before applying. 

How to Apply

If You Are Genuinely Interested In This Opportunity, Please Submit Your Application Along With Your Updated Resume And Provide Detailed Responses To The Following Questions

1️⃣ Why do you believe you are a suitable candidate for this internship?

Please explain your strengths, learning mindset, career aspirations, interest in the ERP domain, and why you feel you are the right fit for the selected role. 

2️⃣ Confirmation of Interest

Kindly confirm that you have carefully read the Internship Program details, Stipend Structure, Terms & Conditions, and Performance Assessment Process, and that you are interested in participating in the 5-Day Assessment Program followed by the internship, if selected. 

3️⃣ Availability Confirmation

Please confirm that you are able to attend both the Assessment Program and the Internship continuously as per the organization's office location, working days, and office timings. 

Important Notice

You may have come across this internship opportunity through various sources, including job portals, social media, WhatsApp groups, referrals, or other online platforms. 

Regardless of where you learned about this opportunity, we strongly recommend that every applicant visit our official website, carefully read the complete Internship Program details, Terms & Conditions, Stipend Structure, and Assessment Process, and submit the application only through the official application process. 

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited does not charge any registration fee, training fee, security deposit, placement fee, or any other payment for this Internship Program. 

If anyone claims to represent the company and requests money or any form of payment in exchange for internship selection or employment, please treat it as fraudulent. We request all applicants to remain vigilant and avoid such scams. 

Application Process

Due to the large number of applications we receive, we request all candidates to: 

- Submit their application through our official website. 
 - Please wait for a response from our Recruitment Team. You will be contacted only if your profile is shortlisted for the next stage of the process. 
 - Avoid submitting multiple applications for the same opportunity. 

Candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted by our HR team. 

For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a WhatsApp message to our official HR number after submitting your application through the website. 

Kindly do not make phone calls, as our recruitment team may not be able to answer individual application enquiries due to the high volume of applicants. 

We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, proving themselves through performance, and building a successful career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited. 

We are looking for individuals with the right attitude, discipline, integrity, willingness to learn, and commitment to prove themselves through performance. Skills can be developed; character and commitment define long-term success. 

HR Contact Details

Whatsapp: +91 7200082250

Email: hr@gwayit. com
