data.title: SW Test Development Engineer 1
data.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. 

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. 

Meet The Team

We're a collaborative and innovative software quality team focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of Dexcom's continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems. Our mission is to build quality into every stage of the development lifecycle through smart automation, rigorous testing, and a passion for improving lives. If you're eager to grow your skills while contributing to life-changing technology, this is the team for you. 

Where You Come In

- You participate in building quality into products by writing automated tests and performing ad hoc testing throughout the development cycle. 
 - You contribute to the development of software requirements and design specifications. 
 - You design, develop, execute, and maintain both automated and manual test scripts to validate Dexcom CGM software and systems. 
 - You create verification and validation test plans, traceability matrices, and test reports, and review them with relevant stakeholders. 
 - You record and track issues using the bug tracking system. 
 - You analyze test failures and collaborate with development teams to investigate root causes. 
 - You contribute to continuous improvement of the release process. 

What Makes You Successful

- You have 1-3 years of hands-on experience in software development or software test development using Python or other object-oriented programming languages. 
 - You have experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. 
 - You bring experience in automated test development for API testing. 
 - You have worked with a variety of automated testing frameworks, including Robot Framework. 
 - Your strong understanding of API testing, microservices, and distributed systems in cloud environments sets you apart. 
 - You have experience with automated UI testing. 
 - You are familiar with cloud platforms like Google Cloud or AWS. 
 - You have experience with containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - You may have experience in the medical device industry and familiarity with FDA design control processes (highly desired). 
 - Your knowledge of GCP tools like Airflow, Dataflow, and BigQuery is a plus. 
 - Experience with distributed event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus. 
 - Experience with performance testing is a plus. 
 - You bring CI/CD experience, especially with cloud-based technologies. 
 - You have five or more years of Agile development and test development experience. 
 - You collaborate effectively across functions to support testing, deployment, and reporting on product performance, quality, security, and stability. 
 - You are a self-starter who works well with minimal guidance and communicates clearly both verbally and in writing. 

What You'll Get

- A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community. 
 - A full and comprehensive benefits program. 
 - Growth opportunities on a global scale. 
 - Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. 
 - An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. 

Experience And Education

- Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 1-3 years of related experience. 

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. 

AI in Hiring Notice: We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people. 

At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional. 

Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom. com.

data.title: QA Engineer - Fresher
data.description:
Job Description

Job Description

QA Engineer - Fresher

Company: Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited

Department: Quality Assurance (QA)

Experience: Fresher

Employment Type: Full-Time

- Role Overview

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and enthusiastic QA Engineer - Fresher to join our ERP product development team. 

GwayERP is a business management platform designed to support complex business operations through integrated modules and workflows. As we continue to develop and deploy GwayERP and other enterprise applications to an increasing number of customers, maintaining application quality, reliability, accuracy, and consistency is essential. 

The selected candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, and the technical team to understand requirements, validate application functionality, identify defects, verify fixes, and ensure that new developments do not negatively affect existing functionality. 

This role provides an opportunity to learn and work on real-world enterprise applications, including ERP workflows, functional testing, API testing, database validation, regression testing, test documentation, and automation fundamentals. 

We are looking for someone who can think logically, investigate problems, understand business requirements, and identify issues before they reach customers. 

The objective is to ensure that every delivered feature works correctly, meets its requirements, and provides a reliable experience for the end user. 

You are not expected to know every testing tool or methodology from day one. However, you must have a strong willingness to learn, investigate unfamiliar problems, understand application behaviour, and continuously improve your testing skills. 

Our QA Philosophy: 

Understand the Requirement → Identify Test Scenarios → Execute Tests → Report Defects → Verify Fixes → Prevent Regression → Improve Quality

- Key Responsibilities
 - Requirement Understanding & Test Planning

Understand application requirements and translate them into practical test scenarios. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Read and understand functional requirements. 
 - Understand user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Clarify unclear requirements with the relevant team members. 
 - Identify positive and negative test scenarios. 
 - Identify boundary conditions and exceptional cases. 
 - Prepare test cases and checklists. 
 - Identify dependencies between different application features. 
 - Understand the expected results before executing tests. 
 - Maintain test documentation. 

The candidate should develop the ability to identify not only what should work, but also what could go wrong. 

- Manual Testing

Perform manual testing of GwayERP and other enterprise applications. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Functional testing. 
 - UI testing. 
 - Form validation testing. 
 - Input validation testing. 
 - Positive and negative testing. 
 - Boundary value testing. 
 - Exploratory testing. 
 - Integration testing. 
 - Smoke testing. 
 - Sanity testing. 
 - Basic compatibility testing. 
 - Error message validation. 
 - User workflow validation. 

The candidate should verify that the application behaves correctly under normal and exceptional conditions. 

Testing must cover both successful operations and scenarios where the application should reject invalid inputs or prevent incorrect actions. 

- ERP Functional Testing

Develop a practical understanding of ERP applications and business workflows. 

GwayERP Includes Business Functions Such As: 

- CRM
 - Sales
 - Procurement
 - Purchase
 - Inventory
 - Production and Manufacturing
 - Engineering
 - Quality
 - Finance
 - Services
 - HRMS
 - Reports
 - Data Services
 - Gate Management

The candidate will learn to validate workflows across relevant modules. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding how individual ERP modules operate. 
 - Validating business rules. 
 - Testing transaction workflows. 
 - Verifying master data and transaction data. 
 - Testing approval workflows. 
 - Validating role-based access. 
 - Checking calculations and totals. 
 - Testing status transitions. 
 - Verifying relationships between transactions. 
 - Testing relevant cross-module integrations. 
 - Identifying inconsistencies between expected and actual business behaviour. 

For example, when testing an inventory transaction, the candidate should verify not only whether the transaction saves successfully, but also whether the resulting stock quantity and related transaction details are correct. 

The expectation is to understand the business process behind the feature, not merely check whether a button works. 

- Test Case Preparation & Execution

Prepare clear, structured, and reusable test cases. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Writing test scenarios. 
 - Preparing step-by-step test cases. 
 - Defining expected results. 
 - Preparing test data. 
 - Executing test cases. 
 - Recording actual results. 
 - Documenting pass/fail status. 
 - Capturing screenshots or supporting evidence when necessary. 
 - Recording defects found during execution. 
 - Updating test cases when functionality changes. 

Test cases should be clear enough for another QA engineer to understand and execute. 

- Bug Identification & Defect Reporting

Identify application defects and communicate them clearly to the development team. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Reproducing reported issues. 
 - Identifying the steps required to reproduce a defect. 
 - Recording expected and actual results. 
 - Capturing screenshots, screen recordings, logs, or other relevant evidence. 
 - Recording the affected module and environment. 
 - Identifying the severity and business impact of defects. 
 - Reporting defects through the designated tracking system. 
 - Providing additional information when developers investigate issues. 
 - Retesting fixes. 
 - Confirming whether the reported issue has been resolved. 

A good defect report should help the developer understand the problem without unnecessary back-and-forth communication. 

The Candidate Should Learn The Difference Between: 

- Bug
 - Enhancement
 - Requirement clarification
 - Environment issue
 - Data issue
 - Expected application behaviour
 - Regression Testing

Regression testing is an important responsibility because ERP modules are interconnected. 

When new features or bug fixes are introduced, existing functionality must continue to work correctly. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Retesting affected functionality. 
 - Identifying related modules that may be impacted. 
 - Executing relevant existing test cases. 
 - Validating important business workflows. 
 - Checking for unintended side effects. 
 - Maintaining regression test cases. 
 - Supporting regression testing before releases. 

The candidate should learn to identify the potential impact of a code change and select appropriate tests to validate it. 

A new feature is not considered successful if it breaks an existing business workflow. 

- API Testing

Learn to validate REST APIs used by GwayERP and other applications. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding HTTP methods. 
 - Testing GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests as applicable. 
 - Understanding request headers and parameters. 
 - Validating request payloads. 
 - Checking response status codes. 
 - Validating response structures. 
 - Testing authentication and authorization. 
 - Testing invalid requests. 
 - Checking validation messages. 
 - Identifying API errors. 
 - Verifying API behaviour against requirements. 

Candidates should learn to use tools such as Postman or similar API testing utilities. 

The objective is to validate backend functionality independently of the user interface wherever possible. 

- Database Validation

Develop basic skills in validating application data. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding database records. 
 - Performing basic MongoDB queries. 
 - Validating data created through application transactions. 
 - Checking whether updates are reflected correctly. 
 - Identifying missing or duplicate records. 
 - Validating data relationships. 
 - Checking transaction consistency. 
 - Investigating data-related defects. 
 - Supporting developers during database-related troubleshooting. 

Basic knowledge of MongoDB is desirable, but candidates should be willing to learn it as part of the role. 

Database access must always follow established permissions and security procedures. Production data must not be modified during testing without explicit authorization. 

- UI & User Experience Testing

Validate the usability and consistency of application interfaces. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Checking page layouts. 
 - Testing forms and input fields. 
 - Validating dropdowns and selection controls. 
 - Checking buttons and navigation. 
 - Verifying error messages. 
 - Checking mandatory field indicators. 
 - Validating field-level restrictions. 
 - Testing tables, filters, sorting, and pagination. 
 - Checking responsive layouts where applicable. 
 - Identifying overlapping elements and display issues. 
 - Testing supported browsers. 
 - Reporting usability problems that may affect business users. 

The candidate should pay attention to small inconsistencies that could affect application usability. 

- Cross-Module & Integration Testing

ERP applications contain interconnected modules, so testing must cover dependencies between them. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding module dependencies. 
 - Testing relevant end-to-end workflows. 
 - Verifying that data moves correctly between modules. 
 - Validating integrated transactions. 
 - Checking API integrations. 
 - Identifying inconsistencies between modules. 
 - Testing failure scenarios in integrated workflows. 
 - Verifying that errors are handled appropriately. 

The candidate should learn to think beyond individual screens and validate the complete business process. 

- Release & Deployment Validation

Work with developers and the DevOps team to validate application releases. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding the changes included in a release. 
 - Reviewing relevant test cases. 
 - Performing smoke testing after deployment. 
 - Verifying important application functionality. 
 - Validating configuration-dependent behaviour. 
 - Checking for deployment-related issues. 
 - Reporting release-blocking defects. 
 - Retesting fixes in the appropriate environment. 
 - Recording testing results. 

The candidate should understand the difference between development, testing, staging, trial, and production environments. 

Production testing must follow approved procedures and must not compromise customer data or live business operations. 

- Test Data Management

Prepare and maintain suitable test data for different testing scenarios. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Creating test records in approved environments. 
 - Preparing valid and invalid inputs. 
 - Maintaining reusable test datasets. 
 - Testing boundary conditions. 
 - Testing duplicate entries. 
 - Testing missing mandatory fields. 
 - Testing large or unusual input values. 
 - Preparing scenarios for different user roles. 
 - Ensuring test data is appropriate for the environment. 

The candidate must follow data privacy and security requirements when handling customer information. 

- Performance & Reliability Testing Fundamentals

Learn the fundamentals of application performance and reliability testing. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Identifying slow application responses. 
 - Reporting long-running operations. 
 - Testing applications with representative data volumes where appropriate. 
 - Observing response times. 
 - Identifying obvious performance inconsistencies. 
 - Learning basic load and stress testing concepts. 
 - Using appropriate tools to investigate performance issues. 
 - Reporting reproducible performance problems. 

Familiarity with tools such as Apache JMeter or k6 will be an advantage. 

The candidate is not expected to be a performance testing specialist initially but should be willing to develop these skills as required. 

- AI-Assisted Testing

Using AI tools intelligently to improve testing productivity and coverage is an important expectation of this role. 

The candidate should learn to use AI tools to support: 

- Understanding requirements. 
 - Identifying missing test scenarios. 
 - Generating test case ideas. 
 - Preparing positive and negative test cases. 
 - Identifying edge cases. 
 - Creating test data. 
 - Analysing error messages. 
 - Improving defect reports. 
 - Generating API test scenarios. 
 - Preparing test documentation. 
 - Exploring regression testing opportunities. 
 - Assisting with test automation. 
 - Summarizing testing results. 

AI-generated test cases and analysis must be reviewed for accuracy and relevance before use. 

The candidate must not blindly trust AI-generated outputs or upload confidential source code, credentials, customer data, or sensitive business information to unauthorized AI tools. 

The objective is to use AI to improve testing accuracy, coverage, and speed without compromising data security. 

The expected approach is better testing in less time, not simply generating more test cases. 

- Test Automation Fundamentals

Develop an understanding of automated testing and gradually contribute to suitable automation activities. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Learning the fundamentals of test automation. 
 - Identifying repetitive test scenarios suitable for automation. 
 - Understanding automated test scripts. 
 - Learning basic scripting where required. 
 - Supporting API test automation. 
 - Learning UI automation tools. 
 - Maintaining automated tests under guidance. 
 - Investigating automation failures. 
 - Understanding the difference between functional defects and test script failures. 

Familiarity with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium will be an advantage. 

Prior automation experience is not mandatory for freshers, but a willingness to learn and practise is expected. 

- Documentation & Quality Reporting

Maintain accurate and useful QA documentation. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Preparing test plans where required. 
 - Maintaining test cases. 
 - Recording test execution results. 
 - Maintaining defect reports. 
 - Documenting regression scenarios. 
 - Recording retesting results. 
 - Preparing basic test summary reports. 
 - Maintaining evidence for important test cases. 
 - Updating documentation when requirements change. 
 - Communicating unresolved issues and testing risks. 

The objective is to ensure that testing activities are traceable, repeatable, and easy for the team to understand. 

- Working With Developers & Business Teams

Work closely with developers, business analysts, QA colleagues, and other relevant team members. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding requirements before testing. 
 - Clarifying expected application behaviour. 
 - Reporting defects with clear evidence. 
 - Discussing issues with developers. 
 - Retesting resolved defects. 
 - Participating in requirement discussions where appropriate. 
 - Providing feedback on testability and usability. 
 - Communicating testing progress. 
 - Identifying risks before a release. 
 - Supporting continuous improvement in application quality. 

The candidate should communicate issues professionally and focus on identifying and resolving problems rather than assigning blame. 

- Learning & Continuous Improvement

This position requires a strong self-learning mindset. 

The Candidate Is Expected To: 

- Learn testing methodologies. 
 - Understand software development fundamentals. 
 - Practise writing effective test cases. 
 - Learn API testing. 
 - Develop basic database testing skills. 
 - Understand ERP business workflows. 
 - Learn relevant testing tools. 
 - Explore AI-assisted testing. 
 - Learn automation fundamentals. 
 - Research unfamiliar issues. 
 - Improve defect reporting. 
 - Learn from feedback. 
 - Document useful findings. 
 - Continuously improve testing accuracy and efficiency. 

We value the ability to learn, investigate, and apply knowledge more than familiarity with a long list of testing tools. 

- Required Technical Skills

Testing Fundamentals

- Understanding of software testing concepts. 
 - Basic knowledge of functional testing. 
 - Understanding of positive and negative test cases. 
 - Basic knowledge of test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Understanding of defect reporting. 
 - Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle. 

API Testing

- Basic understanding of REST APIs. 
 - Familiarity with HTTP methods and status codes. 
 - Willingness to learn Postman or similar tools. 
 - Basic understanding of request and response validation. 

Database Testing

- Basic knowledge of databases. 
 - Understanding of data validation. 
 - Familiarity with MongoDB is an advantage. 
 - Willingness to learn basic database queries. 

Development & Technical Fundamentals

- Basic understanding of web applications. 
 - Familiarity with browsers and developer tools. 
 - Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with Git is desirable. 
 - Willingness to learn test automation. 

AI & Productivity Tools

- Willingness to use AI tools for test design and analysis. 
 - Ability to review AI-generated outputs critically. 
 - Awareness of data privacy and security when using AI. 
 - Good to Have

Familiarity with any of the following will be an advantage: 

- Postman
 - Playwright
 - Cypress
 - Selenium
 - Apache JMeter
 - k6
 - MongoDB
 - Git/GitHub
 - Jira or similar issue-tracking tools
 - Test case management tools
 - Basic SQL
 - JavaScript or TypeScript
 - API automation
 - UI automation
 - AI-assisted testing tools
 - ERP or business management applications

Candidates are not expected to know every tool listed above. 

- Eligibility & Experience

Required

- Fresh graduates or candidates with knowledge in software testing, QA. 
 - Basic understanding of software applications. 
 - Logical and analytical thinking. 
 - Good attention to detail. 
 - Ability to follow structured testing procedures. 
 - Clear written communication. 
 - Willingness to learn testing tools and methodologies. 
 - Interest in understanding business applications. 
 - Ability to investigate problems systematically. 

Preferred Educational Background

- Computer Science. 
 - Information Technology. 
 - Software Engineering. 
 - Computer Applications. 
 - Other relevant technical disciplines. 

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they demonstrate suitable analytical ability and a genuine interest in software quality assurance. 

Academic projects, internships, testing assignments, and practical exposure to software applications will be considered. 

- What We Expect From You

You are not expected to know every testing tool when you join. 

However, We Expect You To: 

- Read requirements carefully. 
 - Think logically about possible failures. 
 - Test beyond the obvious scenarios. 
 - Document defects clearly. 
 - Verify fixes before closing defects. 
 - Communicate issues early. 
 - Take responsibility for assigned testing activities. 
 - Learn unfamiliar application workflows. 
 - Understand the business impact of defects. 
 - Use AI tools responsibly. 
 - Improve your testing skills continuously. 
 - Work collaboratively with developers and other team members. 
 - Maintain confidentiality when handling application and customer data. 

A good QA engineer should be curious about how things work and equally curious about how they might fail. 

- Growth Opportunity

This role is designed for a fresher who wants to build a career in software quality assurance and enterprise application testing. 

The Candidate Will Gain Practical Exposure To: 

- Manual testing. 
 - Functional testing. 
 - ERP workflow testing. 
 - API testing. 
 - Database validation. 
 - Regression testing. 
 - Integration testing. 
 - Release validation. 
 - Test documentation. 
 - AI-assisted testing. 
 - Test automation. 
 - Performance testing fundamentals. 
 - Production issue investigation. 

As technical capability improves, the candidate will have opportunities to handle more complex testing scenarios and contribute to test automation and quality improvement initiatives. 

Potential Career Progression: 

QA Engineer → QA Engineer (Experienced) → Senior QA Engineer → QA Automation Engineer / QA Specialist → QA Lead

Progression will depend on demonstrated skills, performance, and readiness for greater responsibility. 

- Performance Expectations

The Candidate's Performance Will Be Evaluated Based On: 

- Accuracy of test execution. 
 - Quality of test cases. 
 - Ability to identify meaningful defects. 
 - Clarity of defect reports. 
 - Understanding of ERP workflows. 
 - Effectiveness of regression testing. 
 - Quality of retesting. 
 - Testing coverage of assigned requirements. 
 - Ability to identify edge cases. 
 - Timely completion of assigned testing activities. 
 - Appropriate use of AI-assisted testing. 
 - Reduction in avoidable testing omissions. 
 - Improvement in technical knowledge. 
 - Collaboration with developers and business teams. 
 - Consistency in following QA procedures. 

The objective is to develop a dependable QA professional who can identify defects early, validate business requirements accurately, and help prevent issues from reaching customers. 

Quality is not measured by the number of bugs reported alone, but by the ability to identify meaningful risks and help deliver reliable software. 

- The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and interested in understanding how software behaves in real-world business situations. 

You should be willing to explore an application, understand its workflows, investigate unexpected results, prepare meaningful test cases, and communicate defects clearly. 

You do not need to be an expert on your first day. 

However, you should be willing to learn testing methodologies, understand ERP business processes, develop technical skills, use AI tools intelligently, and continuously improve your ability to identify issues. 

We Are Looking For Someone Who Thinks: 

"My responsibility is not just to check whether the application works. It is to understand whether it works correctly, whether the business requirement is satisfied, and what could go wrong. "

If you are passionate about software quality, problem-solving, learning new technologies, and building reliable enterprise applications, we would like to hear from you. 

- How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their applications through the official recruitment website. 

For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a WhatsApp message to our official HR number after submitting your application through the website. 

Kindly do not make phone calls, as our recruitment team may not be able to answer individual application enquiries due to the high volume of applicants. 

We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, and building a successful career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited. 

HR Contact Details

WhatsApp: +91 7200082250

Email: hr@gwayit. com

data.title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
data.description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets - safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights. 

Overview

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities. 
Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation. 

  
Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities
Strategic Focus

- Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities. 
 - Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features. 
 - Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management. 
 - Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare. 
 - Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation. 
 - Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns. 
 - Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms. 
 - Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance. 
 - Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose. 
 - Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues. 
 - Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues. 
 - Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases. 
 - Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption. 
Operational Management

- Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues. 
 - Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions. 
 - Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk. 
 - Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation. 
 - Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria. 

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership  
   

- Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners. 
 - Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors. 
 - Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits. 
 - Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams. 
Governance, Security and Risk

- Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements. 
 - Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners. 
 - Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance. 
 - Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options. 
 - Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer. 
The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs. 

  
Experience & Personal Attributes

- Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation. 
 - Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous. 
 - Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI. 
 - Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support. 
 - Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes. 
 - Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous. 
 - Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation. 
 - Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review. 
 - Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical teams and vendors, set quality expectations and deliver through influence in a matrix environment. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including structured diagnosis of complex integration, data, security and configuration issues. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical options, trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong planning, prioritisation and delivery discipline, with the ability to manage concurrent initiatives and production priorities. 
 - High standards of integrity, discretion and care when handling employee and organisational data.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Infrastructure Security
data.description:
About the team

The Platform & Infrastructure Engineering team owns the foundational estate that everything else runs on. The team designs, builds, automates, and operates scalable cloud-native systems across networks, security, data & storage, and compute. It carries significant regulatory and operational responsibility, with its platforms directly underpinning critical customer-facing systems such as payments and banking, so security and availability are not optional. 

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Infrastructure Security at slice. You will own charters like cloud security, network security, and software supply chain security and build a team that makes the secure path the default path for every engineer. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the architecture, hire and grow the team, and be accountable for measurable, auditable security outcomes across our cloud and hybrid estate. 

What You will do

- Lead, hire and scale the Infrastructure Security team, setting goals, mentoring engineers, and developing technical leaders. 
 - Own the cloud and hybrid network security architecture and roadmap, balancing security, reliability, scalability, velocity and cost. 
 - Establish secure-by-design principles, guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts, organizations and future cloud regions. 
 - Drive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform automation to ensure security controls are version-controlled, tested, repeatable and consistently enforced. 
 - Own IAM, SSO/Identity Center, PAM, least-privilege access, just-in-time access and secrets management. 
 - Enforce encryption, KMS/HSM key management, certificate lifecycle management and data protection standards. 
 - Secure Kubernetes (EKS), compute workloads and container images through hardening, runtime protection and automated patching. 
 - Design secure network architecture, including VPC segmentation, hybrid connectivity, egress controls, firewalls, DNS security, IDS/IPS, and zero-trust access. 
 - Protect internet-facing services and APIs using DDoS mitigation, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and API security controls. 
 - Harden CI/CD pipelines and implement DevSecOps practices, including short-lived credentials (OIDC), SCA, image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and provenance. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and admission controls to prevent misconfigured infrastructure and untrusted or vulnerable artifacts from reaching production. 
 - Govern open-source and third-party dependencies through vulnerability management, license compliance, and remediation of SLAs. 
 - Establish security metrics for control coverage, policy violations, exposure and remediation timelines; continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations and security drifts. 
 - Partner with Cybersecurity, AppSec, GRC and SOC teams to address security and compliance gaps and support audits. 
 - Lead infrastructure security incident responses, including DDoS attacks and cloud misconfigurations, and drive blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Strengthen resilience through availability planning, disaster recovery, capacity management, incident readiness, and recovery exercises for critical infrastructure. 

What You will need

- 9+ years in infrastructure, cloud or security engineering, including 2+ years managing and building high-performing teams. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise in AWS/GCP/Azure security (IAM, Organizations/SCPs, KMS, Security Hub, Guard Duty or equivalents) and cloud security architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of IAM, SSO, PAM, secrets management, encryption and key management. 
 - Deep expertise in cloud and data-center networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection and IDS/IPS. 
 - Practical experience with CI/CD hardening, SCA and image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and policy enforcement. 
 - Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (e. g. , Terraform) and experience building guardrails at scale. 
 - Solid grounding in observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience designing infrastructure for high-scale, highly available environments. 
 - Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments. 
 - Experience with RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, CERT-In guidelines, PCI DSS or NPCI audits. 
 - Depth in admission controllers, policy engines and runtime security tools. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CCSP, CISSP or CKS. 
 - Contributions to security tooling, open source or the wider security community. 

Life at slice

Life so good, you'd think we're kidding: 

- Competitive salaries. Period. 
 - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We'll love you and take care of you, our promise. 
 - Flexible working hours. Just don't call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. 
 - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. 
 - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. 
 - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. 
 - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you'll forget the term "colleagues can't be your friends".

data.title: AI Test Architect
data.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people's lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively. 

We're looking for an AI Test Architect to define, implement, and scale the next generation of quality engineering powered by AI. You will own the test architecture strategy end-to-end-combining LLM-driven automation, computer vision, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems-to deliver robust, scalable, and privacy-first testing for mobile applications and hardware-integrated products. 

This is a senior, hands-on architecture role: you'll set the strategy, establish standards, lead technical decision-making, and build reusable platforms and frameworks while mentoring teams across QA, Dev, and DevOps. 

What You'll Do

- AI Test Strategy & Architecture
 - Define and maintain the enterprise test architecture, roadmap, and standards spanning functional, non-functional, integration, mobile, and HIL layers. 
 - Drive a shift-left and automation-first culture; architect frameworks that are modular, resilient, and easy to evolve. 
 - Establish test design principles, risk-based testing approaches, and coverage models aligned with business goals and compliance requirements. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and decision forums; evaluate build vs. buy for AI tooling and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Test Innovation (LLMs, RAG, CV/OCR)
 - Architect and implement RAG-based test generation using local LLMs (e. g. , Ollama, llama. cpp) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to reason over requirements, app states, and logs. 
 - Build AI agents that can: interpret acceptance criteria, propose and prioritize test scenarios, and auto-generate test cases/scripts. 
 - Develop computer-vision and OCR pipelines (OpenCV, Tesseract, or equivalent) for precise UI validation, visual diffing, and visual regression analysis. 
 - Design models for UI anomaly detection, flakiness prediction, and self-healing locators beyond traditional Appium-style selectors. 
 - Automate localization testing for text, layout, and formatting across languages and screen sizes using AI. 
 - Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Mobile Systems
 - Define and evolve a Python-based HIL framework for end-to-end validation of Mobile/Desktop/WebApp interacting with hardware (e. g. , medical devices, sensors, wearables). 
 - Architect communication interfaces (USB, Bluetooth, Serial) and test harnesses to control/observe device interactions reliably at scale. 
 - Incorporate AI-driven adapters that learn device behaviors, detect drift, and improve robustness of HIL scenarios over time. 
 - Partner with mobile teams (Android/iOS) to integrate Appium/Espresso/XCUITest/FlaUI where appropriate and augment with AI components. 
 - On-Prem Infrastructure & MLOps for Test at Scale
 - Design on-prem/private-cloud inference infrastructure for low-latency, high-throughput model execution with strong data privacy guarantees. 
 - Containerize models and agents (Docker) and integrate into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for parallel execution and test-on-commit workflows. 
 - Implement continuous learning loops to leverage test failures, telemetry, and labels to retrain and improve models. 
 - Establish model lifecycle practices (versioning, evaluation, rollback, governance) using tools like MLflow/Langchain, self-hosted vector stores, and caching. 
 - Automation Platforms & Tooling
 - Extend or replace traditional frameworks (e. g. , Appium) with AI-assisted components that enhance stability and coverage. 
 - Build Python-based toolchains for model training/inference and integrations into test workflows; standardize reusable libraries and templates. 
 - Define reference architectures for UI, API, performance, security, and resilience testing; ensure seamless observability, logging, and triage workflows. 
 - Quality Governance, Metrics & Risk
 - Define quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and release readiness bars; ensure compliance and privacy-by-design. 
 - Track and publish leading indicators and outcome metrics-defect escape rate, test yield, visual regression detection rate, flakiness, mean-time-to-detect/triage, inference latency, infra utilization. 
 - Conduct root cause analyses and drive systemic fixes across tooling, test design, and pipelines. 
 - Audit processes for adherence to standards; champion continuous improvement. 
 - Technical Leadership & Enablement
 - Mentor QA engineers and SDETs on AI/ML testing, HIL, and architectural best practices. 
 - Facilitate collaboration across QA, Development, Data/ML, Security, and DevOps. 
 - Curate internal playbooks, patterns, sample repos, and training content to scale adoption. 

What You Bring

Must-Have

- 10+ years in Quality Engineering / Software Development, with 5+ years in test architecture / QA leadership. 
 - Strong Python expertise and hands-on experience with AI/ML in testing contexts. 
 - Proven experience training or fine-tuning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face. 
 - Solid background in Computer Vision (OpenCV) and OCR for UI/visual validation. 
 - Track record building automation frameworks for mobile and/or device-integrated systems, and clear understanding of limitations of traditional tools (e. g. , Appium). 
 - Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and deploying AI models into test or production environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define strategy, set standards, and lead cross-functional technical initiatives. 

Highly Desirable

- Hands-on with local LLMs (Ollama, llama. cpp) and RAG using LangChain/LlamaIndex. 
 - Prior experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) or Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing. 
 - Familiarity with Android/iOS ecosystems and tooling (ADB, Xcode, Fastlane, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox). 
 - Observability and analytics (e. g. , Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for test health and triage. 
 - Experience in regulated environments (e. g. , medical devices) and familiarity with risk management and compliance (e. g. , ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 14971, HIPAA/GDPR) is a plus. 

Soft Skills

- Strategic thinker with a builder's mindset and strong systems design instincts. 
 - Excellent communicator who simplifies complex concepts and aligns stakeholders. 
 - Strong ownership, bias for action, and comfort navigating ambiguity. 
 - Passion for mentoring and uplifting engineering excellence across teams. 

Success Metrics (Examples)

- >40% reduction in flaky test failures and >30% faster triage through AI triage/visual diffing. 
 - >25% increase in critical defect detection pre-release (vs. prior baseline). 
 - P95 AI inference latency within target SLA for CI pipelines. 
 - Adoption of standardized AI-assisted frameworks across X product teams within Y quarters. 
 - Documented compliance with privacy and model governance standards. 

Tech Stack (Indicative)

- Languages/Frameworks: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, LangChain/LlamaIndex
 - LLMs/Inference: Ollama, llama. cpp, local vector DBs (FAISS/Chroma), Triton Inference Server (optional)
 - Mobile & Automation: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, FlaUI, and Azure DevOps
 - HIL/Protocols: USB, Bluetooth, Serial; vendor SDKs; Python-based device controllers
 - CI/CD & Infra: Azure DevOps, self hosted Ubuntu / MacOS instances
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

Personal competencies

- Strong leadership and coordination skills. 
 - Excellent communication skills in professional written and spoken English. 
 - Detail-oriented with a structured and analytical approach. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively across global teams. 
 - Proactive mindset with a focus on quality and compliance. 

Who we are

At WS Audiology, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services. 

Together with our 12, 000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world. 

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes. 

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you. 

WS Audiology is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Browse and Discovery Platform
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. As we strive to influence the future of television globally, including TV advertising, the ongoing success depends heavily on our investment in the Content Management System. With Roku providing millions of movies, episodes, news, and channels, the Content Management System plays a vital role in managing content ingestion, selection, enrichment, and curation. We are seeking engineers capable of developing, designing, and deploying highly scalable, dependable applications, tools, and automation frameworks essential for efficiently handling the vast volume of content in our pipeline. 

  

What is the role?As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering on the Browse and Discovery Platform team, you will own engineering for featured experiences and lead key components of the browse platform. You will lead and grow a team of backend engineers building the services and APIs that connect content, product capabilities, and user experiences across Roku devices. This role requires strong technical leadership in distributed systems, cloud services, and backend architecture, paired with the ability to translate evolving product requirements into reliable, scalable solutions. You will define technical direction, guide architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver new experiences from concept through launch. The successful candidate will balance product delivery with long-term platform development while developing engineers and promoting a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and accountability. 

  

How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain - coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  

What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Lead and manage a team of backend engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to foster professional growth and development
 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery of featured experiences and key browse platform services, from design and implementation through launch and ongoing operation
 - Architect and evolve highly available, distributed services and APIs that support content discovery and engaging user experiences at scale
 - Build reusable capabilities for configuring, publishing, scheduling, and delivering featured experiences across Roku devices
 - Collaborate with product management, design, client engineering, and content teams to define requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver new capabilities
 - Drive improvements in service reliability, performance, observability, and operational efficiency while enabling experimentation and rapid product iteration
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes to ensure high-quality software delivery
 - Conduct performance evaluations, set clear objectives, and provide mentorship to foster professional growth and development across the team
 - Work closely with senior leadership to align engineering efforts with overall business objectives and timelines  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 10+ years of software development experience with deep technical expertise in building high-availability, large-scale distributed systems and services
 - 5+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing engineering teams and driving software development projects from conception to delivery
 - Proven track record of building and managing high-performing engineering teams
 - Strong proficiency in Java or a similar backend programming language, with experience designing and developing APIs and cloud-based services
 - Deep understanding of backend technologies, architecture patterns, and best practices, including microservices, RESTful APIs, message queues, caching, and databases
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
 - Experience operating production services at scale, including performance optimization, observability, and incident response
 - Strong ability to make practical trade-offs and drive programs with autonomy
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
 What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

data.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve Walmart's next-generation International Pricing platforms. 

The International Pricing team enables Walmart's mission of Every Day Low Price (EDLP). At its core, the team is responsible for the systems that help set, manage, approve, and execute prices for first-party items across Walmart's international markets. 

The platforms you build will support multiple countries, each representing a multi-billion-dollar business. You will solve complex engineering and business problems involving large-scale data processing, pricing recommendations, rules and workflows, downstream price execution, resiliency, auditability, and market-specific requirements. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write production-quality code, lead architecture and design, review critical technical decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. 

About The Team

Walmart International Technology enables our stores, eCommerce operations, associates, and customers across markets outside the United States. 

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets. 

What You'll Do

Remain hands-on and contribute production-quality code for critical platform capabilities, complex integrations, and technically challenging initiatives. 

Define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for International Pricing platforms. 

Write high-quality design documents, including HLDs, LLDs, Architecture Decision Records, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams, and operational readiness plans. 

Review architecture and technical designs produced by engineering teams and ensure alignment with platform standards, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 

Design and build scalable, high-throughput, and low-latency Java- or Kotlin-based microservices deployed on cloud infrastructure. 

Build extensible pricing capabilities using domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, Kafka, API-first principles, and well-defined service boundaries. 

Design solutions for pricing recommendations, rule evaluation, approvals, simulations, publishing, execution, auditability, and downstream-system integration. 

Own data-modelling and persistence strategies across relational, NoSQL, and analytical data stores, with a strong focus on data accuracy, lineage, consistency, and traceability. 

Design resilient distributed workflows using appropriate patterns such as orchestration, outbox, retries, circuit breaking, idempotency, and dead-letter processing. 

Define REST and gRPC APIs with clear contracts, backward-compatibility guarantees, versioning strategies, and consumer-driven contract testing. 

Design for multi-market and multi-tenant use cases while balancing global platform consistency with market-specific business requirements. 

Identify and proactively address systemic risks, including scaling bottlenecks, single points of failure, data-integrity gaps, operational dependencies, and technical-debt accumulation. 

Drive architecture and integration alignment with shared platforms and downstream systems responsible for price calculation, price publishing, execution, catalogue, analytics, and store operations. 

Represent International Pricing in cross-organizational architecture and engineering forums. 

Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security validation, canary deployment, rollback, and production verification. 

Drive observability-first engineering through structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, actionable alerts, and business-flow monitoring. 

Ensure that services comply with enterprise security, privacy, infrastructure, and software-development standards. 

Lead production-readiness reviews, incident investigations, root-cause analyses, and reliability-improvement initiatives. 

Mentor junior, mid-level, and senior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, pairing, and structured feedback. 

Establish engineering standards for design quality, code quality, automated testing, performance, security, release readiness, and operational excellence. 

Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Business, Program, Quality Engineering, and other platform teams to translate complex pricing requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

Promote a platform-first mindset by creating reusable and configurable capabilities that enable multiple markets and engineering teams without duplicating solutions. 

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value. 

Make sound technical decisions and solve complex problems efficiently in a high-impact, fast-moving environment. 

What You'll Bring

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems. 

Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed-system fundamentals, design patterns, and software-engineering principles. 

Strong experience with Kafka or similar messaging platforms and asynchronous processing patterns. 

Experience designing and operating systems using relational and NoSQL databases. 

Advanced experience with cloud infrastructure such as Azure, GCP, or AWS. 

Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, service-to-service communication, autoscaling, resource management, and cloud-native deployment patterns. 

Experience designing systems that process large data volumes while maintaining strong consistency, traceability, performance, and availability. 

Demonstrated ability to author clear technical designs and influence architecture across multiple teams. 

Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, messaging, and data layers. 

Experience driving engineering excellence through automated testing, performance optimization, reliability improvements, operational readiness, and incident prevention. 

Experience integrating machine-learning inference APIs or model endpoints into production services. 

Familiarity with GenAI-assisted engineering tools and their responsible use across software-development workflows. 

Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus-building skills. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and raise the technical capabilities of the broader team. 

Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term platform architecture and sustainability. 

Experience building or operating large-scale retail, eCommerce, pricing, promotion, markdown, or revenue-management platforms. 

Understanding of retail pricing concepts such as EDLP, competitive pricing, price rules, simulations, approvals, price execution, regional pricing, and markdown optimization. 

Experience building multi-tenant or multi-market platforms with shared global capabilities and configurable market-specific behaviour. 

Experience integrating with complex upstream and downstream enterprise systems. 

A continuous drive to simplify, automate, improve, and optimize platforms, tools, development workflows, and operational processes. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Job Description

We are looking for a Staff SDE - IBM OMS Sterling who will serve as a technical leader, driving architectural direction, multi-team initiatives, and the development of highly scalable distributed systems. You will partner with Product, Architecture, DevOps and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver impactful technology solutions across a complex digital ecosystem. 

You will independently define and deliver large-scale, multi-phase projects, mentor engineers, and shape technical strategy. The role also includes leveraging LLMs and GenAI-driven tools to enhance engineering productivity, reduce cycle time, and build the next generation of internal developer experience tools. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Drive technical strategy and architecture for complex distributed systems and core platform components. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact, multi-team engineering initiatives. 
 - Translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, pragmatic technical solutions. 
 - Define technical roadmaps, sequence projects into phases, and ensure timely execution across teams. Software Engineering & System Design

- Architect, develop, and optimize microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud.

- Champion adoption of AI-assisted development practices and LLM/GenAI tools across engineering teams to enhance workflows, improve cycle time, and automate routine tasks. 
 - Define clear guidelines, training, and standards for effective and secure use of AI tools, including prompt engineering, code generation, and review expectations. 
 - Integrate AI-driven capabilities such as code generation, unit test creation, log analysis, documentation summarization, and code review assistance into the development workflow. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices for AI-generated code, including human-in-the-loop reviews, coding standards, test automation, secure coding, and design-first development. 
 - Measure and optimize engineering productivity using AI-related metrics (cycle time, PR throughput, AI-code adoption, defect escape rate, developer satisfaction) and continuously identify opportunities to reduce bottlenecks with AI. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Impact

- Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, QE, DevOps, and peer engineering teams. 
 - Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate across teams to resolve dependencies and align on architectural standards. 
 - Influence technical direction beyond your immediate team. Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Mentor engineers across multiple teams, guiding them in design, coding, debugging, and best practices. 
 - Participate actively in hiring and talent development. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design critiques, and technical leadership. 
 - Help define and uphold engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural principles. Ownership & Operational Excellence

- Take full ownership of systems from development to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
 - Ensure engineering deliverables meet performance, reliability, and security criteria. 
 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and propose scalable, maintainable solutions. 
 - Lead incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Skills and Qualifications

Must-Have - IBM Sterling OMS

- 10+ years of professional experience in IBM OMS Sterling Development. 
 - Hands-on experience with IBM Sterling OMS on-premises - order lifecycle management, distributed order management (DOM), and fulfilment workflows. 
 - Proficiency in Sterling customization: Java extensions via YFS/SMCFS APIs, pipeline configuration (condition trees, transaction pipelines), agent framework, and service framework. 
 - Deep understanding of Sterling Agent Server architecture: master/child agent processes, agent criteria, job thresholds, and concurrency impact on database performance. 
 - Ability to diagnose Sterling on-premises JVM issues: heap sizing, GC tuning (G1/ZGC), root cause analysis, and thread dump/heap dump interpretation. 
 - Experience with IBM Sterling Configuration Deployment Tool (CDT) and environment promotion governance across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Experience with IBM Inventory Visibility (IV): supply, demand class modelling, net availability calculation, and OMS-IV integration. 
 - Understanding of inventory supply and demand mapping: how WMS feeds populate IV supply and how OMS order reservations reduce net availability. 
 - Experience implementing REST-based inventory reservation flows from e-commerce platforms through OMS into IBM IV - including idempotency, retry, rollback, and reservation release on cancellation. 
 - Ability to articulate the end-to-end customer order journey and every OMS/IV touch point - from PDP availability check through order creation, fulfilment, and returns. Assessed in interview. 
 - Delivered at least two IBM Sterling OMS implementations or major platform transformations; able to articulate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and lessons learned from each. 
 - Proven experience shipping scalable, high-availability, high-performance systems, including load handling, horizontal scaling, observability, and fault-tolerant design. 
 - Experience with WAS Application, JMS, distributed system patterns, caching, asynchronous processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of working with databases: Oracle
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, debugging capabilities, and system-level thinking. 
 - Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. 
 - Ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive technical initiatives. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience applying LLMs/GenAI to improve engineering productivity and developer workflows. 
 - Prompt engineering experience and familiarity with integrating models into applications. 
 - Experience with Domain-Driven Design, event-driven systems, CQRS, or enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Familiarity with Linux systems and container-based deployment architectures.

Personal Attributes
