data.title: Full-Stack Flutter Developer -
data.description:
About Cladbe

India sold over ₹6 lakh crore of new homes in its top seven cities, and much of it still runs on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and tools never built for real estate. Cladbe is building the operating system a real-estate developer runs the whole business on: every enquiry, site visit, booking, payment schedule and handover in one place. It connects to property. new, our marketplace built to show buyers every RERA-registered project in a city, checked and current. 

We're building toward commercial launch and hiring a Full-Stack Flutter Developer to join our core engineering team and build features end to end, from the screen to the API behind it. 

Where you'll work: for the first few months, the core team builds together in Bareilly. After that, the whole team moves to Noida, where the role is based. 

What you'll do

- Build our platform in Flutter across web and mobile, from first screen to release. 
 - Turn complex real-estate workflows into screens that are fast and simple to use, on a desktop in a sales office or a phone at a site. 
 - Write the backend your features need: Node. js and TypeScript services and the APIs behind them. 
 - Model data in PostgreSQL that stays correct when many people work on the same records at once. 
 - Keep every screen in step with live data, and keep the app usable on a weak connection: cached data, queued actions, and a clear sign when something is still syncing. 
 - Own quality end to end: performance, releases and tests. 

The stack

- Flutter and Dart, for web and mobile
 - Node. js and TypeScript, on PostgreSQL

Must have

- Flutter and Dart in production, including Flutter Web
 - State management with Riverpod or BLoC
 - Node. js and TypeScript: you've built APIs, not just called them
 - PostgreSQL: schema design, transactions and indexing
 - Real-time sync and offline-first patterns in Flutter: local cache, queued writes and resolving conflicts when they sync
 - Profiling and fixing performance issues on web and mobile

Nice to have

- Event-driven systems (message queues, event buses)
 - Apps shipped to the Play Store or App Store
 - B2B SaaS or real-estate products

Why join us

Join early enough that your decisions shape the platform behind a new way India's homes are marketed and sold. Dense workflows made simple, live data that has to be right, and a product built to be used every day by people who sell homes for a living. You'll work in a small team, close to the founder, where what you build ships. 

If that sounds like your kind of work, apply.

Job Description

This is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g. , Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2. 4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e. , electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!

Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world's leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. This is a Principal position within the  Platform Engineering organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated Platform Engineering hat, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience. 

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure

Infrastructure Automation & IaC

- Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane).

Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience

- Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics. 

- Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths. 

- Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants.

Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default

- Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies. 

- Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity.

Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager based in India. 

Take a leading role in building next-generation agentic AI systems from the ground up, shaping the architecture and engineering practices behind autonomous, multi-step AI workflows. You will lead a team of 10-15 engineers working across large language models, agent orchestration, tool integration, and production infrastructure. This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands-on engineering involvement, from architectural decisions to code reviews and delivery oversight. You will help introduce an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), transforming how engineering teams design, build, test, and deploy software. You will also establish robust evaluation, observability, reliability, and safety frameworks for AI systems operating in dynamic environments. Working closely with product leaders and senior stakeholders, you will turn ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions while developing a high-performing engineering team. 

Accountabilities

- Engineering Leadership and Team Development: Lead, manage, and grow a team of 10-15 AI and Forward Deployed Engineers responsible for developing agentic AI platforms, orchestration systems, tool-use frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Drive recruitment, mentoring, performance management, and career development. 
 - Technical Strategy and Architecture: Define the technical direction for autonomous AI systems, including planning loops, memory management, tool calling, multi-agent coordination, orchestration frameworks, and appropriate safety guardrails. 
 - Agentic AI Platform Development: Oversee the design and implementation of greenfield AI systems that support autonomous, multi-step workflows, enabling agents to plan, interact with tools, and execute tasks with minimal human intervention. 
 - AI-Driven Development Lifecycle: Lead the implementation of an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), introducing AI-enabled engineering practices intended to transform traditional software development and product delivery workflows across the organization. 
 - Observability and Evaluation: Establish comprehensive monitoring, tracing, and evaluation strategies for non-deterministic AI systems. Develop evaluation harnesses and mechanisms to detect performance regressions, behavioral drift, and reliability issues. 
 - Reliability, Security, and Safety: Define engineering standards for autonomous systems, including sandboxing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, rollback strategies, and continuous evaluation to ensure safe and reliable production operations. 
 - Product Collaboration and Delivery: Partner with product managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex, ambiguous requirements into actionable technical plans and deliverable AI-powered features. 
 - Hands-On Technical Guidance: Remain actively involved in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical problem-solving, and implementation decisions while balancing strategic responsibilities with people management. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure and Orchestration: Guide the development and deployment of agentic AI solutions using AWS services, including Bedrock AgentCore and Step Functions, along with supporting orchestration and hosting technologies. 
 - Planning and Performance Management: Develop engineering estimates, monitor delivery velocity and system performance, identify technical risks, and communicate progress, trade-offs, and priorities to senior leadership. 

Requirements

- Professional Experience: At least 12 years of software engineering experience, including a minimum of five years managing engineering teams and delivering complex technical initiatives. 
 - Agentic AI and LLM Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience building or operating LLM-powered systems, including AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom implementations. 
 - AI-Driven Development Lifecycle: Proven experience implementing an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) that has successfully replaced or substantially transformed traditional product and software development lifecycle practices within an engineering organization. 
 - AWS and Cloud Architecture: Excellent knowledge of AWS, particularly Bedrock AgentCore, Step Functions and Amazon States Language (ASL), as well as related services for agent hosting, workflow orchestration, and production deployment. 
 - Harness Engineering: Strong experience with harness engineering practices for building, testing, evaluating, and operating AI-powered systems. 
 - Observability and Evaluation Frameworks: Extensive knowledge of monitoring and tracing non-deterministic systems, building evaluation harnesses, and implementing drift detection, regression testing, and performance monitoring. 
 - Backend Development: Practical experience developing backend services with Python and FastAPI, with the ability to guide implementation decisions and maintain high engineering standards. 
 - Frontend Technologies: Working knowledge of React, Tailwind CSS, and Solstice, the JLL design system, to support collaboration across the application stack. 
 - Technical Architecture and Delivery: Proven ability to design scalable systems, make sound architectural trade-offs, and deliver complex products in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements and real-world constraints. 
 - People Leadership: Strong experience coaching engineers, developing technical talent, establishing engineering standards, and building collaborative, high-performing teams. 
 - Communication and Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. 
 - Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Ability to translate business priorities into technical strategy, estimate engineering effort, manage delivery risks, and balance innovation with reliability and operational needs. 

Benefits

- Collaborative Culture: Work alongside experienced technology professionals in an open, supportive environment that encourages knowledge sharing and teamwork. 
 - High-Impact Projects: Lead innovative engineering initiatives involving agentic AI, LLM orchestration, autonomous workflows, and advanced production infrastructure. 
 - Remote Work: Benefit from a remote working arrangement in India. 
 - Professional Development: Access internal meetups, conferences, workshops, and other learning opportunities. 
 - Online Learning Resources: Benefit from access to Udemy and language courses to support your professional growth. 
 - Company-Sponsored Certifications: Access paid certification opportunities to strengthen your technical expertise. 
 - Career Growth and Internal Mobility: Explore opportunities across technology domains and gain exposure to emerging technologies and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Health and Wellbeing: Receive company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial and legal consultation services. 
 - Global Collaboration: Work with distributed teams on technology initiatives that address complex business challenges across industries.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

data.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found. 

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will

- Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines. 
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius. 
 - Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring. 
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework. 
 - Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access. 
 - Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member. 
 - Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated. 

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain. 
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation. 
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live. 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions, 
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality. 
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap. 
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus. 

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

data.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Associate Software Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming, problem-solving, and software development fundamentals, along with a willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to real-world engineering projects. 

You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, debug, and maintain scalable software applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications based on business requirements. 
 - Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and reusable code. 
 - Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software. 
 - Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices. 
 - Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and technical issues. 
 - Develop and integrate APIs and work with databases. 
 - Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning and daily stand-ups. 
 - Write unit tests and support application testing and debugging. 
 - Stay updated with emerging technologies, development tools, and software engineering practices. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C++, or C#. 
 - Basic knowledge of object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts. 
 - Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing fundamentals. 
 - Basic knowledge of REST APIs and web development concepts. 
 - Familiarity with Git or other version control systems. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team. 
 - Willingness to learn, adapt, and work with new technologies. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Internship experience or academic project experience in software development. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks such as Spring Boot, React, Angular, Django, or similar technologies. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or automated testing tools. 
 - Contributions to GitHub projects or participation in coding competitions. 

What We Offer

- Opportunities to work on real-world software engineering projects. 
 - Mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers. 
 - Exposure to modern technologies and development practices. 
 - A collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate: 

- A strong foundation in computer science and programming. 
 - A passion for building software and solving technical challenges. 
 - A proactive attitude toward learning and problem-solving. 
 - The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver results. 
 - A commitment to writing quality code and continuously improving technical skills.

data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide. 

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring You Will

- Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
 - Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
 - Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
 - Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
 - Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
 - Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
 - Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
 - Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.

 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.

 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

data.company: TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited
data.description:
Company Description TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited is the India arm of NEXTY Electronics, a 100% subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho, a major general trading company in Japan. Established in April 2000 in India, the company specializes in local distribution of electrical components and delivers stable production support through a robust supply chain. Building on decades of expertise in electronics, NEXTY Electronics provides comprehensive one-stop solutions, including system solutions, bespoke software development, and connected solutions for logistics and fleet management. The company collaborates with partner EMS providers for production services and is committed to quality service and innovative, customer-focused solutions. 

Role Description A Senior Embedded Software Manager -PMSM Motor Control leads the design, development, and team execution of firmware, control algorithms, and software architectures for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) & it's related peripherals, communications etc. This role spans automotive traction/Motor drives, industrial automation systems, and high-volume consumer appliances. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end embedded software and system architectures for 3-phase PMSM motor control Electronic Control Units (ECUs), industrial drives, and appliance control boards. 
 - Algorithm & Control Design: Oversee implementation of Field-Oriented Control (FOC), maximum torque per ampere (MTPA), field-weakening, sensorless/sensored commutation, and advanced observers. 
 - Application Scope Strategy: Drive software engineering for diverse applications including EV traction drives, automotive thermal management (electronic water pumps, cooling fans), industrial servo drives, and consumer motor control applications like air conditioning compressor controls. 
 - People & Program Management: Lead, mentor, and scale cross-functional embedded software and motor-control engineering teams. Handle sprint planning, milestone tracking, and cross-department collaboration. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to industry safety and quality standards, managing software lifecycles compliant as per industry needs e. g. ISO 26262 (Automotive ASIL), IEC 61508 (Industrial), IEC 60730 (Consumer Safety), ASPICE, and MISRA C guidelines. 
 - Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with power electronics, inverter hardware, and systems engineering for debugging, HIL/SIL/MIL validation, and motor dynamometer testing.

data.title: IMMEDIATE HIRE Full Stack Developer for SaaS Web app (Python, React, AWS)
data.description:
About the role

  PROS is building a dedicated engineering team for a SaaS web app. We're hiring a Full Stack Developer with at least 4 years of AWS experience to join it. 

You'll work across the whole stack: a Python backend, a React frontend, and the AWS infrastructure behind them. The roadmap is fixed, with one-week sprints and releases. 

Cybersecurity SaaS dev is a plus. 

What you'll do

•            Build REST APIs and services in Python 3. 12+ with FastAPI, Pydantic v2, async SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL 16

•            Build Celery and Redis background jobs that are safe to re-run and meet tight performance targets

•            Build React + TypeScript dashboards, drill-down views and admin screens (TanStack Query, Zod, shadcn/ui)

•            Design schemas and migrations using PostgreSQL row-level security and database roles with minimum permissions

•            Deploy and run everything on AWS with Terraform: EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, IAM and ALB/WAF

•            Keep the GitHub Actions pipeline passing: tests, security scans, SBOMs and signed container images

•            Write tests for every story, including pytest, property-based tests and checks that one customer can never see another's data

•            Join sprint planning, daily stand-ups and Friday demos with the client

What you bring

•            4+ years of full stack development, including 4+ years running production workloads on AWS

•            Strong Python backend skills (FastAPI preferred) and solid PostgreSQL

•            Production experience with React and TypeScript

•            Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS preferred) and Terraform

•            Secure coding knowledge: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, secrets management and least-privilege access

•            Experience with background job queues (Celery, SQS or similar)

•            Comfortable with small pull requests, code review and high test coverage

Using AI code tools to speed up development is a Plus

Cybersecurity SaaS development is a BIG PLUS

Bonus points

•            Multi-tenant B2B SaaS using PostgreSQL row-level security

•            Security, compliance or audit-trail products

•            Supply chain security: SLSA, Sigstore/cosign, Kyverno

•            Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or Salesforce API integrations

•            AWS certification (Developer, Solutions Architect or Security)

The details

•            Remote, full-time (40 hrs/week), starting immediately

•            NDA required

Apply with your resume and a link to a project (GitHub or live) where you built both the backend and the React frontend.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in India. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute your technical expertise to the training and evaluation of next-generation artificial intelligence systems. You will design realistic software engineering challenges that assess AI models' ability to write reliable code, implement features, resolve bugs, refactor complex codebases, and optimize performance. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical capabilities of AI-generated software through rigorous testing and deterministic verification. You will draw on your experience in backend development, algorithms, system design, debugging, and software quality assurance to create meaningful technical assessments. Working independently in a fully remote, flexible contract role, you will have the opportunity to apply your engineering judgment to cutting-edge AI development. Previous experience in AI is not required; strong software engineering skills and a commitment to high-quality technical work are what matter most. 

Accountabilities

- Coding task development: Design realistic, challenging software engineering problems that evaluate AI systems across feature implementation, bug fixing, code refactoring, and performance optimization. 
 - Reference solution development: Create accurate, efficient, and maintainable reference implementations that demonstrate sound engineering practices and meet defined technical requirements. 
 - Automated verification: Develop deterministic verification mechanisms, validation scripts, and comprehensive test cases to assess solution correctness and distinguish acceptable implementations from incomplete or incorrect submissions. 
 - Backend engineering: Apply expertise in backend systems, scalable services, API design, asynchronous processing, and distributed architectures to create practical engineering challenges. 
 - Debugging and troubleshooting: Investigate complex defects, identify root causes, analyze performance bottlenecks, and design tasks that test effective problem-solving approaches. 
 - Testing and quality assurance: Develop robust testing strategies, build and maintain comprehensive test suites, diagnose flaky tests, and improve software reliability through automated validation. 
 - Code review and evaluation: Assess implementations for correctness, readability, maintainability, security, performance, and compliance with established software engineering standards. 
 - Refactoring and optimization: Create challenges that evaluate an AI system's ability to modernize legacy code, simplify complex implementations, improve algorithms, and optimize resource utilization. 
 - Technical reasoning assessment: Evaluate AI-generated solutions involving algorithms, architecture, debugging, system design, and implementation decisions. 
 - Documentation: Clearly document task specifications, expected behavior, reference solutions, test coverage, and acceptance criteria to ensure consistent and reproducible evaluations. 
 - Continuous improvement: Analyze model failures, identify recurring weaknesses, and refine coding tasks and evaluation methods to improve the quality and reliability of AI-generated software. 

Requirements

- Significant professional experience in software engineering, particularly backend development and production-grade applications or services. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Python 3, Java, Rust, TypeScript, C++, Node. js, Go, or comparable technologies. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable services, APIs, and reliable backend systems. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computer science fundamentals, system design, and software architecture. 
 - Extensive practical experience debugging complex applications, conducting root-cause analysis, resolving defects, and optimizing performance. 
 - Strong knowledge of automated testing, test design, regression testing, integration testing, unit testing, and software quality assurance. 
 - Ability to identify edge cases, implementation errors, inefficient algorithms, architectural weaknesses, and potential reliability issues. 
 - Proven experience with code reviews, refactoring, maintainable software design, and established engineering best practices. 
 - Excellent analytical thinking, technical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex engineering challenges independently. 
 - Strong written communication skills and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear, reproducible coding tasks and verification criteria. 
 - Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and consistently deliver high-quality results in a remote, contract-based environment. 

Additional Skills That Would Be Advantageous

- Experience designing and maintaining large-scale test suites and automated testing frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), distributed systems, microservices, and architectural design patterns. 
 - Experience diagnosing flaky tests and improving regression testing, integration testing, and unit testing processes. 
 - Knowledge of deterministic evaluation frameworks, automated code verification, or AI coding agent assessment. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy systems and improving production reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 - A track record of establishing testing standards and improving engineering quality across development teams. 

Previous AI industry experience is not mandatory. Candidates with strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent debugging skills, and sound technical judgment are encouraged to apply. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation: Advertised pay ranges from $30 to $100 per hour, depending on the engagement and applicable compensation arrangements. 
 - Flexible part-time schedule: Work approximately 15 hours per week, with the flexibility to choose your working days and hours, including weekends if preferred. 
 - Fully remote opportunity: Work remotely from India without a daily office commute. 
 - Contract-based engagement: Participate in project-based assignments focused on software engineering, coding challenges, and AI evaluation. 
 - Meaningful technical impact: Contribute to improving the performance, reliability, and capabilities of next-generation AI systems. 
 - Advanced technical challenges: Apply your expertise to complex problems involving backend systems, algorithms, automated testing, debugging, and code optimization. 
 - Independent work environment: Use your professional judgment and engineering experience to complete assignments with flexibility and autonomy. 
 - Potential for rapid onboarding: The selection process can move quickly, with some positions filled within approximately 48 hours. Successful candidates should be prepared to start their first tasks within 24-48 hours after onboarding. 

Important Engagement Details

- Compensation is output-based, with payment tied to tasks that satisfy the defined specifications and acceptance criteria. Actual completion time may vary depending on task complexity and individual experience. 
 - Minimum submission requirements apply, including a specified minimum number of tasks per week. 
 - The selection process may include application screening, an approximately 30-minute AI interview, a technical assessment where required, and a hiring manager review. 
 - Candidates must complete interviews, assessments, and project assignments independently, without assistance from AI tools or other individuals, in accordance with the engagement requirements.

data.title: E&I Engineer
data.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems. 

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 
 - Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms. 
 - Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues. 
 - Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones. 

Essential Requirements

- Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience. 
 - Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory). 
 - HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent. 
 - Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP. 
 - Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives. 

Desirable Experience

- Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects. 
 - Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems. 
 - Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). 
 - OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443). 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

data.title: Mulesoft Technical Manager
data.description:
Description

MuleSoft's Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that shape the future. 

As a Practice Manager, You Get To

Lead a team of technical architects and consultants as they deliver MuleSoft solutions to our customers. In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team. 

This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners to solve critically important business challenges using MuleSoft's Anypoint Platform. You will lead customer, partner, and MuleSoft technical teams through multi-phased delivery projects and provide hands-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and the operational life cycle. 

You will be a key member of the cross-functional MuleSoft leadership team. Collaboration and alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, and Product teams will be integral to your success. 

Responsibilities

- Lead a team of technical architects and consultants as they deliver MuleSoft solutions to our customers. 
 - Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce and MuleSoft environments, optimizing API performance, data orchestration, and platform resource consumption
 - Lead technical design sessions; architect and document complex integration solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
 - Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e. g. , Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate API implementation and integration lifecycle velocity across projects
 - Provide hands-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and the operational life cycle. 
 - Build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team. 
 - Collaborate and align across Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, and Product teams to ensure customer success. 
 - Maintain a target billable utilization and manage operational excellence when it comes to bookings and utilization forecasting. 

To be successful, you have

- 12+ years experience leading by example and being a player and a coach. 
 - A background as a professional services leader with experience growing a practice and a strong consulting background in a credible system integrator firm or high growth enterprise software vendor. 
 - A collaborative mindset and the ability to gain trust with your team and across internal and external functional leaders. 
 - Experience architecting MuleSoft services integrations including a solid understanding of on-premise and cloud-based infrastructures, SDLC pipelines, configuration, and deployment. 
 - Experience with API and integration security with a solid grasp of authentication and authorization concepts and principles. 
 - 6-10 years of proven track record leading integration teams and architecting solutions within a diverse technical team of clients, system integrators, contractors, and internal teams. 
 - A background in conducting technical workshops with technical and business clients to drive effective services and implementations. 
 - The ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a simple yet comprehensive way to non-technical and technical professionals alike. 
 - A desire for continuous study of new technologies and functionality, and involvement in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies. 
 - An appreciation for operational excellence when it comes to bookings and utilization forecast, contract terms, etc. 
 - Excellent verbal and written technical documentation skills. 
 - Experience managing people and projects in a matrix'd environment.

data.title: Founding Engineer – Full Stack (Compliance Automation)
data.description:
About the Company

Seclodian develops secure, reliable, and user-friendly technology products. We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer who can contribute to both frontend and backend development while maintaining high standards for security, performance, scalability, and code quality. 

About the role

You'll be one of Seclodian's first engineers. You'll work directly with the founders to turn compliance requirements into a product that auditors trust and auditees actually like using. You'll ship across the whole stack (Go, PostgreSQL, Next. js) and help decide how the platform grows. 

This role suits you if you've seen compliance from the inside. Maybe you built features for a GRC, audit, privacy or regtech product. Maybe you were the engineer who gathered the evidence and closed the findings during a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit. Either way, you now want to build the tool you wished you'd had. 

What you'll build

- Data models for frameworks, controls, tests and evidence, so one control can map across SOC 2, ISO 27001 and DPDP without duplicate work. 
 - Auditor and auditee workflows: engagements, control assignment, evidence upload and review, remediation, and report approval. 
 - PostgreSQL schemas, migrations and queries for multi-tenant data, where one customer must never see another customer's data. 
 - Secure Go APIs (chi, pgx) with authentication and role-based access for auditors, auditees and admins. 
 - Fast, accessible Next. js and React screens (Tailwind, shadcn/ui) built from our Figma designs. 
 - Audit trails that record who did what and when, in a form an auditor will accept. 
 - One product shipped three ways: an on-prem binary on the client's own server, Docker, and serverless on AWS. 
 - Work with our AI document-intelligence service, which reads policies and evidence and suggests answers with citations, while people stay in control of what gets accepted. 
 - Tests, code reviews, production fixes and better monitoring. 
 - With the founders and compliance experts, turning framework language into clear product behaviour. Must-have

- 2+ years of professional software engineering, building and shipping full-stack products. 
 - Hands-on compliance experience, in at least one of these ways: 
 - You built features for a compliance, GRC, audit, privacy or regtech product, or
 - You worked as an engineer through a SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR or DPDP audit or assessment, producing evidence, fixing findings or putting controls in place. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one of those frameworks. You know what a control is, what counts as evidence and why auditors ask for it. 
 - Production backend experience in Go. Strong engineers from Java, C# or TypeScript/Node are welcome if they're ready to go deep on Go quickly. 
 - Professional frontend experience with React and Next. js in TypeScript. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, indexes, transactions, constraints and migrations. 
 - You've built authentication, authorization and input validation, and you know the OWASP Top 10. 
 - You write automated tests and can debug problems you didn't create. Nice to have

- Experience in other regulated domains: fintech, healthtech, insurance. 
 - Privacy features you've built: consent capture, data retention and deletion, or data subject requests under GDPR or DPDP. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS, audit logging, or append-only or tamper-evident records. 
 - Integrations that pull evidence automatically from tools like AWS, Google Workspace, GitHub or Jira. 
 - Docker, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD. 
 - Background jobs and queues (Redis, SQS), structured logging, metrics and tracing. 
 - LLM or RAG systems in production. 
 - A certification or coursework in ISO 27001, CISA, CISSP or similar (not required). Why join now

- Shape the core product and architecture as one of the first engineers. 
 - Work directly with the founders on product and engineering decisions. 
 - Work on a problem that's growing fast in India as DPDP Act obligations come into force. Equal Opportunity Statement

Seclodian is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Position Summary

HealthEdge is seeking a Manager, DevOps to lead the offshore DevOps engineering team supporting HealthRules® Payer (HRP) and related platforms. This role owns day-to-day delivery, technical direction, and people leadership for the India-based DevOps organization, reporting to the Director, DevOps (India). The Manager will partner closely with onshore DevOps leadership, HRP Engineering, Release Management, InfoSec, and Infrastructure Platform teams to execute the CI/CD modernization, AWS migration, and security remediation roadmap while building a resilient, well-coached team. 

This is a hands-on people-management role: the Manager is expected to run day-to-day operations, remove blockers, coach engineers, and represent the offshore team's work and capacity accurately to onshore leadership - not simply relay status upward. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery Management

- Manage and coach a team of offshore DevOps engineers, including 1: 1s, performance feedback, and career development plans. 
 - Own sprint and quarterly planning for the offshore DevOps workstreams, ensuring realistic capacity allocation across CI/CD, security remediation, and AWS migration initiatives. 
 - Identify and remediate single-point-of-failure (SPOF) risk within the team by building cross-training plans and documented ownership for critical systems (CI/CD infrastructure, release tooling, environment automation). 
 - Provide regular, accurate status reporting to the Director, DevOps and onshore leadership using a decision-focused format (hot topics, upcoming milestones, blockers, risks). 
 - Escalate ownership, scope, or resourcing conflicts early, with clear recommendations rather than status updates alone. 

CI/CD & Platform Engineering Oversight

- Guide execution of the Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions migration, including EKS-based runner architecture, GitHub Apps authentication, and CI/CD pipeline modernization. 
 - Oversee Infrastructure-as-Code (CDK/Ansible) provisioning for internal environments (Dev, QA, Perf, Shared, Preprod), maintaining the boundary that DevOps owns internal environments while Release Management owns customer-facing environments. 
 - Drive the Azure-to-AWS migration workstream for internally owned environments, coordinating with Infrastructure Platform and networking teams to resolve cutover blockers. 
 - Ensure code release, build, and deployment tooling (Nexus, Sonar, Jenkins) is kept current, secure, and migrated per the platform roadmap. 

Security & Compliance Execution

- Lead the offshore team's execution of Q4 security initiatives originating from InfoSec, including dependency-tree generation, secrets detection/rotation, vulnerable-commit blocking, and Wiz runtime integration. 
 - Own DevOps' portion of the secrets remediation program: guardrail tooling, Secrets Manager/Vault integration, and coordination with repo owners and Release Management on rotation. 
 - Maintain clear RACI boundaries when scoping security work - DevOps owns pipeline-level guardrails; repo and environment owners drive remediation; Release Management owns customer-environment actions. 
 - Support FedRAMP 20x and CMS POC evidence requirements as they relate to DevOps-owned controls (STIG AMIs, TLS, Secrets Manager, GitHub Apps, IaC). 

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Partner with the Director, DevOps, onshore senior ICs, and HRP Engineering leadership to align on architecture, release cadence, and upcoming platform changes before they reach the team mid-quarter. 
 - Represent the offshore team in the monthly DevOps/Engineering cadence and biweekly senior IC forums, surfacing toil, risk, and proactive architectural concerns. 
 - Coordinate with Infrastructure Platform, InfoSec, and Release Management to resolve cross-team ownership gaps before they become production issues. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Platform Engineering roles, with at least 2-3 years in a people-management or team-lead capacity. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing distributed or offshore engineering teams, including performance management and coaching plans. 
 - Strong hands-on background in CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK, Ansible, Terraform), and cloud platforms (AWS required; Azure a plus). 
 - Working knowledge of GitHub administration, including GitHub Apps, PAT-to-App migrations, and repository governance at scale (400+ repositories). 
 - Experience with artifact and dependency management tooling (Nexus, Sonar) and secrets management platforms (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager). 
 - Familiarity with security remediation workflows: vulnerability scanning, dependency-tree analysis, secrets rotation, and runtime security tooling (e. g. , Wiz). 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to produce concise, decision-focused updates for senior leadership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve single-point-of-failure risk and to build redundancy into critical operational functions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting healthcare technology, claims processing, or other regulated/compliance-heavy platforms. 
 - Familiarity with FedRAMP, HITRUST, or similar compliance frameworks. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) for CI/CD runner infrastructure or application workloads. 
 - Exposure to DORA metrics and engineering-productivity measurement programs. 
 - Prior experience operating in a matrixed organization with distinct onshore/offshore reporting lines. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 6 Months

- Offshore team capacity, ownership, and SPOF risks are documented and actively being mitigated through cross-training. 
 - Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions and AWS migration workstreams are progressing against a jointly owned, realistic timeline with clear blockers surfaced early. 
 - Security remediation items owned by DevOps show measurable burn-down, with clean ownership boundaries agreed upon with InfoSec and Release Management. 
 - The Director, DevOps and onshore leadership have consistent visibility into offshore delivery through structured, decision-focused reporting.

- Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for Reltio MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.

 - Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports. 
 - Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects. 

Required Skills & Experience

 - Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools. 
 - Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy). 
 - Experience with data quality testing concepts - completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness. 
 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements. 
 - Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint-based delivery teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy. 
 - Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines. 
 - Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus. 
 - Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc. ) for automated testing workflows. 
 - Experience with data migration testing in large-scale MDM implementation projects.

data.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Local AI
data.description:

The invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of PC gaming, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning has ignited modern AI, positioning NVIDIA as a leading AI computing company. 

Artificial intelligence is shifting from passive assistance to autonomous, always-on workflows. Our mission is to make this transition seamless, efficient, and secure for millions globally. The Local AI Inference team is seeking a Senior System Software Engineer to lead the development of robust system-level software and infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying high-quality AI applications and models across Linux and Windows systems powered by RTX and DGX-class GPUs. You will partner with inference engineers, model developers, and AI application teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure that enables reproducible evaluation and improves local AI performance. Using AI tools and developing autonomous agents, you will accelerate infrastructure development, automate operations, and help engineers diagnose complex system issues. If you enjoy tackling systems challenges and shaping how AI infrastructure is built and operated, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner across organizations with benchmarking teams, inference teams, and AI application developers to define requirements, design, and maintain shared infrastructure for deploying, benchmarking, and qualifying AI workloads across infernece backends such as llama. cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, and WinML. 
 - Build Git-based CI infrastructure for automated builds, integration testing, and regression detection across hardware platforms, operating systems, and runtime configurations. 
 - Develop model management services to download, version, cache, and synchronize checkpoints and dependencies for reproducible execution. 
 - Design databases, backend services, and data pipelines to store and query model metadata, benchmark results, system telemetry, and execution artifacts. 
 - Create dashboards and reports that help engineers compare inference configurations, identify regressions, and investigate performance bottlenecks. 
 - Develop and operate server infrastructure, including environment provisioning, workload scheduling, resource management, and failure recovery. 
 - Develop autonomous AI agents for infrastructure management, workload orchestration, monitoring, and diagnostics, with appropriate access controls and execution safeguards. 
 - Maintain Git repositories and companion websites, keeping code, documentation, model recommendations, and evaluation results current. 
 - Collaborate with inference developers to implement instrumentation and debugging capabilities, resolve system issues, and improve infrastructure efficiency and scalability. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 5+ years of relevant software development, with strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, C#, or another systems programming language. 
 - Experience developing system software, backend services, or infrastructure supporting engineering development. 
 - Understanding of system APIs, multithreading, process and resource management, and systems debugging. 
 - Hands-on with Git-based CI, databases, SQL, and data modeling. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently own projects and manage competing priorities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaboration across engineering teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Track record of integrating or debugging AI inference frameworks and building model evaluation or benchmarking platforms
 - Proficiency working with AI agents, including tool integration and evaluation of autonomous infrastructure workflows. 
 - Hands-on expertise in developing telemetry and observability systems using tools such as Grafana or Kibana. 
 - Demonstrated ability to publish technical documentation, model recommendations, or benchmark results through companion websites.

data.title: SWQA Test Developer Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has advanced computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. We are developing the next era of computing through AI, supported by dedicated people and a diverse, collaborative environment. 

We are seeking a SWQA Test Developer Engineer to join the Mobile QA Group and help deliver high-quality products built on NVIDIA Tegra systems on a chip (SoCs). You will be validating Nvidia Shield TV supporting AI-enhanced upscaling, 4K HDR, GeForce NOW cloud gaming, built in Google Assistant, which also supports Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, etc. You will work on AI platforms running Linux, Android, and proprietary operating systems, collaborating with engineers, workstream leads, and release managers. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Apply AI-powered tools and agents throughout the test development lifecycle to accelerate test generation, code development, test analysis, coverage improvement, log analysis, regression triage, root-cause analysis, and code reviews. 
 - Build and use an E2E AI Agentic Workflow with existing and custom agents and skills for every SDLC phase. This will expedite key objectives and important metrics of test and quality engineering. 
 - Develop AI framework for test strategies, plans, and detailed test cases from customer requirements; regularly implement tests for software features on Tegra-based platforms using AI-powered tools. 
 - Review product requirements, specifications, and technical designs, and provide feedback to improve testability and coverage. 
 - Develop applications, test tools, and automated tests using NVIDIA test frameworks for Tegra platforms. 
 - File clear bug reports, investigate failures, and work with engineers to triage issues and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with project management, hardware, and software teams; analyze priority bugs and share periodic quality metrics and reports with collaborators. Improve testing processes and product quality. 
 - Partner with development, architecture, product, and release teams to identify quality risks, analyze sophisticated system-level issues, drive defects to resolution, and communicate release readiness and quality metrics. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. 
 - 3-5 years of professional experience in software validation, preferably with ARM SoC-based Linux or Android products and end-to-end validation of game console devices. 
 - Strong Python programming skills with experience building test frameworks, automation infrastructure, utilities, and validation tools from the ground up. 
 - Hands-on experience bringing to bear AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered workflows for test development, code generation, test analysis, debugging, coverage improvement, or test development workflow optimization. 
 - Strong proficiency in Linux, including shell scripting, system-level debugging, process/resource analysis, and command-line fixing.

 - Ability to manage work independently, demonstrate leadership, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively, with a passion for emerging technologies. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with Android streaming products, graphics rendering techniques, display parameters, graphics processing, shaders, clusters, streaming apps/games, competitive analysis & benchmarking analysis of different streaming devices.
