data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

You will lead the architecture and development of scalable, elastic distributed systems, driving performance, reliability, security, and operational excellence. You will define scalability requirements and SLOs, design fault-tolerant services that support upgrades without downtime, and establish telemetry and rigorous resilience testing. You will also resolve complex production issues, mentor engineers, and build infrastructure automation for safe deployments, patching, and rollbacks. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Basic Qualification

7+ years of industry experience working on commercial or open-source software. 

Strong fluency in C++ or Java or similar modern languages

Excellent problem-solving skills and a deep understanding of Computer Science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems. 

Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and build control plane systems for cloud scale

Strong systems programming skills, including experience with multi-threading and concurrency. 

A solid foundation in distributed systems concepts (e. g. , consistency, scaling, failure recovery). 

Experience with implementation testing, debugging, and documentation, specifically within a Linux development environment. 

BS in Computer Science; Masters preferred

Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems

Experience designing architectures that demonstrate deep technical depth in one area, or span many products, to enable high availability, scalability, market-leading features and flexibility to meet future business demands

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as technical lead on a large scale cloud service

Hands-on experience developing and maintaining services on a public cloud platform (e. g. , OCI, AWS, Azure)

Experience working on Kubernetes

Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) languages, preferably Terraform

Strong knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL)

Strong knowledge of Cloud Networking (OSI layers, HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP. )

Knowledge of Linux internals, Linux/Unix troubleshooting skills

Familiarity with host virtualization technologies (KVM, Containers, Docker, etc. )

Able to effectively communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing (technical proposals, design specs, architecture diagrams and presentations)

Experience with hiring, mentorship and raising the talent bar across the organization

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all.  - Leadership skills to influence all levels of the organization. 
 - You're inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people. 
 - An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding. 
 - You're collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches. 
 - Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change. Qualifications

- M. S in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, M. Tech in Chemical or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of analytical techniques (Chromatography, SEM, ICP-MS, etc). 
 - Deep understanding of Semiconductor wafer Fabrication
 - Proven track record in yield improvement on new and mature technologies
 - Ability to lead cross-functional teams and achieve project completion within timeline and cost targets
 - Ability to work across different cultures and geographies
 - Good team player
 - Innovation and competitive mindsetDesired Experience Level

- 7+ years experience in the semiconductor industry

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Test Strategy & Implementation

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift

 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )

 - Familiarity with:

data.title: Senior ETL Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes-starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world's leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare's most complex challenges. 

At the core of our innovation is Cara, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite-which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation-these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made. 

ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery. 

Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You'll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end testing of ETL and data pipelines across multiple processing stages. 
 - Review requirements, file layouts, data dictionaries, mappings, transformation rules, and data lineage. 
 - Develop test strategies, test cases, validation queries, and traceable QA evidence. 
 - Perform source-to-target, file-to-table, table-to-table, and table-to-file reconciliation. 
 - Validate record counts, field-level values, aggregates, calculations, transformations, filtering, enrichment, standardization, and default values. 
 - Test null handling, duplicates, data loss, referential integrity, matching, de-duplication, mastering, and survivorship rules. 
 - Validate inbound and outbound files for structure, headers, delimiters, data types, field lengths, required fields, encoding, and naming conventions. 
 - Create controlled test files and synthetic data to validate business and transformation rules. 
 - Design positive, negative, boundary, edge-case, regression, reload, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Investigate data-quality issues and identify root causes across source data, requirements, mappings, configurations, transformations, and downstream processing. 
 - Develop reusable SQL queries, scripts, reconciliation checks, and automated data-quality validations. 
 - Investigate production data issues and support post-deployment validation and regression testing. 
 - Collaborate with Data Engineering, Business Analysis, Product, Operations, and other technical teams to improve pipeline testability and diagnostics. 
 - Participate in client and data-vendor onboarding by reviewing specifications, sample files, mappings, and expected outputs. 
 - Identify requirements gaps, data-quality risks, ambiguities, and testability concerns during onboarding. 
 - Communicate testing status, defects, risks, blockers, and production-readiness findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Document and manage defects in Jira with supporting SQL, test evidence, and sample records. 
 - Lead complex ETL QA initiatives independently, defining testing strategy, scope, approach, and quality standards for critical data pipelines. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to QA engineers on SQL validation, data reconciliation, test design, defect investigation, and ETL best practices. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of ETL QA processes by identifying automation opportunities, improving reusable validation frameworks, and strengthening data-quality and production-readiness checks. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 7+ years of hands-on experience in ETL testing, data pipeline testing, database testing, data warehouse testing, or data-feed validation. 
 - Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write complex queries for reconciliation, transformation validation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of ETL architecture and data flow across multiple processing stages. 
 - Experience testing CSV, TXT, delimited, fixed-width, and similar data files. 
 - Experience translating requirements, mappings, file layouts, and transformation rules into comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Strong experience with source-to-target validation and data reconciliation. 
 - Ability to identify and troubleshoot missing records, duplicates, count mismatches, mapping defects, transformation errors, and data-quality issues. 
 - Experience creating synthetic test data and controlled inbound files. 
 - Experience developing reusable SQL validations, scripts, and automated data-quality checks. 
 - Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, negative, boundary, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with Jira or similar defect-management tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with Data Engineering, Business Analysts, Product, Operations, clients, and data vendors. 

Preferred Skills

- Healthcare, life-sciences, clinical, claims, real-world evidence, or patient-level data. 
 - AWS Glue, S3, Redshift, Snowflake, PySpark, or similar data-processing technologies. 
 - Python or other scripting languages for test automation and data validation. 
 - Data matching, entity resolution, de-duplication, mastering, and survivorship testing. 
 - Data governance and data-quality principles. 
 - CI/CD and automated testing within data-engineering environments. 
 - Experience working with clients, data vendors, or external data providers. 
 - Experience with large-scale data warehouses and analytics platforms. 

Learn More About ConcertAI

Our team at ConcertAI is dedicated to transforming healthcare decision-making through the application of RWE and AI to improve patient outcomes. We work in a fast-paced, dynamic, high-performing culture where diversity, collaboration, and innovation are valued. Join us on our quest to create a world free of disease. Learn more about ConcertAI at www. concertai. com , or follow us on LinkedIn. Serving 1, 300 clinical sites globally, TeraRecon - a ConcertAI company - is a Best in KLAS solution provider for AI-empowered radiology, oncology, cardiology, neurology, and vascular surgery. In the future, the combination with ConcertAI could bring a single, advanced AI-augmented diagnosis and interpretation capability from clinical trials to patient care. 

EEO & ADA Statement

ConcertAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and hiring process, as well as during employment, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

data.title: Director of Artificial Intelligence
data.description:
Client: Fortune 500 company in Hyderabad, Telangana

Role: Director/Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Delivery

Duration: Full time (direct hire)

About client: 

- Global AI & Innovation team to build next-generation AI platforms, autonomous agents, and real-time intelligence solutions that transform how a global enterprise operates and serves its customers. 

Position Summary: 

- It's is seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Delivery to lead the Hyderabad GCC AI delivery organization and serve as a critical execution partner to the Global AI & Innovation leadership team. 
 - This role will own the design, delivery, operationalization, and support of enterprise AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions across the prioritized global pipeline. 
 - The successful candidate will manage a multidisciplinary team of AI/ML Engineers, Agent Developers, Data Scientists, MLOps resources, contractors, and delivery partners. 
 - The role will act as the single point of contact for the onshore AI team and business stakeholders, translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions, lead Responsible AI training and awareness, and serve as the first-level escalation point for AI/ML and Agentic AI issues. 
 - This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep knowledge of business operations, strong stakeholder management, and the technical depth to design and deploy secure, reusable, production-grade AI capabilities that integrate into business workflows and create measurable value. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Global AI/ML & Agentic Solution Delivery: 

- Lead end-to-end delivery of AI, ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI initiatives across the prioritized global portfolio, from discovery and design through production deployment, adoption, and value realization. 
 - Create delivery plans, estimates, milestones, resource models, technical dependencies, risk controls, and release readiness criteria. 
 - Ensure solutions are scalable, reusable, maintainable, observable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Establish reusable implementation patterns, accelerators, components, APIs, and reference architectures to improve speed and quality across the portfolio. 
 - Maintain transparent portfolio reporting on scope, schedule, quality, risks, dependencies, budget, adoption, and business outcomes. 

AI Architecture & Hands-on Technical Leadership: 

- Own solution architecture and technical design for AI/ML applications, AI microservices, RAG solutions, intelligent assistants, and single- and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Guide model, algorithm, platform, orchestration, data, integration, and deployment decisions based on business requirements and operational constraints. 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews; establish engineering standards for testing, evaluation, observability, resiliency, security, and supportability. 
 - Remain hands-on in design, prototyping, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production deployment of critical solutions. 
 - Design APIs and integrations that embed AI capabilities into operational processes, enterprise applications, and business workflows. 

GCC Team Leadership & Delivery Management: 

- Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary GCC team of AI/ML Engineers, Agent Developers, Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers, contractors, and partner resources. 
 - Allocate work across the portfolio, balance capacity and demand, remove delivery blockers, and maintain accountability for quality and outcomes. 
 - Define role expectations, engineering practices, onboarding plans, technical learning paths, and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Manage contractors and vendors against defined deliverables, acceptance criteria, security requirements, and performance expectations. 
 - Partner with onshore leadership to evolve the global AI operating model and create effective follow-the-sun delivery and support practices. 

Business Partnership & Operational Knowledge: 

- Serve as the primary GCC AI point of contact for the onshore team, technology leaders, and business stakeholders. 
 - Develop detailed knowledge of It's business operations, workflows, data, controls, customer needs, and regional differences. 
 - Facilitate discovery workshops and translate operational pain points into well-defined AI use cases, solution options, and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Partner with business owners to define success measures, adoption plans, process changes, controls, and quantified value outcomes. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executives, business leaders, product owners, engineers, and control functions. 

AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI: 

- Operationalize It's AI governance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle, including intake, design, risk assessment, approval, testing, deployment, monitoring, and retirement. 
 - Ensure security-by-design and privacy-by-design for sensitive financial, customer, employee, and operational data. 
 - Implement safeguards for prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination and inaccuracy, unauthorized access, model misuse, bias, explainability, and regulatory or compliance risk. 
 - Maintain solution documentation, decision records, model cards, evaluation evidence, approvals, risk treatments, and audit ready artifacts. 
 - Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, Data Governance, and Internal Audit as required. 

Global AI Training, Adoption & Awareness: 

- Own and drive continuous AI learning, enablement, and Responsible AI awareness across global It's teams. 
 - Develop and deliver executive briefings, business enablement sessions, technical workshops, developer training, and role based learning paths. 
 - Create practical guidance that helps employees use AI safely, responsibly, and effectively within approved policies and tools. 
 - Build a network of AI champions and reusable training assets to scale adoption across regions and functions. 
 - Track participation, adoption, proficiency, policy awareness, and feedback to continuously improve enablement programs. 

AI Operations, Support & Escalation: 

- Serve as the first-level escalation point for delivery, production, model, agent, data, integration, governance, and adoption issues related to AI/ML and Agentic AI. 
 - Lead structured triage, root-cause analysis, stakeholder communication, remediation, and preventive action for critical incidents. 
 - Establish operational readiness standards, service ownership, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, support handoffs, and incident response procedures. 
 - Monitor model and agent quality, latency, reliability, cost, drift, safety, and business performance after deployment. 
 - Escalate material risks and decisions promptly with clear impact, options, recommendations, owners, and resolution plans. 

Strategy Execution & Value Realization: 

- Reporting directly to Global Head, AI & Innovation to translate the Global AI Strategy into an executable roadmap and delivery portfolio. 
 - Support portfolio prioritization, investment planning, governance forums, executive reviews, vendor evaluations, and strategic partnerships. 
 - Identify opportunities to reuse platforms, data products, models, agents, and integration patterns across functions and regions. 
 - Define and report measurable outcomes, including business value, adoption, risk reduction, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical adoption paths aligned with business need, enterprise readiness, and risk tolerance. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, data science, AI/ML engineering, enterprise architecture, or digital solution delivery. 
 - 5+ years leading multidisciplinary AI/ML, data science, or advanced engineering teams, including contractors and delivery partners. 
 - Demonstrated success designing, deploying, and supporting production-grade enterprise AI/ML or Generative AI solutions. 
 - Experience operating as a technical and delivery leader across geographically distributed onshore and offshore teams. 
 - Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, risk management, and delivery governance skills. 
 - Ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem solving and detailed operational understanding. 

Required Technical Skills & Experience

AI, Generative AI & Agentic Engineering: 

- LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use, function calling, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, model evaluation, grounding, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI and/or Amazon Bedrock and with relevant model providers and enterprise AI services. 
 - Experience with frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or comparable orchestration frameworks. 

Data Science & Algorithm Selection: 

- Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, feature engineering, predictive modeling, optimization, and model evaluation. 
 - Ability to select algorithms based on business objective, target variable, data volume and quality, latency, interpretability, risk, cost, and deployment constraints. 
 - Practical experience with regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, clustering, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, NLP, recommendation methods, neural networks, and optimization techniques. 
 - Ability to compare candidate models using appropriate evaluation metrics, validation strategies, explainability methods, and business acceptance criteria. 

Software Engineering & Integration: 

- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL; strong understanding of APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, object-oriented design, automated testing, version control, and secure coding.

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. For more information, visit corporate. carrier. com (opens in new window) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier. 

About the role: We are seeking an experienced Component Engineering Services Manager to lead component engineering activities across new product development, sustaining engineering, and value engineering initiatives. This role will be responsible for component lifecycle management, alternate part qualification, obsolescence mitigation, regulatory compliance, engineering change management, and cost optimization while providing technical leadership across global engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing Component Engineering team
 - Lead component engineering strategy and governance across product portfolios. 
 - Drive alternate component identification, evaluation, qualification, and implementation. 
 - Manage component lifecycle activities, including obsolescence monitoring, EOL notifications, and Last Time Buy (LTB) planning. 
 - Establish and execute proactive obsolescence management and risk mitigation programs. 
 - Ensure compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements, including RoHS, REACH, PFAS, California Proposition 65, Conflict Minerals, and SCIP. 
 - Review and assess supplier PCNs/ECNs and drive implementation of required engineering changes. 
 - Partner with Design Engineering, Procurement, Quality, and Suppliers to resolve component-related challenges. 
 - Lead cost reduction and value engineering initiatives through component substitutions, standardization, and supply chain optimization. 
 - Develop approved component strategies, preferred parts lists, and qualification standards. 
 - Mentor and develop component engineering talent while driving best practices and continuous improvement. 

People Leadership

- Provide component engineering expertise to hardware, firmware, manufacturing, and quality teams. 
 - Mentor and develop component engineers and engineering specialists. 
 - Define best practices, standards, and governance for component selection and management. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams in resolving component-related technical challenges. 
 - Set team objectives, manage performance, and support career development plans. 
 - Support resource planning, workload management, and talent acquisition activities

Supplier & Supply Chain Engagement

- Work directly with component manufacturers, distributors, and strategic suppliers. 
 - Evaluate supplier capabilities, technology roadmaps, and long-term support strategies. 
 - Support sourcing decisions for critical and strategic components. 
 - Participate in supplier reviews and technical assessments. 

Data Management & Analytics

- Maintain component databases, AVL/AML systems, and lifecycle management tools. 
 - Develop dashboards and KPIs related to: 
 - Obsolescence risk
 - Compliance status
 - Alternate qualification
 - Cost savings
 - EOL exposure
 - Generate management reports and executive-level presentations

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - 10+ years of experience in Component Engineering, Electronics Design, Product Engineering, or Supply Chain Engineering. 
 - Strong expertise in: 
 - Electronic, electromechanical, and passive components
 - Alternate part qualification and second sourcing
 - Obsolescence and lifecycle management
 - EOL/LTB planning and execution
 - Supplier PCN/ECN management
 - Regulatory and environmental compliance
 - Cost-out and value engineering initiatives
 - Experience working with PLM, component databases, and lifecycle management tools. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Knowledge of semiconductor, power, connectivity, display, and passive component technologies. 
 - Experience supporting global product development organizations. 
 - Ability to lead complex technical decisions impacting product continuity, compliance, cost, and supply chain resilience. 
 - Knowledge of Excel macros, VB macros and automation for productivity enhancement will be an added advantage
 - Material Science / In depth Knowledge on Material will be an added advantage
 - Robust knowledge of Environmental Compliance directives: EU ROHS, China ROHS REACH, WEEE, California Prop65. 
 - Working knowledge of regulatory approval such as UL, FCC etc.

data.title: Salesforce Application Architect
data.description:
Salesforce Application Architect - Sovos SOVOS Salesforce Application Architect

Accounting/Finance· Full-Time

- India

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. 

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence - and helping communities thrive. 

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. 

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. 

The Role

At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here. 

More Specifically, You Will

- Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity. 
 - Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales. 
 - Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access. 
 - Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware. 
 - Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder. 
 - Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy. 
 - Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration. 

What You Bring to Sovos

- You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career. 
 - Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design. 
 - Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios. 
 - Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer. 
 - Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale. 
 - Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance. 
 - Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement. 
 - Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. 

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. 

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

- Global Mentoring Programs
 - AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
 - Continuous Learning and Development
 - Language Learning Support
 - Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
 - Global Parental Leave Policy
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
 - Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
 - Hybrid Work Arrangement
 - Annual Health Check-up

Equal Opportunity Employer

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. 

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. 

More than 100, 000 customers - including half the Fortune 500 - trust Sovos' tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos. com. 

Ready to make your move?

We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

data.title: Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer
data.description:
HRS As a Company

HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay. 

ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations. 

TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers. 

In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers. 

Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value. 

HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains. 

Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide. 

BUSINESS UNIT

You'll join HRS's Product & IT organization, in the team that builds the AI agent layer for our global sales organization. Our goal: give Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Learning & Development, and leadership teams trusted AI agents that work directly inside the tools they use every day, such as our CRM, Microsoft 365, and our data platforms. The foundation is already in place. A central AI gateway on AWS gives every agent secure, audited access to approved AI models, and a dedicated platform engineer builds and maintains the secure connections into our core business systems. That lets you concentrate on building agents that solve real business problems for our teams worldwide. We are deliberately not a single-vendor shop: we build on Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, and other cloud-native agentic workflow engines, with the platform for each use case selected based on the agent capabilities it requires. 

POSITION

As Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer (all genders), you are the lead architect and builder of HRS's growing portfolio of AI agents and agentic workflows. You define the multi-agent architecture and the development standards the team follows across platforms, and personally drive the delivery of production-grade agents that account executives, sales operations managers, and customer success teams use every day - in Microsoft Teams and beyond. 

Our central AI gateway connects agents to approved AI models, and our platform engineer (a separate role) owns the detailed technical integrations into Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, and our other data systems. That leaves your focus on what makes agents valuable: design, orchestration, quality, and scale. You will mentor the mid-level engineer, set the technical bar, and make sure every agent ships as a reliable, well-governed product, whichever platform it runs on. 

CHALLENGE

- Architecture and delivery standards: Define the platform-agnostic multi-agent topology, conversation and workflow design principles, naming conventions, guardrail patterns, and release standards the team follows across all engines. 
 - Multi-agent framework: Design the orchestrator and sub-agent structure, handoff protocols, context passing, and fallback behaviors, including cross-platform communication via open standards like MCP and A2A. 
 - New use cases: Lead design and delivery of agents for pipeline queries, opportunity stage updates, forecasts, opportunity creation, approval workflows, and AI-generated content across a growing sales and customer-facing backlog. 
 - Enterprise data access: Partner with the platform engineer to define tool, API, and connector contracts for Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, SAP, Clay, AWS data products, and internal APIs. Enforce governed interfaces only: no direct database access, no free-form SQL, no plaintext credentials. 
 - Guardrail framework: Define and implement RBAC, DLP controls, prompt-injection defenses, output validation, and audit logging standards for every agent on every platform. 
 - Release management: Own versioning, regression testing, and staged rollout to production, including human approval gates for write-back actions, and sign off on every production promotion. 
 - Mentoring: Guide the mid-level engineer through architecture advice, reviews, and structured onboarding, building a team that delivers independently. 
 - Stakeholder translation: Work with sales and sales operations to scope use cases, define acceptance criteria, and manage delivery expectations. 

FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH

- Experience: Typically 7+ years in software, automation, or integration engineering, with a track record of shipping AI agents or agentic workflows that real users rely on in production. 
 - Agent platforms: Proven experience deploying production agents, including multi-agent orchestrator/sub-agent architectures, on at least one agentic engine (e. g. Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock Agents, LangGraph). Production experience on multiple platforms is a strong plus. 
 - M-shaped profile: Deep agentic engineering expertise plus broad knowledge of enterprise systems such as CRM (e. g. Dynamics 365), ERP (e. g. SAP), Microsoft 365, and cloud data platforms. 
 - Agentic AI patterns: Deep understanding of orchestrator/sub-agent design, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, MCP, agent memory, and evaluation. 
 - Platform judgment: Clear view of each platform's strengths and limits, designing every agent to make the most of where it runs. 
 - API fluency: Confident with REST, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2. 0 / service principals; consumes APIs, connectors, and MCP servers and specifies precisely what agents need from the platform team. 
 - Governance: Solid knowledge of identity and RBAC (e. g. Entra ID), DLP, secrets management, environment and solution lifecycle, and CI/CD for agents. 
 - Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency for agent data handling. 
 - Mentoring: Proven ability to coach engineers and uphold quality standards across a team. 
 - Design and documentation: Strong skills in architecture decision records, conversation and workflow specs, and runbooks. 
 - Certifications (a plus): Microsoft PL-400 or AI-102, AWS, or platform-specific equivalents. 
 - Communication: Fluent English, verbal and written, able to lead discussions with technical and business stakeholders.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring offshore testing activities are planned, coordinated, executed, and reported effectively while maintaining high quality standards across all testing deliverables.

- Act as the primary point of contact between offshore test teams and onshore Test Leads.

 - Communicate testing priorities and requirements to offshore resources. 
 - Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Provide clear and concise status updates to onshore stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate and track queries between offshore and onshore teams. 
 - Ensure agreed actions are understood and executed by offshore teams.

Test Coordination & Governance

Reporting & Tracking

data.title: Continuous Improvement Manager
data.description:
Continuous Improvement Manager

An auto-components supplier to two of the large domestic OEMs, running plants against tight quality and delivery clauses written into its OEM contracts, is hiring a Continuous Improvement Manager through Flexiple to bring its scrap and rework numbers down before the next contract review. 

Where you'd be: Pune, Chennai

The pressure point

OEM contracts in this business carry real penalty clauses for defect rates and delivery misses, and this supplier's scrap and rework figures have been drifting the wrong way for two quarters. The plant has the equipment and the people to fix it; it has not had one person whose full-time job is finding root cause and driving the fix through to close. 

The work

Diagnosis and improvement

- Lead root-cause investigations on recurring defects and scrap drivers on the shop floor
 - Run Lean and Six Sigma projects targeting cycle time, rework, and first-pass yield
 - Facilitate kaizen events with line supervisors and quality engineersTracking and standardisation

- Own the plant's improvement project pipeline and report progress against OEM-linked targets
 - Standardise fixes into updated work instructions so gains do not erode after a few weeks
 - Coordinate with quality on any changes that touch OEM-approved process documentationWhat you'd bring

- 3 to 8 years in continuous improvement, industrial engineering, or quality roles in an automotive-component or similarly regulated manufacturing setting
 - Green Belt or higher Lean Six Sigma certification, with real project outcomes to show
 - Working familiarity with OEM quality systems (IATF-style documentation, PPAP, or equivalent) is a strong plus
 - Confidence running a root-cause session on the floor, not just presenting findings afterwardOn location

On-site at the plant in Pune or Chennai, given the shop-floor nature of the work; this is not a hybrid or remote role. 

How this gets decided

HR Screening → Technical Assignment → Plant Manager Round → Culture Fit

Flexiple considers one application here for future matched roles as well, so your profile stays active beyond this single opening. 

What's in it for you

- A mandate tied directly to a live, contract-linked scrap-reduction target, not a vague improvement brief
 - Direct access to plant leadership on progress reviews
 - A defined, well-run hiring process from screening to offer

About The Role

Corporate Title: AVP (Internal: AVP)

Location: MGS - Bengaluru

Job Profile

Position details

The AVP, Lead Software Engineer will apply hands-on technical knowledge across data integration, database engineering, scripting, cloud-based data services, and AI-enabled solutions. The role is to help design secure, scalable Generative AI capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge bases, semantic search, and document intelligence solutions. 

The successful candidate will combine strong engineering fundamentals with analytical thinking, iterative problem-solving, stakeholder management, and a risk-aware approach. The individual will translate business and technical requirements into reliable solutions, guide development teams, and deliver against milestones in a regulated financial-services environment. In the process, you will have exciting opportunities to develop your skills, expand your network, and build your career. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Design, develop, enhance, and maintain complex ETL mappings, workflows, data pipelines, and UNIX/Linux shell scripts in enterprise data warehouse and data lake environments
 - Build and optimize batch, real-time, and near-real-time integrations using IDMC or comparable integration technologies
 - Develop advanced SQL and database solutions across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or comparable relational platforms, including performance tuning and data-quality controls
 - Contribute to dimensional, canonical, and integration data models, and support data warehouses and data marts
 - Build reusable Python, Java, or scripting components for data processing, orchestration, validation, automation, and operational support
 - Design and build enterprise RAG solutions that retrieve trusted content and provide grounded responses using large language models
 - Create and maintain knowledge ingestion pipelines covering document parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and citation or source traceability
 - Work with vector databases and semantic-search technologies such as Amazon OpenSearch, PostgreSQL with pgvector, or equivalent platforms

 - Build AI-enabled document intelligence solutions for extracting, classifying, summarizing, and validating information from structured and unstructured content
 - Establish evaluation approaches for RAG and Generative AI solutions, including retrieval quality, answer groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost, and regression testing

 - Partner with architecture, security, data governance, model risk, legal/compliance, and business teams to move AI proofs of concept into supportable production services

 - Provide technical knowledge and understandings across design, development, testing, implementation, release, and production-support activities

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience working as a Data Engineer, designing, developing, and supporting scalable data pipelines and data-processing solutions using AWS services
 - 8+ years of experience with IDMC or a comparable enterprise ETL/data-integration platform, including batch and real-time or near-real-time patterns. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on programming or scripting experience using Python, Java, or a comparable language
 - Strong experience with one or more relational database platforms and advanced SQL, including performance tuning and troubleshooting

 - Experience producing technical designs and leading delivery through development, testing, release, and production support

 - Experience with document-processing services and libraries, including OCR, layout-aware extraction, chunking, metadata management, and source citation

People leadership & development.

Degree In Chemical Engineering Or Equivalent Experience Essential

Ability to build effective teams and instil trust Essential

Strategic Thinking & Direction Setting Essential

data.description:

We are a fast-growing, highly collaborative team of platform engineers, AI engineers, and data scientists who value technical depth, ownership, and pragmatic execution. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to define how secure Generative AI is built and governed inside a global technology leader. 

As a Senior SRE in our India hub, you will tackle complex networking and service mesh challenges across a global footprint. Your expertise in Anthos and Istio will be critical in maintaining the high-availability platform that powers Cisco's most advanced AI initiatives. 

Your Impact

- Develop and maintain Terraform scripts to provision and manage scalable GCP and On-premise Kubernetes resources and Docker containers.

 - Implement and audit IAM roles and GCP Quotas, ensuring the environment is "Secure by Design" with robust encryption and secrets updates. 
 - Build and leverage observability dashboards using Elasticsearch and Kibana to monitor system health and provide proactive alerts on performance and cost. 
 - Execute capacity planning and scaling for new feature rollouts, ensuring the environment stays within defined cost envelopes and security standards. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
 - 10+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud/On-prem Operations or DevOps. 
 - Strong proficiency in Terraform, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Extensive experience with IAM implementation, GCP Quota management, and Anthos Service Mesh (ASM)/Istio. 
 - Proven experience with Apigee and the ELK stack. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Jenkins, Spinnaker, and GitHub for automated delivery. 
 - Proven ability to manage hybrid traffic between cloud and on-premise platforms. 
 - Strong analytical skills for cost envelope management and capacity planning. 
 - Advanced proficiency with cloud provider CLIs and automation scripting. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. Leadership

Feed into workforce plans to ensure the right resourcing requirements for current and future business needs. This includes understanding current and future capability needs and addressing those through development interventions. 

Lead succession planning to ensure a strong talent pipeline and to mitigate critical skills gaps.

Support team development and ensure team are appropriately aligned to the technical career path based on their capability and business need. Provide input to the Grade Review Process.

Instil trust and value differences, generating confidence and safety with others through openness and authenticity, modelling high standards of honesty, transparency and integrity whilst promoting a team environment that values, encourages, and supports differences. 

Develop employee engagement strategy for the team to motivate and drive engagement. 

Facilitate collaboration with shared values for engineering to partner across teams and functions to create high performing teams to achieve common goals. 

Provide input and recommendations on reward and benefits processes for team e. g. annual review. 

Carry out people and business processes within HR and Business systems (e. g. Workday process initiation, leave & expense approvals, etc).

Initiate and lead major transformation projects to scale and grow engineering capacity and capability for the organization.

People leadership & development.

(Technical/ professional knowledge and skills competency)

Degree In Chemical Engineering Or Equivalent Experience Essential

Understanding of technology development, engineering and licencing Essential

Member of a recognised Professional Institution Desirable

Personal Skills And Key Competencies

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written - ability to explain complex issues clearly & technical concepts to a non-technical audience Essential

Innovative approach to engineering execution Essential

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500, 000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale. 

We are seeking a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead the development of new services that power the end-to-end travel and expense experience for Amazonians worldwide. You will build and ship solutions across the Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense modules - integrating AI capabilities such as intelligent policy guidance, automated expense categorization, and GenAI-driven workflows into production systems that must work reliably across 64 countries, multiple currencies, and diverse regulatory environments. 

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Software Development Engineers (SDEs), Front-End Engineers (FEEs), and Applied Scientists to translate the platform vision into scalable, high-quality services that simplify how employees travel, host events, and manage expenses.

data.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
data.description:
About the TeamThe team builds and operates technology that helps Walmart understand and improve its physical environments, modernize manufacturing, and support the assets that keep stores running. Its work spans digital representations and simulations of stores and supply chain facilities, IoT and automation in meat and dairy plants, and GNFR systems connecting stores, service technicians, and distribution centers. 

What You Will DoOwn Business Outcomes and Engineering Strategy· Start with operational problems: Work directly with store, energy, real estate, manufacturing, and GNFR partners to understand user workflows, operational constraints, and business priorities. Translate these into product requirements and engineering commitments. 

- Set direction and prioritize investment: Define a multi-year technology roadmap with product and business leaders. Balance new capabilities, modernization, technical debt, operational resilience, and cost; make investment tradeoffs explicit. 
 - Measure value after launch: Establish business, functional, and engineering baselines before delivery. Review adoption and realized benefits with operating teams, and use evidence to adjust priorities and solution design. 

Business and Domain ResponsibilitiesDigital Twins and Energy and Asset Intelligence· Connect Walmart's digital twins: Deliver a federated ecosystem connecting 13+ digital twins through a unified connective layer for shared simulation, standardized data, and cross-domain intelligence. Preserve domain ownership while enabling information to work across business boundaries. 

- Create a consistent operational model: Standardize the enterprise ontology for associates, products, spaces, and equipment. Define shared identifiers, relationships, and data contracts that reduce silos and shorten use-case onboarding from months to weeks. 
 - Turn simulation into operating decisions: Scale simulation for HVAC, lighting, and refrigeration energy efficiency; emergency routing; predictive equipment maintenance; and hazard detection across stores and the supply chain. Partner with business owners to validate results and incorporate them into operational workflows. 
 - Lead the technical design: Own architecture decisions for 3D engine integration, core service databases, spatial and equipment data, alarms, and event processing. Establish data freshness, interoperability, and simulation validation practices so users can trust the results. 
 - Scale efficiently: Set baselines for simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity. Improve compute and storage efficiency while maintaining the performance required by each business use case. 

Modern Manufacturing Engineering· Modernize meat and dairy operations: Direct the engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Walmart's proprietary processing and manufacturing plants. Partner with plant leaders to prioritize operational needs and sequence delivery around production requirements. 

- Connect operational data and workflows: Lead IoT and automation solutions that bring equipment and production information into usable engineering and business applications. Define integrations, data ownership, and exception handling across connected systems. 
 - Improve plant visibility and execution: Enable timely insight into equipment condition and operational exceptions. Work with manufacturing teams to reduce manual intervention and improve the reliability and efficiency of technology-supported production processes. 
 - Deliver safely into live operations: Coordinate testing, site readiness, deployment windows, training, and support with plant and operations partners. Validate changes against operational requirements and establish clear recovery and escalation procedures. 

GNFR Supply Chain and Store Asset Support· Own GNFR warehouse technology: Lead engineering and technical operations for Warehouse Management Systems across the GNFR network, with accountability for dependable inventory and fulfillment workflows. 

- Deliver OneAtlas facility rollouts: Lead technical rollout and integration across upcoming GNFR facilities. Own integration readiness, data migration validation, end-to-end testing, cutover, stabilization, and handoff to operational support. 
 - Support store asset maintenance: Enhance ordering, inventory tracking, and fulfillment of maintenance and replacement parts for commercial HVAC, refrigeration systems, fixtures, and other store assets. Improve visibility for stores and service technicians from request through fulfillment. 
 - Connect procurement and fulfillment: Modernize asset procurement, catalog management, inventory visibility, and order routing between stores, service technicians, and GNFR distribution centers. Address inconsistent data and workflow gaps that delay fulfillment or require manual coordination. 

Technical and Operational LeadershipArchitecture and Technical Depth· Own application and integration design: Guide domain modeling, service boundaries, APIs, event contracts, workflow orchestration, and data architecture across the portfolio. Make deliberate choices on scale, decoupling, extensibility, and maintainability. 

- Engage in the hardest engineering decisions: Work directly with architects and engineers on complex design and production problems. Challenge assumptions, review alternatives, and explain tradeoffs in business and technical terms. 
 - Modernize with continuity: Define incremental migration and integration strategies for existing business systems. Protect data integrity and operational continuity through compatibility planning, reconciliation, controlled rollout, and tested rollback or recovery paths. 
 - Govern data quality and access: Establish clear ownership, validation, lineage, and access controls for equipment, location, catalog, inventory, and operational event data. Partner with security and relevant business teams on privacy, security, and compliance requirements. 

Engineering Excellence and Production Ownership· Own the full development lifecycle: Set expectations for design reviews, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness. Cover integration, performance, resilience, and critical business workflows in validation. 

- Run reliable business services: Define service-level objectives and agreements that reflect operational criticality. Establish end-to-end observability across applications, integrations, and business flows, including detection of stalled or incomplete processing. 
 - Lead incident prevention and recovery: Build clear on-call ownership, runbooks, escalation paths, and recovery procedures. Review incidents with business partners, address recurring causes, and test continuity and disaster recovery plans. 
 - Improve performance and unit economics: Use telemetry, profiling, and capacity analysis to improve latency, throughput, and resource utilization. Manage cloud, storage, and software costs against the business value and workload served. 
 - Eliminate operational toil: Automate repetitive support, data validation, deployment, and recovery tasks. Measure reductions in manual effort and failure rates while retaining appropriate controls for actions affecting live operations. 

Organizational Leadership and Execution· Build and develop the organization: Design teams with clear ownership and appropriate spans and layers. Hire and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors across software, data, IoT, and systems engineering. 

- Set a high performance standard: Run consistent goal setting, coaching, calibration, promotion, and performance management. Build succession plans and strengthen both technical and people leadership. 
 - Establish execution mechanisms: Translate strategy into OKRs, milestones, dependency plans, and regular business reviews. Surface risks early, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain clear accountability for commitments and benefits. 
 - Influence across functions: Align executive stakeholders in Supply Chain, Real Estate, Store Operations, Manufacturing, Product, and Global Technology. Communicate decisions, investment needs, progress, and risks clearly to technical and business audiences. 
 - Model Walmart values: Respect the Individual, Act with Integrity, Serve our Customers and Members, and Strive for Excellence. Create an inclusive environment where associates can challenge assumptions, learn, and take ownership. 

What You Will BringMinimum Qualifications· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

- 15+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, including at least 5 years leading large-scale, multi-team engineering organizations at Director level or above. 
 - A proven record of delivering enterprise business applications and distributed systems, with experience in data integration or federation and complex cross-system workflows. 
 - Demonstrated experience in supply chain technologies, specifically Warehouse Management Systems and enterprise asset management. 
 - Experience leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors, including hiring, organization design, talent development, and performance management. 
 - Evidence of translating business problems into technical requirements and delivering measurable improvements in operational outcomes, service reliability, performance, or cost. 
 - Strong architecture and engineering judgment across APIs, event-driven systems, databases, integration patterns, and the full software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience owning production services and major modernization programs, managing cross-functional dependencies, and communicating with senior business and technology leaders. 

Preferred Qualifications· Experience architecting or operationalizing virtual stores/DC/FCs, simulation engines, enterprise ontologies, or 3D and spatial data solutions. 

- Experience with IoT, equipment telemetry, automation, or technology delivery in manufacturing or industrial environments, especially meat or dairy processing. 
 - Experience with energy management, predictive maintenance, refrigeration or HVAC systems, or technology supporting physical asset operations. 
 - Experience rolling out WMS, asset management, procurement, or related business applications across large distribution, manufacturing, or retail networks. 
 - Experience connecting enterprise applications with operational technology and managing site readiness, cutover, stabilization, and business adoption. 
 - Strong financial and technical governance acumen, including cloud infrastructure budgets, vendor decisions, performance contracts, and total cost of ownership. 

How Success Will Be MeasuredAgree baselines and targets with business owners for the scope of each initiative. Evaluate both business impact and engineering health rather than delivery volume alone. 

- Business results: Energy efficiency and asset reliability; manufacturing operational efficiency and manual effort; GNFR inventory accuracy, ordering and fulfillment cycle times, and facility rollout readiness. 
 - Digital Twin effectiveness: Use-case onboarding time, simulation adoption and validated usefulness, data freshness and quality, simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity. 
 - Engineering and organizational health: Availability, incident impact and recovery time, change quality, delivery predictability, cost efficiency, operational toil, and development of engineering talent. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

Flexible Work

Benefits

data.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross-training, and constant learning, you'll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. Be part of a mission-critical team to protect the data that drives businesses across the world. 

As a Front End Software Engineer, you will be an individual contributor focused on delivering features with high quality, along with continuous quality improvements with the help of automation. Working on the UI, you'll be expected to coordinate with Product Management and User Experience team on the mock-ups as well as with the backend engineers on the interfaces and end-to-end testing. There will be a large variety of features to work on including: distributed and parallel data flows, cloud services, asynchronous programming, performance optimization, infinite scalability, snapshots, resiliency, multiple protocols, and fault tolerance. 

We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management. 

How You'll Spend Your Time Here

As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web-scale. You'll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity's hyper-converged, highly-scalable storage clusters. 

WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING

- 2+ years of developing and troubleshooting UI in large scale distributed systems

 - Strong understanding of UX and UI design principles
