data.title: Software Development Engineer, CAM
data.description:
Description

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems. 

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. 

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands - customer obsession is part of our company DNA. 

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business. 

We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. 

If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!

Work/Life Balance

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e. g. , system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc. ). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team's software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Design Verification Engineering
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Analog Devices is seeking Digital Design Principal Verification Engineer, who will be responsible for design verification of highly integrated solutions and products in a multifunctional team. You will be working on driving real revenue growth on the next generation of Intelligence at the Edge products across multiple products and business units. 

About ADI: 

Analog Devices, Inc. is a leading global high-performance analog technology company dedicated to solving our customers' most complex engineering challenges. We play a critical role at the intersection of the physical and digital world by providing the building blocks to sense, measure, interpret, connect, and power devices and systems. We design, manufacture, test, and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including integrated circuits (ICs), software and subsystems that leverage high-performance analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing technologies. We embrace a culture of innovation and collaboration to push the state of the art. 

About The Role

Lead design verification team for SOC or subsystem design pre silicon verification. The candidate will be responsible for formulating verification strategies, Define verification architecture, Flow, Methodology and leading, driving and completing verification of large integrated products. As a senior team member, it is expected that he/she will lead and influence verification methodologies within both DBU and ADI. The candidate is also encouraged to participate in cross company technical initiatives as well as patent and publish work where possible. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end SoC verification for complex digital SoCs, driving execution from planning to signoff. 
 - Verify complex microprocessor-based designs, AI/ML accelerators, and high-speed peripherals using advanced verification methodologies. 
 - Define and drive team execution by planning tasks, tracking progress, and providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to define requirements and align on verification deliverables and dependencies. 
 - Drive pre-silicon readiness by aligning with emulation, FPGA, and software teams to cover post-silicon validation scenarios early. 
 - Develop and execute end-to-end system-level use cases for comprehensive functional validation. 
 - Architect and implement scalable UVM-based testbenches, DV flows, and methodologies. 
 - Define and review test plans; ensure closure of functional and code coverage across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Work cross-functionally with emulation, FPGA, firmware, and system teams to ensure full-system correctness. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques for IP and subsystem-level validation. 
 - Lead NoC/interconnect verification and ensure robust data flow across the SoC. 
 - Perform performance verification and system-level analysis across real-world use cases. 
 - Drive innovation in verification strategies to meet aggressive schedules and quality goals. 
 - Define overall verification strategy based on product requirements and design specifications, leveraging modern techniques such as formal, emulation, portable stimulus, and virtual platforms. 

Requirements

- B. Tech/M. Tech with 12+ years of experience in digital pre-silicon verification, including leadership across IP, subsystem, or SoC-level DV. 
 - Strong understanding of SoC/Subsystem architectures with hands-on expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbench development, debugging, and methodology implementation. 
 - Proven track record in verification closure using functional and code coverage metrics across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 - Expertise in NoC, bus, and interconnect verification, along with coverage analysis and optimization. 
 - Experience in architecting scalable testbench environments and defining robust DV flows and methodologies. 
 - Strong background in power-aware verification (UPF), including power analysis and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with formal verification, including flow definition, connectivity, and functional property checking. 
 - Solid protocol knowledge and verification experience across high-speed and low-speed interfaces such as I2C, SPI, Ethernet, UART, AXI/AHB, DMA, and SVI3. 
 - Experience in security and safety verification, ensuring compliance with secure design and functional safety requirements. 
 - Familiarity with gate-level simulations with timing annotation (GLS). 
 - Strong expertise in test planning, constrained-random verification, assertions, and transaction-level modeling. 
 - Good understanding of processor-based systems (ARM, RISC-V, Tensilica), AI/ML accelerators, and proficiency in C/C++, SystemC, and scripting (Python/TCL/Shell). 
 - Exposure to mixed-signal/analog verification (ADC/DAC/PLL/PHY) is a plus. 
 - Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams and drive verification innovation. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies

As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process.

data.title: Principle DFT Engineer
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

As a part of the Connectivity BU DFT team the suitable candidate will work on all aspects of DFT in products catering to the networking domain: DFT architecture and Testability strategy, Flow, Implementation, Verification and post-Si bring up. 

Marvell's Connectivity Business Unit is the industry-leading provider of high-speed connectivity solutions powering the full range of network infrastructure - from the optics of AI GPU boards to top-of-rack optical fibers and active copper cables in data centers and their fabrics. The BU spans multiple cutting-edge product lines, including Optical Digital Signal Processing (ODSP), Active Electrical Cable (AEC), and Coherent Digital Signal Processing (CDSP), delivering solutions to enterprise, data center, service providers, and cloud customers worldwide. 

You'll work closely and mentor other DFT team members for DFT features Implementation, Integration and Verification in SoC. You will also have close interaction with Logic Design/Physical design/STA/ATE teams as needed. 

What You Can Expect

- Define and drive the DFT architecture and test strategy for complex IPs and SoCs, ensuring robust testability and alignment with product quality, coverage, and manufacturability goals. 
 - Lead the implementation and integration of Scan, ATPG, JTAG, MBIST, and Boundary Scan (BSCAN) solutions, ensuring compliance with IEEE 1149. 1/1149. 6 standards. 
 - Develop and deploy DFT features including test structures, IP-level DFT integration, ATPG fault models, test point insertion, coverage optimization, scan insertion, and MBIST implementation at both block and chip levels. 
 - Own and execute hierarchical DFT flows across the design hierarchy, from individual IPs through full-chip integration. 
 - Implement, validate, and debug DFT/DFX features, ensuring seamless integration with the overall SoC architecture. 
 - Generate and validate production test patterns, perform RTL and netlist verification, execute gate-level simulations (zero-delay and SDF-based), and ensure comprehensive test-mode validation. 
 - Develop and maintain test timing constraints, including SDC creation, test-mode timing analysis, and support for block- and chip-level STA signoff activities. 
 - Utilize industry-standard EDA tools for Scan, ATPG, MBIST, and JTAG implementation, verification, and debug. 
 - Collaborate closely with Design, Synthesis, Physical Design, STA, Validation, and Silicon Bring-up teams to resolve DFT-related issues and ensure successful project execution. 
 - Drive Post-Silicon bring-up, ATE debug, silicon characterization, and production ramp-up activities, enabling efficient silicon validation and productization. 
 - Own DFT deliverables throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring successful execution from architecture definition through tape out, silicon validation, and manufacturing release. 
 - Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, and technical leadership to ensure successful tape out and post-silicon ramp-up of the project. 

What We're Looking For

- Master's degree and/or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related fields with 12+ years of experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering or related fields and 14+ years of related professional experience. 
 - Hands on working experience in various stages of DFT-Execution, SCAN-Insertion/MBIST/ATPG/Validation/STA/IP-DFX/Post-Silicon Bring up/Debug 
 - Thorough knowledge on various DFT/Test architecture solutions and should be involved in DFT-Architecture definition of at-least couple of Designs. 
 - Strong fundamentals in Digital Circuit Design and Logic Design is required
 - Understanding of DFT Flows and Methodologies and Experience with Cadence/Mentor/Synopsys Tool set (Genus, Modus, NCSim/DC, Tessent, Spyglass/Tmax) 
 - Proven experience leading DFT activities, including technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding DFT engineers, driving successful execution across multiple projects and enabling team scalability. 
 - Experience owning complete DFT responsibility for one or more successful chip tapeouts, ensuring delivery of high-quality test solutions meeting coverage, quality, and schedule targets. 
 - Good scripting skills in Perl and Tcl for flow automation is a plus

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

data.title: Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service

Overview and Context

As part of the Network Products business unit, the Next Generation Network Team is at the heart of Mastercard's transformation, driving innovation and modernization to ensure the network remains resilient, flexible, and competitive in a rapidly evolving payments landscape. 

This team is responsible for building Mastercard's next-generation unified switch and access capabilities, designed to handle all payment and related data flows across transaction types and payment schemes. 

Within Next Gen Network, the Network Expansion team is driving Product Development for a new product named "Switching as a Service" (SwaaS), which opens a new business model in which Mastercard leverages its next-generation platform to switch domestic payment schemes according to their rules, interchange, and settlement, hosted and operated by Mastercard. 

Network Products has signed its first large and strategic SwaaS contract and needs to grow its Product Development team to manage its design, build, and run activities. 

Role Summary

This VP role will lead a team having Product Development accountability for the Core Switching and Data-related services of the SwaaS. The role will ensure delivery of this scope according to the contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions. 

Given the large scope and complexity of SwaaS, this individual will partner closely with a large network of actors, such as: other SwaaS Product Development team members managing other parts of the SwaaS, Avanti project management structure, representative from Product and Engineering of each contributing program, Regional lead driving the on-soil relationship with the SwaaS customer and providing product management and GTM role, Customer delivery, Global Customer Care, Security, Network, etc. 

The individual will also have direct relationship with representatives from the SwaaS customer team to ensure full alignment between their expectations and our solutioning while protecting Mastercard's interest and goals. This SwaaS project spread across multiple time zones. 

The role demands a strong product mindset, drive, structure, organization, technical acumen across the scope, and will require a high degree of collaboration across technical, customer-facing, and other stakeholder teams to bring the first SwaaS implementation to home. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the Product Development team in charge of the Core Switching and Data-related capabilities of the SwaaS product from intake through elaboration, execution, build, and run. 
 - Within the SwaaS governance, provide regular & detailed reporting, stay ahead in risk management, and ensure that the resources allocated to SwaaS execution are rightly used in partnership with PMO's and Finance. 
 - Own delivery of the allocated scope and coordinate with Product Management and Engineering teams to meet contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions. 
 - Ensure the integrity and consistency of SwaaS delivery across vision, capabilities, scalability, performance, speed-to-market, readiness for growth, and reusability. 
 - Build and maintain detailed functional and technical understanding of the delivered platform, including requirements, use cases, architecture, dependencies, interfaces, data flows, runtime operations, support strategies, and maintenance needs. 
 - Drive stakeholder alignment across the SwaaS ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Franchise, Global Customer Delivery, Privacy, and other contributing teams. 
 - Lead by example with a hands-on approach, demonstrate product management excellence, and share best practices. 
 - Apply logic, reasoning, and sound decision-making to develop solutions with all teams. Clarify concepts and build a shared understanding of what will ultimately be delivered. 
 - Define capabilities that enhance the Next Gen platform, respect the platform strategy and principles, and ensure platform integrity. 
 - Support other SwaaS Product team members to ensure collective success. Replicate knowledge, share workload across initiatives, provide mutual backup, and help the team scale, learn, and expand its scope. 
 - Establish product development discipline in the team, including clear methods, structure, content standards, reliable execution, and high-quality on-time contributions. 
 - Recruit, develop, and retain high-performance team while fostering a culture of execution, accountability, and innovation. 
 - Identify opportunities for leveraging AI to improve speed, efficiency and quality. 

All About You

- Fluent in English
 - 10+ years of product development or product management experience in complex, geographically distributed environments
 - Experience managing and developing teams. People leader. 
 - Executive-level stakeholder management and influence in a matrixed organization
 - Expected to bring a strong execution mindset, sound judgment, and practical problem-solving skills
 - Strong technical foundation required to understand complex platform capabilities, dependencies, and delivery risks
 - Prior experience in payments and/or fintech is required; experience with card processing systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, is preferred
 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment across product and engineering teams, including dependency management
 - Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities
 - Strong problem solver who can navigate complexity, unblock teams, and identify alternative paths to deliver the outcomes
 - Strong experience with complex technical products and customer integration planning is a plus
 - Excellent analytical, organizational, and workstream management skills
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate problem statements, frame options and trade-off, and engage internal and external stakeholders clearly. 
 - Customer-facing experience is preferred
 - Ability to work with ambiguity and manage complex projects in fast-paced environments
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently and with minimal day-to-day supervision
 - Ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders, internal teams, and external clients
 - Flexibility to work with multiple time zones

Location: Pune only

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer (GoLang, Kubernetes Operators, CRD)
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

To be successful in this role you have: 

- You will own the design and delivery of significant components and core subsystems of our Kubernetes platform-for example secrets and certificate management, workload identity, storage, or cluster networking-from design through production operation. 
 - You will take a loosely defined platform problem and turn it into a design, a plan, and shipped software, with limited scaffolding from others. 
 - You will contribute to the architecture of distributed workloads running on the platform, working with the teams who depend on it to get the runtime and isolation model right. 
 - You will spend most of your time hands-on in code-operators and controllers, infrastructure automation, and platform services-and in the reviews that keep their quality high. 
 - You will own the operability of what you build: SLOs, failure modes, upgrade and migration paths, and on-call for your own systems. 
 - You will partner with senior staff and principal engineers to keep your work aligned with the wider platform architecture, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers. 
 - You will help us run a platform that serves regulated markets, where compliance constraints including FedRAMP shape design choices. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

- Built and operated Kubernetes platform infrastructure in production before, at meaningful scale-not just consumed it. You can point to specific subsystems you designed, shipped, and then supported through real incidents and upgrade cycles. 
 - 8+ years building production software, including solid experience operating distributed systems.

data.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. 

Overview

Job Description

Corporate Reliability Engineering is advancing an engineering-first model focused on reliability, automation, quality, security, and proactive operations. This hands-on I5 role will work directly with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and adjacent engineering and operations teams to design, build, test, deploy, and support secure AI, agentic automation, API, and reliability solutions across enterprise Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Network environments. 

The engineer will convert recurring operational issues into maintainable, auditable, and production-ready solutions that reduce manual effort, accelerate diagnosis and resolution, strengthen service resilience, and deliver measurable operational outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver AI/ML applications, LLM-enabled solutions, RAG, agentic workflows, automation frameworks, APIs, integrations, and reusable engineering components. 
 - Build intelligent capabilities for incident triage, knowledge retrieval, service-health analysis, root-cause investigation, remediation recommendations, and approved automated execution. 
 - Automate workflows across Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database/EBS, and Network operations through scripting, orchestration, event-driven patterns, and secure API integrations. 
 - Integrate with approved enterprise ticketing, monitoring, CMDB, knowledge, database, collaboration, source-control, and deployment platforms
 - Engineer for reliability through testing, exception handling, rollback, observability, telemetry, runbooks, support models, operational handoff, and measurable service outcomes. 
 - Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, architecture, operations, and product teams and communicate technical decisions, risks, controls, and outcomes clearly

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Professional Attributes

- Work as an embedded engineering partner with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and Reliability Engineering teams to understand operational needs and deliver practical, supportable solutions. 
 - Build trusted relationships with subject matter experts, product owners, operations teams, and global stakeholders; actively listen, incorporate feedback, and align teams around shared outcomes. 
 - Demonstrate a team-first mindset by sharing knowledge, documenting solutions, mentoring peers, supporting collective problem-solving, and contributing to a respectful and inclusive engineering culture. 
 - Combine strong technical depth with professionalism, humility, adaptability, accountability, and sound judgment when leading discussions or responding to operational challenges. 
 - Communicate technical concepts, risks, design choices, and business impacts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Operate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and balance speed, reliability, security, governance, teamwork, and customer impact. 

Visa Governance, Security & Responsible AI Expectations

- Follow Visa policies, Key Controls, Technical and Design Security Requirements, approved architecture standards, and the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Apply secure coding and participate in code review, security assessment, dependency and open-source review, vulnerability remediation, security testing, and required release approvals before production promotion. 
 - Protect Visa information according to its classification and approved handling requirements. Use approved platforms and data sources, enforce least-privilege access, protect credentials and secrets, and prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, retention, or transmission. 
 - Implement traceability through authenticated access, change records, version control, event logging, monitoring, evidence retention, documented ownership, and support procedures. 
 - Apply Visa AI governance requirements across the lifecycle, including defined ownership, risk assessment, data-use review, validation, ongoing monitoring, documented limitations, escalation paths, and controlled retirement or material change. 
 - Design human oversight and approval gates appropriate to risk. Automated actions must remain within approved permissions and guardrails, with safe failure handling, rollback, and manual intervention paths. 
 - Validate generative and agentic AI solutions for quality, reliability, security, privacy, information integrity, and operational risk; document evaluation methods, acceptance criteria, evidence, limitations, and monitoring. 
 - Escalate security incidents, privacy concerns, control gaps, model risks, unexpected AI behavior, and policy exceptions through approved Visa processes. 

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, automation engineering, AI/ML engineering, agentic systems, reliability engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles. 
 - Hands-on experience using Claude Code, GitHub, Copilot, Power automate
 - Hands-on experience developing maintainable applications, scripts, APIs, integrations, automations, or workflow-based solutions in enterprise IT environments. 
 - Proficiency in Python and one or more of PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus experience with Git, testing, debugging, APIs, and CI/CD. 
 - Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agent frameworks, tools or function calling, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, technical judgment, ownership, adaptability, and clear written and verbal communication. 
 - Experience integrating with ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, monitoring platforms, or enterprise support data. 
 - Experience in reliability engineering, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, operational automation, release validation, or controlled deployment. 
 - Ability to define measurable outcomes such as reduced manual effort, higher automation success, faster analysis, fewer repeat issues, stronger traceability, and improved service reliability. 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Title And Summary

PMT - Product Validation Lead

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Product Management Technical professional to lead product validation and payment-domain outcomes. The role connects customer and business needs with engineering delivery, test coverage, and release acceptance. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Own the vision, working-backwards narrative, and measurable outcomes for assigned capabilities. 
 - Translate customer, operational, and business needs into prioritized features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Make and communicate trade-off recommendations across scope, depth, timelines, risk, and technical investment.

 - Maintain clear product documentation and use production or validation metrics as feedback into the backlog. 
 - Identify feature-level delivery or customer risks and drive prioritization and resolution. 
 - Define validation strategy for authorization, clearing, tokenization, ISO 8583, and ISO 20022 payment flows. 
 - Support defect triage and confirm that resolved behavior meets payment-processing requirements. 
 - Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams. 

Essential Skills

- Experience in technical product management, product ownership, business analysis, or payment-product validation. 
 - Knowledge of payment transaction flows and message standards such as ISO 8583 and ISO 20022. 
 - Ability to work with engineers and architects on APIs, data models, non-functional requirements, and operational behavior. 
 - Data-driven decision-making and strong product documentation skills.

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Experience applying AI-driven product validation to improve efficiency, expand coverage, and identify defects earlier in the development lifecycle. 
 - Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

If you're energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we'd be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET'S GO!

ᅠ

Your New Role: 

The Senior Principal, System Architecture reports to the VP Engineering, Converged AdTech & Linear Systems and leads the architecture for WBD's most critical advertising technology platforms. This role owns and drives the systems automation architecture of core adtech platforms to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across the ecosystem. This role is accountable for the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of systems spanning converged planning, linear and digital advertising, scheduling, and affiliate distribution. By architecting the platform rationalization, cloud migration, and next-generation AI/ML-enabled capabilities, the Principal ensures WBD's ad-tech stack is positioned to maximize monetization, enable automation, and deliver premium advertising experiences across all platforms. 

Your Role Accountabilities: 

AI‐Driven & Agentic Systems Automation

Define and drive the long-term architecture for AI-powered and agentic systems across large-scale AdTech platforms. 

- Architect autonomous and human-in-the-loop systems for deployment orchestration, infrastructure lifecycle, and incident response
 - Establish guardrails for safe, observable, and governed AI adoption (reliability, explainability, failure handling)
 - Integrate AI capabilities into core platform layers (decisioning, optimization, experimentation, operations)
 - Drive standardization of agentic workflows across engineering and operationsExpectation: redefines how systems are built and operated using AI and not just adds features. 

Platform Architecture & System Engineering

Own the design and evolution of foundational platforms with strong system engineering principles. 

- Define architecture for core platforms (AdOps automation, optimization, identity, data, measurement, activation) with clear boundaries and contracts
 - Apply system engineering rigor across reliability, scalability, fault isolation, and performance under extreme load
 - Establish patterns for multi-region, high-availability, and disaster-resilient systems
 - Drive platform standardization to reduce fragmentation and improve developer velocityExpectation: builds platforms that are resilient, composable, and operable at scale. 

Enterprise System Evolution & Convergence
Lead transformation of fragmented systems into a cohesive, converged AdTech ecosystem (linear + digital). 

- Identify systemic bottlenecks across latency, data consistency, and cross-platform dependencies
 - Drive simplification of system topology and elimination of redundant architectures
 - Lead large-scale modernization (monolith → services, siloed systems → shared platforms)
 - Ensure seamless interoperability across legacy and next-gen systems  Expectation: reduces long-term complexity while enabling scale and agility. 

Technology Strategy & Architectural Leadership

Shape the long-term technology direction and elevate architectural capability across the organization. 

- Evaluate emerging technologies (streaming, distributed systems, AI infra, Agentic AI, privacy tech) for strategic adoption
 - Mentor Principal engineers and architects on system design and trade-offs
 - Establish architectural governance and decision frameworksExpectation: builds both systems and the people who design them. 

Technical Authority & Execution Influence
Act as the highest-level technical authority across critical initiatives. 

- Review and approve architecture for high-impact, high-risk systems
 - Influence execution across orgs without direct authority
 - Intervene in complex programs to de-risk delivery and ensure architectural integrity
 - Align engineering, product, and business stakeholders on critical trade-offsExpectation: drives decisions that materially impact system and business outcomes

Qualifications & Experience
 - Systems Architecture Leadership: 15+ years of experience architecting and scaling enterprise-grade data platforms, with a proven track record in large-scale ingestion, transformation, and activation pipelines. 
 - Automation Expertise: Experience automating high‐availability, high‐throughput production environments, leveraging AI and agentic architectures. 
 - Distributed Data Expertise: Advanced knowledge of open data Lakehouse formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), distributed compute frameworks (Spark, Flink, Presto), and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

Role: 

Payments is one of the highest stakes domains at StarRez. When a student pays their housing fees, or an institution reconciles a semester of revenue, the transaction must be correct, traceable, and secure, every time. There is no acceptable margin for a payment that is taken twice, refunded to the wrong account, or lost between our platform and a payment provider. As a Senior Quality Engineer on the Payments team, you will own quality for the systems that process card and bank payments, integrate with payment gateways and providers, and handle authorisation, capture, settlement, refunds, and chargebacks. You will be the person on the team with the deepest understanding of how money moves through our platform, the happy paths, the failure modes, and the states in between. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in Hyderabad, working within a globally distributed engineering organisation spanning India, Australia, the UK and the United States. 

You will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for your team, do the work to hold it, and coach the engineers, product managers and designers around you to share ownership of it. You will report to the Director of Quality and work day-to-day with your team's Engineering Manager, Product Manager and engineers, alongside Support and Implementation Services when payment issues reach customers. 

What You Will Own: 

- Own the end-to-end test strategy within your team's area, deciding how things get tested based on the risk each change carries. 
 - Design validation for payment flows including authorisation, capture, settlement, partial and full refunds, failed and retried transactions, chargebacks, idempotency, and reconciliation between our records and the provider's. 
 - Coach and support your team to make of quality everyone's responsibility, and provide hands on support via executing testing activities when required 
 - Validate integrations with third party payment gateways and providers. 
 - Engage from discovery and refinement onward: challenge assumptions, surface missing scenarios, and make sure acceptance criteria are specific and testable before a story is picked up. 
 - Assess your team's current quality maturity honestly, build a plan to lift it over the next two to three quarters, and share what you learn with Senior QAs on other teams facing the same gaps. 
 - Coach engineers on testing principles, test design, and shared ownership of automated tests, the goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it. 
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers on risk assessment, automation, observability and shift left practice. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline health and deployment quality gates: test suite selection, environment readiness, pre and post deploy checks, and safe release strategies including feature flags and staged rollout. 
 - Own production defect triage for Payments: assess customer and financial impact, distinguish severity from priority, drive fixes at the right urgency, follow through to root cause & prevention, and provide regular updates on defect remediation. 
 - Represent Payments quality in incident reviews and, where needed, in conversations with Support and customer facing teams. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years in quality engineering or software engineering with a deep focus on quality, in complex distributed system environments. 
 - Hands on experience testing web-based SaaS products across various levels; front-end, backend, and end to end functional flows. 
 - Experience with transactional or financially sensitive systems, payments, billing, banking, e-commerce checkout, ledger or reconciliation systems, or similar. You understand why correctness, idempotency and auditability matter more here than elsewhere. 
 - Experience contributing to test automation frameworks and using and have a solid understanding of the testing pyramid. 
 - Practical experience working with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness checks. 
 - Ability to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios in collaboration with cross functional teams. 
 - Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills across complex, multi system failures. 
 - Excellent technical communication, you influence engineers, product managers and business stakeholders through evidence and expertise rather than authority. 
 - Practical experience using AI in modern software development, with sound judgement about where it helps and where it does not. 
 - Genuine curiosity about product architecture, customer workflows, and the business impact of engineering decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing payment gateway or provider integrations (e. g. Stripe, or similar). 
 - Familiarity with payment rail nuances, ACH, SEPA, BACS, or card networks, and how timing and compliance rules affect testing. 
 - Exposure to feature flag based or staged rollout strategies for releasing payment features safely. 
 - Experience validating reconciliation between internal records and a provider's settlement data. 

Reasons to join our team: 

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
 - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
 - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
 - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions. 
 - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Engineer – Controls System
data.description:
The Control System - Software Engineer will be part of the Controls & Automation Engineering team and will contribute to the development, implementation, testing, and commissioning of control system software for power plants, rotating equipment, and industrial processes. 

The selected candidate will work alongside senior engineers to design and program control logic, develop HMI applications, perform system validation, and support commissioning activities at site. 

This role requires strong analytical skills, a solid foundation in automation/control software development, and the ability to collaborate effectively in multi-disciplinary and global engineering environments. 

Essential Responsibilities

- Develop and implement control logic for DCS/PLC/RTU-based systems. 
 - Configure and program function blocks, sequential logic, interlocks, and protection schemes. 
 - Support development of HMI/SCADA applications including graphics, trends, alarms, and operator functions. 
 - Assist in converting control philosophies, narratives, and logic diagrams into control software. 
 - Prepare and maintain software-related engineering documents such as: 
 - Control block diagrams
 - Sequence of operations
 - I/O assignment lists
 - Signal interfaces and mapping documents
 - Alarm and event lists
 - Participate in system design reviews and provide inputs for P&IDs and cause‐and‐effect matrices. 
 - Perform offline and real-time simulation/testing of control logic. 
 - Assist in preparing and executing Software FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests). 
 - Troubleshoot logic, communication, or interface issues during testing cycles. 
 - Validate feedback, alarms, setpoints, and interlocks with instrumentation and process teams. 
 - Support on-site commissioning activities, including: 
 - I/O checks and loop testing
 - Control logic validation
 - HMI testing
 - System tuning and troubleshooting
 - Assist in Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and support start-up teams during initial operation. 
 - Coordinate with instrumentation, electrical, and process engineering teams for system integration. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams and support multi-site project execution. 
 - Identify opportunities for software improvement, standardization, and coding efficiency. 
Qualifications/Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or related discipline. 
 - Minimum 3+ years of experience in control system software development (DCS/PLC/SCADA). 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major control platform (e. g. , Siemens, ABB, Schneider, Emerson, Allen-Bradley, GE, etc. ). 
 - Strong understanding of industrial control systems, logic design, and communication protocols (e. g. , Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP). 
 - Good knowledge of automation standards, control loops, and system interfaces. 
 - Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal). 
 - Ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams and support global engineering environments. 
 - Willingness to travel occasionally for FAT, commissioning, and site support. 

Desired Characteristics

- Experience with rotating equipment, turbines, or process plant controls is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with safety instrumented systems (SIS) or safety logic (SIL) is a plus. 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Ability to work independently with a proactive and responsible attitude. 
 - Adaptability to changing priorities and project needs. 
 - Team-oriented and committed to transparent communication and collaboration. 

Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries. 

At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

data.title: Staff Cyber Defense Engineer (SOC Lead) – Automation & AI
data.description:
We are seeking a visionary Lead Cyber Defense Monitoring Engineer to direct our transition toward an AI-driven, agentic Security Operations Center (SOC). Unlike a traditional analyst or leadership role, this position requires a hands-on engineering mindset. In addition to overseeing daily SOC operations, you will actively look for opportunities to improve processes, architect and govern complex automation scripts, and lead the team in the development of automated playbooks. This role is the cornerstone for bridging core cyber defense operations with modern automation, machine learning, and engineering practices. 

As the Lead, you will define the automation roadmap, mentor senior engineers, serve as the Incident Commander during critical breaches, and pioneer the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and data science into our overarching defense strategy. 

Key Responsibilities

Automation, AI & Agentic SOC Strategy

- Translate the organization's strategic roadmap into actionable team goals. Ensure the team successfully deploys and scales AI-driven autonomous agents capable of performing triage, context gathering, and initial containment. 
 - Oversee the team's automation deliverables and SOAR integrations. Enforce coding standards, manage the peer-review pipeline for Python/REST API scripts, and ensure strict team adherence to Detection as Code (DaC) CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Direct the daily work of the engineering and analyst teams. Foster an engineering-first culture by ensuring staff receive the training and guidance needed to upskill in prompt engineering, script writing, and modern data practices. 
 - Supervise the team's application of data analytics and machine learning models to enterprise security datasets, ensuring their work results in high-fidelity alerting and a reduction in false positives. 
 - Hold the team accountable for key performance indicators (KPIs) related to automation efficacy. Ensure the team consistently optimizes SOC workflows to drastically reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR). 

Consolidated Cyber Defense Leadership

- Serve as the Incident Commander for major security events and high-severity breaches, orchestrating the response efforts of your team and coordinating with executive leadership. 
 - Supervise overarching threat hunting and intelligence programs. Ensure the team actively takes novel threats and APT behaviors discovered during hunts and operationalizes them into automated detections. 
 - Manage the holistic health and integration of the core security stack (SIEM, EDR, NDR, Cloud Security), ensuring your team maintains maximum ROI and data quality for the AI engines. 

Qualifications & Skills

- 7+ years of progressive experience in a SOC, Incident Response, or Security Engineering environment, with 2+ years of direct supervisory or team lead experience overseeing technical staff. 
 - Strong conceptual understanding of applied machine learning in cybersecurity, LLM orchestration frameworks, and data pipelines to effectively manage and evaluate the engineering team's output. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of adversary tactics (MITRE ATT&CK), network architecture, and forensic analysis, coupled with proven experience leading technical incident response under pressure. 
 - Strong familiarity with the capabilities and governance of enterprise SOAR platforms (e. g. , Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Torq, or Tines) to effectively guide team deliverables. 
 - BA/BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Security (non-tech degrees acceptable with appropriate levels of Information Security job experience and/or certifications)
 - Advanced security, engineering, or leadership certifications such as GSE, GCIA, GCFA, CISSP, AWS Certified Security / Machine Learning, or SANS SEC573/SEC540/MGT512. 

CME Group: Where Futures are Made

CME Group is the world's leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it - all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we're looking for more. 

At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone's perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.

data.title: Software Engineer Manager, Search Platforms, Search
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software development. 
 - 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems. 
 - 3 years of experience in a people management and 2 years of experience in a technical leadership role. 
 - Experience with Java, C++, or both. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field. 
 - 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization. 
 - Passion for technology, collaboration, and solving challenging problems. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information - any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

- Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals, aligning strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. 
 - Establish clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. 
 - Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap within the scope of your often multiple teams, evolving it to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs. 
 - Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems. 
 - Demonstrate AI fluency, and be prepared to discuss your knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process.

data.description:
Job Title : Lead Verification Engineer

Location : Bangalore/Chennai/Nashik

Job Description: 

We are seeking a technically strong and quality-driven Lead Verification Engineer to lead the test strategy and execution for embedded automation platforms in Surface Drilling systems. You will be responsible for designing and implementing automated test frameworks, validating real-time control systems, and ensuring seamless integration across hardware-software interfaces. 

This role is central to Epiroc's automation roadmap, supporting the development of brand-agnostic, interoperable platforms that enable autonomous operations across global mining fleets. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead verification strategy for embedded control systems in Surface Drilling projects. 
 - Develop automated test frameworks using Python, Robot Framework, and Pytest. 
 - Drive system-level validation for real-time, safety-critical applications. 
 - Collaborate across teams to ensure testability, RTM traceability, and product quality. 
 - Lead defect management, continuous improvement, and own key verification artifacts. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote best practices in test automation and quality. 
 - Drive AI-assisted verification to validate autonomous and intelligent control functions. 
 - Define and report verification metrics such as pass rate, test coverage, and defect trends. 

Required Skills and Qualifications: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or Computer Science. 

Technical Skills: 

- 8-12 years of experience in software verification and automation for embedded systems. 
 - Hands-on experience in HiL, FAT, and SAT across lab, factory, and site environments. 
 - Proficient in Python, Robot Framework, Selenium, and test automation libraries. 
 - Experience in system validation for real-time or industrial control systems. 
 - Strong understanding of communication protocols: CAN, UDS, J1939, LIN, Ethernet. 
 - Excellent analytical, debugging, and communication skills. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted testing, Jira, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, ALM traceability. 
 - Strong system knowledge with the ability to derive and interpret system requirements. 
 - Knowledge of machine electrification and autonomous machine systems. 
 - Good programming skills in Python and CAPL, with basic knowledge of C and C++. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience in mining, construction, or automotive control systems. 
 - ISTQB Test Certifications & Agile certifications (Scrum Master, Product Owner). 
 - Knowledge of AUTOSAR, ADAS, sensor fusion, computer vision, OTA, and SDV. 
 - Exposure to functional safety and cybersecurity (e. g. , ISO 26262, CRA). 
 - International work experience with the ability to collaborate across global teams. 
 - Exposure to Agentic AI-based test automation and traceability. 
 - Familiarity with simulation-driven validation, virtual test environments, and digital twins. 

Soft Skills: 

- Self-driven with a strong curiosity to learn and explore new ideas. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. 
 - Attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality results. 

What We Offer: 

- Competitive Salary and Benefits: Enjoy a rewarding compensation package tailored to your expertise. 
 - Global career opportunities across Epiroc's worldwide network. 
 - Epiroc University for continuous learning and competence development. 
 - Innovative projects that shape the future of automation and sustainability. 
 - Hybrid work culture supporting flexibility, collaboration, and well-being. 
 - Inclusive environment built on trust, innovation, and teamwork. 

Why You Should Apply: 

- This role places you at the heart of automation programs, where your verification expertise will shape safe, reliable next-generation machine solutions. 
 - Work at the intersection of AI, autonomy, and validation engineering to help build safer, smarter, and more sustainable mining solutions for Surface Drilling. 
 - Collaborate globally to align verification, integration, and delivery across teams and sites. 
 - Support team growth by strengthening verification practices and promoting structured technical problem-solving. 

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support. 

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www. epiroc. com

Job Description

WSP's Resources subsector, part of our Energy, Resources & Industry (ERI) business line, supports mining and heavy industrial clients across Canada. Our teams deliver engineering and project execution excellence across the full project lifecycle-from conceptual studies and detailed design to commissioning, optimization, and beyond. 

This is your opportunity to shape high-impact infrastructure, drive innovation in automation and process control, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams delivering transformative outcomes across Canada and globally. 

Based in Noida office, as an Instrumentation & Control (I&C) Engineer, you will support instrumentation and controls engineering for both new construction and brownfield mining, metals and other heavy industrial projects, influencing project outcomes from concept through completion. Your work will help our clients operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. 

Responsibilities

The I&C Engineer shall have experience in Detailed Engineering Design and Consultancy in sectors such as Oil & gas, Bulk Material Handling, Crushers, Grinding Mills. Experience in Power Plant, Coal Grinding, Cement industry will be an added advantage and will be responsible for the following minimum services: 

- Prepare control philosophy, system architecture, and functional specifications for complex process systems
 - Coordination with other engineers internally, CA team leads and deliver the output as per the project schedule. 
 - Ensure that all deliverables are complying project & client requirements

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.

data.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world.
