If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

The Accounts Payable Manager will oversee and participate in all aspects of the accounts payable function across multiple legal entities, including processing vendor bills with accurate general ledger coding, approving employee expense reports, managing timely vendor payments, processing pass-through project expenses in accordance with customer contracts, and performing intercompany payable processing, while supervising the day-to-day work of a team of accounts payable specialists. 

The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for deploying best practices to improve the quality of processes, maintaining electronic supporting records, ensuring compliance with Group accounting and purchasing processes, and delivering on vendor satisfaction and key reporting metrics. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

- Directly supervise a team of accounts payable specialists, providing daily direction on delegated vendor assignments, managing and assigning incoming vendor bills and email distributions, training on systems and procedures, and evaluating job performance
 - Maintain compliance, accuracy, and speed with strategic AP direction for efficiencies, synergies, and automation, ensuring strict adherence to the delegation of authority workflow and achievement of key performance indicators applicable to Accounts Payable
 - Manage international, multicurrency, and intercompany vendors, recording vendor bills in the proper legal entities in accordance with intercompany posting policies set by Controllers
 - Manage general ledger coding in accordance with ERP system and Group accounting policies for prepaids, fixed assets, accruals, and inventory and accrual management
 - Oversee compliance of out-of-pocket/pass-through expense management and intercompany processes, including accurate and timely bill coding, reading contracts, obtaining project manager approvals, and retaining supporting files for multiple contracting entities
 - Support Finance's Accounts Receivable invoicing process related to customer contracts, and support the maintenance of systems that affect vendor bill coding, expense approval workflows, and process improvements
 - Oversee expense report processing in multiple ERP systems in accordance with Group travel compliance policies, and support maintenance of related systems affecting expense report approval workflows and employee changes
 - Support the purchase order process with procurement and supply chain teams, including purchase order workflow approvals and vendor bill matched receipts within an ERP system
 - Propose payments in accordance with Group treasury policies, using banking software for multiple legal entities and currencies
 - Maintain an organized electronic filing system for paperless and mailed vendor bills, purchase order approval support, and payment support
 - Respond to vendor inquiries and internal requests in a timely manner, work collaboratively with internal teams across multiple entities, and track outstanding issues to resolution through effective communication and transparent supporting records, providing excellent customer service
 - Maintain vendor management compliance and account relationships with the quality and ERP systems, treasury processes, and annual tax reporting (prepare 1099 information for year-end submission in accordance with IRS regulations, vendor set-up forms, and sales and use tax and VAT charges)
 - Achieve departmental goals by developing and implementing process improvements that increase the efficiency and accuracy of invoice processing and payment distribution, including testing system upgrades, supporting system integrations, recommending and participating in automation initiatives, testing new processes, supporting global harmonization of practices, and documenting process narratives and workflows
 - Build highly collaborative relationships with Finance General Ledger teams, Supply Chain/Procurement teams, and Client Delivery Project Managers to manage invoice approvals
 - Build highly collaborative relationships with Finance IT to support ERP system processes and upgrades, and the integration of other systems that affect accounts payable processing and expense reports

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential: 

- Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounts payable experience
 - Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience managing accounts payable staff
 - Ability to work with employees in remote locations and within a team environment as an individual contributor, build stable working relationships internally, and work extended hours as needed
 - Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present information, respond to inquiries, and interact well with various levels of management internally and with external individuals at global locations
 - Ability to read and understand contract language and engage in collaborative problem-solving that generates effective solutions consistent with the organization's financial policies and procedures
 - Effective time management skills to develop and direct realistic action plans for supervised teams, while creating a collaborative environment and ensuring internal stakeholder satisfaction
 - Demonstrated judgment and outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Outlook; intermediate Excel skills, including pivot tables, H/V lookups, IF functions, and other advanced functions
 - Experience working with electronic data, including accounting data within an ERP system; extracting and formatting ERP data exports; and maintaining organized paperless records, shared drives, and multiple file folders
 - Confident and professionally poised, with a proven ability to work in a fast-paced team environment, meet deadlines, manage a high volume of transactions, and adapt to change with a seamless effect on the business

Desirable: 

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, or a related discipline
 - Accounts payable industry experience
 - NetSuite ERP and/or Great Plains knowledge

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster - improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. 

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation - not just maintain the status quo. 

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it. 

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough - we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment. 

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

data.title: Lead Data Analyst
data.description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems. 

Our Data team is responsible for building a world class Data Platform with a centralized source of vendor and proprietary research data. We operate in a very dynamic environment utilizing a sophisticated and diverse technology stack. The team interfaces with all aspects of the firm, from Trading, Research, and Technology to Risk, Middle Office and Accounting - providing individuals within the group a full 360-degree view of Jump. Our Proprietary Data team collects and builds research-ready datasets, financial and non-financial, from primary sources, vendors, and public data; cleans, tags, and organizes them with consistent identifiers, taxonomies, and metadata; sources data not available from vendors and evaluates its quality and provenance. It performs deep data analysis, identifies and corrects data quality issues, and surfaces the conventions behind the datasets we use. The team provides human-in-the-loop review for automated and AI-driven pipelines; and partners with engineers to turn manual workflows into repeatable, automated processes. 

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, working closely with researchers, traders, and engineers across the firm. The role offers the individual the opportunity to develop both business and technical expertise, while significantly contributing to our whole platform. 

What You'll Do: 

- The ideal candidate will be able to dig into the details of the data and work with end-users to understand their needs and deliver results. We are looking for individuals who are instinctively curious self-starters, demonstrating the ability to independently drive tasks and projects to completion in a team environment. Curiosity, focus, attention to detail, and a genuine enjoyment of learning are essential to this role. 
 - As Lead Data Analyst, you will lead that team day to day. You will: 
 - Coordinate the team's work: translate requests from researchers, traders, and engineers into well-defined projects, set priorities across competing demands, and drive them to completion. 
 - Own quality: set the standards for how data is collected, tagged, documented, and validated, and review the team's output before it reaches the researchers and traders who depend on it. 
 - Guide individual analysts: assign work suited to each analyst's strengths and development, give regular and specific feedback, and coach them on data research techniques and the effective use of modern AI tools. 
 - Stay hands-on: take on the most ambiguous and highest-stakes data problems yourself, and model the curiosity and rigor expected of the team. 
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for the team: understand the business needs, communicate findings and status clearly and concisely, and manage expectations. 
 - Partner with data engineers to decide which manual workflows to automate and ensure automated and AI-driven pipelines keep appropriate human-in-the-loop review. 
 - Other duties as assigned or needed. 

Skills You'll Need: 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience working with data in the financial industry, at a trading firm, hedge fund, bank, or a vendor serving those institutions. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading complex projects and other analysts. 
 - Direct experience collecting, tagging, and cleaning data; experience on a trading firm's alternative or proprietary data team, or at a vendor selling to such teams, strongly preferred. 
 - Familiarity and breadth with alternative data, fundamental data, market data, and reference data. 
 - Expertise in at least one asset class, such as equities, options, futures, ETFs, or FX, including its data and market conventions. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel for data analysis and manipulation. 
 - Experience using modern AI tools, such as LLMs, agents, and coding assistants, to accelerate data collection, cleaning, tagging, and research. 
 - Exceptional attention to detail, with a focused and methodical approach to work. 
 - Deep curiosity about data and the markets and businesses behind it; enjoys learning and picks up new domains and tools quickly. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate concisely to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Reliable and predictable availability.

Welcome to SITA!

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

About The Role & Team

We are seeking a hands-on Lead Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with strong expertise across application support, Kubernetes environments, and CI/CD pipelines. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and observability of production systems through deep technical analysis and proactive engineering. 

The successful candidate will lead incident and problem investigations, identify root causes, and drive permanent resolutions in close collaboration with Development, Product, and Operations teams. This is an engineering-focused role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, production support experience, and a commitment to continuous service improvement. 

What You Will Do

- Analyze production incidents using logs, metrics, and traces to identify impacted application code and execution paths.

 - Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads, including runtime behavior, networking, health probes, and failure scenarios. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point during critical incidents, providing clear and timely guidance. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions to improve reliability. 
 - Enhance observability and alerting to improve issue detection and resolution. 
 - Partner with Development and Platform teams to resolve systemic issues and strengthen service reliability. 
 - Automate repetitive operational tasks and promote engineering best practices. 
 - Assess the impact of deployments on production environments through CI/CD pipeline expertise. 
 - Monitor system performance and reliability, identifying opportunities to improve resilience and reduce outages. 

Qualifications

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

- Min 8 years' experience in SRE, DevOps, or Production Engineering supporting high-availability systems. 
 - Strong expertise in root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent issue resolution. 
 - Hands-on troubleshooting of production environments using logs, metrics, and traces. 
 - Strong knowledge of Java and/or . NET applications in production. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools for distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tools (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‐education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‐standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‐education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‐on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence-values that continue to define us as we scale. 

Senior Technical Architect - Higher Education Platforms

Location: Pune, India | Hybrid

Employment: Full-time, engaged through SIG's Employer of Record in India

Base salary: ₹25-37 lakh per annum (LPA)

Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in consulting or professional services delivery for external clients

Reports to: Lead - India Centre of Excellence

Working hours: Flexible, with 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern morning. Typically, your day will finish around 9: 00-10: 00 pm IST, with a correspondingly later start. 

Build the solution. Set the technical standard. 

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US-based leader in higher education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernise their student information, HR and finance systems through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM and cybersecurity work. 

We are building our first engineering Centre of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding-team role: you will help establish how the team designs and builds. You will own technical architecture across application integrations, Ellucian Experience Cards, workflow automation and data migration-and write a meaningful part of the production code yourself. This role carries delivery accountability, not just design accountability. 

Ellucian experience is not required. Deep integration expertise, direct US client delivery experience and the ability to learn a new platform quickly are essential. 

What you will do

- Own architecture and delivery: Design secure integrations, web applications, identity solutions and workflow automation on Ellucian platforms. Document practical designs that work within platform, infrastructure and timeline constraints, and stay hands-on with production code. 
 - Build platform expertise: Learn Ellucian Ethos, Experience, Workflow, Banner/Colleague data structures and the API catalogue, then turn that knowledge into reusable patterns and documentation. 
 - Lead and mentor: Run architecture and code reviews, resolve complex technical problems and help new engineers become productive through hands-on guidance. 
 - Work directly with US clients: Lead technical discovery, explain designs and trade-offs, and support project scoping, estimation and technical proposals. 
 - Lead data migration: Own source analysis, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation and cutover into Ellucian platforms. 
 - Deliver and improve: Meet your assigned annual billable utilisation target alongside mentoring and design reviews. Use AI coding assistants responsibly and contribute to SIG's internal AI development tools. 

What you will bring

- Engineering and consulting experience: 10+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 5 years delivering for external clients in consulting or professional services. Direct experience leading technical discussions, presenting designs and managing expectations with US-based clients is required. 
 - Deep integration and API expertise: Experience designing, securing, versioning and operating integrations at scale-not simply consuming REST endpoints. Strong command of synchronous REST, event-driven, message-based, batch, file-based and ETL integrations; point-to-point and hub models; JSON, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, retries, versioning and webhooks. 
 - Identity and security: Hands-on SAML 2. 0 and single sign-on (SSO), including troubleshooting failed assertions; working knowledge of OIDC, identity providers, federation, attribute and role mapping, and provisioning. Strong OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API key, token and scope design, least-privilege service-account access, secrets handling and secure data exchange skills. 
 - Hands-on web engineering: Expert-level TypeScript and React. js, including component architecture, state management and performance; deep server-side Node. js, including API design, asynchronous patterns, error handling, dependency management and production debugging. Ability to design end-to-end web applications across the client, APIs, services, data, caching, sessions and deployment. 
 - Workflow and data delivery: Business process automation expertise and hands-on experience with a workflow or business process management (BPM) tool. Experience planning and executing enterprise data migrations, plus SQL, relational data modelling, Git and modern continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices. 
 - Technical leadership and learning: Demonstrated architecture leadership and mentoring, sound judgement within delivery constraints, clear written and spoken English, and a specific example of learning an unfamiliar platform quickly. Fluency with AI-assisted development, including verifying and explaining AI-generated output before release. 

Preferred Experience-not Essential

- Ellucian Banner, Colleague, Ethos, Experience or Workflow; higher education technology; or enterprise resource planning (ERP), student information systems (SIS), human resource management systems (HRMS) or finance platforms. 
 - Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL or API gateways; AWS S3, SFTP and secure file exchange. 
 - AI/ML tools, large language model (LLM) APIs, prompt engineering, internal developer tools or AI-assisted automated testing. 
 - Low-code/no-code platforms, distributed teams across time zones, or pre-sales solution design and estimation. 

Your first months at SIG

We will provide access to Ellucian training and certification, with platform badges targeted within your first 60 days; direct knowledge transfer from SIG's experienced US consultants; and a defined onboarding deliverable so you start building real solutions early. We expect you to start contributing within two months and to be teaching others within six. 

Outside the required US overlap window, you manage your own hours. We care about what you deliver, not when you are logged in. If you want to keep building, help engineers develop and shape a new team's technical standards, this role is for you.

data.title: Manager - Smelter
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Key Responsibilities of Role

Manager - Smelter - Copper

Production Planning And Execution

- Lead the entire section's (anode and casting, boiler operation, convertor, crane operations, flue gas desulphurisation, primary smelter/ secondary smelter/raw material handling, refractory maintenance, revert crushing, flash smelting furnace and tapping) production across three shifts, ensuring seamless operations and adherence to the production plan. 
 - Plan and ensure the availability of materials, preventing any production delays or issues across shifts. 
 - Execute the business plan for the section, aligning production goals with overall organizational objectives. 
 - Coordinate with shift in-charges and ensure smooth workflow across upstream and downstream processes. 

Process Optimization And Continuous Improvement

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance production efficiency and reduce waste. 
 - Analyze process performance metrics and recommend strategies for improving yield and reducing downtime. 
 - Develop process optimization projects focused on material handling and equipment usage. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices for smelting operations. 

Quality Assurance And Control

- Ensure compliance with quality standards across all production processes, conducting routine checks and process parameter analysis. 
 - Monitor lab assays and operational parameters to ensure minimal deviations from quality standards. 
 - Review feedback from quality control tests to identify areas for improvement. 
 - Lead the troubleshooting of any quality-related issues to prevent recurring defects. 

Equipment Monitoring And Troubleshooting

- Monitor equipment performance across shifts, ensuring timely identification of issues and preventive maintenance. 
 - Direct the scheduling of maintenance demand to avoid unplanned downtime, ensuring equipment runs optimally. 
 - Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions in real-time, collaborating with the maintenance team to resolve issues. 
 - Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed to minimize breakdowns and extend equipment life. 

HSE And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations, including proper handling of materials and equipment. 
 - Lead safety audits and inspections to proactively identify hazards and enforce corrective actions. 
 - Direct the implementation of safety protocols and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain a safe working environment. 
 - Promote a culture of safety among the workforce, ensuring adherence to regulatory and safety standards. 

Cost Management And Budgeting

- Plan and manage the budget for the section, ensuring efficient resource allocation and cost-effective production. 
 - Monitor and approve PR/PO processes to ensure timely procurement of materials and services. 
 - Drive cost-saving initiatives by optimizing resource use and minimizing waste across production cycles. 
 - Review and manage invoice processing to ensure proper cost tracking and financial control. 

Resource And Workforce Management

- Allocate manpower efficiently, including on-roll employees and contractual workers, to meet production demands. 
 - Plan for manpower needs, including manpower planning for shifts and scheduling based on operational requirements. 
 - Lead workforce training and development initiatives, ensuring employees are well-versed in operational and safety standards. 
 - Ensure effective coordination between teams across shifts to maintain production consistency. 

Reporting And Data Analytics

- Analyze key production data, including shift reports, material consumption, and equipment performance, to identify trends and areas for improvement. 
 - Review and submit accurate production reports, ensuring management has up-to-date insights on section performance. 
 - Use data analytics to track process performance metrics and drive data-based decision-making. 
 - Ensure all records are maintained in compliance with regulatory and organizational standards. 

Digitization And Tech Adoption

- Utilize SAP and other digital tools to monitor production, material movement, and equipment performance in real-time. 
 - Lead the adoption of digital technologies to improve operational efficiency and automate routine tasks. 
 - Ensure the section's operations are aligned with the latest technological advancements, driving continuous process improvement. 
 - Promote the use of digital tools for reporting, maintenance tracking, and data analysis. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

- Smelter Sections
 - Maintenance
 - QA Team

Key Stakeholders - External

- Equipment Vendors
 - Regulatory Agencies
 - External Auditors
 - Regulatory Bodies

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

B. E in Metallurgy

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

Minimum 10 years of experience in the metallurgy industry

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials - the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life. 

Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth's natural resources. 

Join nearly 18, 000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you're supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration. 

This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible. 

Job posting end date: 10/19/2026

GENERAL ACCOUNTABILITY

McCloskey International leads the screening and crushing industry with a complete line of equipment including crushers, vibrating screeners, trommels and stacking conveyors. Built with power and durability as standards, every product is field-tested before being deployed in a wide range of industries around the world. 

Job Purpose: 

The Senior Quality Engineer will have strategic responsibility for implementing a Quality strategy and strategic operational goals to exceed customer expectations for product quality, optimising production quality levels and supporting operational excellence. They will work closely with internal and external stakeholders including Sales, Engineering, Suppliers and Aftermarket regarding technical support of their activities. 

They are responsible for all areas of the Quality function and provide support within operations. They will lead and develop the Quality Management System, striving for best-in-class products and business practices to deliver the customers' expectations, managing teams and quality improvement projects across the business. 

Candidate expected to travel to other McCloskey sites for training purposes. 

SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES: 

- Implement a best practice quality vision, strategy, policies, processes and procedures to aid and improve business performance through horizontal deployment of quality standards set by the business globally. 
 - Ensure that quality strategies and processes are in place to meet business objectives and operational needs in terms of quality targets and which enables the company to function and compete effectively in the market and in a sustained manner. 
 - Development of the Shop floor and PDI process. 
 - Assumes final sign-off responsibilities for all PDI dispatches. 
 - Assist with the implementation of any engineering changes in design and production process. 
 - Utilise the voice of the customer feedback to make appropriate changes in Production. 
 - Work closely with the global quality team to align standards across all sites to ensure consistency. 
 - Actively lead in the reduction of customer complaints, warranty, cost of quality and in-house scrap and waste. 
 - Engage in cross functional focus groups to drive an improved quality culture. 
 - Look for quality improvements within the full product lifecycle - from design to manufacturing process. 
 - Work closely with the Aftermarket teams on customer feedback and warranty issues. 
 - Work closely with Operations to gain feedback, utilise resources, and create visuals to support the Quality strategy along with a reduction in quality issues prior to the PDI process. 
 - Implementation of SD (Supplier Disposition) process in Alwar. 
 - Complete any special projects as required. May be assigned to other areas of Operations, based on business or customer requirements. 

PEOPLE ACCOUNTABILITIES: 

- Define the departmental structure and team requirements for the relevant department in span of control. 
 - Motivates, develops and coaches departmental staff to always ensure best performance. 
 - Maintain good relationships with stakeholders. 
 - Implements best practices processes and working instructions for the Quality teams. 
 - Works closely with relevant functional areas and engages in business improvement projects. 
 - Assess and evaluate training needs of the production team related to quality. 

EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: 

Proven experience in Engineering and Quality team with a proven track record in strategic quality improvement in a manufacturing environment. Strong organizational, planning and negotiating skills are required. 

- Good working knowledge of McCloskey Machines, Creo, Pulse
 - Ability to add value, reduce costs and make business improvements. 
 - Proven ability to coordinate projects to successful completion. 
 - Strong collaboration and team building skills. 
 - Be an effective team player at a senior level, engaging fully in development opportunities with members of the SMT. 
 - Outstanding communication (oral/written) skills required. 
 - Must be proficient in MS Office (including, Word, Excel, PowerPoint). 

Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices. 

How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people

Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

data.title: Chief Traction, Distribution, SCADA & MIMIC Panel Integration Expert-K1- Pune
data.description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India's valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. 

Understand better who we are by visiting www. systra. in

Context

We are seeking applications for the position of Chief Traction Distribution, SCADA and MIMIC Panel Integration Expert for Phase-I Extension and Phase-II Projects of Pune Metro Rail Project (PMRP)

The project involves the engagement of a General Consultant (GC) for providing comprehensive consultancy services for the implementation of the Pune Metro Rail Project - Phase-I Extension and Phase-II. The scope broadly covers project management, design and engineering review, construction supervision, contract management, quality assurance, safety, testing and commissioning, and overall monitoring of the works. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Traction Power System
 - Review and supervise the design and implementation of the Metro traction power supply system. 
 - Review traction substation (TSS), auxiliary/receiving substations and associated equipment. 
 - Review technical specifications, SLDs, protection schemes and equipment layouts. 
 - Ensure proper interface between traction power, OHE/third rail and other electrical systems. 
 - Monitor installation, testing and commissioning of traction equipment. 
 - Electrical Distribution System
 - Review HT/LT distribution arrangements for stations, depots and other project facilities. 
 - Review RMU, HT panels, transformers, LT panels, DG/UPS interfaces and associated protection systems. 
 - Verify load calculations, power distribution diagrams and equipment ratings. 
 - Ensure reliable and coordinated power supply to stations and operational systems. 
 - SCADA System
 - Review the design and architecture of the Electrical/Traction SCADA system. 
 - Review RTU/PLC, communication network, servers, workstations and data acquisition systems. 
 - Verify monitoring and control of traction and auxiliary electrical equipment. 
 - Review SCADA I/O lists, point schedules, control philosophy and alarm/event management. 
 - Ensure integration with OCC and station control systems. 
 - MIMIC Panel Integration
 - Review the design and functionality of MIMIC panels at OCC/SCADA control locations. 
 - Ensure correct representation of electrical network topology and equipment status. 
 - Verify indications for breakers, isolators, feeders, transformers and other critical equipment. 
 - Ensure proper interface between MIMIC panels, SCADA and field equipment. 
 - Witness functional and integrated testing of MIMIC panels. 
 - Design & Technical Document Review
 - Review: 
 - SLDs and schematics
 - Protection coordination studies
 - Equipment specifications
 - Cable schedules
 - Interface drawings
 - SCADA architecture
 - I/O lists
 - Control philosophy
 - MIMIC panel drawings
 - Communication/network diagrams
 - Review contractor technical submissions, calculations, method statements and shop drawings. 
 - Interface Coordination
Coordinate With

- Rolling Stock
 - OHE/Third Rail
 - Civil & Structural
 - Station E&M
 - Signalling
 - Telecom
 - AFC
 - Fire & Life Safety
 - Depot systems
 - OCC/Operations
 - SCADA and communication teams

Particular attention should be given to traction power-OHE/third rail, electrical distribution-station systems, SCADA-field equipment and SCADA-OCC interfaces. 

- Construction Supervision
 - Inspect installation of traction and distribution equipment. 
 - Monitor contractor compliance with approved drawings and specifications. 
 - Review site installation quality and identify non-conformities. 
 - Attend technical inspections and resolve site engineering issues. 
 - Monitor progress of critical electrical and SCADA works. 
 - Testing & Commissioning
 - Witness FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning and commissioning of traction and distribution equipment. 
 - Review protection relay testing and functional tests. 
 - Witness SCADA point-to-point testing. 
 - Verify commands, indications, alarms, interlocks and equipment status. 
 - Witness SCADA-MIMIC-field equipment integrated testing. 
 - Support Integrated Testing & Commissioning (ITC) before revenue operation. 
 - Safety & Protection
 - Ensure electrical systems comply with approved safety requirements and applicable standards. 
 - Review protection coordination and interlocking arrangements. 
 - Verify emergency tripping and isolation facilities. 
 - Ensure safe operating procedures for traction and distribution systems. 
 - Contractor & Progress Management
 - Monitor contractor performance and programme. 
 - Participate in technical and progress meetings. 
 - Review RFIs, technical deviations and proposed modifications. 
 - Assist PMC/client in resolving critical technical issues. 
 - Monitor procurement and delivery of critical traction/SCADA equipment. 
 - Handover & Documentation
 - Review As-Built Drawings. 
 - Review testing and commissioning records. 
 - Verify SCADA database and final I/O documentation. 
 - Review O&M manuals, maintenance schedules and spare-parts lists. 
 - Verify training of operations and maintenance personnel. 
 - Support final inspection, taking-over and Defect Liability Period activities. 

Profile/Skills

- Graduate in Electrical - B. tech 20+years in rail related majar infrastructure project / railway/ Metro. 
 - Chief Traction, Distribution, SCADA & MIMIC Panel Integration Expert shall be responsible for leading the technical review, supervision, interface coordination, testing and commissioning of traction power, electrical distribution, SCADA and MIMIC panel systems for the Metro Rail Project. The expert shall review designs, SLDs, protection schemes, technical specifications, SCADA architecture, I/O lists, MIMIC panel drawings and interface requirements. 
 - supervise installation and testing; ensure integration with OHE/third rail, rolling stock, signalling, telecom, station E&M and OCC systems. 
 - resolve technical issues; witness FAT/SAT and integrated testing; and support commissioning, handover and O&M activities. 

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It's not a job - it's a career!

Workplace Type

On-site

data.title: Lead AI Engineer
data.description:
Join Barclays as a Lead AI Engineer role, where you will design and build core AI/ML solutions that power our enterprise AI capabilities. You will take ownership of significant AI subsystems - from agentic workflows and LLM applications to evaluation pipelines and MLOps tooling - delivering production-grade solutions that are secure, scalable, and aligned with our architectural vision. You bridge the gap between AI architecture and hands-on implementation, driving technical delivery while mentoring junior engineers. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it. 

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills: 

- Bachelor's degree (or above) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related discipline
 - 8+ years software engineering experience with at least 3 years building AI/ML systems, scalable ML infrastructure, or model serving platforms at enterprise scale
 - Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, asyncio) and/or Go/Java, with production experience building APIs and microservices serving high-throughput, low-latency workloads
 - Hands-on experience developing agentic AI systems and LLM applications including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, planning frameworks, and deployment of multi-step AI workflows
 - Solid technical knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and modern agentic frameworks (Strands, LangGraph, Google ADK) with ability to build and optimise agent-based solutions
 - Working experience with GenAI/LLM systems - prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model serving (vLLM), and OpenAI-compatible API surfaces
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture - microservices, cloud platforms, API design (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), and event-driven architectures
 - Experience with AWS services - EC2/EKS, S3, IAM, RDS, and at least one AI service (Bedrock, SageMaker)
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes - containerising applications and deploying to orchestrated environments
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation, Terraform), and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing)
 - Ability to work on system design from ideation through completion with limited supervision; effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below

- Experience building evaluation frameworks for agentic systems including agent benchmarking, reasoning traces, and monitoring observability for multi-step AI workflows in production
 - Experience in vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic search, and memory systems for stateful agents with understanding of retrieval optimisation and context management
 - Experience implementing AI safety controls - content filtering, guardrails, prompt injection detection, PII redaction
 - Knowledge of AI security frameworks - NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10
 - Familiarity with model fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, RLHF, supervised fine-tuning) for domain-specific SLMs
 - Knowledge of responsible AI practices, model governance, and security considerations for autonomous systems
 - Understanding of Zero Trust architecture and identity systems (EntraID, OAuth2/OIDC)

This role is based in Bengaluru and Pune office. 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 
 - Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. 
 - Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. 

Assistant Vice President Expectations

- To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. 
 - Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

Senior Software Engineer, Labor Planning & Forecasting

Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India

The Legion application is a high-performance data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality Java code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance. You will also need knowledge and experience with data modeling and relational databases. Our application runs on AWS, so experience with containerization and cloud deployments is desirable. We're using Springboot, Hibernate, MySQL, and JSON, so familiarity with these technologies will be helpful. Frontend experience in JavaScript and Angular and/or React is a big plus. 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

- Develop features with high quality and on time
 - Thorough understanding of the product area
 - Assist with feature design along with CTO/Architect
 - Develop features keeping in mind best coding practices including performance and user experience
 - Own product quality
 - Test features before asking QA engineers to test
 - Write unit tests
 - Work with QA engineers to test the product end-to-end
 - Fix incoming bugs daily: Adhere to bug resolution goals and SLA
 - Be able to demo the Legion product end-to-end
 - Devise robust solutions that enable product engineering teams to rapidly deliver features in a scalable and performant manner
 - Design, build, and support applications from End to End. 
 - Make data-driven technical decisions
 - Use your deep technical knowledge to debug and solve complex technical problems
 - Identify and resolve ambiguities in requirements in consultation with the various stakeholders
 - Contribute to the long-term team charter and quarterly planning
 - Mentor others on the team, and hold a high bar for code quality and standards by conducting design reviews, code reviews, and providing feedback
 - Work with QA team to make the feature as Production ready. 

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline
 - 7-8 years with backend technologies (Java, Spring Boot, MySQL)
 - 7-8 years working on building multi-tenant SaaS applications
 - 7-8 years experience with designing and building APIs
 - 5+ years delivering software in a cloud-based environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
 - Professional software development experience
 - Proficiency in Java or C++, and object-oriented design skills
 - Application architecture and design patterns
 - Experience serving as technical lead throughout the full software development lifecycle, from conception, architecture definition, detailed design, scoping, planning, implementation, and testing to documentation, delivery, and maintenance is preferred
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering and best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
 - Experience in the development of distributed/scalable systems and high-volume transaction applications
 - Proven ability to lead projects from inception to production
 - Strong mastery in communication skills, software architecture design, writing technical documents
 - Strong personal work ethic focused on prioritization, being action-oriented, and being driven to achieve positive results

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

- Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence
 - Personal passion and fervor for industry-leading next-generation technology
 - Ability to operate in an environment with limited resources
 - A great communicator who can distill powerful messages that resonate with customers
 - Track record of building positive relationships with peers
 - Continuous and thoughtful listener, able to learn from others and leverage input
 - Strong personal work ethic focused on high-priority issues; action and results-oriented
 - Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character; demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior
 - Proficiency with AWS products and services
 - Experience in managing frameworks/systems for ensuring code quality such as Coverity, SonarQub, etc. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

- Health Benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
 - Parental Leave 
 - Equity 
 - Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
 - Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. 

Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. 

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3, 200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion's mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion's Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today's hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. 

For more information, visit https: //legion. co

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws. 

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion. co

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion. co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion. co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. 

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay. 

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy ("Policy") describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. ("Legion", "we", "us" and "our") collects, uses, and discloses "personal information" as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California. 

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. 

- Types of Personal Information We Handle

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes: 

- Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts. 
 - Professional or employment-related information, including: 
 - Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver's licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references. 
 - Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
 - Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information. 
 - Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history. 
 - Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application. 
 - How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers' business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions. 

- With Whom We Share Personal Information

data.title: Software Engineer | GO Programming, Cloud-Native, PPPOE/IPOE, Microservices, DHCPV4/DHCPV6 | 8-14 Years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Cisco's cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the world's largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead sophisticated investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability. 

- Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. 
 - Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. 
 - Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. 
 - Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. 
 - Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. 
 - Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. 
 - Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. 
 - Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. 
 - Troubleshoot sophisticated, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. 
 - Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. 
 - Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. 
 - Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. 
 - Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. 
 - Experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. 
 - Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. 
 - Knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. 
 - Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. 
 - Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). 
 - Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. 
 - Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. 
 - Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. 
 - Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). 
 - Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. 
 - Telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

data.description:
Job Description: AI SDET Engineer

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to define and advance quality engineering across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-enabled products. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep test automation expertise and can validate both deterministic software and probabilistic AI behavior. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Design, SRE, Security, and Data/ML teams to build quality into the full delivery lifecycle, improve release confidence, and lead the evolution of our testing strategy, tooling, and people. 

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end quality strategy, including risk-based test planning, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, test matrices, release-readiness criteria, and production validation. 
 - Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, mobile, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, and pytest. 
 - Establish maintainable test architecture through modular design, page or screen objects, reusable fixtures, parametrization, test-data management, and appropriate use of BDD, mocking, and stubbing. 
 - Define API and contract-testing practices for REST and GraphQL services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate, while promoting effective unit testing and close collaboration with developers. 
 - Automate test execution, reporting, quality gates, and deployment controls in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps pipelines. 
 - Lead performance, load, reliability, resiliency, and security validation using tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling; incorporate chaos testing and OWASP-aligned security checks where appropriate. 
 - Use logs, traces, and metrics from platforms such as ELK, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to diagnose failures, reproduce production issues, and drive root-cause analysis. 
 - Build automated evaluation harnesses and regression suites for machine-learning models, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and agentic workflows. 
 - Define quality KPIs and service expectations, including escape rate, flaky-test rate, automation effectiveness, mean time to detect, and release quality; communicate trends and corrective actions to stakeholders. 
 - Create effective defect triage and release-readiness processes, influence product and design decisions, and ensure quality risks are visible and acted upon. 
 - Protect personal and sensitive information through secure test-data generation, access controls, masking, redaction, retention practices, and GDPR/PII-aware validation. 
 - Mentor and lead QA and SDET engineers, contribute to hiring and onboarding, and strengthen engineering practices across distributed cross-functional teams. 

Core Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or an SDET role, with evidence of ownership of complex quality initiatives. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript, supported by strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, networking, and operating-system fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience designing test frameworks and maintainable automation architecture with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, pytest, or comparable tools. 
 - Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk-based testing, integration and end-to-end strategy, TDD/ATDD practices, requirement traceability, coverage analysis, and test-matrix management. 
 - Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and service contracts with Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or equivalent tooling; ability to use mocks and stubs to isolate dependencies. 
 - Practical experience with load and performance testing, reliability or chaos testing, security-testing fundamentals, and OWASP principles. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes concepts, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills using logs, distributed traces, metrics, and production observability platforms. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and partner effectively with Development, SRE, Product, Design, Security, and Data/ML teams. 
 - Experience working with quality KPIs and SLAs, supporting release-readiness assessments, and participating in defect triage. 
 - Working knowledge of GDPR and PII obligations, including secure test-data creation, masking, redaction, and least-privilege access. 

AI Testing Expertise

- Experience testing non-deterministic AI systems and translating product expectations into measurable evaluation criteria, representative datasets, scoring rubrics, statistical thresholds, and repeatable acceptance gates. 
 - Ability to evaluate large language model quality across correctness, groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, consistency, latency, token usage, cost, and failure behavior rather than relying on exact-match assertions alone. 
 - Hands-on understanding of retrieval-augmented generation testing, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval recall and ranking, context relevance, citation accuracy, answer groundedness, and stale or conflicting knowledge. 
 - Experience building golden datasets and regression suites; curating, labeling, versioning, and reviewing evaluation data while preventing leakage, contamination, duplication, and unrepresentative test coverage. 
 - Knowledge of adversarial and safety testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect injection, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure tool use, hallucinations, harmful content, toxicity, bias, fairness, and model or agent misuse. 
 - Ability to test agentic and tool-calling workflows, including multi-step planning, permissions, memory and state, tool selection, retries, timeouts, partial failures, human approvals, and safe recovery. 
 - Experience validating model, prompt, retrieval, and configuration changes through versioned experiments, reproducible environments, baseline comparisons, confidence intervals, and controlled rollout or canary strategies. 
 - Understanding of model and data drift, feedback-loop risks, online quality monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and production signals that detect degradation after release. 
 - Familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as OpenAI Evals, promptfoo, Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of AI-specific privacy and security risks, including training-data exposure, model inversion, membership inference, prompt and response logging, retention controls, and safe use of synthetic data. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience testing mobile, embedded, distributed, event-driven, or highly regulated systems. 
 - Experience with cloud-native testing on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and with ephemeral test environments managed through Kubernetes and Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with MLOps practices, model registries, feature stores, data validation, experiment tracking, dataset or artifact versioning, and quality-engineering enablement or open-source tooling.
