data.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead
data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation. 
 - AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation. 
 - Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection. 
 - Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations. 
 - AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices. 
 - Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace. 
 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions. 
 - Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills. 

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!

Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams.

 - Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‐quality mechanical design solutions. 
 - Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner. 
 - Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation. 
 - Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‐paced, contractor‐integrated environments. 

Work Experience

- 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects. 
 - Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for
 - Water/wastewater pump stations
 - WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
 - Chemical dosing systems
 - Sludge handling systems
 - High‐lift/low‐lift pumping systems
 - Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc. )
 - Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis. 
 - Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‐Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation. 
 - Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‐enabled environment. 
 - Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications. 
 - Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations. 
 - Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment. 
 - Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans. 
 - Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset. 
 - Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
 - Master's degree in relevant field is advantageous
 - Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Mechanical Engineer (CEng) is advantageous

Preferred Attributes

- Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems. 
 - Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning. 
 - Knowledge of sustainability principles and low‐carbon mechanical design approaches. 
 - Experience working with international codes, standards, and global delivery frameworks.

data.description:
At AGCO, our purpose is to provide farmer-focused solutions that sustainably feed our world. Every day, our teams work alongside farmers to deliver innovative machinery, smart technologies, and precision agriculture solutions that help increase productivity while reducing environmental impact. 

Job Summary

The Director of Supplier Quality is responsible for leading AGCO's global supplier quality strategy, performance, and continuous improvement initiatives across the supply base. This role drives world-class supplier quality performance through robust APQP, PPAP, supplier development, supplier performance management, and supplier warranty recovery processes. The position is accountable for reducing supplier-related quality defects, warranty exposure, production disruptions, and cost of poor quality while enabling successful new product introductions and strategic sourcing initiatives. 

A critical focus of this role is developing supplier capability in low-cost countries, improving supplier readiness for new product launches, and driving consistency of supplier quality systems and execution across all global regions. The Director will partner closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Integrity, and Regional Quality teams to improve supplier performance and ensure suppliers consistently meet AGCO's quality, delivery, and reliability expectations. 

What You'll Make Possible

- Improved quality and reliability across AGCO products
 - Successful execution of global product launch programs
 - Stronger supplier capability and manufacturing readiness
 - Reduced quality risks and warranty costs
 - More resilient and sustainable supply chains

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute AGCO's global supplier quality strategy, aligning quality performance with business, sourcing, and operational objectives. 
 - Lead and develop a high-performing global Supplier Quality organization, driving a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. 
 - Drive supplier quality performance through effective supplier development, performance management, corrective actions, and risk mitigation programs. 
 - Enhance supplier capability across global sourcing regions, including India, China, Southeast Asia, and Eastern Europe, with a focus on manufacturing readiness, APQP, PPAP, and quality system maturity. 
 - Lead supplier quality activities supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring robust APQP and PPAP execution, launch readiness, and defect prevention. 
 - Partner with Global Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Integrity, and Regional Quality teams to improve supplier performance and support strategic sourcing initiatives.

data.title: System Software Engineer – SoC Validation
data.description:
Job Overview

Are you interested in understanding how complex SoCs work and using software to find problems in real silicon?

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our SoC Post-Silicon Validation team. We use Linux and software as powerful tools to exercise, validate, and debug advanced SoCs used in Infrastructure and Data Center systems. 

You will work at the intersection of hardware and software, where you can see the direct impact of the code you develop. We will give you opportunities to expand your knowledge of SoC architecture, Linux, system software, and silicon validation while working alongside experienced engineers. 

If you enjoy debugging complex problems and learning how hardware and software work together, we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

You will use Linux to validate SoC functionality, develop software and automated tests, analyze results, and investigate failures. You will work closely with design, firmware, software, and verification engineers to understand problems and contribute to their resolution. 

We will encourage you to look beyond individual tests and help us improve our validation tools, automation, coverage, and ways of working. As your experience grows, you will have opportunities to take ownership of increasingly complex areas of SoC validation. 

Required Skills And Experience

We are looking for someone with around 2-3 years of experience in Linux, embedded software, firmware, system software, validation, or a related area. 

You should have experience programming in C/C++, Assembly and using Python or shell scripting, together with an understanding of computer architecture and operating system fundamentals. Experience using Linux for development, testing, or debugging will help you get started quickly. 

Most importantly, we value curiosity, analytical thinking, collaboration, and an interest in understanding how complex systems work. 

"nice To Have" Skills And Experience

You may already have exposure to areas such as SoC validation, silicon bring-up, Linux kernel or device drivers, CPU and memory systems, PCIe, interrupts, SoC interconnects. 

You do not need experience in all these areas. We are interested in what you can bring to the team and what you would like to learn next. 

IN RETURN

We will support you as you build expertise across Linux, system software, computer architecture, silicon validation, and hardware/software debugging. 

You will have opportunities to learn from experienced engineers, work with advanced SoCs, contribute to real product development, and grow your technical skills and career. We offer a collaborative environment where we share knowledge, learn from each other, and solve challenging engineering problems together. 

We also offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, professional development, and work-life harmony. Specific benefits may vary by location. 

We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need reasonable accommodations or adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to provide appropriate support. 

Interested in using software to explore what is happening inside a complex SoC? We would like to hear from you!

LI#-KR2

Job Overview

Plan A Technologies is looking for a Automation QA Engineer. In this position you will be responsible for designing and building the automated testing infrastructure that ensures the quality, compliance, and performance of slot game development. This role combines expertise in C# development, computer vision, and AI-assisted testing to automate validation across game logic, visual rendering, and math models, while partnering closely with QA, game development, and engineering teams throughout the game lifecycle. 

Please note: you must have at least 5 years of experience in QA automation, with hands-on expertise in C# to be considered for this role. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

- Develop and maintain C# automation suites validating game logic, paytables, reel math, bonus triggers, and payout calculations against certified specs. 
 - Build CV-based systems (OpenCV or similar) to visually verify screen rendering, symbol placement, animations, and on-screen game state - including hardware/cabinet testing where API access is limited. 
 - Develop test harnesses that interface with game engines and firmware to inject test conditions and capture internal state for regulatory certification (GLI, BMM, etc. ). 
 - Create AI/ML tools that detect visual anomalies (glitches, misrenders) and statistical anomalies (RNG/RTP deviations), accelerating regression detection beyond manual QA. 
 - Integrate automated visual, logic, and compliance tests into build pipelines, ensuring every release is validated before reaching QA or regulators. 
 - Other projects and duties as assigned by the manager. 

Experience

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA automation, with hands-on expertise in C# (nice to have: C/C++ development). 
 - Proven experience building computer vision-based testing tools (OpenCV or similar) for visual regression and screen-state validation. 
 - Solid understanding of slot machine/gaming domain concepts (RNG, RTP, paytables, reel math, bonus mechanics) and regulatory standards (GLI, BMM, or similar). 
 - Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to testing, such as anomaly detection or automated test generation.

data.title: Senior Manager - QA & Release
data.description:
About the Team: 

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK's internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. 

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you're passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact. 

Job Purpose: 

The QA & Release Senior Manager is responsible for supporting quality assurance practices and coordinating release management activities across the HR Digital & Technology product portfolio. Working across all HR products, the role ensures that changes are tested to a consistent standard, release readiness criteria are met, and releases are coordinated and communicated effectively across product teams and stakeholders. The role supports the delivery of reliable, secure, and compliant changes by embedding quality activities throughout the delivery lifecycle and maintaining visibility of upcoming releases across the portfolio. Working closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, and service teams, the QA & Release Senior Manager helps ensure that quality is designed-in from refinement through to post-go-live, while supporting a structured and well-governed release process that protects service stability and business outcomes. 

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2-3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Quality Assurance

- Support the implementation of QA standards and test approaches across the HR product portfolio, ensuring functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing is carried out consistently across product teams. 
 - Work with Product Owners and delivery teams to define acceptance criteria, test coverage expectations, and quality gates, ensuring requirements are testable and supported by clear pass/fail criteria. 
 - Execute and coordinate test activities across product teams, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and supporting user acceptance testing, ensuring defects are clearly documented and triaged. 
 - Apply risk-based testing approaches to prioritise effort across critical services, high-transaction workflows, regulated processes, and cross-product integrations, escalating quality risks to senior stakeholders where required. 
 - Support the adoption and maintenance of test automation, contributing to automated regression, API testing, and data integrity checks, and ensuring test scripts are maintained and reusable across releases. 
 - Ensure non-functional requirements (performance, security, accessibility, operability) are clearly defined and tested prior to release, partnering with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams where required. 
 - Manage defect lifecycle processes, ensuring issues are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked through to resolution, and that defect trends are analysed to inform continuous improvement. 

Release Management

- Maintain and coordinate the release calendar across the HR product portfolio, ensuring all product teams have visibility of upcoming releases, dependencies, and sequencing. 
 - Support release readiness assessments by coordinating release checklists, confirming test completion, gathering signoffs, and ensuring documentation (release notes, runbooks, rollback plans) is complete and accurate prior to deployment. 
 - Coordinate release communications across product teams, business stakeholders, and Service Operations, ensuring impacted parties are informed of release scope, timing, and any known risks or workarounds. 
 - Support change control processes, ensuring releases follow required governance and approval workflows and that evidence of testing, risk assessment, and stakeholder sign-off is documented and auditable. 
 - Support go-live and hypercare activities, monitoring for release-related incidents, coordinating triage across product teams, and ensuring issues are escalated and resolved in a timely manner. 
 - Documents and tracks release outcomes and contribute to post-release reviews, capturing lessons learned, analysing release success rates, and identifying opportunities to improve release processes and reduce release-related incidents. 
 - Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 

Required Skills & Qualification: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in business, Information Technology, Project/Programme Management, or equivalent experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience working in QA, testing, release management, or delivery support roles within technology or digital environments. 
 - Experience executing and coordinating test activities including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing across one or more platforms or products. 
 - Experience supporting or coordinating release processes, including release scheduling, readiness assessments, and release communications. 
 - Familiarity with defect management processes, including logging, triaging, and tracking defects through to resolution. 
 - Exposure to test automation approaches, including contributing to or maintaining automated regression or API test scripts. 
 - Awareness of change control, governance, and compliance requirements within enterprise environments. 
 - Experience working within agile or product-based delivery environments and contributing to iterative planning, testing, and release practices. 
 - Experience working across multiple teams or workstreams, coordinating testing or release activity to support aligned delivery. 
 - Professional certifications desirable (e. g. , ITSM, etc). 

Preferred Skills: 

- Strong attention to detail, able to identify, document, and communicate defects and quality risks clearly and accurately. 
 - Good communication skills, able to coordinate across multiple product teams and communicate release schedules, readiness status, and quality findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Organised and structured in approach, able to manage multiple concurrent testing and release activities, maintain accurate documentation, and track progress across product teams under time pressure. 
 - Developing analytical skills, able to identify defect trends, assess test coverage, and contribute insights that support continuous improvement in quality and release practices. 
 - Comfortable working in a matrixed environment, building relationships across product teams and coordinating activity without direct line authority. 
 - Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and change

Skills

Knowledge Management, Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), Penetration Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Assurance Analysis, Regression Testing, Release Management, Scripting, Test Automation Framework, Test Case Design, Test Management Tools, Tool Selection, User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

Job Summary

As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2. 0, OAuth 2. 0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership-driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures. 
 - Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally. 
 - Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles. 
 - Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection. 
 - Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality. 
 - Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company's Tech Radar and security baselines. 
 - Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions. 
 - Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards. 
 - Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration. 
 - Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness. 
 - Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role. 
 - The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/. NET OR Java OR Python . The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/. NET technology stack. 
 - Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts. 
 - Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities. 
 - Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value. 
 - Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders
 - Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2. 0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2. 0/OIDC Authorization Servers. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

- Manage Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities and support supplier quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Conduct Process Audits, Layered Process Audits (LPA), FMEA Line Walks, and risk assessments.

Qualifications & Experience

Technical Expertise

 - Experience with 8D problem solving, CAPA management, and Root Cause Analysis methodologies.

data.description:
Why Mizuho

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Role Overview: 

We are looking for an experienced Security Automation & SOAR Engineer with strong hands-on expertise across Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR and Microsoft Sentinel. The role will be responsible for the design, development, integration, migration, optimization, and operational support of security orchestration and automation capabilities supporting Security Operations. 

The engineer will work closely with SOC, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Vulnerability Management, IAM, and engineering teams to automate security processes, integrate security technologies, improve analyst efficiency, and support the migration and modernization of SOAR capabilities. 

The successful candidate must demonstrate strong software engineering, troubleshooting, and automation skills and be capable of independently developing and supporting complex playbooks, scripts, APIs, and integrations. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

SOAR Engineering & Automation: 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain security automation workflows across Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR and Microsoft Sentinel. 
 - Develop and troubleshoot Cortex XSOAR playbooks, automations, scripts, integrations, and incident workflows. 
 - Develop Microsoft Sentinel automation rules, Logic Apps, and security response playbooks. 
 - Build reusable automation components using Python, Java, PowerShell, REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks. 
 - Automate security use cases including: 
 - Phishing investigation and response
 - Compromised account response
 - Malware and endpoint investigation
 - Threat intelligence enrichment
 - Indicator enrichment and blocking
 - Identity-related investigations
 - Incident enrichment and prioritization
 - Automated containment and remediation
 - Implement appropriate error handling, logging, exception management, and human approval points within automated workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot failed playbooks, integrations, APIs, scripts, and automation dependencies. 
 - Establish disciplined development, testing, version control, and deployment practices for security automation. 

Integration Engineering: 

- Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Cortex XSOAR, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security platforms. 
 - Integrate SOAR platforms with technologies including Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, CyberArk, Entra ID, Active Directory, ServiceNow, email security, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management platforms. 
 - Develop custom integrations where native capabilities do not meet operational requirements. 
 - Build and troubleshoot REST API-based integrations, including authentication, authorization, certificates, secrets, data mapping, and error handling. 
 - Establish reusable and supportable integration patterns across Security Operations. 
 - Monitor integration health, dependencies, failures, and performance. 
 - Maintain integration inventories, technical documentation, and architecture diagrams. 

SOAR Migration & Modernization: 

- Support the migration, consolidation, and modernization of security automation capabilities between SOAR platforms, including Cortex XSOAR and Microsoft Sentinel. 
 - Assess existing playbooks, integrations, scripts, workflows, and platform dependencies. 
 - Map source-platform workflows, data structures, APIs, integrations, incident models, and automation logic to target-platform capabilities. 
 - Re-engineer and optimize automation where appropriate rather than simply replicating legacy workflows. 
 - Identify redundant, duplicate, or obsolete playbooks and integrations during migration. 
 - Support migration activities across: 
 - Discovery and dependency analysis
 - Use-case and playbook mapping
 - Architecture and design
 - Development and integration
 - Functional and regression testing
 - Parallel validation
 - Production cutover
 - Stabilization and operational handover
 - Maintain traceability between existing and migrated automation to identify functional or coverage gaps. 
 - Support migration cutover and rollback planning to minimize disruption to Security Operations. 
 - Develop migration documentation, dependency maps, test evidence, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks. 

Microsoft Sentinel & Detection Engineering: 

- Support Microsoft Sentinel engineering, including data connectors, telemetry ingestion, normalization, platform health, and optimization. 
 - Develop and tune KQL queries, analytics rules, correlation logic, and hunting queries. 
 - Connect security detections with appropriate automated investigation and response workflows. 
 - Support telemetry integration across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email, and enterprise applications. 
 - Partner with detection engineering teams to align relevant detections and response workflows with MITRE ATT&CK. 

Engineering Governance & Operational Support: 

- Implement Git/source control, code review, testing, CI/CD, and controlled release practices for security automation. 
 - Maintain playbook catalogs, integration inventories, technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks. 
 - Monitor automation reliability and effectiveness and identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual activity. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues affecting SOAR platforms, playbooks, APIs, and integrations. 
 - Partner with SOC and Incident Response teams to translate manual processes into scalable automation. 
 - Provide technical knowledge transfer and support to SOC analysts and security engineering teams. 
 - Participate in production support and major incident activities for critical automation and platform issues as required. 

Required Experience & Technical Skills: 

- 8+ years of cybersecurity or Security Operations engineering experience, with significant experience in SIEM/SOAR and security automation. 
 - Strong hands-on Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR engineering experience, including playbook development, custom automation, integrations, scripts, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong hands-on Microsoft Sentinel automation experience, including automation rules, Azure Logic Apps, playbooks, and security orchestration. 
 - Strong software development and scripting capability with hands-on experience in Python and Java. 
 - Strong experience developing and troubleshooting REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and API-based integrations. 
 - Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms used in enterprise integrations, including OAuth, API keys, certificates, and secrets. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating SOAR platforms with EDR, IAM/PAM, ITSM, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, email security, and other security technologies. 
 - Experience migrating, re-engineering, or modernizing SOAR playbooks, scripts, integrations, and workflows between platforms. 
 - Strong KQL capability for Microsoft Sentinel detection, investigation, and hunting use cases. 
 - Experience with PowerShell and Microsoft security automation. 
 - Experience with Git/source control, testing, code review, CI/CD, and structured change-management practices. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across APIs, authentication, networking, automation workflows, and security platforms. 
 - Ability to translate Security Operations processes into scalable, maintainable, and supportable automation. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills: 

- Experience with JavaScript and other scripting languages. 
 - Experience developing Cortex XSOAR custom integrations and Content Packs. 
 - Familiarity with Demisto SDK and XSOAR content-development practices. 
 - Experience with Cortex XSIAM. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR and the wider Microsoft security ecosystem. 
 - Experience developing ServiceNow integrations and automated security workflows. 
 - Experience with Terraform and/or Ansible. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD and automated testing for security automation content. 
 - Experience with cloud environments, including Azure, AWS, and GCP. 
 - Relevant Palo Alto Networks and Microsoft security certifications. 
 - Experience delivering security automation and SOAR migration within a large, regulated enterprise environment.

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world's leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. data.description:
Job Requirements

Role Summary

- We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility

- Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts. 
 - Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes. 
 - Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings. 
 - Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable. 
 - Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e. g. , Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering). 
 - Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e. g. , date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues). 
 - Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC. 
 - Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies. 
 - TMS & Localization Tool

Work Experience

2-5Years

About job

Job Title: Cloud Automation Architect

Location: Hyderabad (onsite)

Experience Level: 12+ years

Job description: 

We are looking for a senior automation architect who does not just write scripts - someone who builds production-grade automation frameworks from the ground up. You will own the full lifecycle: infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, self-healing, and monitoring. If you have spent years turning manual, fragmented ops into reliable, repeatable systems - this is built for you. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Ansible Automation: Design and maintain enterprise-grade playbooks, roles, and collections. Automate OS patching, configuration drift correction, security hardening, and compliance enforcement across AWS, Azure, VMware, and REST-integrated environments. Combine Ansible with Terraform for seamless post-provisioning configuration. 
 - AWS Cloud Automation Architect serverless and event-driven automation using Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SNS/SQS, S3 triggers, and Systems Manager. Build scalable, cross-account automation across AWS Organizations with proper IAM boundaries. Align all implementations with CIS, NIST, and AWS Well-Architected standards. 
 - Kubernetes & Helm Develop and own custom Helm charts for multi-environment Kubernetes deployments. Manage the full Helm lifecycle including upgrades, rollbacks, and canary releases. Drive GitOps adoption using ArgoCD or Flux. Automate namespace management, RBAC, secrets, and network policies. 
 - Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD Build reusable, versioned Terraform modules covering AWS networking, IAM, EKS, ECS, RDS, and security controls. Implement CI/CD pipelines for IaC using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps - with automated testing, linting, drift detection, and policy enforcement baked in. 
 - Security & Compliance Automation Automate CIS benchmark enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening. Integrate with CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, and SSM Parameter Store. Implement policy-as-code using OPA, Gatekeeper, or Conftest. Automate certificate lifecycle management end to end. 
 - Observability & Auto-Remediation Connect automation workflows to New Relic and LogicMonitor for telemetry-driven triggers. Build self-healing routines that detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents automatically. Convert operational runbooks into fully automated diagnostic workflows to cut MTTR significantly. 
 - ITSM Integration Integrate automation into SymphonyAI-driven ticketing, approval flows, CMDB updates, and change management processes. Build operational runbooks that map directly to ITSM workflows. 

What We Are Looking For: 

- 8+ years of hands-on infrastructure automation experience in enterprise environments
 - Expert-level Ansible engineering - advanced Jinja2 templating, dynamic inventory, custom module development
 - Strong Kubernetes and Helm expertise - chart authoring, multi-environment lifecycle management
 - Deep Terraform knowledge - reusable module design, remote state, CI/CD integration
 - Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation scripting
 - Solid AWS architecture knowledge - serverless patterns, IAM design, multi-account networking
 - Bonus Points
 - GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux · OPA / Gatekeeper / Conftest · Multi-account AWS automation · Service mesh (Istio / Linkerd) · IaC testing with Molecule, Terratest, Checkov, or tfsec · AWS cost optimization automationWhy Join

- Own automation end to end - not just a piece of it
 - Replace reactive, manual operations with intelligent, self-healing systems
 - Work across cloud, security, infrastructure, and platform engineering
 - Build patterns and frameworks the entire engineering org will adopt
 - Directly reduce MTTR, improve security posture, and accelerate cloud maturity

data.description:
About Us: 

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12, 000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 

Job Description: 

Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business. 

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we've grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city's Top 150 Privately Held Companies. 

What truly sets us apart is our culture-rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results. 

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services-providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide. 

Our culture is built on: 

- Ownership - Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment. 
 - Flexibility - A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time. 
 - Empowerment - Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact. 
 - Learning and Growth - Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development. 

Career Development and Global Exposure

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You'll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you'll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive. 

If you're ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment-where long-term stability meets start-up agility-and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we'd love to hear from you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Engineer - Controls with 8+ years of experience in the design, development, modification, migration, integration, and implementation of PLC and HMI/SCADA systems for discrete machinery and equipment. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation), and Beckhoff automation platforms. Experience in printing, paper converting, packaging, textile, or other machinery/OEM industries is highly preferred. 

The engineer should be able to take a systems approach to understand the overall machine design, mechanical functions, electrical architecture, control philosophy, safety systems, and automation requirements, and develop robust PLC and HMI programs ensuring the overall functional quality and performance of the machinery/equipment. 

The role will be responsible for the interface between electrical hardware, PLC software, HMI/SCADA, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, and machine-level automation. 

Technical Skills

PLC & HMI Platforms

Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following platforms, with the ability to work across multiple automation platforms: 

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs
 - Siemens Comfort Panels / Unified Comfort Panels
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation PLCs
 - ControlLogix
 - CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff PLC / IPC-based control systems
 - TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT
 - Experience with HMI/SCADA development and integration across Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms. 

PLC & HMI Development

- Hands-on experience developing PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on URS, functional specifications, and client standards. 
 - Ability to understand and develop PLC programs using: 
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram
 - Structured Text
 - Sequential Function Chart
 - Develop machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, permissives, recipes, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Interface PLC programs with HMI/SCADA systems. 
 - Experience in modifying, debugging, migrating, and optimizing existing PLC/HMI programs. 
 - Experience with machine-level automation and discrete manufacturing applications. 
 - HMI scripting/programming experience using JavaScript, C#, or similar technologies is an added advantage. 

Siemens Automation

- Strong hands-on experience with Siemens S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Experience with TIA Portal V15. 1 or above. 
 - TIA Portal V17/V18/V19 or later experience preferred. 
 - Siemens Comfort and Unified Comfort HMI development. 
 - PLC/HMI programming, troubleshooting, commissioning, and debugging. 
 - Experience with Siemens drives and motion systems is preferred. 

Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation

- Hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLCs. 
 - Experience with ControlLogix and/or CompactLogix platforms. 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 / RSLogix programming experience. 
 - Allen-Bradley HMI experience using FactoryTalk View is preferred. 
 - Experience with Rockwell drives, I/O, communication networks, and motion systems is an advantage. 

Beckhoff Automation

- Hands-on experience with Beckhoff PLC/control systems. 
 - Experience with TwinCAT 3 programming and development. 
 - Knowledge of EtherCAT communication and distributed I/O systems. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff IPCs, motion control, servo systems, and drives is preferred. 
 - Experience developing machine control applications using Structured Text is an advantage. 

Industrial Communication & Networking

Good understanding of industrial communication protocols and networking, including: 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS
 - EtherNet/IP
 - EtherCAT
 - AS-i
 - CAN / CANopen
 - DeviceNet
 - Modbus TCP/RTU
 - OPC UA
 - Other industrial Ethernet and fieldbus protocols

Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and integrate PLCs, remote I/O, drives, HMIs, sensors, and other automation devices over industrial networks. 

Drives, Motors & Motion Control

- Knowledge of selection and application of motors, motor controllers, VFDs, servo drives, and motion-control systems. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - Motor horsepower
 - Torque
 - Speed range
 - Gear ratios
 - Reduction ratios
 - Acceleration/deceleration
 - Experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Beckhoff drives is preferred. 
 - Basic understanding of servo positioning and motion-control applications. 

Instrumentation & Control Components

Good understanding of selection and application of industrial control components, including: 

- Sensors for flow, pressure, level, temperature, position, speed, counters, motion, vision, etc. 
 - Digital and analog sensors
 - Proximity and photoelectric sensors
 - Encoders
 - Transducers
 - Solenoid valves
 - Relays
 - Contactors
 - On/Off control devices
 - Analog I/O and signal conditioning
 - A/D and D/A conversion
 - I/P and P/I conversion

Understanding of sensor characteristics such as accuracy, precision, response time, repeatability, reliability, range, and environmental/temperature effects. 

FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Develop automation test cases and procedures for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). 
 - Participate in FAT/SAT with customers and project teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in machine installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and start-up. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, I/O, communication, and machine sequence issues. 
 - Experience with remote commissioning and troubleshooting tools. 
 - Willingness to travel to customer sites for commissioning and project support. 

Standards & Compliance

Working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulations such as: 

- ANSI
 - ISA
 - NEC
 - NEMA
 - NFPA
 - OSHA
 - UL

Experience working with machine safety systems and safety PLCs is an added advantage. 

Tool Skills

Mandatory / Core

- Siemens TIA Portal - V15. 1 or above
 - Siemens S7-1500 PLC
 - Siemens Comfort / Unified Comfort HMI
 - Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Studio 5000
 - ControlLogix / CompactLogix
 - Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
 - EtherCAT

Preferred

- TIA Portal V17+
 - FactoryTalk View
 - Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff drives and motion systems
 - OPC UA
 - Industrial Ethernet networking
 - HMI scripting / C# / JavaScript
 - EPLAN or similar electrical engineering tools

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in industrial automation and controls engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in PLC and HMI programming. 
 - Experience with a combination of Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience developing PLC/HMI programs from scratch. 
 - Experience in machinery/OEM applications is highly preferred. 
 - Experience in printing, packaging, paper converting, textile, or other discrete machinery industries is an advantage. 
 - Experience in machine commissioning and customer-site support is preferred. 

Key Result Areas

- Configure automation hardware and software according to project design specifications. 
 - Develop PLC and HMI programs from scratch based on machine automation requirements. 
 - Integrate Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and Beckhoff automation platforms with machine hardware and control systems. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, quality, and responsiveness of PLC/HMI applications. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, drives, motion, I/O, and industrial communication issues. 
 - Follow software development, change-management, and version-control procedures. 
 - Maintain proper documentation of PLC/HMI software and project changes. 
 - Manage assigned projects and deliver according to agreed schedules and scope. 
 - Communicate project progress, technical issues, and risks to project stakeholders. 
 - Support FAT, SAT, machine start-up, commissioning, and customer acceptance. 
 - Provide technical support to internal teams and customers as required. 

Soft Skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Logical and systematic approach to problem-solving. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to understand complex machine sequences and identify key technical issues. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
 - Strong customer-facing and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing project requirements. 
 - Willingness to learn and work across multiple automation platforms. 

Travel

Occasional domestic and/or international travel may be required, up to 15%, for customer meetings, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project support. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a multi-platform Controls Engineer with strong practical experience in: 

Siemens + Allen-Bradley + Beckhoff

with hands-on capability in: 

PLC Programming → HMI Development → Drives/Motion → Industrial Communication → Machine Integration → FAT/SAT → Commissioning

Experience with OEM/discrete machinery, particularly printing, packaging, paper converting, or textile machinery, will be a strong advantage. 

Barry-Wehmiller is committed to creating a people-centric workplace where employees can bring their best selves to the work they do and grow through meaningful career opportunities. 

At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work-therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We partner directly with domain engineering teams to build modern "paved paths, " reusable design patterns, and clear architectural baselines. By establishing shared foundational capabilities and standard reference architectures, we empower engineering teams to deliver faster, eliminate duplicate efforts, and unlock massive operational efficiencies across the entire corporate ecosystem. 

At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google's IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend & Infrastructure
data.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12, 000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog. 

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. 

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. 

Job Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will join a fast-paced innovation team at Coursera working on AI enablement for our organization and customers. As an internal focus area, this team builds and maintains the infrastructure & tooling required to drive meaningful AI adoption across the organization, providing a platform for non-technical team members to build and deploy tools and transforming entire business functions into AI-native operating models. As a customer-facing focus area, this team builds custom AI-powered solutions for our enterprise customers supporting them in their journey of AI adoption and upskilling beyond just the content on our platforms. 

You will have the opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, and influence the future roadmap, growth and success of Coursera's AI culture. You will work closely with a cross functional team of Software Engineers, AI Specialists and Tech Innovation Strategists - leading architecture, owning technical decisions and ensuring end-to-end delivery throughout the SDLC. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, scale and maintain the infrastructure and platform required to deliver production-grade agentic AI solutions
 - Lead architecture and technical design while ensuring high availability, reliability and scalability in our systems
 - Analyze customer requirements, understand enterprise data landscape and ensure data privacy and residency compliance factors in our engineering framework
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Tech Innovation Strategists to scope out problem statements and narrow down requirements with a laser focus on impact delivered to customers and stakeholders
 - Set a high standard of excellence for engineering culture and developer experience in the team by leading code reviews, mentoring junior engineers and building stronger processes
 - Participate in sprint planning, technical grooming, and retrospective discussions

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role - with a strong background in backend engineering and cloud infrastructure
 - 1+ years of experience building production-grade agentic AI solutions
 - Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, Java, Node. js or Go and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Kafka
 - Strong experience in implementing APIs, working with SQL and NoSQL databases and writing E2E automated tests
 - Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), able to work with self-hosted as well as managed services
 - Expertise in infrastructure as code tools like Terraform and CI/CD solutions such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins
 - Fervent belief in engineering quality and building technical leverage for others
 - Prior experience in leading projects and debugging complex issues with minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with modern evolving technologies on agentic AI such as RAG, MCP, LangGraph, LangFuse, etc. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, and navigate through ambiguity and uncertainty with confidence
 - Proven track record of delivering results in a resource-constrained environment with limited guidance and supervision
 - Excellent communication skills, ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams with a proactive mindset

Why Join Us?

- Solve real-world challenges that drive real impact across Coursera's business functions and enterprise customers
 - Work with a supportive and innovative team with a drive for continuous learning & improvement
 - Become a go-to technical leader in the team and shape the internal developer experience
 - Be part of a mission-driven company transforming global access to education and upskilling in the AI era

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice. 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera. org/udemy. com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. 

If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form. 

Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera. org.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle Functional Consultant / Test Lead to provide functional consultancy and testing leadership across Oracle E-Business Suite implementations, enhancements and international rollout programmes. 

The successful candidate will have strong hands-on Oracle EBS R12 Financials expertise and experience across the full implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support. 

This is a dual functional and testing role. The consultant will design and configure Oracle solutions while using their functional expertise to develop test scenarios, validate end-to-end business processes, support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), manage defects and provide assurance that solutions meet agreed business and statutory requirements. 

Experience of international rollouts and new-market implementations is particularly important, including the establishment of new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units and integration with third-party systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Oracle Functional Consultancy

- Lead requirements gathering and analysis with business, Finance and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into effective Oracle EBS solutions. 
 - Design and configure Oracle Financials solutions, particularly General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, E-Business Tax, Fixed Assets, AGIS and related financial processes. 
 - Configure and support new ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units for international and new-market implementations. 
 - Ensure solutions meet country-specific business and statutory requirements while remaining aligned with the organisation's wider Oracle template and financial architecture. 
 - Produce and maintain functional design and configuration documentation, including MC050 configuration documents and implementation artefacts. 
 - Develop configuration migration plans and support controlled promotion through development, SIT, UAT and production environments, using tools such as ConfigSnapshot where appropriate. 
 - Provide functional input into integrations with third-party applications, including procurement, payroll, foreign exchange/rate providers and retail systems. 
 - Work closely with technical consultants, developers and integration teams to define and validate integrations and customisations. 
 - Provide functional support throughout deployment, cutover, go-live and hypercare. 

Testing and Quality Assurance

- Translate business and functional requirements into structured test scenarios, test cases and expected results. 
 - Define and execute functional test coverage for Oracle configurations, customisations, integrations and end-to-end business processes. 
 - Lead or provide senior functional support for SIT, UAT and regression testing, including country-specific and statutory requirements. 
 - Test both standard business processing and exception/error scenarios across Oracle and connected applications. 
 - Analyse defects to identify root causes across configuration, application functionality, customisation, integration, test data and business processes. 
 - Work with business and technical teams to reproduce, resolve and retest defects. 
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, functional designs, configuration and test coverage. 
 - Support business users during UAT, resolving functional queries and distinguishing genuine application defects from process or data issues. 
 - Provide functional assurance to support implementation readiness and go-live decisions. 
 - Validate critical configuration and business processes following deployment and continue defect investigation during hypercare. 

Qualifications

Functional and Technical Skills

Essential

- Significant experience as a Senior Oracle E-Business Suite Functional Consultant, with strong Oracle EBS R12 Financials knowledge. 
 - Detailed functional experience across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Advanced Global Intercompany System (AGIS) and E-Business Tax. 
 - Experience configuring ledgers, legal entities and operating units/business units. 
 - Proven delivery experience across multi-country, new-market or legal-entity implementations. 
 - Strong requirements gathering, functional solution design, configuration and documentation skills. 
 - Strong understanding of the relationship between Oracle configuration, business processes and downstream testing. 
 - Hands-on experience of SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management and resolution. 
 - Ability to create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases from business requirements and functional designs. 
 - Experience testing interfaces between Oracle EBS and third-party applications. 
 - Experience supporting deployment, cutover, go-live and post-production hypercare. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Finance, business, functional, technical, integration and programme teams. 

Highly Desirable

- Experience using ConfigSnapshot for configuration definition, comparison, migration or assurance. 
 - Experience producing and maintaining MC050 configuration documentation. 
 - Experience implementing statutory ledgers. 
 - Experience within a large international retail environment. 
 - Experience supporting multiple concurrent country implementations. 

Testing Competencies

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong quality and testing mindset, with the ability to understand how Oracle configuration decisions translate into testing requirements. 

They should be capable of assessing how a business process will operate in Oracle, what configuration and integrations support it, how the solution will be validated, how exceptions and failures should be handled, and what regression testing is required when the solution changes. 

The ability to combine deep Oracle functional expertise with structured end-to-end testing is a core requirement of the role. 

Seniority and Leadership

As a senior member of the delivery team, the consultant will take ownership of assigned functional areas and provide guidance to business users, consultants and testers. Responsibilities may include coordinating functional workstreams, reviewing functional and testing deliverables, supporting planning and issue resolution, providing input into implementation readiness and go-live decisions, and supporting junior team members through knowledge transfer and solution guidance. 

Personal Attributes

The Ideal Candidate Will Be

- Analytical, methodical and detail-oriented. 
 - Comfortable owning delivery from initial requirement through to production. 
 - Able to challenge requirements constructively and identify gaps and risks. 
 - Strong at troubleshooting complex functional, configuration and integration issues. 
 - Confident communicating with both business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Comfortable operating within high-profile, business-critical programmes. 
 - Able to balance delivery deadlines with appropriate testing and quality controls. 
 - Capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a wider programme team. 

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability. 

- Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

 - Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people's individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance 
 - Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme 
 - Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies

And many more exciting benefits. . . drop us a note to find out more.
