data.title: Python Backend Developer – Distributed & Event-Driven Systems
data.description:
We are looking for a Python Backend Engineer with hands-on experience in distributed systems and event-driven architecture to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and data processing workflows. 

The ideal candidate will have experience building Python-based microservices, implementing event-driven communication using message brokers, handling asynchronous processing, and developing reliable distributed workflows. Strong programming fundamentals and knowledge of API development, concurrency, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant system design are essential. 

The role involves building scalable backend services, processing events asynchronously, managing service-to-service communication, and ensuring the reliability, performance, and resilience of distributed applications. 

Title : Python Backend Engineer

Location : Remote Work

Employment Type: Full-time

Exp Range: 2+ years

Key Responsibilities: 

- Python Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Distributed Systems: Build and maintain distributed backend services, handling service communication, concurrent requests, failures, timeouts, retries, and fault tolerance. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven workflows using message brokers or event streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Messaging & Event Processing: Develop event producers and consumers, process messages asynchronously, and handle message failures, retries, duplicate events, and delivery guarantees. 
 - Microservices Development: Build independent backend services and implement reliable service-to-service communication and integration. 
 - Asynchronous Processing & Task Scheduling: Implement asynchronous operations, background jobs, scheduled tasks, and task queues using asyncio, Celery, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Data Ingestion & ETL Pipelines: Develop data processing workflows to extract, transform, validate, and load data while maintaining accuracy and reliability. 
 - Database Development: Write and optimize SQL queries, manage database interactions, and integrate backend services with PostgreSQL, AlloyDB, or other SQL databases. 
 - Redis & Caching: Implement caching and efficient data access strategies to reduce database load and improve application performance. 
 - Problem Solving & Debugging: Analyze logs, troubleshoot complex backend issues, identify root causes, and optimize application performance. 
 - Containerization & Cloud Deployment: Use Docker to package backend services and support deployments and troubleshooting in AWS or GCP environments. 
 - Code Quality & Collaboration: Follow clean coding practices, use Git for version control, participate in code reviews, and write maintainable, testable code. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications: 

- Python Backend Development: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing backend applications and REST APIs using Python, preferably with FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Distributed Systems: Practical understanding of distributed services, service-to-service communication, fault tolerance, timeouts, retries, and failure handling. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Hands-on experience with event-driven workflows, message producers and consumers, and asynchronous messaging. 
 - Message Brokers: Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies. Familiarity with message delivery guarantees, acknowledgments, retries, and dead-letter queues is preferred. 
 - Microservices: Understanding of independent backend services, REST APIs, and service integration patterns. 
 - Asynchronous Processing & Concurrency: Knowledge of asyncio, async/await, concurrent execution, and non-blocking I/O. 
 - Task Scheduling & Background Processing: Experience or working knowledge of background jobs, scheduled tasks, and task queues using Celery or equivalent technologies. 
 - SQL & Database Integration: Working knowledge of SQL and experience with PostgreSQL, AlloyDB, or another relational database. 
 - ETL & Data Processing: Exposure to data ingestion, extraction, transformation, validation, or data pipeline development. 
 - Redis & Caching: Understanding of caching strategies and their impact on backend performance. 
 - Docker & Cloud Fundamentals: Familiarity with Docker and basic exposure to AWS or GCP environments. 
 - Problem Solving & Debugging: Strong analytical skills, ability to troubleshoot backend issues, investigate failures, and write clean, maintainable code. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience building production-grade distributed applications. 
 - Understanding of idempotency, eventual consistency, and message ordering. 
 - Exposure to observability tools, structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

Salesforce has immediate opportunities for software developers who want their lines of code to have significant and measurable positive impact for users, the company's bottom line, and the industry. You will be working with a group of world-class engineers to build the breakthrough features our customers will love, adopt, and use while keeping our trusted CRM platform stable and scalable. The software engineer role at Salesforce encompasses architecture, design, implementation, and testing to ensure we build products right and release them with high quality. 

Code review, mentoring junior engineers, and providing technical guidance to the team (depending on the seniority level) We pride ourselves on writing high-quality, maintainable code that strengthens the stability of the product and makes our lives easier. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone on the team to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe that autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions will empower the individuals, the product, the company, and the customers they serve to thrive. 

Your Impact

As An Engineering Lead, Your Responsibilities Include

- Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code
 - Design and orchestrate complex, scalable systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale
 - Make architectural and design decisions with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and future extensibility
 - Contribute to all phases of the SDLC, including design, implementation, code reviews, automation, and testing in a hybrid engineering model
 - Build efficient components and algorithms within a microservices-based, multi-tenant SaaS cloud environment
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context - an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably
 - Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance

Required Skills

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, distributed systems, and scalable architecture
 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Scala, C#, Go, Node. js, or C++

 - Strong understanding of relational and non-relational databases (e. g. , PostgreSQL, Trino, Redshift, MongoDB) and solid SQL skills
 - Experience with distributed systems concepts such as queues, locking, scheduling, event-driven architecture, and workload distribution

Unleash Your Potential

Senior Software Engineer - Backend

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you're in the right place. 

Why This Job's a Big Deal

Join an Agile team of professionals that are instrumental in building the next generation of travel applications. We constantly explore new technologies and engineer better solutions for ever demanding business needs. 

Our team of engineers, at all levels, work with the business leaders in defining the product roadmap and come up with innovative solutions to grow the future of travel. We design and develop our back end systems and REST APIs that serve hundreds of millions of searches a day, collecting and parsing data across thousands of partners to get the best deals for our customers

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We'd love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III
data.description:
What is Hunch?

Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room. 

With 2. 4M+ daters, 1. 47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world. 

Link to our fundraising announcement

Key Offerings Of Hunch

- One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe. 
 - Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage. 
 - Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections. 
 - Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever. 

About The Role

We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We're looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally. 

What You'll Do

- Own backend features end-to-end - product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket. 
 - Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next. js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy). 
 - Own async & event-driven work - queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler. )
 - Ship LLM-backed product features - tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users. 
 - Keep production legible - tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke. 
 - Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python - strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role. 
 - Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL - schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones. 
 - Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka - producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates. 
 - Service design & delivery - clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD. 
 - End-to-end ownership - you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus. 
 - Engineering hygiene - writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved. 

Preferred Experience

- ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double. 
 - LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus. 
 - Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog). 
 - Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly. 
 - Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products. 

What We Offer

- Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI). 
 - Employee benefits like Medical Insurance. 
 - Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options). 

Life at Hunch

Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room. 

What We Hire For - The ABCs

Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work: 

- Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it. 
 - Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice. 
 - Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions - about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know. 

How We Work

- Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping. 
 - Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters. 
 - Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours. 
 - Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product. 

Backed by Global Investors

Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios. 

Experienced Leadership

Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

Under normal physics, you'd staff this surface with a 15-person platform team plus a 15-person AppSec org - the size of our entire engineering team. 

We don't want either. 

We already run one of the most AI-augmented pipelines in Indian fi ntech - our internal agent

Jarvis ships real code, triages alerts, and reviews PRs across the whole estate every day. Our engineers move fast because the paved road is intelligent. We want the same for platform and security together. That's your job. 

What "AI-first DevSecOps" means at Jupiter

Not "we bought a Copilot license. 

- " It means: Deployment orchestration, capacity planning, incident triage, CVE work, threat modeling, IaC review, cost anomaly detection - all designed as agent loops first, human-supervised and continuously improved
 - Every "senior SRE would have caught this rollback" and every "senior AppSec would have caught this XSS" becomes a repeatable, evaluated agent check - codified, not tribal 
 - Deploy latency, incident MTTR, security-review latency, unit cost per transaction -metrics you drive down quarterly, not queues you defend
 - Auditors and partners get automated evidence packs, not spreadsheet marathonsWhat you'll actually own

Platform / DevOps

- The paved road for shipping: CI/CD, Spinnaker deploy pipelines, build systems, feature flags, release gates
 - Cloud + Kubernetes across a multi-cloud estate (AWS + OCI, multiple accounts); IaC (Terraform +Terragrunt for cloud, Helm 3 + Kustomize for K8s) as the source of truth
 - Observability platform: logs, metrics, traces, alerting as a product engineers want to use
 - SRE practice: on-call, incident command, error budgets, capacity + cost engineering
 - Developer experience: local dev, preview environments, secrets provisioning, self-serve infraSecurity

- AppSec paved road: SAST / DAST / SBOM / secret-scan / IaC scan/dependency CVE triage -as PR checks that don't get routed around
 - Cloud + K8s security posture; IAM boundaries, network segmentation for partner integrations
 - Threat modeling on every new service touching money, PII, or a partner API
 - Incident response: detection, containment, forensics, post-mortems
 - RBI cyber framework, PCI-DSS, DPDP - as artifacts your pipelines emit, not documents your team writes; future-ready for ISO 27001 / SOC 2 when we choose to pursue them
 - Direct interface with banking partners and regulators on our security + reliability postureExperience & background we're looking for

- Non-negotiable 15+ years total in software engineering, of which 8+ years hands-on across DevOps / Platform / SRE and Application / Cloud Security (real depth in both - not "managed a team that did it")
 - 6+ years leading engineering teams, at least 2 as second-line (managing managers or senior ICs)
 - 3+ years in a regulated industry - fintech, banking, healthtech, or an equivalent audit-heavyenvironment. You've been through at least one RBI / PCI-DSS (or equivalent) audit as an owner, not a bystander. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 experience is a plus. 
 - Deep AWS + Kubernetes production experience (multi-account, IAM, VPC, EKS, IaC via Terraform / Terragrunt + Helm / Kustomize). OCI experience is a plus. 
 - Hands-on with modern LLM tooling (Claude / GPT / agentic frameworks) for real engineering work - you've shipped or heavily used AI dev tools in the last 12 months, not just experimented
 - Can read Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript comfortably; write Python fluentlyStrong plus

- Previously built the DevSecOps function at an Indian fintech under RBI supervision
 - Ran incident command for a Sev-1 that touched customer money - and led the post-mortem
 - Public work: OSS contributions to security or platform tooling, conference talks, technical blog with depth
 - Certifications: CISSP / CCSP / OSCP (security), CKA / CKS (Kubernetes), AWS Security Specialty nice signals but we care about what you've shipped, not what you've certified
 - History of hiring and retaining strong ICs (references we can call)Explicit non-requirements

- MBA / management degree - irrelevant here
 - Big-Tech (FAANG) tenure - nice signal, not required; we've seen more Jupiter-fit talent from product startups than from BigCo
 - Prior "Director" title - if you're a Principal / Staff who's been operating at Director scope, applyYou know it's you if. . . 

- You've shipped platform tooling and security tooling that engineers didn't route around both
 - You can read Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript, and you write Python without thinking about it
 - You've owned an on-call rota you'd want to be on
 - You've been hands-on with Claude / GPT / agentic frameworks for real work - not just chat
 - You've run platform or security in a regulated environment and know what a real audit feels like
 - You believe the future infra + security leader is 30% engineer, 30% agent-builder, 40% coach -and you're excited about the middle 30%You should probably skip this if. . . 

- You want to lead a large team from day one (small strong team, senior-IC-heavy, is by design)
 - You prefer governance to building
 - You're skeptical that agents can do meaningful platform or security work - we'd rather hire someone who's already proven it to themselves
 - You want to specialize in only one side (only Sec, only DevOps) - the whole point of this role is one strong leader across bothThe offer

- Reports directly to the President. 
 - Board-level visibility on infra + security posture. 
 - Small strong team, budget to build (tooling, agents, headcount as we scale). 
 - Bangalore, work from office. 
 - Comp calibrated to senior director / VP band at leading Indian fintechs.

40

data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

YOUR ROLE

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications. 

As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time. 

In this context, you will be responsible for Camera Image Sensor SoC validation, focusing on Security, Secure Streaming, Cryptographic Validation, and System-Level Functional validation. 

The candidate will be responsible for validating security features across the Camera Image Sensor SoC, ensuring robust implementation of security architectures including Secure Boot, Root of Trust, Authentication, Encryption, Hashing, Secure Firmware Update, Secure Streaming, and Anti-Tamper mechanisms. The role requires deep understanding of imaging pipelines, embedded systems, security protocols, and automation using Python. 

Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration. 

To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs. 

You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team. 

Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate end-to-end security architecture of Camera Image Sensor SoCs. 
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans for hybrid cryptographic schemes combining classical and PQC algorithms: 
 - Secure Boot
 - Chain of Trust
 - Secure Firmware Loading
 - Secure Debug Access
 - Secure Key Provisioning
 - Anti-Tamper Mechanisms
 - Secure Manufacturing Flows
 - Secure video streaming
 - Verify authentication and authorization mechanisms. 
 - Validate OTP -based security configurations. 
 - Perform negative testing and security robustness testing. 
Your Skills & Experiences

- Object-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
 - Version management tools (git, svn)
 - Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.

 - Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc. )
 - Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI, DP, eDP
 - Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
 - Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.

data.title: Embedded System - FPGA & SoC Performance Engineer
data.description:
About CynLr

Just like a baby's brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see & pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link). 

Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn't exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment. 

CynLr-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on-the-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO-like micro-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change. 

At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr' s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision-making, and action. 

This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world. 

About the Role: 

Product Design begins as a hypothetical concept. Transforming that concept into a functional Product is a highly creative and experimental process that requires a strong understanding of system-level fundamentals and application-driven trade-offs. 

In FPGA-based embedded systems, the utility and limitations of a product are defined by how effectively the FPGA platform is configured, integrated, and used at the system and application level. Performance, latency, determinism, and I/O capability depend on IP selection, configuration, firmware integration, and system architecture. 

You will be responsible for the application-level design, integration, validation, and deployment of FPGA-based embedded systems. The Product Design team will be your internal customer. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Supporting CynLr's Product Design team with all FPGA application and system-level activities. 
 - FPGA platform configuration and integration using vendor-provided IP cores and reference designs. 
 - System bring-up, validation, and debugging of FPGA-based hardware platforms. 
 - Verification & Validation (V&V)
 - Defining test procedures for FPGA-based systems and firmware
 - Executing tests and validating manufactured PCBs and assemblies
 - Interfacing with vendors (FPGA vendors, IP providers, PCB manufacturers, component suppliers, simulation and service providers) to plan and coordinate successful project execution. 
 - Acting as the FPGA application and system knowledge base for design engineers and freshers joining the organization. 

Team Structure & Career Path: 

This role resides in the Electronics team and is part of the larger hardware team. The role has touchpoints with other teams most notably the Product Design team. We are a startup and there is a tremendous potential to build your own team or grow into a principal engineer role over time in the space or expand into other areas. 

Job Requirements

Below are some key requirements. We expect working knowledge in most areas and deep hands-on expertise in either FPGA or SoC

A. Electronics & System Fundamentals: 

- Strong understanding of digital electronics and system-level architecture. 
 - Solid understanding of register-based systems and memory architectures (DDR, SRAM, Flash). 
 - Working knowledge of power distribution and sequencing for FPGA-based systems. 
 - Understanding of processor and accelerator architectures (ARM-based SoC FPGAs). B. FPGA Application & Platform Development: 

- Hands-on experience with FPGA or SoC-FPGA. 
 - Strong familiarity with FPGA vendor toolchains (Vivado, Quartus, Libero). 
 - Experience configuring and integrating: 
 - Vendor-provided IP cores
 - Memory controllers
 - Communication and data-movement IP Blocks
 - Ability to generate FPGA bitstreams using existing IP and reference designs. C. Embedded Firmware Design & Development: 

- Strong experience in embedded firmware development using C/C++. 
 - Experience developing firmware for ARM cores inside FPGA SoCs
 - Experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems. 
 - Ability to develop and debug drivers for memory-mapped peripherals. 
 - Good understanding of boot flows, BSPs, and build systems. D. Interfaces & Communication: 

- Strong working knowledge of communication protocols: 
 - UART, SPI, I2C, AXI
 - Ethernet, USB
 - Experience debugging data flow, latency, and performance issues at the system level. E. Verification and Validation: 

- Adept in using JTAG-based debugging tools. 
 - Experience with system bring-up and validation of FPGA-based boards. 
 - Experience using: 
 - Logic analyzers
 - Oscilloscopes
 - Vendor-provided tools (Vivado, Quartus, Libero)
 - Ability to create and execute test procedures and validation plans. 
 - Ability to debug data flow and performance bottlenecks at the system level. F. Behavioural Tendency: 

Critical Thinking, Available, Responsible, Versatile, Resourceful, Thorough, Attention to Details & "Humble". 

What Will You Do: 

CynLr' s vision system is central in the control loop of the vision guided manipulation platform. The stereo vision system is acquiring at 75 FPS and this means processing must also happen at this speed or higher and the processing method based on neural network is computationally intensive as it involves a high level of successive matrix multiplication. For this the processing is split between multiple processing units FPGA, GPU and CPU based on the type of processing that is required. Your focus will be majorly on the FPGA, working closely with the Product Design team to build and deploy FPGA-based embedded systems at the application and system level. This includes configuring FPGA platforms using vendor tools and IP, developing embedded firmware to control and interface with FPGA logic, bringing up and validating hardware, and debugging system-level issues involving interfaces, memory, and peripherals. You will define and execute verification and validation procedures, support prototypes and manufacturing builds, and ensure reliable system behaviour in real-world use. This role focuses on integration, firmware, and system validation

How Will You Do: 

Though confined to a focused area, the work is pretty much expected to be entrepreneurial with the exact advantages and difficulties of a startup. Since this is a startup and the product will evolve at a rapid pace, the contours of the technology, toolchain & Process will have to constantly adapt to the changes. You will participate in actively contributing in building the process & tool chain too. You will have complete freedom here, but you will be subjected to reviews. 

Detailed JD Here: Embedded System Engineer - FPGA/SoC

data.title: Manager Devsecops
data.description:
Job Description

About the Role We are looking for a DevSecOps Manager to lead the team responsible for securing company's cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and CI/CD pipelines. You will manage a team of 5-8 DevSecOps engineers, own the team's roadmap and delivery commitments, and be accountable for the security posture of the infrastructure and deployment platforms on which engineering organization runs on. This is a people and delivery leadership role. You will not be writing production code day to day, but you are expected to have the technical depth to review designs, challenge approaches, make informed tradeoffs, and earn the trust of a senior engineering team. Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and growth of your team, and by measurable improvement in security outcomes. Roles and Responsibilities Team Leadership & People Management Build the Team: Own hiring for the DevSecOps team end to end - define roles and leveling, run a high-signal interview loop, and close senior candidates in a competitive market. Develop Engineers: Run regular 1: 1s, set clear expectations and growth plans, and actively develop engineers toward Senior and Staff scope. Create and defend time for learning and deep work. Performance Management: Give direct, timely feedback. Run fair and well-evidenced performance cycles, recognize strong contribution, and address underperformance early and constructively. Team Health: Own on-call sustainability, workload balance, and retention. Build a psychologically safe environment where engineers surface risk and bad news early. Delivery & Execution Roadmap Ownership: Own the DevSecOps team roadmap. Translate security strategy and engineering priorities into a sequenced, resourced plan with clear owners and dates. Predictable Delivery: Run planning, prioritization, and execution rituals. Deliver committed work predictably and communicate slippage early with options, not surprises. Prioritization & Tradeoffs: Arbitrate between security remediation, platform investment, compliance obligations, and support requests - and make the reasoning behind those calls visible. Dependency Management: Identify and unblock cross-team dependencies with Cloud Security, Product Security, SRE, and application teams before they become delivery risk. Metrics & Reporting: Define and report the team's operating metrics - vulnerability SLA adherence, mean time to detect and remediate, pipeline security coverage, control-automation progress - to engineering leadership. Security Program Ownership Platform Security Posture: Be accountable for the security posture of cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), Kubernetes and container platforms, and CI/CD toolchains. Shift-Left Program: Own the program that embeds automated security testing, static and dynamic analysis, IaC scanning, and dependency scanning into the development lifecycle, with adoption and signal quality as explicit goals. Vulnerability Management: Own the vulnerability lifecycle for the team's scope - intake, risk-based prioritization, SLA definition and enforcement, remediation tracking, and exception governance. Compliance & Audit Readiness: Partner with GRC and Cloud Security to ensure infrastructure and deployments meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and GDPR/CCPA obligations. Drive automated, continuously evidenced controls over manual evidence collection. Standards & Governance: Work with Cloud Security and Product Security to define security standards, policies, and frameworks - then own their rollout and adoption within your scope. Operational Excellence & Incident Response Security Incident Management: Own the team's security incident response readiness. Act as incident commander or escalation point for infrastructure and pipeline security events. Post-Incident Rigor: Ensure every significant incident produces a blameless post-mortem with tracked systemic remediation - not just a closed ticket. Detection Coverage: Hold the team accountable for monitoring and alerting coverage, alert quality, and runbook completeness. Risk Escalation: Maintain a clear-eyed view of accepted risk in your scope and escalate it to leadership with context and recommended options. Technical Judgment & Cross-Functional Partnership Technical Depth: Review designs and architecture proposals, ask the right questions, and make or ratify consequential technical decisions - without becoming the bottleneck. Build vs Buy: Lead tooling evaluation and vendor decisions for security tooling, with cost, integration effort, and operational burden all accounted for. Stakeholder Management: Represent the team to engineering leadership, Security, GRC, and - where needed - enterprise customers and auditors. Security-First Culture: Partner with peer engineering managers to make secure practice the default across development teams through enablement, documentation, and shared goals rather than mandates. What Makes You Relevant for This Role? Required Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience in DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, or Security Engineering roles. 3+ years directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development. Prior experience as a senior individual contributor before moving into management. Strong working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD toolchains such as Jenkins, Tekton, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD - enough to lead technical discussions credibly. Solid understanding of secure infrastructure design, identity and access management, network security, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Demonstrated experience owning a security or infrastructure program with measurable outcomes - vulnerability SLAs, control automation, audit readiness, or incident-response maturity. Experience running incident response and blameless post-mortem practice for production systems. Excellent written and verbal communication; able to brief engineering leadership and translate technical risk into business terms. Preferred Experience managing a DevSecOps, Cloud Security Engineering, or Platform Security team specifically. Hands-on experience taking an organization through SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI-DSS certification or audit. Experience in a multi-tenant SaaS environment handling regulated consumer or financial data. Familiarity with policy-as-code (OPA, Kyverno), secrets management (Vault, KMS), and software supply-chain security (SBOM, artifact signing). Experience building a team from a small base - defining process and operating cadence where little existed. Exposure to securing AI/ML workloads and agentic systems. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKS, or AWS Certified Security - Specialty. Why this role ? Own the security posture of a cloud-native platform that powers transactions for thousands of dealerships and their consumers. Build and shape a team at a company still early enough that your operating decisions set the standard. Direct access to engineering leadership and a real seat in platform and security strategy. Work with some of the smartest minds in the industry on complex security problems at genuine scale. An innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture where good ideas move quickly. 

Required Skills

['Kubernetes', 'DevSecOps', 'Docker', 'Security']

Additional Information

Look out for people with devops & security knowledge

 - Lead workforce planning, succession management, leadership development, and capability-building initiatives. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous learning.

 - Enterprise Leadership-

Qualifications

 - Proven track record of delivering large transformation programs and managing complex technology portfolios.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems & Data Engineering
data.description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-time | Core AI Engineering Team | Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead

About Taiyo. AI

Taiyo. AI is building a living world model of the built economy-an intelligence platform connecting infrastructure projects, construction, energy, investment, companies, procurement, and real-world risks. 

Our proprietary data ecosystem spans millions of projects, tens of millions of tenders, and thousands of sources worldwide. We're turning this fragmented information into structured, continuously evolving intelligence that enterprises can interrogate through advanced AI agents and decision-making workflows. 

We're building at the frontier of applied AI, large-scale data engineering, and domain-specific intelligence systems. Our challenge isn't simply making LLMs answer questions. It's building systems that know what is happening in the real world, distinguish evidence from inference, deal intelligently with uncertainty, and improve as new information arrives. 

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional, hands-on AI Engineer who can help architect, build, and scale the next generation of Taiyo's intelligence infrastructure. 

You'll work across advanced Python engineering, agentic AI orchestration, AI-powered data enrichment, entity intelligence, retrieval systems, and large-scale data pipelines. 

We're a small team with large technical ambitions. You'll have significant ownership, work directly with the founders and engineering team, and be expected to move quickly from architectural thinking to working production systems. 

This is a builder's role, not a research-only position or a prompt engineering job. 

What You'll Build

- Advanced AI Agents & Orchestration
 - Design and develop sophisticated agentic workflows using LLMs, tools, APIs, retrieval, and structured reasoning. 
 - Build robust multi-step and multi-agent execution systems with clear state management, error handling, and observability. 
 - Develop orchestration that integrates multiple models, proprietary data, external information, and enterprise workflows. 
 - Improve agent reliability, grounding, latency, evaluation, and inference economics. 
 - Experiment rapidly with emerging AI architectures while maintaining production engineering discipline. 

2. AI-Native Data Engineering & World Models

- Build scalable pipelines for ingesting, processing, normalizing, and enriching large volumes of structured and unstructured data. 
 - Develop AI-driven extraction, classification, entity resolution, deduplication, and information reconciliation systems. 
 - Help create persistent, interconnected representations of projects, organizations, assets, locations, events, relationships, and their evolution over time. 
 - Develop reliable methods for integrating multiple conflicting or incomplete sources into coherent, structured intelligence. 
 - Build scalable enrichment systems for future infrastructure projects, project status, timelines, financing, procurement, delivery methods, risks, and other domain-specific attributes. 
 - Contribute to flexible data schemas, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, and emerging industry data standards. 

3. Data Reliability, Provenance & AI Evaluation

- Engineer systems that distinguish verified facts, sourced estimates, model inferences, and genuinely unknown information. 
 - Build source-level provenance, evidence linking, confidence assessment, temporal tracking, and structured uncertainty management. 
 - Design automated validation, quality monitoring, and evaluation frameworks for AI-generated data and agent outputs. 
 - Develop mechanisms to detect contradictions, stale information, hallucinations, and inconsistent entity relationships. 
 - Create measurable improvements in data accuracy, completeness, freshness, and traceability. 

4. Production AI Infrastructure & Backend Systems

- Build production-grade Python services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and distributed processing infrastructure. 
 - Work with cloud services, databases, search indexes, vector retrieval, queues, and scalable data architectures. 
 - Improve the reliability, performance, monitoring, and cost efficiency of AI and data systems. 
 - Own features end to end, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

What We're Looking For

- Strong production Python engineering skills, ideally 4-7+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience building complex AI applications, LLM orchestration systems, or agentic workflows. 
 - Strong foundations in data engineering, SQL, data modeling, APIs, and distributed or asynchronous systems. 
 - Experience with structured data extraction, retrieval, enrichment pipelines, or large-scale information processing. 
 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), Docker, production deployment, and engineering observability. 
 - Sound understanding of LLM limitations, grounding, evaluations, reliability, and production failure modes. 
 - Ability to write excellent code, think architecturally, debug difficult problems, and ship quickly. 

Especially Valuable

- LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agent orchestration architectures. 
 - Knowledge graphs, entity resolution, temporal data modeling, and semantic data systems. 
 - Apache Spark, Ray, Airflow, Dagster, or comparable data processing technologies. 
 - FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, vector databases, or graph databases. 
 - LLM evaluation, tracing, experimentation, model routing, and cost optimization. 
 - Experience with Langfuse or similar AI observability tools. 
 - Experience developing high-reliability AI enrichment pipelines using real-world, incomplete, or contradictory datasets. 

We care more about demonstrated engineering depth and exceptional execution than specific frameworks or academic credentials. 

Who Thrives Here

You have built serious systems, not just demos. 

You are comfortable working at the intersection of AI research developments and pragmatic production engineering. 

You think deeply about architecture, correctness, and failure modes, but you're also fast, resourceful, and willing to get your hands dirty. 

You enjoy ambiguous problems, take ownership without waiting for instructions, and can move from experimentation to scalable implementation. 

You're intellectually curious, ambitious, and excited by the challenge of building a foundational intelligence platform for a massive global industry. 

Why Join Taiyo. AI?

You'll help solve challenging problems at the frontier of agentic AI and real-world intelligence, working with one of the richest emerging data ecosystems focused on the physical economy. 

You'll have the opportunity to shape the architecture of a living world model, build new AI capabilities used by major enterprises, and grow into a technical leadership role as the platform scales. 

You'll join a small team where exceptional engineers have real influence, meaningful ownership, and the freedom to build.

data.title: Senior SRE/DevOps Engineer
data.description:
About TrueFoundry

Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all. 

That infrastructure layer is being built right now. 

We are looking for a Senior SRE/DevOps Engineer to join the team. 

The Problem We're Solving

Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents. 

The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready. 

You Need a Control Plane That Handles

- Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
 - Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
 - Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
 - A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

AI Gateway is the control plane: five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance. 

We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform. 

Roles / Responsibilities

- Write Terraform modules for deploying different components of infrastructure in AWS, like Kubernetes, RDS, Prometheus, Grafana, and Static Website
 - The SRE will work closely with TrueFoundry customers, gaining a deep understanding of the TrueFoundry platform to ensure smooth deployments, reliable operations, and best practices adoption. This role will also involve training and onboarding new customers, assisting them in implementing TrueFoundry effectively, and helping drive platform adoption and operational excellence across customer teams. 
 - Configure networking and autoscaling. continuous deployment, security, and multiple environments
 - Make sure the infrastructure is SOC2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA compliant
 - Automate all the steps to provide a seamless experience to developers. 

Requirements

- Experience with Golang or Python is a must. **
 - 4-8 years of work experience writing clean production code
 - Well-versed in maintaining infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc). High proficiency with Terraform / Terragrunt is absolutely critical
 - Experience in setting up CI/CD pipelines from scratch
 - Experience with ETL pipelines, Bigdata infra
 - Understanding of common security issues

Perks of Working at TrueFoundry

- Join a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family. 
 - Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule. 
 - Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office. 
 - Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
data.description:
Company Description

Logward, a Shippeo company, is a pioneer in AI-powered supply chain execution workflows. As part of Shippeo - the global leader in real-time transportation visibility - Logward brings together trusted, SLA-backed visibility data with intelligent workflows and automation, helping global supply chain teams respond faster, reduce manual effort, and run more connected operations. 

*Please note: this role is locally employed by and contracted directly through Logward India Private Limited. *

Founded in 2014, Shippeo is a leading European SaaS company transforming supply chain visibility. With a global presence and multicultural team of 27 nationalities operating across Europe, North America, and Asia, we offer real-time multimodal transportation visibility to top industry leaders across various sectors. 

Our ambition is to become the world's leading supply chain data platform, using predictive AI, high-quality real-time data, and a robust partner network to enhance customer experience and operational excellence. 

Learn more about our mission and values on our website: https: //www. shippeo. com/en/company/about-us

___

About the role

Logward, a Shippeo company, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Data to join its core product development team in Bengaluru. You will help build Logward's No-Code Data Platform, creating reusable product capabilities that enable users to ingest, model, transform, validate, monitor, and operationalize data workflows without writing code. 

This is a backend product engineering role, not a customer implementation or data integration delivery role. You will work with product managers, architects, frontend engineers, and QA engineers to build reliable, configurable, observable, and enterprise-ready platform capabilities. 

Location & Work Model: 

- Location: Bengaluru
 - Work Model: Hybrid (4 days per week in-office)

Application Requirement: 

As we operate internationally, we kindly request all candidates to submit their CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages cannot be considered. 

- Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent - Individual Contributor
 - Function: Engineering, Data Platform

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop the core data backbone for Logward's No-Code Data Platform. 
 - Build reusable capabilities for ingestion, parsing, schema management, mapping, transformation, validation, orchestration, monitoring, and operational workflows. 
 - Develop scalable backend services, APIs, workers, and execution engines using Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar technologies. 
 - Build configuration-driven and metadata-driven frameworks that allow users to define pipelines, mappings, validations, and business rules without writing code. 
 - Use distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or similar technologies. 
 - Support ingestion of structured, semi-structured, and flat-file data, including JSON, XML, CSV, fixed-width files, EDI, APIs, and database sources. 
 - Implement transformations such as lookups, joins, enrichments, calculations, conditional logic, aggregations, normalization, and format conversions. 
 - Build observability capabilities including execution logs, audit trails, lineage, error tracking, retry handling, SLA monitoring, and data quality checks. 
 - Contribute to AI-assisted capabilities such as schema inference, mapping suggestions, transformation recommendations, anomaly detection, error explanation, and pipeline troubleshooting. 
 - Design safe AI-agent workflows with tool orchestration, structured outputs, validation layers, guardrails, audit logs, and human review. 
 - Convert product requirements into architecture, technical designs, and production-ready code, while contributing to design reviews, testing, debugging, and production readiness. 
 - Collaborate with product, engineering, and design teams to build robust, user-friendly, extensible, and scalable platform features. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - At least 4 years of experience as a Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, or in a comparable product-focused engineering role. 
 - Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar programming languages, with a strong grasp of object-oriented design, clean coding practices, testing, debugging, and performance tuning. 
 - Hands-on experience developing backend systems, APIs, background workers, orchestration layers, or execution engines for scalable applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of data engineering fundamentals, including ingestion, transformation, validation, orchestration, data quality, metadata management, and monitoring. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, and NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB or Redis. 
 - Familiarity with JSON, XML, CSV, fixed-width files, EDI, RESTful APIs, asynchronous processing, message queues, retries, idempotency, and error handling. 
 - Understanding of data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD, GitHub, Docker, cloud-native development, and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow. 
 - Exposure to AI and LLM product capabilities, including agents, tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and enterprise guardrails. 
 - A product-oriented mindset and the ability to translate requirements into scalable, reusable, and configurable platform features. 
 - Ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, mentor peers, and uphold strong engineering practices. 

Preferred (Not Required)

- Experience designing rule engines, expression evaluators, workflow engines, schema registries, or metadata-driven systems. 
 - Experience with data contracts, dataset versioning, backward compatibility, schema evolution, and data lineage. 
 - Understanding of security, tenant isolation, permission-aware execution, auditability, and data privacy in enterprise SaaS products. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, object storage, distributed workers, event-driven architectures, or AI-driven data products. 

Why Join Shippeo?

At Shippeo, you will join a fast-moving company that values ambition, care, delivery, and collaboration. We offer an environment where impact is encouraged, ideas are valued, and development is supported. 

What sets us apart: 

- Meaningful work with real-world impact in global supply chains. 
 - A diverse, inclusive, and international team. 
 - A culture of transparency, feedback, and continuous learning. 
 - Opportunities for growth, internal mobility, and professional development
 - Hybrid work model and flexible policies. 

To learn more about our culture and people, visit our Careers section or explore team stories on our social platforms. 

Recruitment Process

Our hiring process includes the following steps: 

- Preliminary call with a Talent Acquisition Manager
 - First interview with the Hiring Manager
 - Case study interview or technical assessment
 - Final interview with leadership or cross-functional team members

Diversity and Inclusion

At Shippeo, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value the perspectives, experiences, and contributions of individuals from all backgrounds. Our policies, practices, and company culture reflect this commitment to equal opportunity and mutual respect. 

If you have specific needs or questions regarding disability inclusion, you may reach out to our dedicated Disability Advisor at inclusion@shippeo. com for support during the application process. 

This position is published via the Shippeo global talent platform on behalf of Logward, a Shippeo group company. The hiring entity and legal employer of record for this role is Logward India Private Limited. All interviews, offer letters, and employment contracts will be executed directly through Logward India.

data.title: SDE I - Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) | AI, Agentic Systems & Software Engineering

Are you a strong software engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous, real-world business problems and turning them into production-ready technology?

We're looking for Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who combine: 

💻 Strong software engineering

🤖 AI & Agentic Engineering

🧠 Product thinking

🔧 Hands-on problem solving

🤝 Customer & stakeholder collaboration

🏗️ End-to-end ownership

🔹 What You'll Do

As an FDE, you'll take ownership of complex problems - from discovery → solution design → prototype → implementation → production deployment → continuous improvement. 

You will: 

• Work directly with customers, product teams, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand complex problems and translate them into technical solutions. 

• Build production-grade applications, backend services, APIs, integrations, and AI-powered workflows. 

• Design and develop AI agents and agentic workflows using LLMs, tool/function calling, APIs, RAG, MCP, and emerging AI technologies. 

• Integrate solutions with internal platforms and external enterprise systems. 

• Rapidly prototype ideas and convert successful prototypes into scalable production systems. 

• Debug complex issues across applications, APIs, infrastructure, data, models, and third-party integrations. 

• Make pragmatic architectural decisions balancing scalability, reliability, security, latency, cost, and time-to-market. 

• Determine when to use deterministic software vs. AI/LLM-based approaches. 

• Implement guardrails, authorization, observability, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms for AI systems. 

• Work effectively with incomplete requirements and evolving customer needs. 

• Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

🔹 Strong Software Engineering Fundamentals

We're looking for hands-on experience with: 

• Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent

• APIs, databases, distributed systems, and backend architecture

• Production-grade applications and services

• Debugging and troubleshooting

• Authentication & authorization

• Security, scalability, reliability, observability, and performance

• Quickly understanding unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and systems

🔹 AI & Agentic Engineering

Hands-on experience or strong practical understanding of: 

• Large Language Models (LLMs)

• LLM APIs & SDKs

• AI agents & agentic workflows

• Tool/function calling

• Prompt & context engineering

• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

• Model evaluation & quality measurement

• Guardrails & hallucination mitigation

• Agent state, memory & orchestration

• Human-in-the-loop workflows

• Model cost, latency & accuracy trade-offs

Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangGraph, MCP, or similar AI/agent frameworks is highly desirable. 

💡 We value engineers who understand when NOT to use an LLM just as much as those who know how to use one. 

🔹 Enterprise Integration & Architecture

Experience with some of the following is highly desirable: 

• REST / GraphQL APIs

• Webhooks & event-driven architectures

• Messaging / queueing systems

• SQL / NoSQL databases

• OAuth / OIDC & enterprise authentication

• SaaS & enterprise system integrations

• Cloud platforms & containerized environments

• Microservices & distributed systems

🔹 What Makes a Strong FDE?

We're particularly interested in engineers who: 

• Are comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete requirements. 

• Ask the right questions before jumping into implementation. 

• Can independently convert a business problem into a working technical solution. 

• Are equally comfortable discussing requirements with customers and debugging code with engineers. 

• Have strong product judgment and focus on solving the underlying problem - not just implementing requested features. 

• Can rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies and systems. 

• Prefer building and validating solutions over producing lengthy theoretical designs. 

• Take end-to-end ownership and remain accountable after the solution reaches production. 

• Balance engineering quality with practical delivery timelines. 

• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently. 

🔹 Required Experience

1-3 years of software engineering experience for FDE roles. 

Additionally: 

• Experience delivering customer-facing or enterprise solutions

• Experience taking a product/system from concept or prototype to production

• Experience in fast-moving product, platform, fintech, SaaS, AI, or enterprise technology environments

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers or business stakeholders is an advantage

• Experience building AI-powered products or production agentic systems is a strong advantage

The successful candidate should be capable of: 

Understanding the problem → Designing the solution → Writing the code → Integrating systems → Deploying → Debugging production issues → Improving the product

👉 The ability to build is fundamental to this role. 

🔹 Ideal Candidate

The ideal FDE is a combination of: 

Strong Software Engineer + Pragmatic Solution Architect + Product Thinker + Customer-Facing Problem Solver

You should enjoy being given a difficult problem with no obvious solution and being responsible for figuring out: 

What needs to be built → How to build it → How to deploy it → How to make it work in the real world. 

🔹 What You Should Be Comfortable With

🏢 Working from the office 5 days a week

⚡ Working in a fast-paced, high-impact engineering environment

🚀 Challenging conventional thinking and driving innovation

🎯 Taking end-to-end ownership of complex problems

🔹 What We Value

🚀 You Take the Shot

Make decisions with confidence and execute with speed. 

🎯 You Own It

Act like the CEO of your work - taking complete ownership and accountability. 

🎨 You Craft with Pride

Continuously learn, strive for excellence, and take pride in building secure, scalable, world-class products.

data.description:
Job Overview

Arm is seeking a visionary and technical leader for a Staff Structural Test Verification/Simulation Engineer role in Bangalore. In this high-visibility position with 10+ years of experience, you will spearhead structural test, design-for-test (DFT), and test verification methodologies across advanced, world-class Arm products. You will act as a technical authority, ensuring flawless manufacturing test quality, high silicon yield, and robust fault coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

- DFT Verification Leadership: Define and drive the comprehensive pre-silicon verification and simulation strategy for advanced logic and memory test architectures. 
 - Logic Diagnostics & ATPG: Drive the simulation of ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns and logic diagnostics flows to guarantee fault coverage and defect detection. 
 - Memory Diagnostics & MBIST: Drive the simulation of MBIST (Memory Built-In Self-Test) controllers, memory repair algorithms, and memory diagnostics architectures. 
 - Tool & Standard Integration: Utilize industry-standard test methodologies and EDA tools (ICL, PDL, Tessent, and TetraMAX) to validate DFT insertions, boundary scan, and scan compression logic.

 - Expert-level understanding of Logic Diagnostics and ATPG pattern verification/simulation. 
 - Deep expertise in Memory Diagnostics and MBIST pattern verification/simulation. 
 - Ecosystem & Tool Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of industry-standard DFT languages and tools, including ICL (Instrument Connection Language), PDL (Procedure Description Language), Siemens Tessent, and Synopsys TetraMAX.

data.title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain. 

Job Description

We are seeking a visionary and highly technical AI Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success. 

Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend. 

Responsibilities

- AI Architecture & Custom Integration
 - Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components. 
 - Build proprietary internal LLM-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects. 
 - Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e. g. , CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow-up scheduling) across the revenue organization. 
 - Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
 - Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high-cost, low-utility third-party vendors. 
 - Implement predictive modeling to identify high-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real-time "Next Best Action" recommendations. 
 - Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting. 
 - Cross-Functional Efficiency
 - Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers. 
 - Consult with Marketing leadership on AI-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC). 
 - Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads-to-Revenue" funnel and "Best-in-Class" SaaS ecosystems. 
 - Ability to write and maintain production integrations - Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent - connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no-code tools. 
 - Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack - specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
 - Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance. 
 - Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD, " you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel. 
 - Experience with AI agent orchestration - managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce). 
 - Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents - treating agent training as a discipline, not a one-time setup. 
 - Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it - and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all. 

Additional Information

- Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance. 
 - Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation. 
 - Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done. 
 - An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy. 
 - Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

About QAD And QAD Redzone

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. 

QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD's vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning. NeuralMesh by WEKA sets the standard for agentic AI data infrastructure with a cloud and AI-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy. 

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We've raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world's largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We're passionate about solving our customers' most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey. 

About The Role

WEKA's Developer Experience (DevEx) team writes the software that builds, tests and merges the WEKA Data Platform. It's a large Python codebase that runs our CI, test scheduling and execution, and every R&D engineer depends on it every day. You'll write, refactor and own that Python code, along with the build, CI and infrastructure it runs on: a large monorepo, many release lines, and thousands of automated test runs on physical and cloud clusters. We're modernizing the whole stack now, which makes this a good time to join. 

What You'll Do

- Write and maintain the Python services, CLIs and libraries behind our CI, test scheduling and execution. 
 - Break a long-lived Python monolith into well-defined, independently testable services with clean interfaces. 
 - Build AI-driven tools in Python for failure triage, root-cause analysis and developer automation. 
 - Develop our CI flows: event-driven PR workflows on GitHub Actions, cascade merges across release branches, test selection and merge gating. 
 - Work on our Bazel-based build and packaging flow and its integration with CI. 
 - Own the infrastructure the platform runs on: CI runners on Kubernetes, cloud-based test agent pools, and the services behind them. 
 - Keep it all healthy and visible: build dashboards, alerts and health checks, and take part in on-call. 

Requirements

- 3-5 years of professional software development in Python. 
 - Strong Python: production services and tools, testing with pytest, type hints, and packaging. 
 - Experience in a large, mature codebase: reading unfamiliar code, refactoring safely, and writing meaningful tests. 
 - Good software design: clear module boundaries, logic separated from I/O, code that's easy to test. 
 - Curiosity and a real drive to learn. Our stack is broad, and you'll pick up whatever the problem needs. 
 - Hands-on CI/CD experience in a complex environment, preferably GitHub Actions. 
 - Solid Git beyond everyday use: merging, rebasing, resolving conflicts across long-lived branches. 
 - Experience building tools on top of LLM APIs: agents, triage bots or automation. 
 - A monitoring mindset: metrics, dashboards and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus or similar). 
 - Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and at least one cloud provider (AWS, GCP or OCI). 

Nice to have

- Bazel or another build system (Buck, Pants, CMake). 
 - API and service design for internal platforms. 
 - Job orchestration and distributed execution: queues, workflow engines, worker pools. 
 - Packaging and artifact formats: container images, OS packages. 
 - Buildkite, ArgoCD. 

Why join us

- Your work directly sets the velocity of WEKA's entire R&D organization. 
 - Real scale and complexity: a large monorepo, many release lines and hardware-bound testing. 
 - A real chance to shape the stack: services, build, infrastructure and execution systems are being refreshed now. 
 - Real use of AI in day-to-day engineering tooling. 
 - A hands-on team that works closely with R&D across storage, platform and QA. 

The WEKA Way

- We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always- even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility & ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards. 
 - We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation. 
 - We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn't only about working together. It's about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we're unstoppable. 
 - We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win. 

Concerned that you don't meet every qualification above?

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don't meet every qualification specified. At WEKA, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned that your past work experience doesn't match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway - you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA. 

WEKA is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
