data.title: Power & Performance Validation Engineer
data.description:
Power and Performance Validation Engineer

About Us

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. 

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. 

Job Summary

Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Power and Performance Validation Lead will drive validation strategy and execution for advanced AI compute silicon and systems. The role is responsible for leading power, thermal and performance validation activities across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments to ensure products meet efficiency, reliability and scalability expectations. 

This role requires strong technical expertise and collaboration across multiple engineering disciplines to deliver robust validation methodologies, scalable automation frameworks and actionable performance insights. 

The Team

The Power and Performance Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for validating the performance, efficiency and thermal behaviour of Graphcore silicon and systems. 

The team supports the full product lifecycle, from early architectural modelling through to first silicon bring-up, characterization and production readiness. Engineers work closely with cross-functional teams globally to debug complex issues, optimize workloads and continuously improve validation infrastructure and methodologies. 

Responsibilities and Duties

- Define and lead validation strategies for power, thermal and performance characterization of AI compute silicon and platforms
 - Contribute to planning and execution of validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
 - Develop comprehensive validation plans covering functional, stress, workload and corner-case scenarios
 - Lead post-silicon bring-up and characterization activities for power and performance validation
 - Drive validation of CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O subsystems under complex workload conditions
 - Develop scalable automation frameworks, regression infrastructure and reporting tools using Python
 - Design and execute benchmark workloads, parameter sweeps and performance experiments to identify optimization opportunities
 - Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems teams to debug and resolve complex technical issues
 - Define validation metrics, pass/fail criteria and reporting methodologies to ensure repeatable and high-quality analysis
 - Guide development of custom workload generators and micro-benchmarks where required

data.title: Data QA Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data QA Engineer based in India. 

As a Data QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data delivered to customers. 

You will work with web data extraction projects and AI-assisted solutions, translating customer requirements into clear, measurable quality standards. 

Rather than treating quality assurance as a final checkpoint, you will help identify potential issues early and prevent defects before they reach production. 

Combining exploratory testing, data analysis, and automation, you will investigate anomalies and provide actionable insights to developers and project teams. 

You will use Python, SQL, and modern testing tools to assess data quality and communicate results through meaningful reports, metrics, and visualizations. 

Working closely with project managers, developers, and clients, you will have the autonomy to improve testing processes and strengthen quality practices. 

This is an opportunity to join a globally distributed, multicultural team that values ownership, continuous improvement, and flexible ways of working. 

Accountabilities

- Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, testable criteria and comprehensive QA strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. 
 - Perform exploratory, manual, and visual testing, complemented by automated testing where it provides measurable value. 
 - Execute test cycles on extracted datasets to validate compliance with customer specifications and identify inconsistencies, inaccuracies, missing information, and other defects. 
 - Document defects clearly and thoroughly, providing reproducible steps and supporting evidence so developers can investigate and resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. 
 - Prepare quality reports and scoring metrics that communicate results honestly to internal teams and, where appropriate, customers. 
 - Clearly identify the scope of testing, any untested areas, and the associated risks to support informed project decisions. 
 - Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify ambiguous requirements and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA begins. 
 - Contribute to the development and improvement of test automation frameworks, with an emphasis on coverage, reliability, and performance. 
 - Identify, propose, and implement improvements to QA processes and tooling, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing tools. 
 - Work independently while maintaining close collaboration with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to uphold quality standards throughout delivery. 

Requirements

- At least 5 years of experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable role involving software testing, data testing, or data quality assurance. 
 - Proficiency in Python for data analysis and validation, preferably using Pandas and Jupyter notebooks. 
 - Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including the ability to query and validate data in at least one relational database environment. 
 - Strong understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. 
 - Experience testing HTTP/REST APIs and validating their responses against expected requirements. 
 - Solid knowledge of test case design, test data management, and practical approaches to exploratory and automated testing. 
 - Understanding of data quality principles, particularly completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. 
 - Experience working in an Agile environment, such as Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating effectively with developers. 
 - Familiarity with AI and large language model (LLM) tools to improve test case generation and accelerate data validation workflows. 
 - A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with strong ownership of project quality and the confidence to uphold standards under delivery pressure. 
 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly, understand complex project requirements, and adapt testing strategies to different domains. 
 - Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly and precisely. 

Nice To Have

- Practical knowledge of Scrapy or other Python-based web scraping frameworks. 
 - Experience working with test automation frameworks. 
 - An interest in data science concepts and their application to data analysis and validation. 
 - Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered approaches to improve data quality assurance. 

Benefits

- 35 days of paid holidays, supporting substantial time away from work. 
 - Flexible, location-independent working, with the freedom to work from where you are most productive. 
 - Global, multicultural team: Join a self-motivated, progressive, and internationally distributed team. 
 - Modern technology: Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools. 
 - Autonomy and ownership: Contribute ideas, take responsibility for improvements, and help shape QA processes and tooling. 
 - Collaborative environment: Work closely with technical and project teams to solve meaningful data quality challenges. 
 - Additional details regarding salary, healthcare, retirement plans, and other benefits were not specified in the original job description.

data.title: Team Lead/Manager — AI & IP Innovation - Biotech
data.description:
Purpose

Lead complex patent intelligence engagements across Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, and Healthcare technologies, while guiding research teams and leveraging agentic AI workflows to deliver reproducible, defensible insights and strategic outcomes for clients. 

Key Responsibilities

• Define research strategy and execution approach for complex patent intelligence engagements across biotechnology and pharmaceutical technologies. 

• Design and optimize AI-assisted search workflows and prompt strategies. 

• Lead large-scale novelty, patentability, invalidation, freedom-to-operate, opposition, and patent landscape projects. 

• Oversee development of claim-element mappings and Evidence of Use (EoU) with precise technical and patent citations. 

• Interpret complex patent claims, patent families, CPC/IPC classifications, sequence-related disclosures, Markush structures, and citation networks. 

• Conduct and supervise technical searches across patent and non-patent literature, including scientific publications, clinical literature, regulatory sources, sequence databases, and product-related information. 

• Validate AI-generated results through expert scientific and technical review. 

• Prepare and review client-ready sections including methodology, sources, findings, claim analysis, and strategic conclusions. 

• Ensure research outputs are scientifically accurate, reproducible, and legally defensible. 

• Improve prompt libraries, search methodologies, and quality assurance frameworks for biotechnology and pharmaceutical research. 

• Lead and mentor a team of strategists and senior strategists, providing scientific guidance and reviewing research outputs. 

• Allocate research tasks, monitor project progress, and ensure high-quality deliverables. 

• Support client discussions by translating complex scientific and patent findings into clear strategic insights. 

Must-have

• 6-10+ years of experience in patent research, IP analytics, or patent intelligence within Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, or related technologies. 

• Proven expertise in novelty searches, invalidation studies, freedom-to-operate analysis, patent landscapes, claim charts, and drafting support. 

• Strong understanding of patent claims, patent families, classification systems, sequence searching, Markush structures, and citation analysis. 

• Ability to understand and analyze complex scientific disclosures across biologics, pharmaceuticals, molecular biology, and life sciences. 

• Experience leading research teams and managing complex client projects. 

• Excellent analytical thinking, scientific interpretation, and technical writing skills. 

Patent & IP Expertise

• Advanced experience in patent research including novelty, invalidation, FTO, opposition, landscapes, and claim charts. 

• Expertise in interpreting patent claims, families, CPC/IPC classifications, prosecution histories, and citation networks. 

• Experience analyzing composition-of-matter, formulation, method-of-treatment, dosage regimen, biomarker, biologics, process, and platform technology claims. 

• Understanding of Markush claims, chemical structures, biological sequences, antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids, and sequence identity-based claims. 

• Familiarity with global patent databases such as USPTO, EPO, WIPO Patentscope, Google Patents, and Espacenet. 

• Familiarity with scientific and life-sciences databases such as PubMed, Google Scholar, NCBI, UniProt, BLAST, ClinicalTrials. gov, and regulatory databases. 

• Ability to review and guide claim-element mapping and Evidence of Use (EoU) aligned with patent and scientific evidence standards. 

• Experience supporting litigation, licensing, due diligence, competitive intelligence, or portfolio strategy engagements. 

Education Background

• Bachelor's/Master's degree in Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related fields. 

• PhD or advanced specialization may be preferred for highly technical biotechnology or pharmaceutical engagements. 

Strong understanding of: 

• Molecular biology and genetics

• Biochemistry and cell biology

• Recombinant DNA and gene technologies

• Proteins, antibodies, peptides, and biologics

• Genomics, proteomics, and bioinformatics

• Pharmaceutical formulations and drug delivery systems

• Pharmacology and drug development

• Small-molecule and biologic therapeutics

• Vaccines and immunology

• Cell and gene therapies

• Diagnostics, biomarkers, and personalized medicine

• Fermentation, bioprocessing, and biologics manufacturing

• Clinical development and regulatory concepts

Tools - Examples

• AI & agentic: ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini; orchestration tools; prompt libraries; evaluation sets

• Patent: Google Patents, Espacenet, Patentscope, USPTO, EPO

• Scientific/NPL: PubMed, Google Scholar, NCBI, UniProt, BLAST, ClinicalTrials. gov

• Other: Sequence-search tools, chemical/biological databases, translators, spreadsheets, visualization and reporting tools

KPIs

• Project delivery quality and audit pass-rate

• Turnaround time adherence across engagements

• Scientific and technical accuracy of research outputs

• Defensibility and reproducibility of patent research findings

• Team mentoring effectiveness and peer-review quality

• Contributions to biotechnology/pharma research playbooks and AI-enabled workflows

• Client satisfaction and engagement outcomes

Levelling Notes

Lead - AI & IP Innovation (Team Leader): 

Leads biotechnology/pharma patent research projects, including patentability, FTO, invalidation, landscaping and competitive intelligence studies. Guides and mentors a team of strategists, conducts quality reviews, translates client requirements into clear project scope and methodology, and ensures timely, high-quality delivery. 

Manager - AI & IP Innovation (Biotechnology): 

Owns a portfolio of biotechnology/pharma engagements and manages multiple research teams and team leads. Acts as the senior point of contact for key clients, drives technical and commercial proposals, and handles the most complex scientific and patent matters. Contributes to practice growth, capability building, and the development of AI-enabled IP research methodologies. 

Service Scope

Novelty/Patentability, Invalidation/Opposition, Freedom-to-Operate, Claim Charts/EoU, Drafting Support, Patent Landscapes, Sequence & Structure-Based Patent Searching, Competitive Intelligence, Due Diligence, Licensing Support, and IP Strategy programs.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. 

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. 

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. 

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. 

If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen. 

About The Role

Gen Digital is building a Financial Wellness platform that powers Norton Money, Norton 360 and LifeLock, spanning bank-linking, transactions and insights, credit, identity protection and a digital marketplace for financial products. 

We're looking for a Lead Backend Software Engineer to lead the backend architecture for the Gen Financial Wellness platform. 

You'll own critical services end-to-end, set technical direction, and work across teams to deliver secure, reliable and compliant financial experiences at scale. 

In This Role, You Will

- Own and evolve backend services for Financial Wellness (Norton Money, Norton 360, Norton Genie and LifeLock) from design and implementation to operations and observability (Java/Spring Boot on AWS, Postgres, Kafka). 
 - Design and review REST APIs and data contracts between internal and external services, providers, keeping them secure, versioned and easy to integrate. 
 - Champion event-driven architectures and telemetry pipelines for offers, leads, financial events and alerts, using Kafka and well-governed schemas. 
 - Drive reliability and performance: SLOs, capacity planning, multi-AZ resilience, performance and endurance testing, and incident response for your services. 
 - Partner with Security, Privacy and Legal to ensure backend designs meet PII, credit-reporting and regulatory requirements across Gen product portfolio. 
 - Mentor engineers, lead design reviews and help shape the long-term technical roadmap for Financial Wellness backends at Gen. 

About You

Must-haves

- Strong experience building backend services in Java (Spring Boot or similar) and operating them in production at scale. 
 - Hands-on expertise with cloud-native architectures on AWS (ECS/EKS or Fargate, RDS/Aurora, VPC, load balancers, WAF, S3, Secrets Manager). 
 - Solid knowledge of relational databases (Postgres or equivalent) and at least one NoSQL store (e. g. , DynamoDB, DocumentDB), including schema design and migrations. 
 - Experience with event streaming/messaging (Kafka or similar) and event-driven system design. 
 - A track record of owning architecture for a product/domain, influencing cross-team decisions and working directly with senior stakeholders. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software design (authN/authZ, least privilege, PII handling, auditing) and comfort working with security/compliance reviews. 

Nice-to-haves

- Background in financial services, financial wellness, embedded finance, banking or credit products, or identity-/privacy-focused platforms. 
 - Experience with serverless (API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Redis) and/or integrating with AI platforms (e. g. , Bedrock, Strands agents, AgentCore, tool-calling) in data-heavy products. 
 - Familiarity with observability stacks such as Datadog, Dynatrace or Sumo Logic, and defining SLOs and alerts. 

Our stack (short version)

You don't need prior experience with every technology, but you should be comfortable leading in an environment that includes: 

- Languages & frameworks: Java (Spring Boot), some Node. js and Kotlin; Python for selected serverless/AI workloads. 
 - Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora), DynamoDB/DocumentDB, Redis/ElastiCache, Kafka/MSK, BigQuery/Burger for analytics. 
 - Infra & observability: AWS, ECS Fargate, API Gateway, WAF, Terraform, CloudWatch, Datadog, Dynatrace and Sumo. 

What's Next

The interview process consists of two stages and combines both technical and managerial interviews. 

You can expect a series of conversations where you'll have the opportunity to demonstrate your technical expertise, discuss your experience, and meet key stakeholders to learn more about the role and the team.

data.title: Team Lead - AI & Data Science
data.description:
Designation : Team Lead - AI & Data Science

Required Experience: 5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership. 

Job Description:   

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.   

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production. 

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments. 

Key Responsibilities:   

    

1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria. 

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs. 

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach. 

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications. 

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement. 

2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring. 

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern. 

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices. 

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimization while enabling the team to execute independently. 

3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate. 

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation. 

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior. 

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed. 

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops. 

4. Applied machine learning and data science

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization. 

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly. 

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data. 

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role. 

5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation. 

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture. 

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover. 

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable. 

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities. 

6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support. 

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers. 

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts. 

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards. 

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk. 

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks. 

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

Required Qualifications and experience: 

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                          

  AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience. 

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes. 

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations. 

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals. 

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations. 

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred. 

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support. 

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope. 

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills. 

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider. 

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline. 

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization. 

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable. 

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments. 

●Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.

Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team's hybrid work schedule requirements. 

Who We Are

Wayfair's Customer Technology organization builds the digital experiences and platforms that help customers move seamlessly from discovery to purchase and beyond. We're looking for a passionate Senior Engineering Manager to lead teams building reliable, scalable customer-facing technology for customers across multiple geographies. 

Our platforms support key moments on Wayfair's websites and apps, from browsing products and evaluating delivery options to completing checkout and managing orders. Payments is a critical part of this experience. Our teams make it easy and reliable for customers to pay using the methods available in their geography, while meeting local compliance and regulatory requirements. Supporting different payment methods, rules, and customer expectations across markets brings significant technical and operational complexity. 

We work across engineering, product, design, and partner teams to make complex systems feel simple for customers. Our platforms must respond quickly, handle high volumes, and remain resilient as customer needs and business priorities evolve. Every interaction is an opportunity to build trust, reduce friction, and deliver a better experience. 

What You'll Do

Help shape and drive a multi-year technology strategy for a complex platform that supports customers across multiple geographies. 

Lead one or more software engineering teams, designing scalable solutions and owning the full software development lifecycle-from design and delivery to ongoing operation and maintenance.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Lead substantial engineering work within a X3 squad, delivering maintainable modern capabilities while protecting X3 behaviour, upgradeability and operational continuity. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong software engineering experience delivering cloud-native SaaS platforms and distributed systems using modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/Node. js, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a track record of building secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including service decomposition, synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, event-driven architectures, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, scalability, observability, eventual consistency, and failure-recovery strategies. 
 - Deep experience designing, developing, and evolving API-first platforms, including REST, GraphQL, event-driven integrations, service contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, security controls, and integration governance. 
 - Experience designing and operating solutions using relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, migration strategies, and operational support. 
 - Strong cloud-native engineering experience across containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, telemetry, secure software supply chains, reliability engineering, release management, upgrade strategies, disaster recovery, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience defining domain boundaries, service ownership models, integration contracts, extensibility frameworks, and modernization patterns that improve maintainability, scalability, and customer continuity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern web application architecture, including React, TypeScript, component-based design, state management, accessibility, responsive design, browser performance optimization, and browser-to-service integration patterns where relevant to the domain. 
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering responsibly with appropriate human review, traceability, automated testing, security validation, and regression evidence. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, participate in architecture reviews, and collaborate effectively across globally distributed engineering teams. 

Modern Platform Skills for this Role

- Own service and API contracts, event-driven integrations, and domain boundaries within the assigned area, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Design and operate distributed services using modern SaaS engineering principles, including observability, performance management, fault isolation, resiliency patterns, capacity planning, and reliability engineering. 
 - Drive secure software delivery through CI/CD, supply-chain security controls, identity and secrets management, policy enforcement, automated quality gates, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Establish and maintain OpenTelemetry-compatible observability practices, including logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, operational dashboards, alerting strategies, and production diagnostics. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering capabilities through containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, self-service delivery patterns, and automation that improves developer productivity and operational excellence. 
 - Own compatibility, upgrade, migration, recovery, and rollback strategies for services under management, ensuring customer continuity and operational resilience. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing legacy business applications, ERP platforms, batch-processing systems, data migration solutions, reporting platforms, or other enterprise software environments. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are beneficial but not required. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React, Next. js, TypeScript, design systems, micro-frontends, accessibility frameworks, and advanced user experience patterns. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, messaging platforms, distributed data architectures, performance engineering, platform engineering, and production operations at SaaS scale. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted software development practices, including code generation, automated testing, code review workflows, security validation, traceability, and regression management. 
 - Experience operating global-scale SaaS platforms with strong reliability, observability, security, compliance, and operational governance requirements. 

Senior Software Engineer Hiring Signal

- Senior Software Engineers are expected to design, build, and operate distributed SaaS platforms, own domain-level architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, mentor engineers, and deliver reliable cloud-native services using technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, while leveraging X3 domain knowledge to accelerate transformation rather than as a prerequisite for hiring. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering commercial products. Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering or a related field. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Substantial slices reach production predictably with tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback plans. 
 - Technical debt and coupling are reduced in the owned area without breaking supported customer behaviour. 
 - Code reviews, estimates and incident learning improve squad flow and engineering quality. 
 - Less experienced engineers deliver safely with useful coaching and examples. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Collaborates with Product, Principal/Staff Engineers, Software and Automation Engineers, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and domain specialists in Europe/North America. Owns outcomes from India with deliberate overlap for design and production conversations. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Takes ownership, raises risks early, gives kind and precise feedback, and keeps learning visible. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Break outcomes into sound designs, vertical slices and estimates; deliver production-quality code across services, APIs, UI or data paths. 
 - Make day-to-day technical decisions on component boundaries, GraphQL contracts, PostgreSQL access, observability, test strategy and safe rollout. 
 - Analyse legacy dependencies and contribute to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire decisions with evidence. 
 - Review code and designs, support incident resolution and improve the squad's automation, documentation and delivery flow. 
 - Pair with and mentor Software Engineers while learning from Principal Engineers and Architects. 

Decision ownership: 

Implementation design and sequencing inside the squad, technical risk escalation, test and observability approach, and readiness of owned work for review and release. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS

Location: Mumbai

Role: Full time, Founding Team

Joining: November

Looking for an engineer who is also an Entrepreneur, Builder and Mr. Figureoutable at heart to join our founding team. 

About Us: 

We are a D2C brand led by IITR alum. We are pre-launch and have raised pre-seed funding backed by founders of Souled Store, TIGC, partners from Investment banking, and strong startup operators. 

We aim to become a 5000 Crore brand by 2030 and tech would be at the core of how we achieve this goal. 

But why hire in tech for a D2C brand?

We're building what we hope will be one of India's first truly AI-native, tech-first D2C brands. 

- Not a D2C company that occasionally uses ChatGPT. 
 - A company where AI and technology are at the core of how we operate, make decisions, serve customers, and scaleThus we are looking for a Founding Engineer cum AI builder to make this happen. 

Who are we looking for?

- A strong full-stack engineer, AI enthusiast, problem solver, and someone with serious entrepreneurial energy. 
 - Has a high bias for action. You'd rather ship something in 3 days than discuss it for 3 weeks. 
 - Someone who can independently take products from idea to deployment. 
 - Can build for web and mobile (or is confident in figuring out what they don't know). 
 - Is genuinely excited about, stays highly updated and has built products using AI, LLMs, agents, and automation. 
 - Thinks like a founder, not just an engineer. 
 - Loves ownership, ambiguity, and figuring things out. 
 - Bachelors from tier-1 colleges - IIT/BITS/IIIT
 - Bonus: Experience building AI agents, agentic AI systems which are being used on production and at scale would be a big plus
 - Bonus: ex-founders, ex-founding engineer at funded startups

What will you actually do?

Pretty much everything tech. 

- Build our website, mobile app, and customer-facing experiences. 
 - Build AI agents and automate workflows across marketing, operations, customer experience, and more. 
 - Experiment with new AI tools, ship quickly, break things, fix things. 
 - Own the entire tech stack, from writing code to deploying products. 
 - Eventually help build the tech team as we scale. 

Why this should be exciting?

- Because you will one of the first few engineers in India who will build a real-life case study on building brands in the age of AI. 
 - You'll get to experiment with technology across the entire business, not just a product; and you get to see the impact your work is bringing. 
 - If you have that entrepreneurial itch, this could be one of the most interesting ways to scratch it. 
 - It's the perfect opportunity if you are looking for a role that could be a stepping stone before building your own startup

Important Disclaimer

- This might come with a pay cut. If maximizing your salary over the next 12 months is your top priority, this probably isn't the right opportunity. 
 - We're looking for someone optimizing for ownership, learning, building incredible things, and long-term upside. 
 - There will be meaningful ESOPs, real decision-making power, and a chance to build something that becomes a case study talked about globally. 

Interested?

 - Link to something you've built that you're ridiculously proud of at palakjajoo10@gmail. com,

Senior Manager - Site Reliability Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager - Site Reliability Engineering to lead a team of 8+ Site Reliability Engineers within our core platform engineering organization. The team supports a high-throughput, low-latency distributed platform that processes more than 500 billion requests daily, with stringent performance requirements where every millisecond matters. 

As a leader, you will own the reliability charter for this platform: setting technical direction, growing engineers, partnering with product and development leadership, and ensuring the infrastructure is resilient, scalable, and always available. 

The team is also evolving rapidly toward agentic AI. You should be well-versed in the modern AI ecosystem and capable of driving the adoption of AI-powered tools, workflows, and automation frameworks that improve engineering productivity, operational excellence, and platform reliability. 

What You'll Do People Leadership & Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 8-10 SREs across varying experience levels, fostering a culture of ownership, learning, and psychological safety. 

• Drive AI adoption, AIOps, intelligent automation, and agentic AI initiatives. • Conduct regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations; define clear growth paths for individual contributors. 

• Drive hiring: partner with recruiting to define role requirements, lead interviews, and build a diverse, highperforming SRE team. 

• Manage team workload, priorities, and on-call rotations to prevent burnout while maintaining operational excellence. 

• Champion SRE best practices, including error budgets, SLOs/SLIs/SLAs, and blameless post-mortems, and instill a data-driven reliability culture

Infrastructure Strategy & Ownership

• Own the end-to-end reliability roadmap for a high-scale, real-time platform, including load balancers, data stores, CI/CD pipelines, observability stacks, and networking layers. 

• Define and drive multi-quarter infrastructure programs focused on resilience, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency to support more than 500 billion requests daily. 

• Develop and enforce policies and procedures that improve platform stability; represent the team in architectural reviews and cross-functional planning. 

• Establish infrastructure-as-code standards using tools such as Terraform, Puppet, or Ansible and ensure consistent adoption across the team. 

• Bring deep, hands-on technical expertise in Kubernetes, including cluster design, multi-tenancy, networking, autoscaling, upgrades, and operational best practices at scale. 

• Drive architectural ownership across the SRE landscape, making high-judgment decisions on platform design, service topology, and infrastructure trade-offs. 

• Define and evolve the cloud and container strategy, including Kubernetes, service mesh, CI/CD, and observability, to support rapid product growth and engineering velocity. 

• Lead capacity planning, performance engineering, and resilience initiatives, including disaster recovery, chaos engineering, and multi-region availability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with software engineering leads to set quality and performance benchmarks; ensure production-readiness criteria are met before every deployment. 

• Participate in system design reviews, providing leadership-level input on infrastructure reliability, security, and operability. 

• Serve as the primary point of escalation for high-severity incidents; coordinate cross-team response and ensure transparent communication to stakeholders. 

• Collaborate with product management to balance feature velocity against reliability investments, using error budgets as a shared language. 

Tooling, Automation & Performance

• Drive the vision for internal SRE tooling, including monitoring, alerting, deployment automation, failure detection, and self-healing systems. 

• Champion full-stack performance optimization, from request handling and network paths to database query tuning, with a focus on sub-millisecond latency targets. 

• Ensure robust observability across all services using Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack; establish dashboards and alerts that provide real-time operational insight. 

• Oversee CI/CD pipeline health using tools such as Jenkins and Argo CD, and continuously improve deployment speed, safety, and rollback capabilities. 

Who Should Apply Required Qualifications

• B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

• 13+ years of overall experience in SRE, infrastructure engineering, or DevOps, including at least 2 years in a people management role leading teams of 8+ engineers. 

• Proven track record of building and scaling SRE teams supporting high-volume, latency-sensitive distributed systems. 

• Strong technical foundation in networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, and SDN, as well as modern software architectures. 

• Hands-on proficiency in Python, Go, or Ruby, with a strong automation mindset. 

• Deep experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with GCP or AWS, in addition to operating large-scale co-location data centers. 

• Strong understanding of agentic AI, AIOps, MCP, A2A, and AI automation frameworks. 

• Demonstrated ability to define and operate against SLOs, error budgets, and reliability metrics at scale. 

• Ability to independently own complex problem statements, set team priorities, and drive solutions end to end. 

Preferred Skills & Tool Expertise

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Puppet, or Ansible. 

• Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack. 

• CI/CD Pipelines: Jenkins and Argo CD. 

• Databases: MySQL, Redis, Aerospike, HBase, or similar technologies. 

• Web Proxies & Service Networking: Envoy and Nginx. 

• Version Control: Git-based workflows at team scale. 

• Experience operating high-throughput, low-latency platforms or large-scale real-time distributed systems is a strong plus. 

• Familiarity with incident management frameworks, PagerDuty ecosystems, and a blameless post-mortem culture.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Implement, test and support well-defined slices of X3 modernisation while developing strong X3 domain knowledge and safe engineering habits. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong software engineering experience in modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a proven ability to build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade services. 
 - Solid foundation in software design, object-oriented and distributed systems principles, API-first development, automated testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery practices. 
 - Required understanding of distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, event-driven architectures, scalability, resiliency patterns, fault tolerance, asynchronous processing, observability, and data consistency trade-offs. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST, GraphQL, and event-based integrations, with strong understanding of API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and secure service interactions. 
 - Experience working with relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, migration, and operational considerations. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, including containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, secure software supply chains, and operational readiness. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Practical experience with modern web application development using React and TypeScript or equivalent modern dynamic UX frameworks, including component-based architectures, responsive and accessible user experiences, state management, browser diagnostics, and automated UI testing. 
 - Ability to learn and work effectively within Sage X3 business processes, metadata-driven architectures, extensibility models, modernization initiatives, and SaaS transformation programs. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed global engineering teams and contribute to technical design discussions and code reviews. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Implement and test service/API contracts and integrations in the assigned discipline; follow secure CI/CD, identity/secrets and telemetry patterns, and contribute compatibility, upgrade and rollback checks. Build hands-on container or IaC skills when required by the owned service, using team-supported paths. 

Preferred Skills

- Commercial ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance experience, including L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL. 
 - React, automated API testing, telemetry, batch processing or migration tooling. 
 - Practical use of AI coding assistants with human review and regression checks. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years of professional software development, or equivalent practical experience. Degree, diploma or apprenticeship in computer science, engineering or a related discipline is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Owned work is delivered to agreed acceptance criteria with useful tests and no avoidable regression. 
 - The engineer builds confidence in X3 domain knowledge and contributes to safe modernisation decisions. 
 - Defects, risks and support issues are surfaced early with enough evidence to act. 
 - Learning, review feedback and delivery estimates become more accurate over time. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Senior and Principal Engineers, Automation, Product, Architecture, Security, Cloud Support/L3 and Customer Services. India-based delivery is integrated with distributed squads and planned Europe/North America overlap. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Asks good questions, honours commitments, learns from feedback and keeps quality visible. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Implement features, fixes, APIs, components or migration assets from clear designs and acceptance criteria. 
 - Write maintainable code and automated tests, participate in review, and keep technical documentation and operational notes current. 
 - Learn X3 processes, metadata, Xtrem/X3 architecture and the effect of changes on customers, partners and upgrades. 
 - Use CI/CD, observability and local diagnostics to find problems early; escalate uncertainty with evidence. 
 - Contribute to refactoring, automation, accessibility, performance and reliability improvements within the squad. 

Decision ownership: 

Implementation choices within agreed patterns, test coverage for owned changes, and prompt escalation when requirements, customer behaviour, security or rollback are unclear. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

Job Description

Role purpose

Make release confidence a scalable engineering capability. Own the automation strategy and evidence model that allow X3 components, upgrades, customisations and migration waves to move quickly without weakening customer continuity. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Deep experience designing automation frameworks for web, API, GraphQL, data and distributed services. 
 - Strong programming ability in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages, with CI/CD integration. 
 - Strong SQL/data validation and enterprise integration testing, including REST/SOAP, JSON/XML and batch workflows. 
 - Experience with containers, observability, test data, environment lifecycle, performance and reliability testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Able to communicate a release recommendation clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Set cross-squad automated evidence for API compatibility, secure pipeline and artefact provenance, deployment/upgrade/rollback, reliability and migration reconciliation. Make quality feedback fast and actionable; use containers and Kubernetes as standard across the test platform. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle and data migration validation. 
 - Practical understanding of X3 processes, metadata, customisation and regression risk, including Web/Syracuse where applicable. 
 - Migration diffing, golden datasets, contract testing, property-based testing or synthetic monitoring. 
 - Cloud delivery, security testing and accessibility testing. 
 - Experience certifying partner solutions or operating quality gates across regional releases. 
 - Preferred, not required: prior Sage X3 experience, including Progress 4GL/L4G or proprietary/runtime-specific legacy technologies where useful for compatibility, support or migration; this is not a prerequisite for modern target-stack roles. 
 - Experience with comparably scaled ERP suites such as SAP, Infor, IFS, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Oracle NetSuite, including relevant partner technologies and suites, is also desirable. 
 - Where relevant to the role, demonstrate end-to-end involvement in one or more ERP value streams and integrations. Breadth across manufacturing, operations, sales, HCM and finance is advantageous; experience in every domain is not required. 
 - ERP product and partner-suite experience is transferable evidence, not a hard gate: evaluate the candidate's ability to learn X3 semantics, map equivalent processes and protect customer continuity rather than requiring one named vendor history. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 10+ years in software quality engineering or automation, with experience leading quality strategy across more than one team. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Automated quality gates provide trusted evidence per change, release and migration wave. 
 - Regression coverage grows around the highest-value customer behaviour and legacy-modern equivalence risks. 
 - Flaky tests, escaped defects, manual verification effort and rollback uncertainty trend down. 
 - Every AI-generated or translated capability has human review, regression evidence, security checks and a recovery path. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Partners with Principal Engineers, Architects, Senior Automation and Software Engineers, Product, SRE/Cloud Support, Security, Customer Services and migration leads. Works daily with India squads and maintains overlap with Europe/North America for release decisions and incident learning. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Protects quality without creating theatre, makes risk legible, develops others and treats evidence as a product capability. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Source and document control

Document version: 2. 0. 3 | Updated: 1 October 2026, 09: 11 BST (UTC+01: 00)

Source: Additive Roles/Principal Software Automation Engineer. docx; SHA-256 c2ee5761d46f

Change history

- 2. 0. 3 | 1 October 2026, 09: 11 BST (UTC+01: 00) | Role-specific content unchanged in this release; retained preferred ERP-suite and end-to-end domain criteria and revalidated Leela source SHA-256 lineage and en-GB proofing. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Define the quality and automation strategy across squads, including risk-based coverage, contract tests, regression, performance, security and operational verification. 
 - Own quality gates and evidence standards for AI-assisted modernisation, component releases, partner extensions and segmented migrations. 
 - Build or guide frameworks that make tests reliable, diagnosable, parallel and useful to engineers rather than a late manual checkpoint. 
 - Lead investigation of escaped defects, flaky suites, data drift and release risk; turn learning into prevention and measurable improvement. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and embed quality ownership in multidisciplinary squads. 

Decision ownership: 

Automation architecture, test evidence thresholds, quality-gate design, risk-based release recommendations and when a migration or deployment must pause, rollback or receive additional proof. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Treat Progress 4GL/L4G and X3 proprietary or runtime-specific patterns as LEGACY SOURCE technologies to understand, contain, migrate or replace. Approved target languages are modern technologies selected for the role and architecture; Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, Rust and Go are not labelled legacy by default. 
 - Demonstrate safe agentic delivery with tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot coding/cloud agent, Codex or Claude Code; no named product is mandatory. Show task decomposition, bounded specialist agents, scoped permissions or isolation, reviewed and tested generated changes, privacy/IP and security protection, and evidence of outcomes. 
 - Use harness engineering to make repositories and context legible, provide appropriate tools and guardrails, and create fast feedback and evaluation loops. Apply graph-based context, dependency or workflow techniques where useful; treat these as transferable practices, not vendor products. 
 - For hyperscale and sovereign cloud deployments, evaluate residency and jurisdiction, identity and control-plane separation, connectivity and operational constraints, service availability and portability, key management, observability and support, and compliance. Select patterns from workload and customer requirements, not a provider assumption. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.
