data.title: Software Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Create and maintain dependable automated checks that protect X3 customer behaviour and give X3 squads fast feedback on every change, release and migration asset. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code. 
 - Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing. 
 - Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control. 
 - Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows. 
 - Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the team's secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices. 

Preferred Skills

- TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle. 
 - Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports. 
 - Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence. 
 - Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change. 
 - Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact. 
 - The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building a finance, accounting, payroll and expense management** solution****s** that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring. 
 - Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Develop automated UI, API, GraphQL, integration and regression tests from clear risks and acceptance criteria. 
 - Maintain test data, environments, diagnostics and documentation so failures can be reproduced and fixed efficiently. 
 - Contribute tests to CI/CD quality gates and help identify flaky, missing or redundant coverage. 
 - Learn X3 processes, metadata and customisation patterns so automation reflects real customer outcomes. 
 - Participate in defect analysis, release verification, upgrade checks and rollback rehearsals. 

Decision ownership: 

Test implementation for assigned stories, defect evidence, coverage recommendations and escalation of quality or environment risks. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.title: Senior Network/Automation QA Engineer
data.description:
This role has been designed as ''Onsite' with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

Job Family Definition: 

Set and maintain quality standards for company products through the use of systematic processes. Develops, modifies, and executes software test strategies, plans and suites. Analyzes and writes test standards and procedures. Maintains documentation of test results to assist in debugging and modification of software. Analyzes test results to ensure existing functionality and recommends corrective action. May develop tools and environments to automate test execution. Consults with development engineers in resolution of problems. 

Management Level Definition

Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others. 

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain system testbeds involving Mist Edge (L2TPv3/IPsec concentrator) along with switches, routers, and servers. 
 - Perform QA validation of Mist Edge datapath, tunneling, and security features. 
 - Validate end-to-end client-to-cloud architecture, including traffic flow across L2TPv3/IPsec tunnels. 
 - Recreate complex customer networking and datapath issues in lab environments and collaborate with US and Beijing Engineering teams for resolution. 
 - Work closely with CS teams to review customer-reported issues and enhance test coverage for real-world deployments. 
 - Create and manage bugs in Jira and drive closure with Engineering teams. 
 - Perform timely escalation of critical datapath, scale, or performance issues. 
 - Develop technical documentation for QA and CS teams in Confluence. 
 - Train and mentor Level 1/2 Engineers on advanced networking, tunneling protocols, and troubleshooting techniques. 
 - Leverage AI-powered tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test creation, log analysis, and debugging workflows. 
 - Contribute to automation frameworks using AI-assisted code generation to improve test coverage, regression efficiency, and defect detection. 
 - Apply AI-assisted approaches for anomaly detection, traffic pattern analysis, and faster root cause identification. 

What You Need To Bring

- BE/ME/MS in EE, CS, or related discipline. 
 - Strong understanding of low-level datapath and packet processing. 
 - Hands-on experience with L2TPv3 and IPsec (tunnel establishment, encapsulation, troubleshooting). 
 - Solid knowledge of Layer 2 Switching and Layer 3 Routing concepts (VLANs, DHCP, DNS, NAT, trunking). 
 - Experience with DHCP Relay, RadSec, and authentication flows. 
 - Working knowledge of multicast and service discovery protocols such as IGMP, MLD, and mDNS. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump) and log analysis. 
 - Ability to analyze and debug complex networking issues across control and data planes. 
 - Familiarity with automation frameworks and AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot). 
 - Passion for solving customer issues in a fast-paced, highly technical environment. 
 - Ability to quickly and accurately assess and drive resolution of technical problems. 
 - Experience level: 10-15 years

Preferred Qualifications

- CWNA/CWSP/CWAP/CWNE Certified. 
 - Scripting in Python. 
 - Hands on experience on ISE/ClearPass. 
 - Basic knowledge of L2TPv3/IPsec. 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. 

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have - whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. 

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. 

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

data.description:
Job Title: Design Quality Assurance Engineer_(Immediate Joiners)

Experience: 5-8 Years

Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Biomedical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline

Job Summary

We are seeking a Design Assurance Engineer to ensure that product design, risk management, verification and validation, and design-control activities comply with applicable regulatory and quality requirements throughout the product lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support design control activities, including design inputs, design outputs, traceability, and maintenance of the Design History File (DHF). 
 - Lead or support product risk-management activities, including hazard analysis, FMEA, and Risk Management File preparation. 
 - Ensure compliance with ISO 14971 and applicable medical-device quality and regulatory requirements. 
 - Review and approve verification and validation (V&V) protocols and reports for hardware and software. 
 - Assess design and process changes and support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs). 
 - Support CAPA, nonconformance, complaint, and investigation activities. 
 - Participate in internal, customer, and regulatory audits. 
 - Work closely with R&D, systems, software, hardware, quality, and regulatory teams. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation, traceability, and objective evidence are maintained throughout product development. Required Skills

- Strong knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR Part 820. 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and IEC 62366. 
 - Experience with design controls, risk management, and V&V processes. 
 - Strong technical documentation and review skills. 
 - Ability to interpret engineering and regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable quality processes. 
 - Experience in audit preparation and supporting regulatory compliance activities. Preferred

- CQE, CQA, or equivalent quality certification. 
 - Experience in medical devices or other regulated/safety-critical products.

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code. 
 - Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing. 
 - Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control. 
 - Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows. 
 - Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the team's secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices. 

Preferred Skills

- TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle. 
 - Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports. 
 - Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence. 
 - Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change. 
 - Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact. 
 - The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

About Us

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building a finance, accounting, payroll and expense management** solution****s** that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending. 

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed. 

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking). 
 - Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context. 
 - Build evaluation frameworks - both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) - so we can measure whether agents are improving. 
 - Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals. 
 - Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform. 
 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring. 
 - Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data. 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production. 

Technical Skills

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code. 
 - Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling. 
 - Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e. g. , MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams. 

Mindset & Collaboration

- Growth mindset - curious, always learning, and open to feedback. 
 - Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes. 
 - Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted. 
 - Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling. 
 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching. 
 - Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure. 

What to Expect

- We value humility and collaboration - we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. 
 - We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code - including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Develop automated UI, API, GraphQL, integration and regression tests from clear risks and acceptance criteria. 
 - Maintain test data, environments, diagnostics and documentation so failures can be reproduced and fixed efficiently. 
 - Contribute tests to CI/CD quality gates and help identify flaky, missing or redundant coverage. 
 - Learn X3 processes, metadata and customisation patterns so automation reflects real customer outcomes. 
 - Participate in defect analysis, release verification, upgrade checks and rollback rehearsals. 

Decision ownership: 

Test implementation for assigned stories, defect evidence, coverage recommendations and escalation of quality or environment risks. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

Job Description

Our Mission: 

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content. 

About Us

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives. 

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services. 

Position Summary

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment. 
 - Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 - Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality. 
 - Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements. 

Test Strategy & Coverage

- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content. 
 - Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e. g. , S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance. 
 - Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases. 

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

- Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium. 
 - Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation. 
 - Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing. 
 - Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers. 
 - Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks. 
 - Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage. 

Functional & Workflow Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions. 
 - Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows. 
 - Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes. 
 - Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services. 
 - Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle. 

XML and Publishing Validation

- Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines. 
 - Verify XML structures (e. g. , DITA maps, topics, etc. ), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms. 
 - Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows. 
 - Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules. 
 - Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats. 
 - Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines. 

Data Layer Testing

- Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures. 
 - Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes. 
 - Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases . 
 - Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules. 
 - Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories. 
 - Ensure data consistency across systems and environments. 

API and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services. 
 - Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications. 
 - Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows. 
 - Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points. 

Performance and Reliability Testing

- Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads. 
 - Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams. 
 - Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines. 
 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance. 

Experience And Skills

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications: 

- Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes. 
 - Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management. 
 - Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content. 
 - Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts. 
 - Experience testing modern APIs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems. 
 - Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira. 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. . 
 - Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership. 
 - Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision. 
 - Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level. 
 - Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience. 
 - Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent). 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

- Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation. 
 - Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL). 
 - Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG & EAA compliance). 
 - Proficiency with Git and version control systems. 
 - Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud-based testing environments (AWS/Azure). 
 - Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution. 
 - Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

data.title: SENIOR TEST ENGINEER - Python
Senior Software Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Lead automation and quality engineering for a X3 squad, turning customer and migration risks into fast, reliable evidence that supports confident releases. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong automation programming in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages. 
 - Experience with UI, API, GraphQL, integration, data and end-to-end test design. 
 - Strong SQL/data validation, REST/SOAP integration and batch or migration workflow testing. 
 - CI/CD, containers, test data, observability and defect analysis in a cloud-native environment. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Ability to explain quality risk and evidence in clear English across time zones. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Automate contract and event-integration checks, secure pipeline controls, release/upgrade/rollback evidence, and migration reconciliation. Make failures observable and useful to developers; apply container or orchestration test environments when relevant to the suite. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle or Web/Syracuse testing. 
 - Working X3 domain knowledge and understanding of metadata, customisation and upgrade risk. 
 - Contract testing, performance testing, accessibility, security or chaos/resilience testing. 
 - Migration comparison tooling, synthetic monitoring or golden customer datasets. 
 - Cloud environments and partner certification. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years in quality engineering or software automation, with ownership of automation for a substantial product area. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- The squad has a trusted regression signal for the highest-risk customer and migration paths. 
 - Quality gates run consistently in delivery pipelines and failures are diagnosed promptly. 
 - Migration and upgrade evidence supports predictable go/no-go, hypercare exit and rollback decisions. 
 - Manual regression effort and escaped defects reduce without reducing meaningful coverage. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior/Principal Automation Engineers, Product, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and migration/partner teams across India, Europe and North America. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Challenges weak evidence respectfully, follows risk to impact and helps the whole squad own quality. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Design and implement maintainable automated tests across UI, API, GraphQL, data, integration, performance and operational journeys. 
 - Own risk-based regression for an X3 domain or platform capability, including legacy-modern equivalence and customisation behaviour. 
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD quality gates and make failures diagnosable, actionable and visible to the squad. 
 - Support migration waves, upgrades and rollback rehearsals with repeatable evidence and clear exit criteria. 
 - Coach Software Automation Engineers and partner with developers early in design and implementation. 

Decision ownership: 

Test design and automation approach for owned scope, risk-based coverage, evidence quality and release recommendations within agreed programme guardrails. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

Description

About Opalus and OPAL

Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI-powered SaaS business operating platform for SMEs. OPAL places accounting at the core and connects finance, customers, people, projects, documents and workflow in one secure operating environment. We are establishing our software development team and office in Kochi, Kerala. 

The opportunity

Build the automated quality controls needed to release OPAL's connected SaaS modules with confidence, security and reliable regression coverage. 

What you'll do

- Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web, API, integration and data testing. 
 - Create automated coverage for cross-module and end-to-end business workflows. 
 - Validate tenant isolation, permissions, security boundaries and audit behaviour. 
 - Test accounting calculations, transactional integrity, reporting and compliance-related workflows. 
 - Plan and execute performance, load, resilience and scalability testing. 
 - Integrate quality gates and automated suites into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Partner with product and engineering to improve testability, defect prevention and release readiness. 

Company description

Opalus Investments Limited is developing OPAL, an AI-powered SaaS business operating platform for small and medium-sized businesses. With accounting at its core, OPAL is designed to connect finance, banking, customers, people, recruitment, projects, documents, workflow and reporting in one secure operating environment. A permissioned AI layer is being designed across the connected business record to help users understand information, prepare work and take controlled action with appropriate approvals and audit trails. 

The company has completed a high-fidelity working prototype and is building the production-grade platform for an initial Australian release. Opalus is now establishing a software development office and multidisciplinary product team in Kochi, Kerala, to help take OPAL through engineering, testing, release and ongoing product development. 

Requirements

What you bring

- 7-10 years of QA engineering experience, including 4-5 years of hands-on test automation experience. 
 - Experience independently designing automation frameworks for a SaaS product. 
 - Experience defining test strategies for a SaaS product, with a sound understanding of risk-based testing and defect analysis. 
 - Experience driving quality practices across a SaaS product. 
 - Experience using Testrail. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - Strong automation experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or comparable tooling. 
 - API testing experience using REST Assured, Postman or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Performance testing experience with JMeter or similar tools. 
 - SQL, MongoDB, and data-validation skills. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD workflows. 
 - Exposure security testing and accessibility testing. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience working closely with stakeholders across product and engineering. 
 - Eligible to work in India. 

Preferred experience

- Experience testing accounting, ERP, banking or financial applications. 

Location requirement

This position is based in Kochi, Kerala, India. Applicants must already be based in Kochi or be willing to relocate to Kochi.   

You must be eligible to work in India.

data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve robust CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient, reliable, and scalable software delivery. 
 - Automate software build, testing, packaging, deployment, release, and environment provisioning processes to improve quality, speed, and consistency. 
 - Maintain and optimize build, test, and deployment environments across multiple operating systems, platforms, and software configurations. 
 - Administer and support Azure, VMware vSphere, servers, virtual machines, storage, networking, and related infrastructure, ensuring security, availability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Manage and maintain DevOps tools and platforms, including source control, build, release, code quality, and artifact management solutions. 
 - Integrate automated testing, security scanning, static code analysis, software composition analysis, and quality gates into CI/CD workflows using tools such as Coverity and Black Duck. 
 - Support automated functional, integration, installation, upgrade, compatibility, and hardware-in-the-loop testing processes. 
 - Manage software artifacts, packages, dependencies, installers, certificates, software signing, and secure build and release credentials. 
 - Develop and maintain automation tools, scripts, and solutions using Python, Shell, and related technologies to improve developer productivity and reduce manual effort. 
 - Administer and support containerized platforms and workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
 - Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives to standardize and automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes. 
 - Monitor application and infrastructure health through logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions, driving operational excellence and system reliability. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex build, deployment, infrastructure, networking, platform, and software configuration issues; perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures. 
 - Support application servers, web servers, middleware platforms, and related technologies. 
 - Define, implement, and promote DevOps standards, best practices, technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. 
 - Collaborate with development, QA, security, and infrastructure teams to improve the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle and coordinate cross-functional issue resolution. 
 - Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, release readiness activities, deployment validation, continuous improvement initiatives, and resolution of issues affecting software delivery. 
 - Evaluate, recommend, and introduce new DevOps, cloud, automation, infrastructure, and testing technologies to enhance platform capabilities and operational efficiency. 

Who You Are: 

- B. E/B. Tech or M. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related Engineering discipline. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- 6-9 years of experience as Lead DevOps Engineer responsible for design, maintain, and improve the systems, and infrastructure, used to build, package, and release enterprise software 
 - Experience designing, implementing, and supporting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Batch scripting, or comparable languages. 
 - Knowledge of software development practices and object-oriented programming languages such as C#, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with source control systems and branching strategies using Git, SVN, or equivalent version control platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience managing Windows Server and Windows-based build, test, and application environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere, ESXi, virtual machines, templates, and automated environment provisioning. 
 - Understanding and practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform.

 - Working knowledge of networking, storage, backup, server infrastructure, and related enterprise platform technologies.

 - Experience using APIs and modern automation techniques to integrate development, testing, infrastructure, and operational systems. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted development tools, coding assistants, and agent-based engineering workflows. .

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven features. Drive end-to-end ownership-from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release-while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast-paced Agile environment. 
 - Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures. 
 - Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long-term product strategy and technical roadmaps. 
 - Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine-tuning models, deploying pre-trained models, and evaluating their performance. 
 - Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content. 
 - Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms. 
 - Create sophisticated prompts and fine-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses. 
 - Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e. g. , Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems. 
 - Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI-driven capabilities into customer-facing products and internal tools. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company's offerings. 
 - Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

We'd Love For You To Have

- 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles - transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning. 
 - Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, multi-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short-term and long-term). 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs). 
 - In-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus. 
 - Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails - tools like Langfuse or equivalent - to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems. 
 - Proficiency in prompt engineering - crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context-sensitive, domain-specific LLM outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers. 
 - Experience with data preprocessing, vectorization, and handling large-scale datasets. 
 - Ability to present complex technical ideas and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience in building AI agents using graph-based architectures, including knowledge graph embeddings and graph neural networks (GNNs). 
 - Experience with training small base models using custom data, including data collection, pre-processing, and fine-tuning models to specific domains or tasks. 
 - Familiarity with deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, or ad auction mechanics. 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-integration standards
 - Publication or contributions to research in AI, LLMs, or related fields. 

Qualification

Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!. 

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

data.description:
P-1408

The Mission

We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization's data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight. 

The Role

- As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company. 
 - You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users": 
 - The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren't trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions. 
 - The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces. 

The Technical Challenge

This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form: 

- Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent). 
 - Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context. 
 - High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality. 
 - Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics. 

Why This is the Place to Be

- You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let's talk. 

What We're Looking For

- The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms. 
 - The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K). 
 - The Bridge Builder: You're excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Who We Are: 

MoxiWorks is the leading real estate AI marketing platform built by real estate pros, for real estate pros. Our AI-powered system helps brokerages and their agents find, win, and close more deals. 

Drawing on decades of industry expertise, we build tools that remove complexity and let real estate professionals focus on what matters most. Our newest innovation, RISE, is a native-AI sales and marketing tool designed to help agents stay ahead in an increasingly competitive landscape. 

At MoxiWorks, you'll find a team of innovators, collaborators, and doers who care deeply about our customers, our craft, and each other. If you're excited by meaningful work, big ideas, and building technology that empowers people, you'll fit right in. 

Our Pune team plays a critical role in delivering these innovations. As part of our global engineering and technology organization, you'll collaborate with talented colleagues across the United States and India to build products used by more than 3, 000 brokerages and 400, 000 real estate professionals worldwide. 

If you're passionate about solving meaningful problems, building high-quality software, and working in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment, we'd love to have you on our team.

- Customer First
 - Innovative
 - Passionate
 - Sense of Urgency
 - Accountable & Reliable
 - Relentless Execution

Join MoxiWorks in Pune and help shape the future of PropTech while growing your career with a global team committed to innovation, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes. 

Your Next Opportunity: 

Job Overview: 

We are hiring an Engineering Team Lead to lead a small team of engineers in Pune building the MoxiWorks / ActivePipe platform - a Ruby on Rails service plus PHP integrations and Kafka-driven ETL pipelines that ingest millions of MLS, contact, and identity records every day. You will set technical direction, raise the engineering bar, stay hands-on to write code and review designs on the highest-leverage parts of the system. 

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Global engineering leadership, and adjacent MoxiWorks teams to translate roadmap into well-scoped engineering work that thousands of brokerages depend on every day. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the architecture and technical direction of the ActivePipe Ruby on Rails platform, ETL pipelines, and PHP integration services. 
 - Drive design reviews and RFCs on Kafka topology, ETL idempotency, GraphQL evolution, and cross-product data contracts. 
 - Stay hands-on - contribute code, review the hard PRs, and debug the gnarly incidents (roughly 30-40% of your time). 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards: RSpec coverage, Rubocop, observability via Datadog, deployment hygiene via Buildkite, and on-call quality. 
 - Coach mid-level engineers into seniors and seniors into staff-track contributors; run a healthy interview loop and onboarding plan. 
 - Run sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and quarterly OKR planning aligned with MoxiWorks engineering rituals. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, and Platform stakeholders to translate roadmap into well-scoped engineering work; own delivery commitments - estimation accuracy, scope discipline, and on-time releases. 
 - Represent ActivePipe Engineering in cross-team initiatives across the broader MoxiWorks technology org and in collaborations with global engineering leadership. 
 - Drive incident response and post-incident learning; own the on-call posture and reliability of the platform. 

Required Skills

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years leading a team of 3+ engineers (tech lead, or staff engineer with people leverage). 
 - Deep Ruby on Rails background - you have shipped, scaled, and rescued non-trivial Rails systems in production. 
 - Strong systems thinking - distributed systems, event-driven architecture, ETL / data pipelines, and SQL at scale. 
 - Hands-on Kafka (or equivalent streaming platform) and Sidekiq (or equivalent background processing). 
 - Solid experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a strong plus. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL), including schema design, indexing, query optimization, and migration safety at scale. 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers, conducting fair code reviews, and running healthy hiring loops. 
 - Excellent written communication - design docs, PR descriptions, incident write-ups, and clear async updates with global teammates. 
 - Comfortable operating in a multi-team, cross-product organization with stakeholders in multiple time zones. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

- Real estate, MLS, CRM, MarTech, or other high-volume data-driven SaaS domain experience. 
 - Familiarity with real estate data standards (RESO Data Dictionary, RESO Web API, RETS). 
 - GraphQL schema stewardship across multiple consumers; exposure to schema federation. 
 - AWS infrastructure literacy - ability to read Terraform, debug an ECS deployment, or reason about RDS performance. 
 - Prior experience contributing to or owning observability and SRE practices (Datadog, on-call rotations, SLOs). 
 - Experience leading a polyglot team - specifically Ruby + PHP, or Ruby + JVM/Go. 

Tech Stack

Ruby on Rails, PHP, REST and GraphQL APIs, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, Sidekiq, Karafka / Kafka, AWS, Docker, Git/GitHub, Buildkite, Datadog, Protobuf, and a growing set of internal tooling for building, monitoring, and operating the platform at scale. 

Growth Opportunities

- Work on scalable, SaaS products with real-world impact on thousands of users. 
 - Gain hands-on experience with modern technologies, architecture, and best engineering practices. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Design, and Customer Success. 
 - Continuous learning through mentorship, feedback cycles, and access to learning resources. 

Moxians Are Covered: 

All benefits are subject to review on an annual basis whereas we continuously assess our total reward proposition aligning with the needs of our people, our business and the market. Benefits are effective on 1st day of employment

Your Benefits at a Glance - Designed to support your health, wellbeing, and peace of mind

- Medical insurance for employees and family, including parents/in-laws
 - Accident coverage for employees
 - EAP powered by Living App

 - Indoor games and team engagement

data.description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI and DevOps

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. To build, maintain and operate this software, engineers are essential to us. 

SimCorp's AI & Insights area is building the foundation for the agentic future of investment operations: Running SimCorp agents, leveraging partner agents, and integrating with clients workflows. The AI Platform team owns that foundation: a compliant, standardized, secure, and user-friendly agentic ecosystem that domain teams can leverage when building their AI features. 

The team's recent deliveries and current focus include preparing Agent Orchestrator and SimCorp One Neo for production, publishing the Agent Development Stack, implementing evaluation, trust, safety and guardrails, progressing multi-agent orchestration, and exploring MCP for SimCorp One APIs. 

You will be working with a team located in Noida/Hyderabad in India and Copenhagen, Denmark. The Product Development team functions as a center of enablement for artificial intelligence (AI), providing knowledge and guidelines to other teams, as well as working hands on implementing and operating solutions with AI. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Lead Software Engineer (DevOps) at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for

DevOps best practices and the Azure cloud ecosystem for AI enabled software solutions. This role requires a strong mix of hands-on engineering, architectural thinking, and leadership to ensure both immediate delivery and long-term sustainability. You will be part of a scrum team working closely with Product Owner and business stakeholders. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. 

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it's a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves. 

Daily tasks are for example: 

- Build and maintain Infrastructure, CI/CD process and monitoring for AI solutions developed using C#, . Net and Azure. 
 - Going from proof-of-concepts to high quality, production ready solutions. 
 - Lead the design and development of DevOps solutions and infrastructure ensuring they meet business needs and technical requirements
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
 - Collaborate with product management, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high-quality solutions that are scalable, reliable, and performant
 - Ensure adherence to Devops best practices, including industry standards, testing, and documentation
 - Take ownership of key features and components, driving their design and implementation from concept to delivery
 - Continuously assess and improve engineering processes, AI advancements, automation, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality
 - Participate in code reviews, ensuring that the team follows best practices and maintains high standards for azure infrastructure and pipelines. 

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with DevOps. 
 - Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, industry best practices and tooling
 - Sound understanding of Azure cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, scalability and architecture
 - Experience deploying solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure Foundry, model versioning & quota mgmt. 
 - Experience with RAG pipelines (Azure AI Search, embedding pipelines, indexing jobs)
 - Exposure to Agentic frameworks (MAF, MCP/A2A plugins, etc)
 - Observability design (App Insights/Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry) and incident response
 - Good understanding of Managed Identity first, Key Vault integration, secure network boundaries, Azure Policy, RBAC, networking, private endpoints
 - Solid experience of Azure Bicep, PowerShell scripts and Yaml for IaC. 
 - Understanding of data governance (PII, tenant isolation) for AI workloads

As a person, you have the following traits: 

- Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks. 
 - Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks. 
 - You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals. 
 - Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is. 
 - Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset. 
 - Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
 - Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
 - Excellent English verbal and communication skills

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process.
