At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

The Manager, Data Storage Platforms is responsible for leading a team of platform engineers overseeing the planning, the build, and the operations of data platforms. They will be responsible for architecting, engineering, and optimizing large‐scale, cloud‐native data platforms on AWS and Azure. This role leads development of event‐driven data architectures, CDC frameworks, data lake ingestion pipelines, and scalable ETL/ELT processes. The architect partners closely with cross‐functional teams, leads technical delivery, ensures operational excellence, and provides hands‐on support for global data transformation initiatives. They will be a part of the Data Services Platforms team and provide technological and process expertise and support the global domain data product delivery teams. They will provide leadership by assisting business partners in identifying and responding to opportunities for cost-effective data implementations and solutions by analyzing and making decisions that have cross functional business impact. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of data platform engineers
 - Accountable for strategic planning and technical roadmap development for data platforms. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of data engineering pipelines in a multi-cloud environment, including integrations with a variety of data sources (including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data)
 - Collaborate with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams and other stakeholders in Architecture, Data Integration, DevOps, and Data Governance to deliver data platform initiatives
 - Ensure data engineering standards align with industry best practices for data governance, data quality, and data security. 
 - Monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, ensuring they meet SLAs for data availability and quality. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to improve data engineering processes and outcomes, in collaboration with the Domain Data Product Delivery teams. 
 - Effectively communicate and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and patient needs. 
 - Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement. 
 - Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners. 
 - Manage datasets using Apache Hudi (version 0. 11. x and higher), focusing on supporting near real-time data processing and incremental data loading utilizing cutting-edge features for more efficient data lake management and complex data transformation pipelines
 - Implement the latest versions of Terraform (0. 12. x and higher) to efficiently handle infrastructure changes and versioning with enhanced security and flexibility

Key Experiences & Attributes

- Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or relevant subject area
 - Minimum 5+ years of progressive technical experience in one or more of the cloud-based data warehouse/data lake platforms such as AWS S3, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse. 
 - Significant experience in leading teams in Data & Analytics programs with experience in native digital technologies (cloud, big data and predictive) in organizations driving product development. 
 - Change Agent - Catalyst for the teams and expected to lead the transformation to a fail-fast-learn-fast culture enabling continual improvement. 
 - Servant Leader - Able to gain respect from their team and willing to get their hands dirty to get the job done. 
 - Courageous - Able to effectively challenge and influence peers and teams, leading them through difficult or uncertain situations. 
 - Significant experience working in a global matrix environment. 
 - Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills. 
 - Strong knowledge of business process flow and/or entity relationship modeling. 
 - Demonstrated outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with other technology teams as well as business partners. Ability to effectively present information, interact with, and respond to questions from managers, employees, customers, and vendors
 - Experience in applying best practices to ELT/ETL data transformation from variety of data sources to AWS and other data warehouse platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse etc. 

Required Technical Skills

- AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python)
 - AWS Glue (ETL, Catalog, Crawlers, Job Bookmarks)
 - AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, EventBridge
 - Amazon Kinesis, Route 53, S3 (events, triggers)
 - Terraform (0. 12+)
 - Apache Hudi (0. 11+) and CDC methodologies
 - AWS DMS
 - Apache Spark (2. 4+) and PySpark
 - Amazon EMR (5. x+)
 - Python (3. 6+) for automation and pipeline development
 - IBM DataStage (for supplemental ETL workflows)
 - Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Synapse

Reasonable Accommodation

Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

Vantive has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Vantive employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.title: Platform Engineer
data.description:
Note: Looking for immediate joiners. 

Location options: Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad

Mandatory Tech Stack Experience: 

- AWS Bedrock
 - Agentcore
 - Python
 - LLM

Role Overview

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) works directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end to end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment. 

The role combines the technical rigor of a software engineer with the urgency and ownership needed to deliver measurable business outcomes. FDEs also create reusable architectures, patterns and engineering practices that help the wider FDE practice scale. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embed with customer engineering teams: Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture and operational constraints. Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable, AI-enabled production systems. 
 - Build production AI applications: Design and develop production-grade software for AI and agentic workflows, including multi-agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation and decision intelligence. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost and security. 
 - Own production: Take systems from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. Troubleshoot incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale. 
 - Accelerate customer transformation: Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Build reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures for future engagements. 
 - Raise the bar: Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Feed reusable components and learnings back into products and services. 

Core technical skills (must have): 

Python: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems. 

Agentic AI on AWS:   Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, including prompt engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration with a framework (e. g. Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain). 

RAG & retrieval: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e. g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector). 

Core AWS services: Working knowledge of serverless and container services, storage, security and networking on AWS (e. g. Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, IAM). 

Production engineering: Taking AI systems to production: CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, evaluations and guardrails for AI output. 

Good to have: 

- Infrastructure as code (e. g. Terraform, AWS CDK) and containers (Docker). 
 - LLM evaluation and tracing tools (e. g. Bedrock Guardrails, RAGAS, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry). 
 - MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns, or other frameworks such as CrewAI or LlamaIndex. 
 - API frameworks such as FastAPI, SQL, and event-driven services (e. g. Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge). 
 - A second language such as TypeScript/Node. js or Java. 
 - Amazon SageMaker, and model fine-tuning or customization on Bedrock. 
 - Experience in regulated industries (banking, capital markets, insurance): security reviews, audit and data-residency controls. 
 - AWS certifications: AI Practitioner, Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, Solutions Architect - Associate/Professional, or Generative AI Developer - Professional. 

Basic qualifications: 

- 5+ years of professional software development experience (excluding internships). 
 - 5+ years of programming in at least one software programming language. 
 - 5+ years leading design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability and scaling). 
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience building production AI or ML applications, including agentic workflows. 
 - 5+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working in customer-facing environments.

About The Hub

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 

ROLE PURPOSE

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 

Key Responsibilities

- Transition and shared services set-up
 - Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. 
 - Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. 
 - Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. 
 - Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 
 - Process ownership and service delivery
 - Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. 
 - Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. 
 - Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. 
 - Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 
 - Governance, risk and controls
 - Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. 
 - Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. 
 - Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 
 - Continuous improvement and digital
 - Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. 
 - Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. 
 - Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. 
 - Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas.

 - Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. 
 - Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. 
 - Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. 
 - Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.

Indicative target

Increased year on year

100% on schedule

At or above target

Audit and quality findings

Closed within agreed timelines

CI participation

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

Customer-centric leadership

Essential

Preferred

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO. 

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter. 

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can. 

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria. 

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails. 

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls). 

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one. 

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents. 

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers. 

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework. 

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud. 

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal. 

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders. 

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails. 

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services. 

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling. 

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications. 

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents. 

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team - the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1. 5 billion risk calculations every day. 

As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core - providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale. 

Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability. 

You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform. 

Responsibilities

Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team: 

Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards. 

Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work: 

Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning. 

Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250, 000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.

 - Review and strengthen SOPs, operating discipline, shift handover practices, daily management systems, and production reporting mechanisms.

Safety, Health and Environment

- Drive a zero-harm and LTI-free culture across the plant by implementing robust safety systems, behavior-based safety practices, and regular shopfloor engagement.

Quality, Metallurgy & Process Excellence

data.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: 

Garmin is searching for a talented and passionate Java Software Engineer to join our team of code enthusiasts! You are self-motivated, goal-oriented and strong team player who is willing to be an active contributor to the success of the team, providing technical solutions and support in a dynamic and highly performing environment. We offer you the chance to join a team of software professionals who all work together to achieve the best results for our customers. You'll be working in a dynamic and agile environment surrounded by people with a pioneering spirit and passion for challenges. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: 

We're looking for strong technologists who enjoy working on cross-functional teams and are passionate about what they do. Some responsibilities are: 

- Developing API's, which are scalable, supportable, and reliable that service the entire Garmin ecosystem. 
 - Participating in the full lifecycle of development from conception, analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment.

data.title: Senior ASIC Verification Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a passionate, highly motivated, and creative software engineer to be part of its CPU Infrastructure team. We develop methodologies and craft tools to streamline the design/verification of NVIDIA's CPU and SOC designs. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have created a team of outstanding people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. Come, join us today!

What You'll Be Doing

- Set up scalable verification flows for large IP's that caters to multiple projects and variants. 
 - Improve continuous integration processes across multiple branches for various IP versions and projects. 
 - Continuous improvement of the speed of build and simulation flows. 
 - Set up automated metrics and dashboards to monitor health of the infrastructure flows and resources. 
 - Set up processes to identify suboptimal areas, and help in improving verification efficiency for the large team of HW engineers. 
 - Remove inefficiency wherever you can find it!
 - Architect and develop tools, user interfaces, and reports for chip development, data visualization, resource management, etc. 
 - Analyze performance bottlenecks, improve data analytics and visualizations of day to day workflows
 - Debug interesting, complex, and important problems that impact the team

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. / M. Tech or equivalent experience with 5+ years of relevant experience
 - Experience with Linux shell scripting, Makeppfiles, and Perl/Python or equivalent
 - Background with ASIC EDA tool flows, simulators, waveform debug tools, and equivalent
 - Experience with LSF, compute farms, filers, and networks
 - Experience with setup, configuration, and maintenance of Jenkins build servers
 - Background with Web development (HTML/JavaScript/REST) and databases

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- A desire to constantly grow and learn new things. In this team you will constantly be exposed to new technologies and new problems. Your ability to assimilate new ideas and handle tough problems as they arise will be the key to your success. 
 - Exposure to RTL design/verification tools (VCS or equivalent simulation tools, debug tools like Verdi) and computer architecture
 - Exposure to source control systems (Perforce/Git) and continuous integration systems (Jenkins)

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you.

data.description:
Company Description Guru Education India Pvt Ltd is dedicated to transforming the Indian education landscape through learner-centric and customized teaching approaches. Led by visionary educationist Mahendra Giri, the organization focuses on nurturing a lifelong love for learning in each student. data.title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)
data.description:
Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)

Company Overview

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony's risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony's Second Line of Defense. 

Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges. 

Role Summary/ Purpose

The eGRC Solution Architect is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that automate, standardize, and integrate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deliver GRC solutions: Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions. 
 - Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions . 
 - Lead technical implementations : Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms. 
 - Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation. 
 - Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
 - Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e. g. , RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives . 
 - GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 . 
 - Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements. 
 - Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Architectural and technical skills: Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines. 
 - Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

Work Timings: 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST

We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. 

Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events. 

For Internal Applicants

- Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying. 
 - Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday. 
 - Ensure that your Professional Profile is updated (fields such as Education, Prior experience, Other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format) 
 - Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal LPP)
 - L10+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible. 
 - L10+ Employees can apply

Grade/Level: 12

Job Family Group

Risk Management

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS - AI Automation Engineer - Senior, Technology Consulting

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

About the Role: 

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer - Senior to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI automation solutions for global clients. This role emphasizes deep hands-on engineering expertise, focusing on optimizing AI systems, improving model performance, and delivering scalable, production-ready AI-enabled automation. 

You will work under architect guidance while owning key solution components, leading small workstreams, and delivering high-impact AI solutions across consulting engagements. The role requires a strong blend of software engineering, applied AI, optimization techniques, and secure development practices. 

The ideal candidate demonstrates the ability to independently implement and optimize AI-driven systems, contribute to reusable accelerators, and mentor junior engineers while operating in a client-facing consulting environment. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and optimize AI-driven automation solutions using LLMs, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms. 
 - Own and deliver end-to-end implementation of solution components, including integration into enterprise systems and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Optimize AI systems across dimensions such as latency, cost, accuracy, and scalability (e. g. , caching, batching, prompt optimization). 
 - Develop and enhance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, re-ranking, and embeddings optimization. 
 - Implement and optimize fine-tuning strategies, including dataset preparation, prompt tuning, and model evaluation workflows. 
 - Build and productionize agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents. 
 - Develop automated evaluation frameworks, benchmarking pipelines, and model performance metrics. 
 - Contribute to AI harness frameworks, reusable accelerators, and enterprise AI development standards. 
 - Lead small workstreams, client discussions, demos, and proof-of-concept (POC) implementations. 
 - Mentor and review work of junior AI Automation Engineers, ensuring engineering quality and best practices. 
 - Collaborate closely with architects to translate high-level designs into scalable implementations. 
 - Ensure adherence to secure coding, DevSecOps, and AI security best practices. 

Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred): 

- Application Security: 
 - Secure coding practices, SAST/DAST, DevSecOps integration, CI/CD pipeline automation
 - API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management, secure SDLC
 - Offensive Security: 
 - Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, adversarial testing
 - Exposure to AI/LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and model misuse
Technical Skills and Expertise: 

- Programming: Strong proficiency in Python; exposure to JavaScript, TypeScript, or other languages
 - AI/LLM Tools: OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, and similar developer tools
 - AI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents
 - Cloud Platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP
 - AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
 - Vector Databases: Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search, Weaviate, or equivalent
 - Observability & Evaluation: LangSmith, PromptLayer, Azure Monitor, or equivalent tools
 - DevOps & CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar
 - Prototyping Tools: Replit, notebooks, rapid experimentation frameworks
 - Core Concepts: RAG optimization, prompt engineering, embeddings, model fine-tuning (LoRA/basic), evaluation frameworks, agentic workflows

Soft Skills and Attributes: 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
 - Ability to lead small teams and guide junior engineers
 - Effective communication and client interaction skills
 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments
 - Strong ownership mindset and focus on delivery excellence

Performance Expectations / KPIs: 

- Improvement in model performance metrics (accuracy, relevance, hallucination reduction)
 - Optimization of inference cost and latency
 - Number and impact of AI automation use cases delivered
 - Contribution to reusable assets, frameworks, and accelerators
 - Quality of mentoring and team capability uplift

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
 - 4-8 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or automation engineering
 - Strong hands-on experience in implementing and optimizing AI/LLM-based solutions
 - Experience working in client-facing consulting environments

Relevant certifications (preferred): 

- Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate
 - AWS Machine Learning Specialty
 - Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

What We Offer: 

- Opportunity to work on advanced AI engineering and optimization use cases
 - Exposure to global clients and large-scale enterprise AI transformations
 - Continuous learning through innovation programs, certifications, and hands-on delivery
 - Collaborative environment with strong focus on engineering excellence and growth

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
data.description:
ReOrbit is looking for a motivated and detail oriented Software Product Assurance Engineer for Space Systems to join our growing team. 

As our new Software Product Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of software throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle. You will define and evolve software product assurance requirements, adapted to lean and agile development practices, while applying a criticality-based approach where the level of rigour is aligned with the safety and mission impact of each software item. 

You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, AIT, Product Assurance and supplier teams to ensure that software development, verification, configuration management and change control activities meet the required quality and product assurance standards. 

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve software product assurance requirements across the development lifecycle, adapted to lean and agile development practices. 
 - Apply a criticality-based approach to software product assurance, scaling the level of rigour according to the safety and mission impact of the software item. 
 - Develop, implement, monitor and review Software Product Assurance (SW PA) plans. 
 - Oversee and participate in verification and validation (V&V) activities according to defined V&V plans. 
 - Support Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) activities, working with IV&V personnel to mitigate software risks and enhance safety and quality. 
 - Help drive internal and external reviews of development plans and software designs to ensure seamless integration with the satellite system. 
 - Participate in the analysis and evaluation of software designs, including change impact analysis and regression testing, particularly for COTS software. 
 - Support Product Assurance activities across engineering and flight models and associated infrastructure, ensuring documentation and objective evidence are captured consistently. 
 - Contribute to estimating and tracking the expected reliability and availability of the satellite platform as part of Product Assurance reporting. 
 - Support Product Assurance follow-up on supplier discrepancies and defects, ensuring corrective actions are documented and tracked. 
 - Support engineering change control, including understanding the Class I / Class II concept and ensuring the required approvals are obtained. 
 - Be willing to travel to supplier facilities for audits when required. 

Skills And Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace, electronics, information technology, systems engineering and minimum 8 years of work experience in a similar relevant field. 
 - Knowledge of software development processes and lifecycles. 
 - Knowledge of software verification techniques, including testing and inspections. 
 - Knowledge of software configuration management fundamentals and related tools. 
 - Clear conceptual understanding of the difference between proactive Product Assurance and retrospective Quality Control. 
 - Familiarity with non-conformances, deviations, waivers, and corrective/preventive actions, including RCA and CAPA, at a basic level. 
 - Awareness of SW Product Assurance principles and the ECSS/Q Product Assurance philosophy. 
 - Ability to constructively challenge engineering decisions and ask, "What is the risk?"
 - Comfortable working cross-functionally with systems, hardware, software, AIT and suppliers. 
 - Clear and effective technical writing and communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
 - Previous exposure to satellite technologies through an internship, thesis, or student satellite project (e. g. CubeSat, nanosat or payloads), with an understanding of software Product Assurance concepts such as verification matrices, test coverage and configuration management. 
 - Introductory knowledge of risk management and single-point failure identification, with proficiency in C/C++ and Python and familiarity with NASA software assurance standards such as NASA-STD-8739. 8 and NASA-GB-8719. 13. 

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India. 

Working at ReOrbit

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We're all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength. 

We offer

- Challenging but rewarding environment - you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard. 
 - Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space . 
 - Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor. 
 - We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking - runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion. 

Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications

About the Role

Job Purpose: 

The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 

Responsibilities

- The Senior Software Test Engineer role ensures delivery of high‐quality, reliable, and secure software by leading comprehensive testing across distributed, microservices‐based applications. 
 - It involves designing and executing test cases, supporting automation frameworks, and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines to validate functionality, performance, and scalability. 
 - By collaborating with cross‐functional teams, identifying and documenting issues, and driving continuous improvement, the role enhances product stability and accelerates delivery cycles. 
 - As per company policy, this role requires presence in the office 4 days per week. 

Duties: 

- Test Case Development & Execution: Collaborate with senior engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test cases that align with project requirements, ensuring thorough testing of software functionality, performance, and security. 
 - Automation Support: Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts and frameworks. Assist in enhancing test automation coverage for both system-level and front-end applications. 
 - Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify, track, and document software defects, functionality issues, and performance problems, working closely with developers to reproduce, debug, and resolve issues. 
 - Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and senior testers, to ensure alignment on testing goals and priorities. Communicate findings and progress effectively. 
 - Test Reporting & Metrics: Contribute to the preparation of test reports and track key testing metrics to assess test coverage, defect resolution, and overall testing progress. 
 - Support in Test Planning: Participate in test planning activities, contributing to discussions about scope, approach, and strategy for different types of testing, such as functional, regression, and integration testing. 
 - Version Control & Configuration Management: Utilize version control systems (e. g. , Git, Subversion) for maintaining test scripts, test cases, and related artifacts. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Assist in integrating test scripts into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure that automated tests are executed as part of the development process. 
 - Manual Testing: Conduct manual testing where required, especially in areas that are difficult to automate or require more exploratory testing to identify edge cases. 
 - Collaboration on Automation Strategy: Support senior engineers by contributing ideas and improvements to the automation strategy, tools, and frameworks used in the testing process. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Provide feedback on testing processes and practices, suggesting improvements and applying lessons learned from past testing cycles to enhance efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 

Required Skills

- 4-7 years of hands‐on experience testing distributed, microservices‐based applications, including test strategy definition, design, execution, and maintenance. 
 - Strong expertise in automated testing frameworks such as Robot Framework and Python for service‐level and end‐to‐end testing across backend and consumer‐facing applications. 
 - Proficiency in API testing (RESTful services), including contract validation, payload verification, error handling, and service dependency checks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with containerisation technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes), including deployment validation and scalability testing. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms and their deployment models. 
 - Experience supporting applications deployed via CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Bitbucket) with understanding of microservices promotion across environments. 
 - Proficiency with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), test management tools (TestRail), and version control systems (Git). 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, microservices concepts, and test methodologies with ability to collaborate across development, DevOps, and testing teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to write clear test cases, maintain accurate documentation, and track quality metrics in fast‐moving environments. 

Preferred Skills

- Broader exposure to advanced automation strategies or scripting for test environments. 
 - Certifications in testing frameworks, cloud technologies, or DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with performance testing and monitoring tools. 
 - Familiarity with security testing or compliance validation in microservices architectures. 
 - Resourceful with strong analytical and communication skills at all organisational levels. 
 - Self-starter with excellent time management, attention to detail, and initiative. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and cross-cultural teams.

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Manager
data.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior, hands-on mechanical engineering leader to manage the engineering team and own final technical quality control across our engineering workstreams. These include CAD and engineering design data, simulation load cases, and reviews of FEA and CFD work used in AI development. 

You will assess whether deliverables are technically sound, supported by evidence, and ready for client delivery. The role combines broad engineering judgment with detailed technical review, guidance for engineers and external partners, and ownership of consistent quality standards as delivery scales. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own final technical review and sign-off across workstreams; identify critical issues, request corrections, and verify their resolution before delivery. 

• Review CAD models, assemblies, drawings, design changes, and engineering rationale for functional validity, consistency, and manufacturability. 

• Evaluate FEA and CFD simulation assumptions, material properties, loads, boundary conditions, mesh quality, results, and relevant modelling choices; assess convergence, physical plausibility, and whether conclusions are supported. 

• Review load-case definitions and engineering workflows for realistic use scenarios, clear documentation, and traceability between requirements, models, and outputs. 

• Define acceptance criteria and review checklists, resolve technical disagreements, and involve specialist reviewers where deeper domain expertise is needed. 

• Manage and mentor engineers, assess vendor and freelancer capability, and improve review processes to increase throughput while maintaining quality. 

• Communicate directly with customers to clarify technical requirements, discuss review findings, and explain risks and limitations; align with project leads on delivery readiness. 

REQUIREMENTS

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
data.description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. 

NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team's transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. 
 - Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. 
 - Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. 
 - Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. 
 - Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. 

What We Need To See

- Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 
 - 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 - Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. 
 - High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team's traditional capacity. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. 
 - Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. 
 - Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. 

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

AI Business Solutions -AI Engineer Senior Manager: 

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager - AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions. . 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks. 
 - Drive enterprise-wide adoption of intelligent agents built using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#). 
 - Define architecture standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Mentor team members and ensure high-quality delivery across AI initiatives. 
 - Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. 
 - Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#). 
 - Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem. 
 - Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows. 
 - Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components. 
 - Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards. 
 - Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore-offshore delivery models. 

Ideally, you'll also

The following skills are preferred and add value to the role: 

- Experience with Power Platform. 
 - Experience with Azure Integration Services. 
 - Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
 - Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
 - Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

What We Look For

- Total Experience: [12+ Years]
 - Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
 - Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements. 
 - Degree in BE / B. Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience. 
 - Microsoft AI certification is preferred. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 

Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 

People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 

Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 

How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Director, Full-Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees' growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world's investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. 

Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance - and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. 

We're seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Full-stack Engineer in our Custody Enterprise platform. The role is based in Pune. 

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

- Lead the vision, architecture, and delivery of BNY's next-generation Corporate Actions Processing Engine, a strategic greenfield platform critical to the firm's future operations. 
 - Drive the end-to-end design and development of a scalable, resilient, and high-performance processing engine that transforms Corporate Actions capabilities across the enterprise. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership while establishing architectural standards, engineering best practices, and modern development frameworks. 
 - Influence the long-term technology strategy and roadmap for a mission-critical platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise architecture. 
 - Partner with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and operational excellence. 
 - Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Accelerate modernization efforts by leveraging emerging technologies and engineering patterns to enhance platform capabilities and future readiness. 

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following: 

Technical Skills

- 15+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in leadership roles (e. g. Head of Engineering, Technical Lead) 
 - Expert-level proficiency in Java and frameworks like Spring Boot for building microservices 
 - Strong expertise with relational databases (Oracle) and data modelling expertise (canonical data models, JSON) 
 - Deep experience with enterprise messaging platforms (Kafka, IBM MQ) 
 - Proven experience implementing AI/ML solutions ( using Python or other frameworks) to solve business problems 
 - Full-stack development experience (RESTful APIs, front-end frameworks such as Angular) 
 - Experience with Cloud and Containerization technologies 
 - CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automated testing frameworks

Domain Expertise

- Significant experience in financial services, specifically: 
 - Post-trade processing and settlement 
 - Custody and asset servicing operations 
 - Corporate actions lifecycle (dividends, stock splits, mergers, tender offers, etc. ) 
 - Proven track record delivering mission-critical systems in banking environments 
Leadership & Delivery

- Demonstrated success leading engineering teams through complex, multi-year transformation programs 
 - Strong Agile/Scrum methodology experience 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills at senior levels 
 - Ability to operate in a matrixed, global organization

data.title: Staff Cloud Infra Engineer
data.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it. 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started. 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible. 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places. 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. 

About The Role

You'll own a significant area of our cloud platform end to end - the Kubernetes and IaC foundations, the reliability of what runs on them, or the security controls that wrap them - across cloud regions and out to edge sites co-located with our satellite gateways. 

At Staff level we expect you to take a problem that's stated loosely, turn it into a plan, and deliver it without close supervision. You'll write the design doc, get it reviewed, build the thing, and then operate it. You're not expected to set direction for the whole org - but you are expected to shape it for your area, and to be the person others come to when that area is on fire. This is a hands-on role. The majority of your week is building. 

What you'll own

Platform and Kubernetes

- Operate and improve our multi-cluster, multi-region Kubernetes platform: cluster lifecycle, upgrades, workload isolation, networking, and resource management. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure as code as a real engineering artifact - reviewed, tested, versioned, no manual drift. 
 - Extend our developer platform so shipping a service is fast and boring: golden paths, progressive delivery, environments that don't require a ticket. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines for workloads ranging from ordinary stateless services to network functions with strict latency and availability requirements. 

Reliability and observability

- Instrument services against SLOs and build out the metrics, logs, and tracing needed to know whether we're meeting them. 
 - Participate in on-call, lead incidents in your area, and write postmortems that produce real changes rather than filed documents. 
 - Tune alerting so engineers trust it. Drive down toil through automation, deliberately and measurably. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, failure-domain design, and DR testing for a network that can't take a casual maintenance window. 

Security and compliance infrastructure

- Implement and maintain platform security controls: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, image scanning, and supply-chain integrity. 
 - Automate the evidence that compliance requires, so audits are a query rather than a project. 
 - Work with Security on the requirements that come with operating inside a carrier's network. 

Technical contribution

- Write design docs for the systems you own and take them through review. 
 - Review code and infrastructure changes with an eye on operability, not just correctness. 
 - Mentor mid-level engineers and improve the team's practices by demonstrating them. 

What we're looking for

Required

- 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE roles, with clear ownership of production systems that mattered. 
 - Strong production Kubernetes experience - not just deploying to it, but operating it: upgrades, networking, resource limits, and debugging failures that aren't in the documentation. 
 - Hands-on depth in AWS or GCP. Exposure to a second cloud, or to hybrid and edge infrastructure, is a real plus - our footprint isn't uniform and we need people who don't stall when the environment gets irregular. 
 - Solid infrastructure as code practice (Terraform or equivalent), applied where discipline actually mattered. 
 - Proficiency in at least one systems or automation language - Go or Python preferred - enough to build tooling, not only scripts. 
 - Direct production reliability ownership: you've carried a pager for something important, run incidents, and changed systems as a result. 
 - Working knowledge of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets, network policy, container hardening. 
 - Clear written communication. Design docs and postmortems are core to how this team works. 

Strongly Preferred

- Telecom or network infrastructure exposure - 5G core, cloud-native network functions, or carrier-grade availability requirements. 
 - Have some experience in managing databases and applications with High Availability of 99. 999%. 
 - Edge or on-premises infrastructure alongside public cloud, particularly sites with constrained connectivity. 
 - Compliance-adjacent environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or carrier security requirements). 
 - FinOps Cost engineering - you've meaningfully reduced cloud spend without degrading reliability. 
 - Working across distributed teams and time zones. 

What This Role Is Not

- Not a people-management role. This is an IC position and we intend to keep it one. 
 - Not a ticket queue. You'll be given problems, not tasks, and we expect you to scope them yourself. 
 - Not a greenfield rewrite. You'll be improving a system already carrying live traffic, which is harder and more interesting. 

Why this role is worth your time

Satellite direct-to-device is a genuinely new category, and the infrastructure patterns for it are not settled. The team is small enough that what you build is in production within weeks and visibly yours. If you're strong technically and looking for scope that would take years to get at a larger company, that's the trade we're offering. 

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as: 

- Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
 - Comprehensive benefits plans
 - Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
 - A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
 - Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be part of developing and running the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
 - Access to a world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
 - Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

EEO Statement

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.
